ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Moses added, “If you along with everyone on earth were to be ungrateful, then ˹know that˺ Allah is indeed Self-Sufficient, Praiseworthy.”

ayahs.textArabic: أَلَمۡ يَأۡتِكُمۡ نَبَؤُاْ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِكُمۡ قَوۡمِ نُوحٖ وَعَادٖ وَثَمُودَ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُهُمۡ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُۚ جَآءَتۡهُمۡ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ فَرَدُّوٓاْ أَيۡدِيَهُمۡ فِيٓ أَفۡوَٰهِهِمۡ وَقَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا كَفَرۡنَا بِمَآ أُرۡسِلۡتُم بِهِۦ وَإِنَّا لَفِي شَكّٖ مِّمَّا تَدۡعُونَنَآ إِلَيۡهِ مُرِيبٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Alam yatikum nabao allatheena min qablikum qawmi noohin waAAadin wathamooda waallatheena min baAAdihim la yaAAlamuhum illa Allahu jaathum rusuluhum bialbayyinati faraddoo aydiyahum fee afwahihim waqaloo inna kafarna bima orsiltum bihi wainna lafee shakkin mimma tadAAoonana ilayhi mureebun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Has there not reached you the news of those before you - the people of Noah and 'Aad and Thamud and those after them? No one knows them but Allah. Their messengers brought them clear proofs, but they returned their hands to their mouths and said, "Indeed, we disbelieve in that with which you have been sent, and indeed we are, about that to which you invite us, in disquieting doubt."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Have you not ˹already˺ received the stories of those who were before you: the people of Noah, ’Âd, Thamûd, and those after them? Only Allah knows how many they were. Their messengers came to them with clear proofs, but they put their hands over their mouths and said, “We totally reject what you have been sent with, and we are certainly in alarming doubt about what you are inviting us to.”

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ قَالَتۡ رُسُلُهُمۡ أَفِي ٱللَّهِ شَكّٞ فَاطِرِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ يَدۡعُوكُمۡ لِيَغۡفِرَ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمۡ وَيُؤَخِّرَكُمۡ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٖ مُّسَمّٗىۚ قَالُوٓاْ إِنۡ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا بَشَرٞ مِّثۡلُنَا تُرِيدُونَ أَن تَصُدُّونَا عَمَّا كَانَ يَعۡبُدُ ءَابَآؤُنَا فَأۡتُونَا بِسُلۡطَٰنٖ مُّبِينٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qalat rusuluhum afee Allahi shakkun fatiri alssamawati waalardi yadAAookum liyaghfira lakum min thunoobikum wayuakhkhirakum ila ajalin musamman qaloo in antum illa basharun mithluna tureedoona an tasuddoona AAamma kana yaAAbudu abaona fatoona bisultanin mubeenin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Their messengers said, "Can there be doubt about Allah, Creator of the heavens and earth? He invites you that He may forgive you of your sins, and He delays your death for a specified term." They said, "You are not but men like us who wish to avert us from what our fathers were worshipping. So bring us a clear authority."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Their messengers asked ˹them˺, “Is there any doubt about Allah, the Originator of the heavens and the earth? He is inviting you in order to forgive your sins, and delay your end until your appointed term.” They argued, “You are no more than humans like us! You ˹only˺ wish to turn us away from what our forefathers worshipped. So bring us some compelling proof.”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَتۡ لَهُمۡ رُسُلُهُمۡ إِن نَّحۡنُ إِلَّا بَشَرٞ مِّثۡلُكُمۡ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَمُنُّ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهِۦۖ وَمَا كَانَ لَنَآ أَن نَّأۡتِيَكُم بِسُلۡطَٰنٍ إِلَّا بِإِذۡنِ ٱللَّهِۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلۡيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qalat lahum rusuluhum in nahnu illa basharun mithlukum walakinna Allaha yamunnu AAala man yashao min AAibadihi wama kana lana an natiyakum bisultanin illa biithni Allahi waAAala Allahi falyatawakkali almuminoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Their messengers said to them, "We are only men like you, but Allah confers favor upon whom He wills of His servants. It has never been for us to bring you evidence except by permission of Allah. And upon Allah let the believers rely.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Their messengers said to them, “We are ˹indeed˺ only humans like you, but Allah favours whoever He chooses of His servants. It is not for us to bring you any proof without Allah’s permission. And in Allah let the believers put their trust.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا لَنَآ أَلَّا نَتَوَكَّلَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ وَقَدۡ هَدَىٰنَا سُبُلَنَاۚ وَلَنَصۡبِرَنَّ عَلَىٰ مَآ ءَاذَيۡتُمُونَاۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلۡيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلۡمُتَوَكِّلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama lana alla natawakkala AAala Allahi waqad hadana subulana walanasbiranna AAala ma athaytumoona waAAala Allahi falyatawakkali almutawakkiloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And why should we not rely upon Allah while He has guided us to our [good] ways. And we will surely be patient against whatever harm you should cause us. And upon Allah let those who would rely [indeed] rely."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Why should we not put our trust in Allah, when He has truly guided us to ˹the very best of˺ ways? Indeed, we will patiently endure whatever harm you may cause us. And in Allah let the faithful put their trust.”

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِرُسُلِهِمۡ لَنُخۡرِجَنَّكُم مِّنۡ أَرۡضِنَآ أَوۡ لَتَعُودُنَّ فِي مِلَّتِنَاۖ فَأَوۡحَىٰٓ إِلَيۡهِمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ لَنُهۡلِكَنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waqala allatheena kafaroo lirusulihim lanukhrijannakum min ardina aw lataAAoodunna fee millatina faawha ilayhim rabbuhum lanuhlikanna alththalimeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And those who disbelieved said to their messengers, "We will surely drive you out of our land, or you must return to our religion." So their Lord inspired to them, "We will surely destroy the wrongdoers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The disbelievers then threatened their messengers, “We will certainly expel you from our land, unless you return to our faith.” So their Lord revealed to them, “We will surely destroy the wrongdoers,

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَنُسۡكِنَنَّكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنۡ خَافَ مَقَامِي وَخَافَ وَعِيدِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walanuskinannakumu alarda min baAAdihim thalika liman khafa maqamee wakhafa waAAeedi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We will surely cause you to dwell in the land after them. That is for he who fears My position and fears My threat."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and make you reside in the land after them. This is for whoever is in awe of standing before Me and fears My warning.”

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱسۡتَفۡتَحُواْ وَخَابَ كُلُّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِيدٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waistaftahoo wakhaba kullu jabbarin AAaneedin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And they requested victory from Allah, and disappointed, [therefore], was every obstinate tyrant.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And both sides called for judgment, so every stubborn tyrant was doomed.

ayahs.textArabic: مِّن وَرَآئِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ وَيُسۡقَىٰ مِن مَّآءٖ صَدِيدٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Min waraihi jahannamu wayusqa min main sadeedin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Before him is Hell, and he will be given a drink of purulent water.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Awaiting them is Hell, and they will be left to drink oozing pus,

ayahs.textArabic: يَتَجَرَّعُهُۥ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُسِيغُهُۥ وَيَأۡتِيهِ ٱلۡمَوۡتُ مِن كُلِّ مَكَانٖ وَمَا هُوَ بِمَيِّتٖۖ وَمِن وَرَآئِهِۦ عَذَابٌ غَلِيظٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: YatajarraAAuhu wala yakadu yuseeghuhu wayateehi almawtu min kulli makanin wama huwa bimayyitin wamin waraihi AAathabun ghaleethun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He will gulp it but will hardly [be able to] swallow it. And death will come to him from everywhere, but he is not to die. And before him is a massive punishment.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: which they will sip with difficulty, and can hardly swallow. Death will overwhelm them from every side, yet they will not ˹be able to˺ die. Awaiting them still is harsher torment.

ayahs.textArabic: مَّثَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِرَبِّهِمۡۖ أَعۡمَٰلُهُمۡ كَرَمَادٍ ٱشۡتَدَّتۡ بِهِ ٱلرِّيحُ فِي يَوۡمٍ عَاصِفٖۖ لَّا يَقۡدِرُونَ مِمَّا كَسَبُواْ عَلَىٰ شَيۡءٖۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلضَّلَٰلُ ٱلۡبَعِيدُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Mathalu allatheena kafaroo birabbihim aAAmaluhum karamadin ishtaddat bihi alrreehu fee yawmin AAasifin la yaqdiroona mimma kasaboo AAala shayin thalika huwa alddalalu albaAAeedu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The example of those who disbelieve in their Lord is [that] their deeds are like ashes which the wind blows forcefully on a stormy day; they are unable [to keep] from what they earned a [single] thing. That is what is extreme error.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The parable of the deeds of those who disbelieve in their Lord is that of ashes fiercely blown away by wind on a stormy day. They will gain nothing from what they have earned. That is ˹truly˺ the farthest one can stray.

ayahs.textArabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۚ إِن يَشَأۡ يُذۡهِبۡكُمۡ وَيَأۡتِ بِخَلۡقٖ جَدِيدٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Alam tara anna Allaha khalaqa alssamawati waalarda bialhaqqi in yasha yuthhibkum wayati bikhalqin jadeedin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Have you not seen that Allah created the heavens and the earth in truth? If He wills, He can do away with you and produce a new creation.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Have you not seen that Allah created the heavens and the earth for a reason? If He wills, He can eliminate you and produce a new creation.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ بِعَزِيزٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama thalika AAala Allahi biAAazeezin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And that is not difficult for Allah.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And that is not difficult for Allah ˹at all˺.

ayahs.textArabic: وَبَرَزُواْ لِلَّهِ جَمِيعٗا فَقَالَ ٱلضُّعَفَٰٓؤُاْ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسۡتَكۡبَرُوٓاْ إِنَّا كُنَّا لَكُمۡ تَبَعٗا فَهَلۡ أَنتُم مُّغۡنُونَ عَنَّا مِنۡ عَذَابِ ٱللَّهِ مِن شَيۡءٖۚ قَالُواْ لَوۡ هَدَىٰنَا ٱللَّهُ لَهَدَيۡنَٰكُمۡۖ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡنَآ أَجَزِعۡنَآ أَمۡ صَبَرۡنَا مَا لَنَا مِن مَّحِيصٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wabarazoo lillahi jameeAAan faqala aldduAAafao lillatheena istakbaroo inna kunna lakum tabaAAan fahal antum mughnoona AAanna min AAathabi Allahi min shayin qaloo law hadana Allahu lahadaynakum sawaon AAalayna ajaziAAna am sabarna ma lana min maheesin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And they will come out [for judgement] before Allah all together, and the weak will say to those who were arrogant, "Indeed, we were your followers, so can you avail us anything against the punishment of Allah?" They will say, "If Allah had guided us, we would have guided you. It is all the same for us whether we show intolerance or are patient: there is for us no place of escape."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They will all appear before Allah, and the lowly ˹followers˺ will appeal to the arrogant ˹leaders˺, “We were your ˹dedicated˺ followers, so will you ˹then˺ protect us from Allah’s torment in any way?” They will reply, “Had Allah guided us, we would have guided you. ˹Now˺ it is all the same for us whether we suffer patiently or impatiently, there is no escape for us.”

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ لَمَّا قُضِيَ ٱلۡأَمۡرُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ وَعَدَكُمۡ وَعۡدَ ٱلۡحَقِّ وَوَعَدتُّكُمۡ فَأَخۡلَفۡتُكُمۡۖ وَمَا كَانَ لِيَ عَلَيۡكُم مِّن سُلۡطَٰنٍ إِلَّآ أَن دَعَوۡتُكُمۡ فَٱسۡتَجَبۡتُمۡ لِيۖ فَلَا تَلُومُونِي وَلُومُوٓاْ أَنفُسَكُمۖ مَّآ أَنَا۠ بِمُصۡرِخِكُمۡ وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُصۡرِخِيَّ إِنِّي كَفَرۡتُ بِمَآ أَشۡرَكۡتُمُونِ مِن قَبۡلُۗ إِنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waqala alshshaytanu lamma qudiya alamru inna Allaha waAAadakum waAAda alhaqqi wawaAAadtukum faakhlaftukum wama kana liya AAalaykum min sultanin illa an daAAawtukum faistajabtum lee fala taloomoonee waloomoo anfusakum ma ana bimusrikhikum wama antum bimusrikhiyya innee kafartu bima ashraktumooni min qablu inna alththalimeena lahum AAathabun aleemun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And Satan will say when the matter has been concluded, "Indeed, Allah had promised you the promise of truth. And I promised you, but I betrayed you. But I had no authority over you except that I invited you, and you responded to me. So do not blame me; but blame yourselves. I cannot be called to your aid, nor can you be called to my aid. Indeed, I deny your association of me [with Allah] before. Indeed, for the wrongdoers is a painful punishment."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And Satan will say ˹to his followers˺ after the judgment has been passed, “Indeed, Allah has made you a true promise. I too made you a promise, but I failed you. I did not have any authority over you. I only called you, and you responded to me. So do not blame me; blame yourselves. I cannot save you, nor can you save me. Indeed, I denounce your previous association of me with Allah ˹in loyalty˺. Surely the wrongdoers will suffer a painful punishment.”

ayahs.textArabic: وَأُدۡخِلَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ جَنَّٰتٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا بِإِذۡنِ رَبِّهِمۡۖ تَحِيَّتُهُمۡ فِيهَا سَلَٰمٌ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waodkhila allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha biithni rabbihim tahiyyatuhum feeha salamun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And those who believed and did righteous deeds will be admitted to gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding eternally therein by permission of their Lord; and their greeting therein will be, "Peace!"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Those who believe and do good will be admitted into Gardens, under which rivers flow—to stay there forever by the Will of their Lord—where they will be greeted with “Peace!”

ayahs.textArabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ كَيۡفَ ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلٗا كَلِمَةٗ طَيِّبَةٗ كَشَجَرَةٖ طَيِّبَةٍ أَصۡلُهَا ثَابِتٞ وَفَرۡعُهَا فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Alam tara kayfa daraba Allahu mathalan kalimatan tayyibatan kashajaratin tayyibatin asluha thabitun wafarAAuha fee alssamai
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Have you not considered how Allah presents an example, [making] a good word like a good tree, whose root is firmly fixed and its branches [high] in the sky?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Do you not see how Allah compares a good word to a good tree? Its root is firm and its branches reach the sky,

ayahs.textArabic: تُؤۡتِيٓ أُكُلَهَا كُلَّ حِينِۭ بِإِذۡنِ رَبِّهَاۗ وَيَضۡرِبُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡأَمۡثَالَ لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Tutee okulaha kulla heenin biithni rabbiha wayadribu Allahu alamthala lilnnasi laAAallahum yatathakkaroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: It produces its fruit all the time, by permission of its Lord. And Allah presents examples for the people that perhaps they will be reminded.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹always˺ yielding its fruit in every season by the Will of its Lord. This is how Allah sets forth parables for the people, so perhaps they will be mindful.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَثَلُ كَلِمَةٍ خَبِيثَةٖ كَشَجَرَةٍ خَبِيثَةٍ ٱجۡتُثَّتۡ مِن فَوۡقِ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مَا لَهَا مِن قَرَارٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wamathalu kalimatin khabeethatin kashajaratin khabeethatin ijtuththat min fawqi alardi ma laha min qararin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the example of a bad word is like a bad tree, uprooted from the surface of the earth, not having any stability.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And the parable of an evil word is that of an evil tree, uprooted from the earth, having no stability.

ayahs.textArabic: يُثَبِّتُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ بِٱلۡقَوۡلِ ٱلثَّابِتِ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَفِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِۖ وَيُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَۚ وَيَفۡعَلُ ٱللَّهُ مَا يَشَآءُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yuthabbitu Allahu allatheena amanoo bialqawli alththabiti fee alhayati alddunya wafee alakhirati wayudillu Allahu alththalimeena wayafAAalu Allahu ma yashao
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Allah keeps firm those who believe, with the firm word, in worldly life and in the Hereafter. And Allah sends astray the wrongdoers. And Allah does what He wills.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Allah makes the believers steadfast with the firm Word ˹of faith˺ in this worldly life and the Hereafter. And Allah leaves the wrongdoers to stray. For Allah does what He wills.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ أَلَمۡ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ بَدَّلُواْ نِعۡمَتَ ٱللَّهِ كُفۡرٗا وَأَحَلُّواْ قَوۡمَهُمۡ دَارَ ٱلۡبَوَارِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Alam tara ila allatheena baddaloo niAAmata Allahi kufran waahalloo qawmahum dara albawari
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Have you not considered those who exchanged the favor of Allah for disbelief and settled their people [in] the home of ruin?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Have you not seen those ˹disbelievers˺ who meet Allah’s favours with ingratitude and lead their own people to their doom?

ayahs.textArabic: جَهَنَّمَ يَصۡلَوۡنَهَاۖ وَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡقَرَارُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Jahannama yaslawnaha wabisa alqararu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [It is] Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the settlement.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: In Hell they will burn. What an evil place for settlement.

ayahs.textArabic: وَجَعَلُواْ لِلَّهِ أَندَادٗا لِّيُضِلُّواْ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦۗ قُلۡ تَمَتَّعُواْ فَإِنَّ مَصِيرَكُمۡ إِلَى ٱلنَّارِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: WajaAAaloo lillahi andadan liyudilloo AAan sabeelihi qul tamattaAAoo fainna maseerakum ila alnnari
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And they have attributed to Allah equals to mislead [people] from His way. Say, "Enjoy yourselves, for indeed, your destination is the Fire."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They set up equals to Allah to mislead ˹others˺ from His Way. Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Enjoy yourselves! Surely your destination is the Fire.”

ayahs.textArabic: قُل لِّعِبَادِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ يُقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُنفِقُواْ مِمَّا رَزَقۡنَٰهُمۡ سِرّٗا وَعَلَانِيَةٗ مِّن قَبۡلِ أَن يَأۡتِيَ يَوۡمٞ لَّا بَيۡعٞ فِيهِ وَلَا خِلَٰلٌ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qul liAAibadiya allatheena amanoo yuqeemoo alssalata wayunfiqoo mimma razaqnahum sirran waAAalaniyatan min qabli an yatiya yawmun la bayAAun feehi wala khilalun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [O Muhammad], tell My servants who have believed to establish prayer and spend from what We have provided them, secretly and publicly, before a Day comes in which there will be no exchange, nor any friendships.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Tell My believing servants to establish prayer and donate from what We have provided for them—openly and secretly—before the arrival of a Day in which there will be no ransom or friendly connections.

ayahs.textArabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَأَخۡرَجَ بِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ رِزۡقٗا لَّكُمۡۖ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡفُلۡكَ لِتَجۡرِيَ فِي ٱلۡبَحۡرِ بِأَمۡرِهِۦۖ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Allahu allathee khalaqa alssamawati waalarda waanzala mina alssamai maan faakhraja bihi mina alththamarati rizqan lakum wasakhkhara lakumu alfulka litajriya fee albahri biamrihi wasakhkhara lakumu alanhara
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: It is Allah who created the heavens and the earth and sent down rain from the sky and produced thereby some fruits as provision for you and subjected for you the ships to sail through the sea by His command and subjected for you the rivers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: It is Allah Who created the heavens and the earth and sends down rain from the sky, causing fruits to grow as a provision for you. He has subjected the ships for your service, sailing through the sea by His command, and has subjected the rivers for you.

ayahs.textArabic: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَ دَآئِبَيۡنِۖ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيۡلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wasakhkhara lakumu alshshamsa waalqamara daibayni wasakhkhara lakumu allayla waalnnahara
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And He subjected for you the sun and the moon, continuous [in orbit], and subjected for you the night and the day.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He has ˹also˺ subjected for you the sun and the moon, both constantly orbiting, and has subjected the day and night for you.

ayahs.textArabic: وَءَاتَىٰكُم مِّن كُلِّ مَا سَأَلۡتُمُوهُۚ وَإِن تَعُدُّواْ نِعۡمَتَ ٱللَّهِ لَا تُحۡصُوهَآۗ إِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ لَظَلُومٞ كَفَّارٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waatakum min kulli ma saaltumoohu wain taAAuddoo niAAmata Allahi la tuhsooha inna alinsana lathaloomun kaffarun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And He gave you from all you asked of Him. And if you should count the favor of Allah, you could not enumerate them. Indeed, mankind is [generally] most unjust and ungrateful.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And He has granted you all that you asked Him for. If you tried to count Allah’s blessings, you would never be able to number them. Indeed humankind is truly unfair, ˹totally˺ ungrateful.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِذۡ قَالَ إِبۡرَٰهِيمُ رَبِّ ٱجۡعَلۡ هَٰذَا ٱلۡبَلَدَ ءَامِنٗا وَٱجۡنُبۡنِي وَبَنِيَّ أَن نَّعۡبُدَ ٱلۡأَصۡنَامَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waith qala ibraheemu rabbi ijAAal hatha albalada aminan waojnubnee wabaniyya an naAAbuda alasnama
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [mention, O Muhammad], when Abraham said, "My Lord, make this city [Mecca] secure and keep me and my sons away from worshipping idols.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Remember˺ when Abraham prayed, “My Lord! Make this city ˹of Mecca˺ secure, and keep me and my children away from the worship of idols.

ayahs.textArabic: رَبِّ إِنَّهُنَّ أَضۡلَلۡنَ كَثِيرٗا مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِۖ فَمَن تَبِعَنِي فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّيۖ وَمَنۡ عَصَانِي فَإِنَّكَ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Rabbi innahunna adlalna katheeran mina alnnasi faman tabiAAanee fainnahu minnee waman AAasanee fainnaka ghafoorun raheemun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: My Lord, indeed they have led astray many among the people. So whoever follows me - then he is of me; and whoever disobeys me - indeed, You are [yet] Forgiving and Merciful.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: My Lord! They have caused many people to go astray. So whoever follows me is with me, and whoever disobeys me—then surely You are ˹still˺ All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

ayahs.textArabic: رَّبَّنَآ إِنِّيٓ أَسۡكَنتُ مِن ذُرِّيَّتِي بِوَادٍ غَيۡرِ ذِي زَرۡعٍ عِندَ بَيۡتِكَ ٱلۡمُحَرَّمِ رَبَّنَا لِيُقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ فَٱجۡعَلۡ أَفۡـِٔدَةٗ مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ تَهۡوِيٓ إِلَيۡهِمۡ وَٱرۡزُقۡهُم مِّنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَشۡكُرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Rabbana innee askantu min thurriyyatee biwadin ghayri thee zarAAin AAinda baytika almuharrami rabbana liyuqeemoo alssalata faijAAal afidatan mina alnnasi tahwee ilayhim waorzuqhum mina alththamarati laAAallahum yashkuroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Our Lord, I have settled some of my descendants in an uncultivated valley near Your sacred House, our Lord, that they may establish prayer. So make hearts among the people incline toward them and provide for them from the fruits that they might be grateful.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Our Lord! I have settled some of my offspring in a barren valley, near Your Sacred House, our Lord, so that they may establish prayer. So make the hearts of ˹believing˺ people incline towards them and provide them with fruits, so perhaps they will be thankful.

ayahs.textArabic: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ تَعۡلَمُ مَا نُخۡفِي وَمَا نُعۡلِنُۗ وَمَا يَخۡفَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مِن شَيۡءٖ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَا فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Rabbana innaka taAAlamu ma nukhfee wama nuAAlinu wama yakhfa AAala Allahi min shayin fee alardi wala fee alssamai
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Our Lord, indeed You know what we conceal and what we declare, and nothing is hidden from Allah on the earth or in the heaven.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Our Lord! You certainly know what we conceal and what we reveal. Nothing on earth or in heaven is hidden from Allah.

ayahs.textArabic: ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي وَهَبَ لِي عَلَى ٱلۡكِبَرِ إِسۡمَٰعِيلَ وَإِسۡحَٰقَۚ إِنَّ رَبِّي لَسَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Alhamdu lillahi allathee wahaba lee AAala alkibari ismaAAeela waishaqa inna rabbee lasameeAAu aldduAAai
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Praise to Allah, who has granted to me in old age Ishmael and Isaac. Indeed, my Lord is the Hearer of supplication.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: All praise is for Allah who has blessed me with Ishmael and Isaac in my old age. My Lord is indeed the Hearer of ˹all˺ prayers.

ayahs.textArabic: رَبِّ ٱجۡعَلۡنِي مُقِيمَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِيۚ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلۡ دُعَآءِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Rabbi ijAAalnee muqeema alssalati wamin thurriyyatee rabbana wtaqabbal duAAai
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and [many] from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: My Lord! Make me and those ˹believers˺ of my descendants keep up prayer. Our Lord! Accept my prayers.

ayahs.textArabic: رَبَّنَا ٱغۡفِرۡ لِي وَلِوَٰلِدَيَّ وَلِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ يَوۡمَ يَقُومُ ٱلۡحِسَابُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Rabbana ighfir lee waliwalidayya walilmumineena yawma yaqoomu alhisabu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Our Lord! Forgive me, my parents, and the believers on the Day when the judgment will come to pass.”

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَا تَحۡسَبَنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَٰفِلًا عَمَّا يَعۡمَلُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَۚ إِنَّمَا يُؤَخِّرُهُمۡ لِيَوۡمٖ تَشۡخَصُ فِيهِ ٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wala tahsabanna Allaha ghafilan AAamma yaAAmalu alththalimoona innama yuakhkhiruhum liyawmin tashkhasu feehi alabsaru
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And never think that Allah is unaware of what the wrongdoers do. He only delays them for a Day when eyes will stare [in horror].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Do not think ˹O Prophet˺ that Allah is unaware of what the wrongdoers do. He only delays them until a Day when ˹their˺ eyes will stare in horror—

ayahs.textArabic: مُهۡطِعِينَ مُقۡنِعِي رُءُوسِهِمۡ لَا يَرۡتَدُّ إِلَيۡهِمۡ طَرۡفُهُمۡۖ وَأَفۡـِٔدَتُهُمۡ هَوَآءٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: MuhtiAAeena muqniAAee ruoosihim la yartaddu ilayhim tarfuhum waafidatuhum hawaon
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Racing ahead, their heads raised up, their glance does not come back to them, and their hearts are void.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: rushing forth, heads raised, never blinking, hearts void.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَنذِرِ ٱلنَّاسَ يَوۡمَ يَأۡتِيهِمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ فَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ رَبَّنَآ أَخِّرۡنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٖ قَرِيبٖ نُّجِبۡ دَعۡوَتَكَ وَنَتَّبِعِ ٱلرُّسُلَۗ أَوَلَمۡ تَكُونُوٓاْ أَقۡسَمۡتُم مِّن قَبۡلُ مَا لَكُم مِّن زَوَالٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waanthiri alnnasa yawma yateehimu alAAathabu fayaqoolu allatheena thalamoo rabbana akhkhirna ila ajalin qareebin nujib daAAwataka wanattabiAAi alrrusula awalam takoonoo aqsamtum min qablu ma lakum min zawalin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And, [O Muhammad], warn the people of a Day when the punishment will come to them and those who did wrong will say, "Our Lord, delay us for a short term; we will answer Your call and follow the messengers." [But it will be said], "Had you not sworn, before, that for you there would be no cessation?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And warn the people of the Day when the punishment will overtake ˹the wicked among˺ them, and the wrongdoers will cry, “Our Lord! Delay us for a little while. We will respond to Your call and follow the messengers!” ˹It will be said,˺ “Did you not swear before that you would never be removed ˹to the next life˺?”

ayahs.textArabic: وَسَكَنتُمۡ فِي مَسَٰكِنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ وَتَبَيَّنَ لَكُمۡ كَيۡفَ فَعَلۡنَا بِهِمۡ وَضَرَبۡنَا لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَمۡثَالَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wasakantum fee masakini allatheena thalamoo anfusahum watabayyana lakum kayfa faAAalna bihim wadarabna lakumu alamthala
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And you lived among the dwellings of those who wronged themselves, and it had become clear to you how We dealt with them. And We presented for you [many] examples."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: You passed by the ruins of those ˹destroyed peoples˺ who had wronged themselves. It was made clear to you how We dealt with them, and We gave you ˹many˺ examples.

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَدۡ مَكَرُواْ مَكۡرَهُمۡ وَعِندَ ٱللَّهِ مَكۡرُهُمۡ وَإِن كَانَ مَكۡرُهُمۡ لِتَزُولَ مِنۡهُ ٱلۡجِبَالُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waqad makaroo makrahum waAAinda Allahi makruhum wain kana makruhum litazoola minhu aljibalu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And they had planned their plan, but with Allah is [recorded] their plan, even if their plan had been [sufficient] to do away with the mountains.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They devised every plot, which was fully known to Allah, but their plotting was not enough to ˹even˺ overpower mountains ˹let alone Allah˺.

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَا تَحۡسَبَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِفَ وَعۡدِهِۦ رُسُلَهُۥٓۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٞ ذُو ٱنتِقَامٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fala tahsabanna Allaha mukhlifa waAAdihi rusulahu inna Allaha AAazeezun thoo intiqamin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So never think that Allah will fail in His promise to His messengers. Indeed, Allah is Exalted in Might and Owner of Retribution.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So do not think ˹O Prophet˺ that Allah will fail to keep His promise to His messengers. Allah is indeed Almighty, capable of punishment.

ayahs.textArabic: يَوۡمَ تُبَدَّلُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ غَيۡرَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُۖ وَبَرَزُواْ لِلَّهِ ٱلۡوَٰحِدِ ٱلۡقَهَّارِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yawma tubaddalu alardu ghayra alardi waalssamawatu wabarazoo lillahi alwahidi alqahhari
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [It will be] on the Day the earth will be replaced by another earth, and the heavens [as well], and all creatures will come out before Allah, the One, the Prevailing.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Watch for˺ the Day ˹when˺ the earth will be changed into a different earth and the heavens as well, and all will appear before Allah—the One, the Supreme.

ayahs.textArabic: وَتَرَى ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ يَوۡمَئِذٖ مُّقَرَّنِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَصۡفَادِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Watara almujrimeena yawmaithin muqarraneena fee alasfadi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And you will see the criminals that Day bound together in shackles,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: On that Day you will see the wicked bound together in chains,

ayahs.textArabic: سَرَابِيلُهُم مِّن قَطِرَانٖ وَتَغۡشَىٰ وُجُوهَهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Sarabeeluhum min qatranin wataghsha wujoohahumu alnnaru
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Their garments of liquid pitch and their faces covered by the Fire.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: with garments of tar, and their faces covered with flames.

ayahs.textArabic: لِيَجۡزِيَ ٱللَّهُ كُلَّ نَفۡسٖ مَّا كَسَبَتۡۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلۡحِسَابِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Liyajziya Allahu kulla nafsin ma kasabat inna Allaha sareeAAu alhisabi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So that Allah will recompense every soul for what it earned. Indeed, Allah is swift in account.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: As such, Allah will reward every soul for what it has committed. Surely Allah is swift in reckoning.

ayahs.textArabic: هَٰذَا بَلَٰغٞ لِّلنَّاسِ وَلِيُنذَرُواْ بِهِۦ وَلِيَعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَٰهٞ وَٰحِدٞ وَلِيَذَّكَّرَ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Hatha balaghun lilnnasi waliyuntharoo bihi waliyaAAlamoo annama huwa ilahun wahidun waliyaththakkara oloo alalbabi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: This [Qur'an] is notification for the people that they may be warned thereby and that they may know that He is but one God and that those of understanding will be reminded.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: This ˹Quran˺ is a ˹sufficient˺ message for humanity so that they may take it as a warning and know that there is only One God, and so that people of reason may be mindful.

ayahs.textArabic: الٓرۚ تِلۡكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَقُرۡءَانٖ مُّبِينٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Aliflamra tilka ayatu alkitabi waquranin mubeenin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Alif, Lam, Ra. These are the verses of the Book and a clear Qur'an.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Alif-Lãm-Ra. These are the verses of the Book; the clear Quran.

ayahs.textArabic: رُّبَمَا يَوَدُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَوۡ كَانُواْ مُسۡلِمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Rubama yawaddu allatheena kafaroo law kanoo muslimeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Perhaps those who disbelieve will wish that they had been Muslims.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹The day will come when˺ the disbelievers will certainly wish they had submitted ˹to Allah˺.

ayahs.textArabic: ذَرۡهُمۡ يَأۡكُلُواْ وَيَتَمَتَّعُواْ وَيُلۡهِهِمُ ٱلۡأَمَلُۖ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Tharhum yakuloo wayatamattaAAoo wayulhihimu alamalu fasawfa yaAAlamoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Let them eat and enjoy themselves and be diverted by [false] hope, for they are going to know.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹So˺ let them eat and enjoy themselves and be diverted by ˹false˺ hope, for they will soon know.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَآ أَهۡلَكۡنَا مِن قَرۡيَةٍ إِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابٞ مَّعۡلُومٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama ahlakna min qaryatin illa walaha kitabun maAAloomun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We did not destroy any city but that for it was a known decree.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We have never destroyed a society without a destined term.

ayahs.textArabic: مَّا تَسۡبِقُ مِنۡ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسۡتَـٔۡخِرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ma tasbiqu min ommatin ajalaha wama yastakhiroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: No nation will precede its term, nor will they remain thereafter.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: No people can advance their doom, nor can they delay it.

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالُواْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِي نُزِّلَ عَلَيۡهِ ٱلذِّكۡرُ إِنَّكَ لَمَجۡنُونٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waqaloo ya ayyuha allathee nuzzila AAalayhi alththikru innaka lamajnoonun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And they say, "O you upon whom the message has been sent down, indeed you are mad.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They say, “O you to whom the Reminder is revealed! You must be insane!

ayahs.textArabic: لَّوۡمَا تَأۡتِينَا بِٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Law ma tateena bialmalaikati in kunta mina alssadiqeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Why do you not bring us the angels, if you should be among the truthful?"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Why do you not bring us the angels, if what you say is true?”

ayahs.textArabic: مَا نُنَزِّلُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَمَا كَانُوٓاْ إِذٗا مُّنظَرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ma nunazzilu almalaikata illa bialhaqqi wama kanoo ithan munthareena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: We do not send down the angels except with truth; and the disbelievers would not then be reprieved.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We do not send the angels down except for a just cause, and then ˹the end of˺ the disbelievers will not be delayed.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نَزَّلۡنَا ٱلذِّكۡرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَٰفِظُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna nahnu nazzalna alththikra wainna lahu lahafithoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, it is We who sent down the Qur'an and indeed, We will be its guardian.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: It is certainly We Who have revealed the Reminder, and it is certainly We Who will preserve it.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِكَ فِي شِيَعِ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walaqad arsalna min qablika fee shiyaAAi alawwaleena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We had certainly sent [messengers] before you, [O Muhammad], among the sects of the former peoples.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, We sent messengers before you ˹O Prophet˺ among the groups of early peoples,

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا يَأۡتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama yateehim min rasoolin illa kanoo bihi yastahzioona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And no messenger would come to them except that they ridiculed him.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: but no messenger ever came to them without being mocked.

ayahs.textArabic: كَذَٰلِكَ نَسۡلُكُهُۥ فِي قُلُوبِ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kathalika naslukuhu fee quloobi almujrimeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Thus do We insert denial into the hearts of the criminals.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: This is how We allow disbelief ˹to steep˺ into the hearts of the wicked.

ayahs.textArabic: لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِهِۦ وَقَدۡ خَلَتۡ سُنَّةُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: La yuminoona bihi waqad khalat sunnatu alawwaleena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They will not believe in it, while there has already occurred the precedent of the former peoples.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They would not believe in this ˹Quran˺ despite the ˹many˺ examples of those ˹destroyed˺ before.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَوۡ فَتَحۡنَا عَلَيۡهِم بَابٗا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَظَلُّواْ فِيهِ يَعۡرُجُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walaw fatahna AAalayhim baban mina alssamai fathalloo feehi yaAArujoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [even] if We opened to them a gate from the heaven and they continued therein to ascend,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And even if We opened for them a gate to heaven, through which they continued to ascend,

ayahs.textArabic: لَقَالُوٓاْ إِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتۡ أَبۡصَٰرُنَا بَلۡ نَحۡنُ قَوۡمٞ مَّسۡحُورُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Laqaloo innama sukkirat absaruna bal nahnu qawmun mashooroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They would say, "Our eyes have only been dazzled. Rather, we are a people affected by magic."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: still they would say, “Our eyes have truly been dazzled! In fact, we must have been bewitched.”

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدۡ جَعَلۡنَا فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجٗا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا لِلنَّٰظِرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walaqad jaAAalna fee alssamai buroojan wazayyannaha lilnnathireena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We have placed within the heaven great stars and have beautified it for the observers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, We have placed constellations in the sky, and adorned it for all to see.

ayahs.textArabic: وَحَفِظۡنَٰهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيۡطَٰنٖ رَّجِيمٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wahafithnaha min kulli shaytanin rajeemin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We have protected it from every devil expelled [from the mercy of Allah]
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And We protected it from every accursed devil,

ayahs.textArabic: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱسۡتَرَقَ ٱلسَّمۡعَ فَأَتۡبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٞ مُّبِينٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Illa mani istaraqa alssamAAa faatbaAAahu shihabun mubeenun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Except one who steals a hearing and is pursued by a clear burning flame.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: except the one eavesdropping, who is then pursued by a visible flare.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ مَدَدۡنَٰهَا وَأَلۡقَيۡنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِيَ وَأَنۢبَتۡنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ مَّوۡزُونٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalarda madadnaha waalqayna feeha rawasiya waanbatna feeha min kulli shayin mawzoonin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the earth - We have spread it and cast therein firmly set mountains and caused to grow therein [something] of every well-balanced thing.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: As for the earth, We spread it out and placed upon it firm mountains, and caused everything to grow there in perfect balance.

ayahs.textArabic: وَجَعَلۡنَا لَكُمۡ فِيهَا مَعَٰيِشَ وَمَن لَّسۡتُمۡ لَهُۥ بِرَٰزِقِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: WajaAAalna lakum feeha maAAayisha waman lastum lahu biraziqeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We have made for you therein means of living and [for] those for whom you are not providers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And We made in it means of sustenance for you and others, who you do not provide for.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِن مِّن شَيۡءٍ إِلَّا عِندَنَا خَزَآئِنُهُۥ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِقَدَرٖ مَّعۡلُومٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wain min shayin illa AAindana khazainuhu wama nunazziluhu illa biqadarin maAAloomin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And there is not a thing but that with Us are its depositories, and We do not send it down except according to a known measure.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: There is not any means ˹of sustenance˺ whose reserves We do not hold, only bringing it forth in precise measure.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَرۡسَلۡنَا ٱلرِّيَٰحَ لَوَٰقِحَ فَأَنزَلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَأَسۡقَيۡنَٰكُمُوهُ وَمَآ أَنتُمۡ لَهُۥ بِخَٰزِنِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waarsalna alrriyaha lawaqiha faanzalna mina alssamai maan faasqaynakumoohu wama antum lahu bikhazineena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We have sent the fertilizing winds and sent down water from the sky and given you drink from it. And you are not its retainers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We send fertilizing winds, and bring down rain from the sky for you to drink. It is not you who hold its reserves.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِنَّا لَنَحۡنُ نُحۡيِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَنَحۡنُ ٱلۡوَٰرِثُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wainna lanahnu nuhyee wanumeetu wanahnu alwarithoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and We are the Inheritor.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Surely it is We Who give life and cause death. And We are the ˹Eternal˺ Successor.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدۡ عَلِمۡنَا ٱلۡمُسۡتَقۡدِمِينَ مِنكُمۡ وَلَقَدۡ عَلِمۡنَا ٱلۡمُسۡتَـٔۡخِرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walaqad AAalimna almustaqdimeena minkum walaqad AAalimna almustakhireena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We have already known the preceding [generations] among you, and We have already known the later [ones to come].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We certainly know those who have gone before you and those who will come after ˹you˺.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحۡشُرُهُمۡۚ إِنَّهُۥ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wainna rabbaka huwa yahshuruhum innahu hakeemun AAaleemun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And indeed, your Lord will gather them; indeed, He is Wise and Knowing.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Surely your Lord ˹alone˺ will gather them together ˹for judgment˺. He is truly All-Wise, All-Knowing.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِن صَلۡصَٰلٖ مِّنۡ حَمَإٖ مَّسۡنُونٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walaqad khalaqna alinsana min salsalin min hamain masnoonin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We did certainly create man out of clay from an altered black mud.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, We created man from sounding clay moulded from black mud.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلۡجَآنَّ خَلَقۡنَٰهُ مِن قَبۡلُ مِن نَّارِ ٱلسَّمُومِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waaljanna khalaqnahu min qablu min nari alssamoomi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the jinn We created before from scorching fire.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: As for the jinn, We created them earlier from smokeless fire.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِذۡ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّي خَٰلِقُۢ بَشَرٗا مِّن صَلۡصَٰلٖ مِّنۡ حَمَإٖ مَّسۡنُونٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waith qala rabbuka lilmalaikati innee khaliqun basharan min salsalin min hamain masnoonin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [mention, O Muhammad], when your Lord said to the angels, "I will create a human being out of clay from an altered black mud.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Remember, O Prophet˺ when your Lord said to the angels, “I am going to create a human being from sounding clay moulded from black mud.

ayahs.textArabic: فَإِذَا سَوَّيۡتُهُۥ وَنَفَخۡتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِي فَقَعُواْ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faitha sawwaytuhu wanafakhtu feehi min roohee faqaAAoo lahu sajideena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So when I have fashioned him and had a spirit of My Own ˹creation˺ breathed into him, fall down in prostration to him.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَسَجَدَ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمۡ أَجۡمَعُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fasajada almalaikatu kulluhum ajmaAAoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So the angels prostrated all together—

ayahs.textArabic: إِلَّآ إِبۡلِيسَ أَبَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Illa ibleesa aba an yakoona maAAa alssajideena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Except Iblees, he refused to be with those who prostrated.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: but not Iblîs, who refused to prostrate with the others.

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ يَٰٓإِبۡلِيسُ مَا لَكَ أَلَّا تَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala ya ibleesu ma laka alla takoona maAAa alssajideena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Allah] said, O Iblees, what is [the matter] with you that you are not with those who prostrate?"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Allah asked, “O Iblîs! What is the matter with you that you did not join others in prostration?”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ لَمۡ أَكُن لِّأَسۡجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقۡتَهُۥ مِن صَلۡصَٰلٖ مِّنۡ حَمَإٖ مَّسۡنُونٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala lam akun liasjuda libasharin khalaqtahu min salsalin min hamain masnoonin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He said, "Never would I prostrate to a human whom You created out of clay from an altered black mud."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He replied, “It is not for me to prostrate to a human You created from sounding clay moulded from black mud.”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ فَٱخۡرُجۡ مِنۡهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala faokhruj minha fainnaka rajeemun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Allah] said, "Then get out of it, for indeed, you are expelled.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Allah commanded, “Then get out of Paradise, for you are truly cursed.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِنَّ عَلَيۡكَ ٱللَّعۡنَةَ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wainna AAalayka allaAAnata ila yawmi alddeeni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And indeed, upon you is the curse until the Day of Recompense."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And surely upon you is condemnation until the Day of Judgment.”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرۡنِيٓ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ يُبۡعَثُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala rabbi faanthirnee ila yawmi yubAAathoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Satan appealed, “My Lord! Then delay my end until the Day of their resurrection.”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُنظَرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala fainnaka mina almunthareena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Allah] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Allah said, “You will be delayed

ayahs.textArabic: إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡوَقۡتِ ٱلۡمَعۡلُومِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ila yawmi alwaqti almaAAloomi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Until the Day of the time well-known."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: until the appointed Day.”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغۡوَيۡتَنِي لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَأُغۡوِيَنَّهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala rabbi bima aghwaytanee laozayyinanna lahum fee alardi walaoghwiyannahum ajmaAAeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Iblees] said, "My Lord, because You have put me in error, I will surely make [disobedience] attractive to them on earth, and I will mislead them all
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Satan responded, “My Lord! For allowing me to stray I will surely tempt them on earth and mislead them all together,

ayahs.textArabic: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنۡهُمُ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Illa AAibadaka minhumu almukhlaseena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Except, among them, Your chosen servants."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: except Your chosen servants among them.”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ عَلَيَّ مُسۡتَقِيمٌ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala hatha siratun AAalayya mustaqeemun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Allah] said, "This is a path [of return] to Me [that is] straight.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Allah said, “This is the Way, binding on Me:

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ عِبَادِي لَيۡسَ لَكَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ سُلۡطَٰنٌ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلۡغَاوِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna AAibadee laysa laka AAalayhim sultanun illa mani ittabaAAaka mina alghaweena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, My servants - no authority will you have over them, except those who follow you of the deviators.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: you will certainly have no authority over My servants, except the deviant who follow you,

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوۡعِدُهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wainna jahannama lamawAAiduhum ajmaAAeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And indeed, Hell is the promised place for them all.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and surely Hell is their destined place, all together.

ayahs.textArabic: لَهَا سَبۡعَةُ أَبۡوَٰبٖ لِّكُلِّ بَابٖ مِّنۡهُمۡ جُزۡءٞ مَّقۡسُومٌ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Laha sabAAatu abwabin likulli babin minhum juzon maqsoomun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: It has seven gates; for every gate is of them a portion designated."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: It has seven gates, to each a group of them is designated.”

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّٰتٖ وَعُيُونٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna almuttaqeena fee jannatin waAAuyoonin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, the righteous will be within gardens and springs.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, the righteous will be amid Gardens and springs.

ayahs.textArabic: ٱدۡخُلُوهَا بِسَلَٰمٍ ءَامِنِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Odkhulooha bisalamin amineena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Having been told], "Enter it in peace, safe [and secure]."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹It will be said to them,˺ “Enter in peace and security.”

ayahs.textArabic: وَنَزَعۡنَا مَا فِي صُدُورِهِم مِّنۡ غِلٍّ إِخۡوَٰنًا عَلَىٰ سُرُرٖ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: WanazaAAna ma fee sudoorihim min ghillin ikhwanan AAala sururin mutaqabileena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We will remove whatever is in their breasts of resentment, [so they will be] brothers, on thrones facing each other.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We will remove whatever bitterness they had in their hearts. In a friendly manner, they will be on thrones, facing one another.

ayahs.textArabic: لَا يَمَسُّهُمۡ فِيهَا نَصَبٞ وَمَا هُم مِّنۡهَا بِمُخۡرَجِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: La yamassuhum feeha nasabun wama hum minha bimukhrajeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: No fatigue will touch them therein, nor from it will they [ever] be removed.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: No fatigue will touch them there, nor will they ever be asked to leave.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ نَبِّئۡ عِبَادِيٓ أَنِّيٓ أَنَا ٱلۡغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Nabbi AAibadee annee ana alghafooru alrraheemu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [O Muhammad], inform My servants that it is I who am the Forgiving, the Merciful.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Inform My servants ˹O Prophet˺ that I am truly the All-Forgiving, Most Merciful,

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَنَّ عَذَابِي هُوَ ٱلۡعَذَابُ ٱلۡأَلِيمُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wa anna AAathabee huwa alAAathabu alaleemu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And that it is My punishment which is the painful punishment.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and that My torment is indeed the most painful.

ayahs.textArabic: وَنَبِّئۡهُمۡ عَن ضَيۡفِ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wanabbihum AAan dayfi ibraheema
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And inform them about the guests of Abraham,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And inform them ˹O Prophet˺ about Abraham’s guests

ayahs.textArabic: إِذۡ دَخَلُواْ عَلَيۡهِ فَقَالُواْ سَلَٰمٗا قَالَ إِنَّا مِنكُمۡ وَجِلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ith dakhaloo AAalayhi faqaloo salaman qala inna minkum wajiloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: When they entered upon him and said, "Peace." [Abraham] said, "Indeed, we are fearful of you."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: who entered upon him and greeted ˹him with˺, “Peace!” He ˹later˺ said, “Surely we are afraid of you.”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُواْ لَا تَوۡجَلۡ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qaloo la tawjal inna nubashshiruka bighulamin AAaleemin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [The angels] said, "Fear not. Indeed, we give you good tidings of a learned boy."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They reassured ˹him˺, “Do not be afraid! Surely we give you good news of a knowledgeable son.”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ أَبَشَّرۡتُمُونِي عَلَىٰٓ أَن مَّسَّنِيَ ٱلۡكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala abashshartumoonee AAala an massaniya alkibaru fabima tubashshirooni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He said, "Have you given me good tidings although old age has come upon me? Then of what [wonder] do you inform?"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He wondered, “Do you give me good news despite my old age? What unlikely news!”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُواْ بَشَّرۡنَٰكَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلۡقَٰنِطِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qaloo bashsharnaka bialhaqqi fala takun mina alqaniteena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They said, "We have given you good tidings in truth, so do not be of the despairing."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They responded, “We give you good news in all truth, so do not be one of those who despair.”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ وَمَن يَقۡنَطُ مِن رَّحۡمَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala waman yaqnatu min rahmati rabbihi illa alddalloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He said, "And who despairs of the mercy of his Lord except for those astray?"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He exclaimed, “Who would despair of the mercy of their Lord except the misguided?”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ فَمَا خَطۡبُكُمۡ أَيُّهَا ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala fama khatbukum ayyuha almursaloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He ˹then˺ added, “What is your mission, O messenger-angels?”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّآ أُرۡسِلۡنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوۡمٖ مُّجۡرِمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qaloo inna orsilna ila qawmin mujrimeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They replied, “We have actually been sent to a wicked people.

ayahs.textArabic: إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ إِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Illa ala lootin inna lamunajjoohum ajmaAAeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Except the family of Lot; indeed, we will save them all
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: As for the family of Lot, we will certainly deliver them all,

ayahs.textArabic: إِلَّا ٱمۡرَأَتَهُۥ قَدَّرۡنَآ إِنَّهَا لَمِنَ ٱلۡغَٰبِرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Illa imraatahu qaddarna innaha lamina alghabireena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Except his wife." Allah decreed that she is of those who remain behind.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: except his wife. We have determined that she will be one of the doomed.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Falamma jaa ala lootin almursaloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when the messengers came to the family of Lot,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So when the messengers came to the family of Lot,

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ إِنَّكُمۡ قَوۡمٞ مُّنكَرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala innakum qawmun munkaroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He said, "Indeed, you are people unknown."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: he said, “You are surely an unfamiliar people!”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُواْ بَلۡ جِئۡنَٰكَ بِمَا كَانُواْ فِيهِ يَمۡتَرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qaloo bal jinaka bima kanoo feehi yamtaroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They said, "But we have come to you with that about which they were disputing,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They responded, “We have come to you with that ˹torment˺ which they have doubted.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَتَيۡنَٰكَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَإِنَّا لَصَٰدِقُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waataynaka bialhaqqi wainna lasadiqoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And we have come to you with truth, and indeed, we are truthful.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We come to you with the truth, and we are certainly truthful.

ayahs.textArabic: فَأَسۡرِ بِأَهۡلِكَ بِقِطۡعٖ مِّنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَٱتَّبِعۡ أَدۡبَٰرَهُمۡ وَلَا يَلۡتَفِتۡ مِنكُمۡ أَحَدٞ وَٱمۡضُواْ حَيۡثُ تُؤۡمَرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faasri biahlika biqitAAin mina allayli waittabiAA adbarahum wala yaltafit minkum ahadun waimdoo haythu tumaroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So set out with your family during a portion of the night and follow behind them and let not anyone among you look back and continue on to where you are commanded."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So travel with your family in the dark of night, and follow ˹closely˺ behind them. Do not let any of you look back, and go where you are commanded.”

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَضَيۡنَآ إِلَيۡهِ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡأَمۡرَ أَنَّ دَابِرَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَقۡطُوعٞ مُّصۡبِحِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waqadayna ilayhi thalika alamra anna dabira haolai maqtooAAun musbiheena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We conveyed to him [the decree] of that matter: that those [sinners] would be eliminated by early morning.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We revealed to him this decree: “Those ˹sinners˺ will be uprooted in the morning.”

ayahs.textArabic: وَجَآءَ أَهۡلُ ٱلۡمَدِينَةِ يَسۡتَبۡشِرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wajaa ahlu almadeenati yastabshiroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the people of the city came rejoicing.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And there came the men of the city, rejoicing.

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ضَيۡفِي فَلَا تَفۡضَحُونِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala inna haolai dayfee fala tafdahooni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Lot] said, "Indeed, these are my guests, so do not shame me.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Lot pleaded, “Indeed, these are my guests, so do not embarrass me.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُخۡزُونِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waittaqoo Allaha wala tukhzooni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And fear Allah and do not disgrace me."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Fear Allah and do not humiliate me.”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُوٓاْ أَوَلَمۡ نَنۡهَكَ عَنِ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qaloo awalam nanhaka AAani alAAalameena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They said, "Have we not forbidden you from [protecting] people?"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They responded, “Have we not forbidden you from protecting anyone?”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِيٓ إِن كُنتُمۡ فَٰعِلِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala haolai banatee in kuntum faAAileena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Lot] said, "These are my daughters - if you would be doers [of lawful marriage]."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He said, “O my people! Here are my daughters ˹so marry them˺ if you wish to do so.”

ayahs.textArabic: لَعَمۡرُكَ إِنَّهُمۡ لَفِي سَكۡرَتِهِمۡ يَعۡمَهُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: LaAAamruka innahum lafee sakratihim yaAAmahoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: By your life, [O Muhammad], indeed they were, in their intoxication, wandering blindly.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: By your life ˹O Prophet˺, they certainly wandered blindly, intoxicated ˹by lust˺.

ayahs.textArabic: فَأَخَذَتۡهُمُ ٱلصَّيۡحَةُ مُشۡرِقِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faakhathathumu alssayhatu mushriqeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So the shriek seized them at sunrise.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So the ˹mighty˺ blast overtook them at sunrise.

ayahs.textArabic: فَجَعَلۡنَا عَٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمۡطَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ حِجَارَةٗ مِّن سِجِّيلٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: FajaAAalna AAaliyaha safilaha waamtarna AAalayhim hijaratan min sijjeelin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We made the highest part [of the city] its lowest and rained upon them stones of hard clay.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And We turned the cities ˹of Sodom and Gomorrah˺ upside down and rained upon them stones of baked clay.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّلۡمُتَوَسِّمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna fee thalika laayatin lilmutawassimeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed in that are signs for those who discern.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Surely in this are signs for those who contemplate.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيلٖ مُّقِيمٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wainnaha labisabeelin muqeemin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And indeed, those cities are [situated] on an established road.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Their ruins still lie along a known route.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗ لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna fee thalika laayatan lilmumineena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed in that is a sign for the believers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Surely in this is a sign for those who believe.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِن كَانَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡأَيۡكَةِ لَظَٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wain kana ashabu alaykati lathalimeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the companions of the thicket were [also] wrongdoers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And the residents of the Forest were truly wrongdoers,

ayahs.textArabic: فَٱنتَقَمۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡ وَإِنَّهُمَا لَبِإِمَامٖ مُّبِينٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faintaqamna minhum wainnahuma labiimamin mubeenin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So We took retribution from them, and indeed, both [cities] are on a clear highway.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: so We inflicted punishment upon them. The ruins of both nations still lie on a well-known road.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدۡ كَذَّبَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡحِجۡرِ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walaqad kaththaba ashabu alhijri almursaleena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And certainly did the companions of Thamud deny the messengers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, the residents of the Stone Valley also denied the messengers.

ayahs.textArabic: وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمۡ ءَايَٰتِنَا فَكَانُواْ عَنۡهَا مُعۡرِضِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waataynahum ayatina fakanoo AAanha muAArideena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We gave them Our signs, but from them they were turning away.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We gave them Our signs, but they turned away from them.

ayahs.textArabic: وَكَانُواْ يَنۡحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا ءَامِنِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wakanoo yanhitoona mina aljibali buyootan amineena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And they used to carve from the mountains, houses, feeling secure.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They carved their homes in the mountains, feeling secure.

ayahs.textArabic: فَأَخَذَتۡهُمُ ٱلصَّيۡحَةُ مُصۡبِحِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faakhathathumu alssayhatu musbiheena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But the shriek seized them at early morning.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But the ˹mighty˺ blast overtook them in the morning,

ayahs.textArabic: فَمَآ أَغۡنَىٰ عَنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fama aghna AAanhum ma kanoo yaksiboona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So nothing availed them [from] what they used to earn.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and all they achieved was of no help to them.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَأٓتِيَةٞۖ فَٱصۡفَحِ ٱلصَّفۡحَ ٱلۡجَمِيلَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama khalaqna alssamawati waalarda wama baynahuma illa bialhaqqi wainna alssaAAata laatiyatun faisfahi alssafha aljameela
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We have not created the heavens and earth and that between them except in truth. And indeed, the Hour is coming; so forgive with gracious forgiveness.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We have not created the heavens and the earth and everything in between except for a purpose. And the Hour is certain to come, so forgive graciously.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ ٱلۡخَلَّٰقُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna rabbaka huwa alkhallaqu alAAaleemu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, your Lord - He is the Knowing Creator.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Surely your Lord is the Master Creator, All-Knowing.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَٰكَ سَبۡعٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡمَثَانِي وَٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ ٱلۡعَظِيمَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walaqad ataynaka sabAAan mina almathanee waalqurana alAAatheema
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We have certainly given you, [O Muhammad], seven of the often repeated [verses] and the great Qur'an.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We have certainly granted you the seven often-repeated verses and the great Quran.

ayahs.textArabic: لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيۡنَيۡكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعۡنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزۡوَٰجٗا مِّنۡهُمۡ وَلَا تَحۡزَنۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَٱخۡفِضۡ جَنَاحَكَ لِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: La tamuddanna AAaynayka ila ma mattaAAna bihi azwajan minhum wala tahzan AAalayhim waikhfid janahaka lilmumineena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [certain] categories of the disbelievers, and do not grieve over them. And lower your wing to the believers
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Do not let your eyes crave the ˹fleeting˺ pleasures We have provided for some of the disbelievers, nor grieve for them. And be gracious to the believers.

ayahs.textArabic: وَقُلۡ إِنِّيٓ أَنَا ٱلنَّذِيرُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waqul innee ana alnnatheeru almubeenu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And say, "Indeed, I am the clear warner" -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And say, “I am truly sent with a clear warning”—

ayahs.textArabic: كَمَآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَى ٱلۡمُقۡتَسِمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kama anzalna AAala almuqtasimeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Just as We had revealed [scriptures] to the separators
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹a warning˺ similar to what We sent to those who divided ˹the Scriptures˺,

ayahs.textArabic: ٱلَّذِينَ جَعَلُواْ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ عِضِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Allatheena jaAAaloo alqurana AAideena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Who have made the Qur'an into portions.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: who ˹now˺ accept parts of the Quran, rejecting others.

ayahs.textArabic: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسۡـَٔلَنَّهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fawarabbika lanasalannahum ajmaAAeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So by your Lord, We will surely question them all
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So by your Lord! We will certainly question them all

ayahs.textArabic: عَمَّا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: AAamma kanoo yaAAmaloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: About what they used to do.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: about what they used to do.

ayahs.textArabic: فَٱصۡدَعۡ بِمَا تُؤۡمَرُ وَأَعۡرِضۡ عَنِ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: FaisdaAA bima tumaru waaAArid AAani almushrikeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then declare what you are commanded and turn away from the polytheists.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So proclaim what you have been commanded, and turn away from the polytheists.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّا كَفَيۡنَٰكَ ٱلۡمُسۡتَهۡزِءِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna kafaynaka almustahzieena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, We are sufficient for you against the mockers
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Surely We will be sufficient for you against the mockers,

ayahs.textArabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجۡعَلُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَۚ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Allatheena yajAAaloona maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara fasawfa yaAAlamoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Who make [equal] with Allah another deity. But they are going to know.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: who set up ˹other˺ gods with Allah. They will soon come to know.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدۡ نَعۡلَمُ أَنَّكَ يَضِيقُ صَدۡرُكَ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walaqad naAAlamu annaka yadeequ sadruka bima yaqooloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We already know that your breast is constrained by what they say.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We certainly know that your heart is truly distressed by what they say.

ayahs.textArabic: فَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fasabbih bihamdi rabbika wakun mina alssajideena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord and be of those who prostrate [to Him].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So glorify the praises of your Lord and be one of those who ˹always˺ pray,

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱعۡبُدۡ رَبَّكَ حَتَّىٰ يَأۡتِيَكَ ٱلۡيَقِينُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: WaoAAbud rabbaka hatta yatiyaka alyaqeenu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And worship your Lord until there comes to you the certainty (death).
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and worship your Lord until the inevitable comes to you.

revelationExceptions: Except the last three verses from Madinah

ayahs.textArabic: أَتَىٰٓ أَمۡرُ ٱللَّهِ فَلَا تَسۡتَعۡجِلُوهُۚ سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ata amru Allahi fala tastaAAjiloohu subhanahu wataAAala AAamma yushrikoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The command of Allah is coming, so be not impatient for it. Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The command of Allah is at hand, so do not hasten it. Glorified and Exalted is He above what they associate ˹with Him in worship˺!

ayahs.textArabic: يُنَزِّلُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ بِٱلرُّوحِ مِنۡ أَمۡرِهِۦ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهِۦٓ أَنۡ أَنذِرُوٓاْ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱتَّقُونِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yunazzilu almalaikata bialrroohi min amrihi AAala man yashao min AAibadihi an anthiroo annahu la ilaha illa ana faittaqooni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He sends down the angels, with the inspiration of His command, upon whom He wills of His servants, [telling them], "Warn that there is no deity except Me; so fear Me."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He sends down the angels with revelation by His command to whoever He wills of His servants, ˹stating:˺ “Warn ˹humanity˺ that there is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Me, so be mindful of Me ˹alone˺.”

ayahs.textArabic: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۚ تَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Khalaqa alssamawati waalarda bialhaqqi taAAala AAamma yushrikoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He created the heavens and earth in truth. High is He above what they associate with Him.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He created the heavens and the earth for a purpose. Exalted is He above what they associate with Him ˹in worship˺!

ayahs.textArabic: خَلَقَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطۡفَةٖ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٞ مُّبِينٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Khalaqa alinsana min nutfatin faitha huwa khaseemun mubeenun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He created man from a sperm-drop; then at once, he is a clear adversary.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He created humans from a sperm-drop, then—behold!—they openly challenge ˹Him˺.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمَ خَلَقَهَاۖ لَكُمۡ فِيهَا دِفۡءٞ وَمَنَٰفِعُ وَمِنۡهَا تَأۡكُلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: WaalanAAama khalaqaha lakum feeha difon wamanafiAAu waminha takuloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the grazing livestock He has created for you; in them is warmth and [numerous] benefits, and from them you eat.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And He created the cattle for you as a source of warmth, food, and ˹many other˺ benefits.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَكُمۡ فِيهَا جَمَالٌ حِينَ تُرِيحُونَ وَحِينَ تَسۡرَحُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walakum feeha jamalun heena tureehoona waheena tasrahoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And for you in them is [the enjoyment of] beauty when you bring them in [for the evening] and when you send them out [to pasture].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They are also pleasing to you when you bring them home and when you take them out to graze.

ayahs.textArabic: وَتَحۡمِلُ أَثۡقَالَكُمۡ إِلَىٰ بَلَدٖ لَّمۡ تَكُونُواْ بَٰلِغِيهِ إِلَّا بِشِقِّ ٱلۡأَنفُسِۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكُمۡ لَرَءُوفٞ رَّحِيمٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Watahmilu athqalakum ila baladin lam takoonoo baligheehi illa bishiqqi alanfusi inna rabbakum laraoofun raheemun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And they carry your loads to a land you could not have reached except with difficulty to yourselves. Indeed, your Lord is Kind and Merciful.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And they carry your loads to ˹distant˺ lands which you could not otherwise reach without great hardship. Surely your Lord is Ever Gracious, Most Merciful.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلۡخَيۡلَ وَٱلۡبِغَالَ وَٱلۡحَمِيرَ لِتَرۡكَبُوهَا وَزِينَةٗۚ وَيَخۡلُقُ مَا لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalkhayla waalbighala waalhameera litarkabooha wazeenatan wayakhluqu ma la taAAlamoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [He created] the horses, mules and donkeys for you to ride and [as] adornment. And He creates that which you do not know.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹He also created˺ horses, mules, and donkeys for your transportation and adornment. And He creates what you do not know.

ayahs.textArabic: وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ قَصۡدُ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَمِنۡهَا جَآئِرٞۚ وَلَوۡ شَآءَ لَهَدَىٰكُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: WaAAala Allahi qasdu alssabeeli waminha jairun walaw shaa lahadakum ajmaAAeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And upon Allah is the direction of the [right] way, and among the various paths are those deviating. And if He willed, He could have guided you all.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: It is upon Allah ˹alone˺ to ˹clearly˺ show the Straight Way. Other ways are deviant. Had He willed, He would have easily guided all of you.

ayahs.textArabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗۖ لَّكُم مِّنۡهُ شَرَابٞ وَمِنۡهُ شَجَرٞ فِيهِ تُسِيمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Huwa allathee anzala mina alssamai maan lakum minhu sharabun waminhu shajarun feehi tuseemoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: It is He who sends down rain from the sky; from it is drink and from it is foliage in which you pasture [animals].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He is the One Who sends down rain from the sky, from which you drink and by which plants grow for your cattle to graze.

ayahs.textArabic: يُنۢبِتُ لَكُم بِهِ ٱلزَّرۡعَ وَٱلزَّيۡتُونَ وَٱلنَّخِيلَ وَٱلۡأَعۡنَٰبَ وَمِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yunbitu lakum bihi alzzarAAa waalzzaytoona waalnnakheela waalaAAnaba wamin kulli alththamarati inna fee thalika laayatan liqawmin yatafakkaroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He causes to grow for you thereby the crops, olives, palm trees, grapevines, and from all the fruits. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who give thought.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: With it He produces for you ˹various˺ crops, olives, palm trees, grapevines, and every type of fruit. Surely in this is a sign for those who reflect.

ayahs.textArabic: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيۡلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ وَٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَۖ وَٱلنُّجُومُ مُسَخَّرَٰتُۢ بِأَمۡرِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَعۡقِلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wasakhkhara lakumu allayla waalnnahara waalshshamsa waalqamara waalnnujoomu musakhkharatun biamrihi inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yaAAqiloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And He has subjected for you the night and day and the sun and moon, and the stars are subjected by His command. Indeed in that are signs for a people who reason.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And He has subjected for your benefit the day and the night, the sun and the moon. And the stars have been subjected by His command. Surely in this are signs for those who understand.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا ذَرَأَ لَكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مُخۡتَلِفًا أَلۡوَٰنُهُۥٓۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَذَّكَّرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama tharaa lakum fee alardi mukhtalifan alwanuhu inna fee thalika laayatan liqawmin yaththakkaroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [He has subjected] whatever He multiplied for you on the earth of varying colors. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who remember.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And ˹He subjected˺ for you whatever He has created on earth of varying colours. Surely in this is a sign for those who are mindful.

ayahs.textArabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي سَخَّرَ ٱلۡبَحۡرَ لِتَأۡكُلُواْ مِنۡهُ لَحۡمٗا طَرِيّٗا وَتَسۡتَخۡرِجُواْ مِنۡهُ حِلۡيَةٗ تَلۡبَسُونَهَاۖ وَتَرَى ٱلۡفُلۡكَ مَوَاخِرَ فِيهِ وَلِتَبۡتَغُواْ مِن فَضۡلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wahuwa allathee sakhkhara albahra litakuloo minhu lahman tariyyan watastakhrijoo minhu hilyatan talbasoonaha watara alfulka mawakhira feehi walitabtaghoo min fadlihi walaAAallakum tashkuroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And it is He who subjected the sea for you to eat from it tender meat and to extract from it ornaments which you wear. And you see the ships plowing through it, and [He subjected it] that you may seek of His bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And He is the One Who has subjected the sea, so from it you may eat tender seafood and extract ornaments to wear. And you see the ships ploughing their way through it, so you may seek His bounty and give thanks ˹to Him˺.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَلۡقَىٰ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ رَوَٰسِيَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِكُمۡ وَأَنۡهَٰرٗا وَسُبُلٗا لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَهۡتَدُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalqa fee alardi rawasiya an tameeda bikum waanharan wasubulan laAAallakum tahtadoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And He has cast into the earth firmly set mountains, lest it shift with you, and [made] rivers and roads, that you may be guided,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He has placed into the earth firm mountains, so it does not shake with you, as well as rivers, and pathways so you may find your way.

ayahs.textArabic: وَعَلَٰمَٰتٖۚ وَبِٱلنَّجۡمِ هُمۡ يَهۡتَدُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: WaAAalamatin wabialnnajmi hum yahtadoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And landmarks. And by the stars they are [also] guided.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Also by landmarks and stars do people find their way.

ayahs.textArabic: أَفَمَن يَخۡلُقُ كَمَن لَّا يَخۡلُقُۚ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Afaman yakhluqu kaman la yakhluqu afala tathakkaroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then is He who creates like one who does not create? So will you not be reminded?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Can the One Who creates be equal to those who do not? Will you not then be mindful?

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِن تَعُدُّواْ نِعۡمَةَ ٱللَّهِ لَا تُحۡصُوهَآۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَغَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wain taAAuddoo niAAmata Allahi la tuhsooha inna Allaha laghafoorun raheemun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And if you should count the favors of Allah, you could not enumerate them. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: If you tried to count Allah’s blessings, you would never be able to number them. Surely Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّونَ وَمَا تُعۡلِنُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: WaAllahu yaAAlamu ma tusirroona wama tuAAlinoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And Allah knows what you conceal and what you declare.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And Allah knows what you conceal and what you reveal.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَا يَخۡلُقُونَ شَيۡـٔٗا وَهُمۡ يُخۡلَقُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waallatheena yadAAoona min dooni Allahi la yakhluqoona shayan wahum yukhlaqoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And those they invoke other than Allah create nothing, and they [themselves] are created.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But those ˹idols˺ they invoke besides Allah cannot create anything—they themselves are created.

ayahs.textArabic: أَمۡوَٰتٌ غَيۡرُ أَحۡيَآءٖۖ وَمَا يَشۡعُرُونَ أَيَّانَ يُبۡعَثُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Amwatun ghayru ahyain wama yashAAuroona ayyana yubAAathoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They are, [in fact], dead, not alive, and they do not perceive when they will be resurrected.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They are dead, not alive—not even knowing when their followers will be resurrected.

ayahs.textArabic: إِلَٰهُكُمۡ إِلَٰهٞ وَٰحِدٞۚ فَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ قُلُوبُهُم مُّنكِرَةٞ وَهُم مُّسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ilahukum ilahun wahidun faallatheena la yuminoona bialakhirati quloobuhum munkiratun wahum mustakbiroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Your god is one God. But those who do not believe in the Hereafter - their hearts are disapproving, and they are arrogant.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Your God is ˹only˺ One God. As for those who do not believe in the Hereafter, their hearts are in denial, and they are too proud.

ayahs.textArabic: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعۡلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعۡلِنُونَۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلۡمُسۡتَكۡبِرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: La jarama anna Allaha yaAAlamu ma yusirroona wama yuAAlinoona innahu la yuhibbu almustakbireena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Assuredly, Allah knows what they conceal and what they declare. Indeed, He does not like the arrogant.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Without a doubt, Allah knows what they conceal and what they reveal. He certainly does not like those who are too proud.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُم مَّاذَآ أَنزَلَ رَبُّكُمۡ قَالُوٓاْ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waitha qeela lahum matha anzala rabbukum qaloo asateeru alawwaleena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when it is said to them, "What has your Lord sent down?" They say, "Legends of the former peoples,"
