ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: When the Hellfire sees them from a distant place, they will hear its fury and roaring.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Once it sees them from a distance, they will hear it fuming and growling.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِذَآ أُلۡقُواْ مِنۡهَا مَكَانٗا ضَيِّقٗا مُّقَرَّنِينَ دَعَوۡاْ هُنَالِكَ ثُبُورٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waitha olqoo minha makanan dayyiqan muqarraneena daAAaw hunalika thubooran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when they are thrown into a narrow place therein bound in chains, they will cry out thereupon for destruction.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And when they are tossed into a narrow place inside ˹Hell˺, chained together, then and there they will cry out for ˹instant˺ destruction.

ayahs.textArabic: لَّا تَدۡعُواْ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ ثُبُورٗا وَٰحِدٗا وَٱدۡعُواْ ثُبُورٗا كَثِيرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: La tadAAoo alyawma thubooran wahidan waodAAoo thubooran katheeran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [They will be told], "Do not cry this Day for one destruction but cry for much destruction."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹They will be told,˺ “Do not cry only once for destruction, but cry many times over!”

ayahs.textArabic: قُلۡ أَذَٰلِكَ خَيۡرٌ أَمۡ جَنَّةُ ٱلۡخُلۡدِ ٱلَّتِي وُعِدَ ٱلۡمُتَّقُونَۚ كَانَتۡ لَهُمۡ جَزَآءٗ وَمَصِيرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qul athalika khayrun am jannatu alkhuldi allatee wuAAida almuttaqoona kanat lahum jazaan wamaseeran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Say, "Is that better or the Garden of Eternity which is promised to the righteous? It will be for them a reward and destination.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Is this better or the Garden of Eternity which the righteous have been promised, as a reward and ˹an ultimate˺ destination?

ayahs.textArabic: لَّهُمۡ فِيهَا مَا يَشَآءُونَ خَٰلِدِينَۚ كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ وَعۡدٗا مَّسۡـُٔولٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Lahum feeha ma yashaoona khalideena kana AAala rabbika waAAdan masoolan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: For them therein is whatever they wish, [while] abiding eternally. It is ever upon your Lord a promise [worthy to be] requested.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: There they will have whatever they wish for, forever. That is a promise ˹to be sought after˺, binding on your Lord.”

ayahs.textArabic: وَيَوۡمَ يَحۡشُرُهُمۡ وَمَا يَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَيَقُولُ ءَأَنتُمۡ أَضۡلَلۡتُمۡ عِبَادِي هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ أَمۡ هُمۡ ضَلُّواْ ٱلسَّبِيلَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wayawma yahshuruhum wama yaAAbudoona min dooni Allahi fayaqoolu aantum adlaltum AAibadee haolai am hum dalloo alssabeela
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [mention] the Day He will gather them and that which they worship besides Allah and will say, "Did you mislead these, My servants, or did they [themselves] stray from the way?"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Watch for˺ the Day He will gather them along with what they used to worship besides Allah, and ask ˹the objects of worship˺, “Was it you who misled these servants of Mine, or did they stray from the Way ˹on their own˺?”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُواْ سُبۡحَٰنَكَ مَا كَانَ يَنۢبَغِي لَنَآ أَن نَّتَّخِذَ مِن دُونِكَ مِنۡ أَوۡلِيَآءَ وَلَٰكِن مَّتَّعۡتَهُمۡ وَءَابَآءَهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ نَسُواْ ٱلذِّكۡرَ وَكَانُواْ قَوۡمَۢا بُورٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qaloo subhanaka ma kana yanbaghee lana an nattakhitha min doonika min awliyaa walakin mattaAAtahum waabaahum hatta nasoo alththikra wakanoo qawman booran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They will say, "Exalted are You! It was not for us to take besides You any allies. But You provided comforts for them and their fathers until they forgot the message and became a people ruined."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They will say, “Glory be to You! It was not right for ˹others like˺ us to take any lords besides You, but You allowed enjoyment for them and their forefathers ˹for so long˺ that they forgot ˹Your˺ remembrance and became a doomed people.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَقَدۡ كَذَّبُوكُم بِمَا تَقُولُونَ فَمَا تَسۡتَطِيعُونَ صَرۡفٗا وَلَا نَصۡرٗاۚ وَمَن يَظۡلِم مِّنكُمۡ نُذِقۡهُ عَذَابٗا كَبِيرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faqad kaththabookum bima taqooloona fama tastateeAAoona sarfan wala nasran waman yathlim minkum nuthiqhu AAathaban kabeeran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So they will deny you, [disbelievers], in what you say, and you cannot avert [punishment] or [find] help. And whoever commits injustice among you - We will make him taste a great punishment.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹The doomed will be told˺, “Your gods have clearly denied your claims. So now you can neither ward off ˹the punishment˺ nor get any help.” And whoever of you does wrong, We will make them taste a horrible punishment.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا قَبۡلَكَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ إِلَّآ إِنَّهُمۡ لَيَأۡكُلُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَيَمۡشُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَسۡوَاقِۗ وَجَعَلۡنَا بَعۡضَكُمۡ لِبَعۡضٖ فِتۡنَةً أَتَصۡبِرُونَۗ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ بَصِيرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama arsalna qablaka mina almursaleena illa innahum layakuloona alttaAAama wayamshoona fee alaswaqi wajaAAalna baAAdakum libaAAdin fitnatan atasbiroona wakana rabbuka baseeran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We did not send before you, [O Muhammad], any of the messengers except that they ate food and walked in the markets. And We have made some of you [people] as trial for others - will you have patience? And ever is your Lord, Seeing.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We never sent any messenger before you ˹O Prophet˺, who did not eat food and go about in market-places. We have made some of you a trial for others. Will you ˹not then˺ be patient? And your Lord is All-Seeing.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَرۡجُونَ لِقَآءَنَا لَوۡلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيۡنَا ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ أَوۡ نَرَىٰ رَبَّنَاۗ لَقَدِ ٱسۡتَكۡبَرُواْ فِيٓ أَنفُسِهِمۡ وَعَتَوۡ عُتُوّٗا كَبِيرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waqala allatheena la yarjoona liqaana lawla onzila AAalayna almalaikatu aw nara rabbana laqadi istakbaroo fee anfusihim waAAataw AAutuwwan kabeeran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And those who do not expect the meeting with Us say, "Why were not angels sent down to us, or [why] do we [not] see our Lord?" They have certainly become arrogant within themselves and [become] insolent with great insolence.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Those who do not expect to meet Us say, “If only the angels were sent down to us, or we could see our Lord!” They have certainly been carried away by their arrogance and have entirely exceeded all limits.

ayahs.textArabic: يَوۡمَ يَرَوۡنَ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ لَا بُشۡرَىٰ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ وَيَقُولُونَ حِجۡرٗا مَّحۡجُورٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yawma yarawna almalaikata la bushra yawmaithin lilmujrimeena wayaqooloona hijran mahjooran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The day they see the angels - no good tidings will there be that day for the criminals, and [the angels] will say, "Prevented and inaccessible."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹But˺ on the Day they will see the angels, there will be no good news for the wicked, who will cry, “Keep away! Away ˹from us˺!”

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَدِمۡنَآ إِلَىٰ مَا عَمِلُواْ مِنۡ عَمَلٖ فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُ هَبَآءٗ مَّنثُورًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waqadimna ila ma AAamiloo min AAamalin fajaAAalnahu habaan manthooran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We will regard what they have done of deeds and make them as dust dispersed.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then We will turn to whatever ˹good˺ deeds they did, reducing them to scattered dust.

ayahs.textArabic: أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ يَوۡمَئِذٍ خَيۡرٞ مُّسۡتَقَرّٗا وَأَحۡسَنُ مَقِيلٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ashabu aljannati yawmaithin khayrun mustaqarran waahsanu maqeelan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The companions of Paradise, that Day, are [in] a better settlement and better resting place.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹But˺ on that Day the residents of Paradise will have the best settlement and the finest place to rest.

ayahs.textArabic: وَيَوۡمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِٱلۡغَمَٰمِ وَنُزِّلَ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ تَنزِيلًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wayawma tashaqqaqu alssamao bialghamami wanuzzila almalaikatu tanzeelan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [mention] the Day when the heaven will split open with [emerging] clouds, and the angels will be sent down in successive descent.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Watch for˺ the Day the heavens will burst with clouds, and the angels will be sent down in successive ranks.

ayahs.textArabic: ٱلۡمُلۡكُ يَوۡمَئِذٍ ٱلۡحَقُّ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِۚ وَكَانَ يَوۡمًا عَلَى ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ عَسِيرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Almulku yawmaithin alhaqqu lilrrahmani wakana yawman AAala alkafireena AAaseeran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: True sovereignty, that Day, is for the Most Merciful. And it will be upon the disbelievers a difficult Day.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: True authority on that Day will belong ˹only˺ to the Most Compassionate. And it will be a hard day for the disbelievers.

ayahs.textArabic: وَيَوۡمَ يَعَضُّ ٱلظَّالِمُ عَلَىٰ يَدَيۡهِ يَقُولُ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي ٱتَّخَذۡتُ مَعَ ٱلرَّسُولِ سَبِيلٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wayawma yaAAaddu alththalimu AAala yadayhi yaqoolu ya laytanee ittakhathtu maAAa alrrasooli sabeelan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the Day the wrongdoer will bite on his hands [in regret] he will say, "Oh, I wish I had taken with the Messenger a way.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And ˹beware of˺ the Day the wrongdoer will bite his nails ˹in regret˺ and say, “Oh! I wish I had followed the Way along with the Messenger!

ayahs.textArabic: يَٰوَيۡلَتَىٰ لَيۡتَنِي لَمۡ أَتَّخِذۡ فُلَانًا خَلِيلٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ya waylata laytanee lam attakhith fulanan khaleelan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Oh, woe to me! I wish I had not taken that one as a friend.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Woe to me! I wish I had never taken so-and-so as a close friend.

ayahs.textArabic: لَّقَدۡ أَضَلَّنِي عَنِ ٱلذِّكۡرِ بَعۡدَ إِذۡ جَآءَنِيۗ وَكَانَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ لِلۡإِنسَٰنِ خَذُولٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Laqad adallanee AAani alththikri baAAda ith jaanee wakana alshshaytanu lilinsani khathoolan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He led me away from the remembrance after it had come to me. And ever is Satan, to man, a deserter."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: It was he who truly made me stray from the Reminder after it had reached me.” And Satan has always betrayed humanity.

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالَ ٱلرَّسُولُ يَٰرَبِّ إِنَّ قَوۡمِي ٱتَّخَذُواْ هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ مَهۡجُورٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waqala alrrasoolu ya rabbi inna qawmee ittakhathoo hatha alqurana mahjooran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the Messenger has said, "O my Lord, indeed my people have taken this Qur'an as [a thing] abandoned."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The Messenger has cried, “O my Lord! My people have indeed received this Quran with neglect.”

ayahs.textArabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ جَعَلۡنَا لِكُلِّ نَبِيٍّ عَدُوّٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِرَبِّكَ هَادِيٗا وَنَصِيرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wakathalika jaAAalna likulli nabiyyin AAaduwwan mina almujrimeena wakafa birabbika hadiyan wanaseeran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And thus have We made for every prophet an enemy from among the criminals. But sufficient is your Lord as a guide and a helper.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Similarly, We made enemies for every prophet from among the wicked, but sufficient is your Lord as a Guide and Helper.

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَوۡلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيۡهِ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانُ جُمۡلَةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗۚ كَذَٰلِكَ لِنُثَبِّتَ بِهِۦ فُؤَادَكَۖ وَرَتَّلۡنَٰهُ تَرۡتِيلٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waqala allatheena kafaroo lawla nuzzila AAalayhi alquranu jumlatan wahidatan kathalika linuthabbita bihi fuadaka warattalnahu tarteelan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And those who disbelieve say, "Why was the Qur'an not revealed to him all at once?" Thus [it is] that We may strengthen thereby your heart. And We have spaced it distinctly.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The disbelievers say, “If only the Quran had been sent down to him all at once!” ˹We have sent it˺ as such ˹in stages˺ so We may reassure your heart with it. And We have revealed it at a deliberate pace.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَا يَأۡتُونَكَ بِمَثَلٍ إِلَّا جِئۡنَٰكَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَأَحۡسَنَ تَفۡسِيرًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wala yatoonaka bimathalin illa jinaka bialhaqqi waahsana tafseeran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And they do not come to you with an argument except that We bring you the truth and the best explanation.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Whenever they bring you an argument, We come to you with the right refutation and the best explanation.

ayahs.textArabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُحۡشَرُونَ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمۡ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ شَرّٞ مَّكَانٗا وَأَضَلُّ سَبِيلٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Allatheena yuhsharoona AAala wujoohihim ila jahannama olaika sharrun makanan waadallu sabeelan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The ones who are gathered on their faces to Hell - those are the worst in position and farthest astray in [their] way.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Those who will be dragged into Hell on their faces will be in the worst place, and are ˹now˺ farthest from the ˹Right˺ Way.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا مُوسَى ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَجَعَلۡنَا مَعَهُۥٓ أَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ وَزِيرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walaqad atayna moosa alkitaba wajaAAalna maAAahu akhahu haroona wazeeran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We had certainly given Moses the Scripture and appointed with him his brother Aaron as an assistant.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We certainly gave Moses the Book and appointed his brother Aaron as his helper.

ayahs.textArabic: فَقُلۡنَا ٱذۡهَبَآ إِلَى ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَدَمَّرۡنَٰهُمۡ تَدۡمِيرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faqulna ithhaba ila alqawmi allatheena kaththaboo biayatina fadammarnahum tadmeeran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We said, "Go both of you to the people who have denied Our signs." Then We destroyed them with [complete] destruction.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We had ordered ˹them˺, “Go to the people who would deny Our signs.” Then We annihilated the deniers entirely.

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَوۡمَ نُوحٖ لَّمَّا كَذَّبُواْ ٱلرُّسُلَ أَغۡرَقۡنَٰهُمۡ وَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمۡ لِلنَّاسِ ءَايَةٗۖ وَأَعۡتَدۡنَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ عَذَابًا أَلِيمٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waqawma noohin lamma kaththaboo alrrusula aghraqnahum wajaAAalnahum lilnnasi ayatan waaAAtadna lilththalimeena AAathaban aleeman
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the people of Noah - when they denied the messengers, We drowned them, and We made them for mankind a sign. And We have prepared for the wrongdoers a painful punishment.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And when the people of Noah rejected the messengers, We drowned them, making them an example to humanity. And We have prepared a painful punishment for the wrongdoers.

ayahs.textArabic: وَعَادٗا وَثَمُودَاْ وَأَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلرَّسِّ وَقُرُونَۢا بَيۡنَ ذَٰلِكَ كَثِيرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: WaAAadan wathamooda waashaba alrrassi waquroonan bayna thalika katheeran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [We destroyed] 'Aad and Thamud and the companions of the well and many generations between them.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Also ˹We destroyed˺ ’Ȃd, Thamûd, and the people of the Water-pit, as well as many peoples in between.

ayahs.textArabic: وَكُلّٗا ضَرَبۡنَا لَهُ ٱلۡأَمۡثَٰلَۖ وَكُلّٗا تَبَّرۡنَا تَتۡبِيرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wakullan darabna lahu alamthala wakullan tabbarna tatbeeran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And for each We presented examples [as warnings], and each We destroyed with [total] destruction.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: For each We set forth ˹various˺ lessons, and We ultimately destroyed each.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَتَوۡاْ عَلَى ٱلۡقَرۡيَةِ ٱلَّتِيٓ أُمۡطِرَتۡ مَطَرَ ٱلسَّوۡءِۚ أَفَلَمۡ يَكُونُواْ يَرَوۡنَهَاۚ بَلۡ كَانُواْ لَا يَرۡجُونَ نُشُورٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walaqad ataw AAala alqaryati allatee omtirat matara alssawi afalam yakoonoo yarawnaha bal kanoo la yarjoona nushooran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And they have already come upon the town which was showered with a rain of evil. So have they not seen it? But they are not expecting resurrection.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They have certainly passed by the city ˹of Sodom˺, which had been showered with a dreadful rain ˹of stones˺. Have they not seen its ruins? But they do not expect to be resurrected.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِذَا رَأَوۡكَ إِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي بَعَثَ ٱللَّهُ رَسُولًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waitha raawka in yattakhithoonaka illa huzuwan ahatha allathee baAAatha Allahu rasoolan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when they see you, [O Muhammad], they take you not except in ridicule, [saying], "Is this the one whom Allah has sent as a messenger?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: When they see you ˹O Prophet˺, they only make fun of you, ˹saying,˺ “Is this the one that Allah has sent as a messenger?

ayahs.textArabic: إِن كَادَ لَيُضِلُّنَا عَنۡ ءَالِهَتِنَا لَوۡلَآ أَن صَبَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهَاۚ وَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُونَ حِينَ يَرَوۡنَ ٱلۡعَذَابَ مَنۡ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: In kada layudilluna AAan alihatina lawla an sabarna AAalayha wasawfa yaAAlamoona heena yarawna alAAathaba man adallu sabeelan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He almost would have misled us from our gods had we not been steadfast in [worship of] them." But they are going to know, when they see the punishment, who is farthest astray in [his] way.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He would have almost tricked us away from our gods, had we not been so devoted to them.” ˹But˺ soon they will know, when they face the punishment, who is far astray from the ˹Right˺ Way.

ayahs.textArabic: أَرَءَيۡتَ مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَٰهَهُۥ هَوَىٰهُ أَفَأَنتَ تَكُونُ عَلَيۡهِ وَكِيلًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Araayta mani ittakhatha ilahahu hawahu afaanta takoonu AAalayhi wakeelan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Have you seen the one who takes as his god his own desire? Then would you be responsible for him?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Have you seen ˹O Prophet˺ the one who has taken their own desires as their god? Will you then be a keeper over them?

ayahs.textArabic: أَمۡ تَحۡسَبُ أَنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ يَسۡمَعُونَ أَوۡ يَعۡقِلُونَۚ إِنۡ هُمۡ إِلَّا كَٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ بَلۡ هُمۡ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Am tahsabu anna aktharahum yasmaAAoona aw yaAAqiloona in hum illa kaalanAAami bal hum adallu sabeelan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Or do you think that most of them hear or reason? They are not except like livestock. Rather, they are [even] more astray in [their] way.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Or do you think that most of them listen or understand? They are only like cattle—no, more than that, they are astray from the ˹Right˺ Way!

ayahs.textArabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَيۡفَ مَدَّ ٱلظِّلَّ وَلَوۡ شَآءَ لَجَعَلَهُۥ سَاكِنٗا ثُمَّ جَعَلۡنَا ٱلشَّمۡسَ عَلَيۡهِ دَلِيلٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Alam tara ila rabbika kayfa madda alththilla walaw shaa lajaAAalahu sakinan thumma jaAAalna alshshamsa AAalayhi daleelan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Have you not considered your Lord - how He extends the shadow, and if He willed, He could have made it stationary? Then We made the sun for it an indication.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Have you not seen how your Lord extends the shade—He could have simply made it ˹remain˺ still if He so willed—then We make the sun its guide,

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ قَبَضۡنَٰهُ إِلَيۡنَا قَبۡضٗا يَسِيرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thumma qabadnahu ilayna qabdan yaseeran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then We hold it in hand for a brief grasp.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: causing the shade to retreat gradually?

ayahs.textArabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيۡلَ لِبَاسٗا وَٱلنَّوۡمَ سُبَاتٗا وَجَعَلَ ٱلنَّهَارَ نُشُورٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wahuwa allathee jaAAala lakumu allayla libasan waalnnawma subatan wajaAAala alnnahara nushooran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And it is He who has made the night for you as clothing and sleep [a means for] rest and has made the day a resurrection.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He is the One Who has made the night for you as a cover, and ˹made˺ sleep for resting, and the day for rising.

ayahs.textArabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَرۡسَلَ ٱلرِّيَٰحَ بُشۡرَۢا بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡ رَحۡمَتِهِۦۚ وَأَنزَلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ طَهُورٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wahuwa allathee arsala alrriyaha bushran bayna yaday rahmatihi waanzalna mina alssamai maan tahooran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And it is He who sends the winds as good tidings before His mercy, and We send down from the sky pure water
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And He is the One Who sends the winds ushering in His mercy, and We send down pure rain from the sky,

ayahs.textArabic: لِّنُحۡـِۧيَ بِهِۦ بَلۡدَةٗ مَّيۡتٗا وَنُسۡقِيَهُۥ مِمَّا خَلَقۡنَآ أَنۡعَٰمٗا وَأَنَاسِيَّ كَثِيرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Linuhyiya bihi baldatan maytan wanusqiyahu mimma khalaqna anAAaman waanasiyya katheeran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: That We may bring to life thereby a dead land and give it as drink to those We created of numerous livestock and men.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: giving life to a lifeless land, and providing water for countless animals and humans of Our Own creation.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدۡ صَرَّفۡنَٰهُ بَيۡنَهُمۡ لِيَذَّكَّرُواْ فَأَبَىٰٓ أَكۡثَرُ ٱلنَّاسِ إِلَّا كُفُورٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walaqad sarrafnahu baynahum liyaththakkaroo faaba aktharu alnnasi illa kufooran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We have certainly distributed it among them that they might be reminded, but most of the people refuse except disbelief.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We certainly disperse it among them so they may be mindful, but most people persist in ungratefulness.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَوۡ شِئۡنَا لَبَعَثۡنَا فِي كُلِّ قَرۡيَةٖ نَّذِيرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walaw shina labaAAathna fee kulli qaryatin natheeran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And if We had willed, We could have sent into every city a warner.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Had We willed, We could have easily sent a warner to every society.

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ وَجَٰهِدۡهُم بِهِۦ جِهَادٗا كَبِيرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fala tutiAAi alkafireena wajahidhum bihi jihadan kabeeran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So do not obey the disbelievers, and strive against them with the Qur'an a great striving.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So do not yield to the disbelievers, but strive diligently against them with this ˹Quran˺.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي مَرَجَ ٱلۡبَحۡرَيۡنِ هَٰذَا عَذۡبٞ فُرَاتٞ وَهَٰذَا مِلۡحٌ أُجَاجٞ وَجَعَلَ بَيۡنَهُمَا بَرۡزَخٗا وَحِجۡرٗا مَّحۡجُورٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wahuwa allathee maraja albahrayni hatha AAathbun furatun wahatha milhun ojajun wajaAAala baynahuma barzakhan wahijran mahjooran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And it is He who has released [simultaneously] the two seas, one fresh and sweet and one salty and bitter, and He placed between them a barrier and prohibiting partition.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And He is the One Who merges the two bodies of water: one fresh and palatable and the other salty and bitter, placing between them a barrier they cannot cross.

ayahs.textArabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ مِنَ ٱلۡمَآءِ بَشَرٗا فَجَعَلَهُۥ نَسَبٗا وَصِهۡرٗاۗ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ قَدِيرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wahuwa allathee khalaqa mina almai basharan fajaAAalahu nasaban wasihran wakana rabbuka qadeeran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And it is He who has created from water a human being and made him [a relative by] lineage and marriage. And ever is your Lord competent [concerning creation].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And He is the One Who creates human beings from a ˹humble˺ liquid, then establishes for them bonds of kinship and marriage. For your Lord is Most Capable.

ayahs.textArabic: وَيَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُهُمۡ وَلَا يَضُرُّهُمۡۗ وَكَانَ ٱلۡكَافِرُ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ ظَهِيرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: WayaAAbudoona min dooni Allahi ma la yanfaAAuhum wala yadurruhum wakana alkafiru AAala rabbihi thaheeran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But they worship rather than Allah that which does not benefit them or harm them, and the disbeliever is ever, against his Lord, an assistant [to Satan].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Yet they worship besides Allah what can neither benefit nor harm them. And the disbeliever always collaborates against their Lord.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰكَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرٗا وَنَذِيرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama arsalnaka illa mubashshiran wanatheeran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a bringer of good tidings and a warner.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And We have sent you ˹O Prophet˺ only as a deliverer of good news and a warner.

ayahs.textArabic: قُلۡ مَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍ إِلَّا مَن شَآءَ أَن يَتَّخِذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qul ma asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin illa man shaa an yattakhitha ila rabbihi sabeelan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Say, "I do not ask of you for it any payment - only that whoever wills might take to his Lord a way."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Say, “I do not ask you for any reward for this ˹message˺, but whoever wishes, let them pursue the Way to their Lord.”

ayahs.textArabic: وَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَى ٱلۡحَيِّ ٱلَّذِي لَا يَمُوتُ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِهِۦۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِهِۦ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Watawakkal AAala alhayyi allathee la yamootu wasabbih bihamdihi wakafa bihi bithunoobi AAibadihi khabeeran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And rely upon the Ever-Living who does not die, and exalt [Allah] with His praise. And sufficient is He to be, with the sins of His servants, Acquainted -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Put your trust in the Ever-Living, Who never dies, and glorify His praises. Sufficient is He as All-Aware of the sins of His servants.

ayahs.textArabic: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٖ ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلۡعَرۡشِۖ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ فَسۡـَٔلۡ بِهِۦ خَبِيرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Allathee khalaqa alssamawati waalarda wama baynahuma fee sittati ayyamin thumma istawa AAala alAAarshi alrrahmanu faisal bihi khabeeran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He who created the heavens and the earth and what is between them in six days and then established Himself above the Throne - the Most Merciful, so ask about Him one well informed.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹He is˺ the One Who created the heavens and the earth and everything in between in six Days, then established Himself on the Throne. ˹He is˺ the Most Compassionate! Ask ˹none other than˺ the All-Knowledgeable about Himself.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱسۡجُدُواْۤ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ قَالُواْ وَمَا ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ أَنَسۡجُدُ لِمَا تَأۡمُرُنَا وَزَادَهُمۡ نُفُورٗا۩
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waitha qeela lahumu osjudoo lilrrahmani qaloo wama alrrahmanu anasjudu lima tamuruna wazadahum nufooran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when it is said to them, "Prostrate to the Most Merciful," they say, "And what is the Most Merciful? Should we prostrate to that which you order us?" And it increases them in aversion.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: When it is said to them, “Prostrate to the Most Compassionate,” they ask ˹in disgust˺, “What is ‘the Most Compassionate’? Will we prostrate to whatever you order us to?” And it only drives them farther away.

ayahs.textArabic: تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجٗا وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا سِرَٰجٗا وَقَمَرٗا مُّنِيرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Tabaraka allathee jaAAala fee alssamai buroojan wajaAAala feeha sirajan waqamaran muneeran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Blessed is He who has placed in the sky great stars and placed therein a [burning] lamp and luminous moon.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Blessed is the One Who has placed constellations in the sky, as well as a ˹radiant˺ lamp and a luminous moon.

ayahs.textArabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ ٱلَّيۡلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ خِلۡفَةٗ لِّمَنۡ أَرَادَ أَن يَذَّكَّرَ أَوۡ أَرَادَ شُكُورٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wahuwa allathee jaAAala allayla waalnnahara khilfatan liman arada an yaththakkara aw arada shukooran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And it is He who has made the night and the day in succession for whoever desires to remember or desires gratitude.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And He is the One Who causes the day and the night to alternate, ˹as a sign˺ for whoever desires to be mindful or to be grateful.

ayahs.textArabic: وَعِبَادُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَمۡشُونَ عَلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ هَوۡنٗا وَإِذَا خَاطَبَهُمُ ٱلۡجَٰهِلُونَ قَالُواْ سَلَٰمٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: WaAAibadu alrrahmani allatheena yamshoona AAala alardi hawnan waitha khatabahumu aljahiloona qaloo salaman
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily, and when the ignorant address them [harshly], they say [words of] peace,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The ˹true˺ servants of the Most Compassionate are those who walk on the earth humbly, and when the foolish address them ˹improperly˺, they only respond with peace.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَبِيتُونَ لِرَبِّهِمۡ سُجَّدٗا وَقِيَٰمٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waallatheena yabeetoona lirabbihim sujjadan waqiyaman
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And those who spend [part of] the night to their Lord prostrating and standing [in prayer]
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹They are˺ those who spend ˹a good portion of˺ the night, prostrating themselves and standing before their Lord.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا ٱصۡرِفۡ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَۖ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waallatheena yaqooloona rabbana isrif AAanna AAathaba jahannama inna AAathabaha kana gharaman
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And those who say, "Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is ever adhering;
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹They are˺ those who pray, “Our Lord! Keep the punishment of Hell away from us, for its punishment is indeed unrelenting.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّهَا سَآءَتۡ مُسۡتَقَرّٗا وَمُقَامٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innaha saat mustaqarran wamuqaman
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, it is evil as a settlement and residence."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: It is certainly an evil place to settle and reside.”

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَنفَقُواْ لَمۡ يُسۡرِفُواْ وَلَمۡ يَقۡتُرُواْ وَكَانَ بَيۡنَ ذَٰلِكَ قَوَامٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waallatheena itha anfaqoo lam yusrifoo walam yaqturoo wakana bayna thalika qawaman
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [they are] those who, when they spend, do so not excessively or sparingly but are ever, between that, [justly] moderate
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹They are˺ those who spend neither wastefully nor stingily, but moderately in between.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَدۡعُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ وَلَا يَقۡتُلُونَ ٱلنَّفۡسَ ٱلَّتِي حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَا يَزۡنُونَۚ وَمَن يَفۡعَلۡ ذَٰلِكَ يَلۡقَ أَثَامٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waallatheena la yadAAoona maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara wala yaqtuloona alnnafsa allatee harrama Allahu illa bialhaqqi wala yaznoona waman yafAAal thalika yalqa athaman
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And those who do not invoke with Allah another deity or kill the soul which Allah has forbidden [to be killed], except by right, and do not commit unlawful sexual intercourse. And whoever should do that will meet a penalty.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹They are˺ those who do not invoke any other god besides Allah, nor take a ˹human˺ life—made sacred by Allah—except with ˹legal˺ right, nor commit fornication. And whoever does ˹any of˺ this will face the penalty.

ayahs.textArabic: يُضَٰعَفۡ لَهُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ وَيَخۡلُدۡ فِيهِۦ مُهَانًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: YudaAAaf lahu alAAathabu yawma alqiyamati wayakhlud feehi muhanan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Multiplied for him is the punishment on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide therein humiliated -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Their punishment will be multiplied on the Day of Judgment, and they will remain in it forever, in disgrace.

ayahs.textArabic: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلٗا صَٰلِحٗا فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمۡ حَسَنَٰتٖۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورٗا رَّحِيمٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Illa man taba waamana waAAamila AAamalan salihan faolaika yubaddilu Allahu sayyiatihim hasanatin wakana Allahu ghafooran raheeman
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Except for those who repent, believe and do righteous work. For them Allah will replace their evil deeds with good. And ever is Allah Forgiving and Merciful.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: As for those who repent, believe, and do good deeds, they are the ones whose evil deeds Allah will change into good deeds. For Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَن تَابَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحٗا فَإِنَّهُۥ يَتُوبُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَتَابٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waman taba waAAamila salihan fainnahu yatoobu ila Allahi mataban
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And he who repents and does righteousness does indeed turn to Allah with [accepted] repentance.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And whoever repents and does good has truly turned to Allah properly.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَشۡهَدُونَ ٱلزُّورَ وَإِذَا مَرُّواْ بِٱللَّغۡوِ مَرُّواْ كِرَامٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waallatheena la yashhadoona alzzoora waitha marroo biallaghwi marroo kiraman
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [they are] those who do not testify to falsehood, and when they pass near ill speech, they pass by with dignity.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹They are˺ those who do not bear false witness, and when they come across falsehood, they pass ˹it˺ by with dignity.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ لَمۡ يَخِرُّواْ عَلَيۡهَا صُمّٗا وَعُمۡيَانٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waallatheena itha thukkiroo biayati rabbihim lam yakhirroo AAalayha summan waAAumyanan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And those who, when reminded of the verses of their Lord, do not fall upon them deaf and blind.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹They are˺ those who, when reminded of the revelation of their Lord, do not turn a blind eye or a deaf ear to it.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا هَبۡ لَنَا مِنۡ أَزۡوَٰجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعۡيُنٖ وَٱجۡعَلۡنَا لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waallatheena yaqooloona rabbana hab lana min azwajina wathurriyyatina qurrata aAAyunin waijAAalna lilmuttaqeena imaman
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And those who say, "Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us an example for the righteous."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹They are˺ those who pray, “Our Lord! Bless us with ˹pious˺ spouses and offspring who will be the joy of our hearts, and make us models for the righteous.”

ayahs.textArabic: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ يُجۡزَوۡنَ ٱلۡغُرۡفَةَ بِمَا صَبَرُواْ وَيُلَقَّوۡنَ فِيهَا تَحِيَّةٗ وَسَلَٰمًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Olaika yujzawna alghurfata bima sabaroo wayulaqqawna feeha tahiyyatan wasalaman
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Those will be awarded the Chamber for what they patiently endured, and they will be received therein with greetings and [words of] peace.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: It is they who will be rewarded with ˹elevated˺ mansions ˹in Paradise˺ for their perseverance, and will be received with salutations and ˹greetings of˺ peace,

ayahs.textArabic: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۚ حَسُنَتۡ مُسۡتَقَرّٗا وَمُقَامٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Khalideena feeha hasunat mustaqarran wamuqaman
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Abiding eternally therein. Good is the settlement and residence.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: staying there forever. What an excellent place to settle and reside!

ayahs.textArabic: قُلۡ مَا يَعۡبَؤُاْ بِكُمۡ رَبِّي لَوۡلَا دُعَآؤُكُمۡۖ فَقَدۡ كَذَّبۡتُمۡ فَسَوۡفَ يَكُونُ لِزَامَۢا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qul ma yaAAbao bikum rabbee lawla duAAaokum faqad kaththabtum fasawfa yakoonu lizaman
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Say, "What would my Lord care for you if not for your supplication?" For you [disbelievers] have denied, so your denial is going to be adherent.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “You ˹all˺ would not ˹even˺ matter to my Lord were it not for your faith ˹in Him˺. But now you ˹disbelievers˺ have denied ˹the truth˺, so the torment is bound to come.”

ayahs.textArabic: طسٓمٓ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Taseenmeem
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Ta, Seen, Meem.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Ṭâ-Sĩn-Mĩm.

ayahs.textArabic: تِلۡكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ ٱلۡمُبِينِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Tilka ayatu alkitabi almubeeni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: These are the verses of the clear Book.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: These are the verses of the clear Book.

ayahs.textArabic: لَعَلَّكَ بَٰخِعٞ نَّفۡسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُواْ مُؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: LaAAallaka bakhiAAun nafsaka alla yakoonoo mumineena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Perhaps, [O Muhammad], you would kill yourself with grief that they will not be believers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Perhaps you ˹O Prophet˺ will grieve yourself to death over their disbelief.

ayahs.textArabic: إِن نَّشَأۡ نُنَزِّلۡ عَلَيۡهِم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ ءَايَةٗ فَظَلَّتۡ أَعۡنَٰقُهُمۡ لَهَا خَٰضِعِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: In nasha nunazzil AAalayhim mina alssamai ayatan fathallat aAAnaquhum laha khadiAAeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: If We willed, We could send down to them from the sky a sign for which their necks would remain humbled.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: If We willed, We could send down upon them a ˹compelling˺ sign from the heavens, leaving their necks bent in ˹utter˺ submission to it.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا يَأۡتِيهِم مِّن ذِكۡرٖ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ مُحۡدَثٍ إِلَّا كَانُواْ عَنۡهُ مُعۡرِضِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama yateehim min thikrin mina alrrahmani muhdathin illa kanoo AAanhu muAArideena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And no revelation comes to them anew from the Most Merciful except that they turn away from it.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Whatever new reminder comes to them from the Most Compassionate, they always turn away from it.

ayahs.textArabic: فَقَدۡ كَذَّبُواْ فَسَيَأۡتِيهِمۡ أَنۢبَٰٓؤُاْ مَا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faqad kaththaboo fasayateehim anbao ma kanoo bihi yastahzioona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: For they have already denied, but there will come to them the news of that which they used to ridicule.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They have certainly denied ˹the truth˺, so they will soon face the consequences of their ridicule.

ayahs.textArabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ إِلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ كَمۡ أَنۢبَتۡنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوۡجٖ كَرِيمٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Awalam yaraw ila alardi kam anbatna feeha min kulli zawjin kareemin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Did they not look at the earth - how much We have produced therein from every noble kind?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Have they failed to look at the earth, ˹to see˺ how many types of fine plants We have caused to grow in it?

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Surely in this is a sign. Yet most of them would not believe.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wainna rabbaka lahuwa alAAazeezu alrraheemu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And your Lord is certainly the Almighty, Most Merciful.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِذۡ نَادَىٰ رَبُّكَ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱئۡتِ ٱلۡقَوۡمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waith nada rabbuka moosa ani iti alqawma alththalimeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [mention] when your Lord called Moses, [saying], "Go to the wrongdoing people -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Remember˺ when your Lord called out to Moses, “Go to the wrongdoing people—

ayahs.textArabic: قَوۡمَ فِرۡعَوۡنَۚ أَلَا يَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qawma firAAawna ala yattaqoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear Allah?"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: the people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear ˹Allah˺?”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala rabbi innee akhafu an yukaththibooni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He said, "My Lord, indeed I fear that they will deny me
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He replied, “My Lord! I fear that they will reject me.

ayahs.textArabic: وَيَضِيقُ صَدۡرِي وَلَا يَنطَلِقُ لِسَانِي فَأَرۡسِلۡ إِلَىٰ هَٰرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wayadeequ sadree wala yantaliqu lisanee faarsil ila haroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And that my breast will tighten and my tongue will not be fluent, so send for Aaron.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And ˹so˺ my heart will be broken and my tongue will be tied. So send Aaron along ˹as a messenger˺.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَهُمۡ عَلَيَّ ذَنۢبٞ فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقۡتُلُونِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walahum AAalayya thanbun faakhafu an yaqtulooni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And they have upon me a [claim due to] sin, so I fear that they will kill me."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Also, they have a charge against me, so I fear they may kill me.”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ كـَلَّاۖ فَٱذۡهَبَا بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآۖ إِنَّا مَعَكُم مُّسۡتَمِعُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala kalla faithhaba biayatina inna maAAakum mustamiAAoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Allah] said, "No. Go both of you with Our signs; indeed, We are with you, listening.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Allah responded, “Certainly not! So go, both of you, with Our signs. We will be with you, listening.

ayahs.textArabic: فَأۡتِيَا فِرۡعَوۡنَ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fatiya firAAawna faqoola inna rasoolu rabbi alAAalameena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Go to Pharaoh and say, 'We are the messengers of the Lord of the worlds,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Go to Pharaoh and say, ‘We are messengers from the Lord of all worlds,

ayahs.textArabic: أَنۡ أَرۡسِلۡ مَعَنَا بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: An arsil maAAana banee israeela
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Commanded to say], "Send with us the Children of Israel."'"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹commanded to say:˺ ‘Let the Children of Israel go with us.’’”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ أَلَمۡ نُرَبِّكَ فِينَا وَلِيدٗا وَلَبِثۡتَ فِينَا مِنۡ عُمُرِكَ سِنِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala alam nurabbika feena waleedan walabithta feena min AAumurika sineena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Pharaoh] said, "Did we not raise you among us as a child, and you remained among us for years of your life?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Pharaoh protested, “Did we not raise you among us as a child, and you stayed several years of your life in our care?

ayahs.textArabic: وَفَعَلۡتَ فَعۡلَتَكَ ٱلَّتِي فَعَلۡتَ وَأَنتَ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: WafaAAalta faAAlataka allatee faAAalta waanta mina alkafireena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [then] you did your deed which you did, and you were of the ungrateful."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then you did what you did, being ˹utterly˺ ungrateful!”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ فَعَلۡتُهَآ إِذٗا وَأَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala faAAaltuha ithan waana mina alddalleena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Moses] said, "I did it, then, while I was of those astray.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Moses replied, “I did it then, lacking guidance.

ayahs.textArabic: فَفَرَرۡتُ مِنكُمۡ لَمَّا خِفۡتُكُمۡ فَوَهَبَ لِي رَبِّي حُكۡمٗا وَجَعَلَنِي مِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fafarartu minkum lamma khiftukum fawahaba lee rabbee hukman wajaAAalanee mina almursaleena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So I fled from you when I feared you. Then my Lord granted me wisdom and prophethood and appointed me [as one] of the messengers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So I fled from you when I feared you. Then my Lord granted me wisdom and made me one of the messengers.

ayahs.textArabic: وَتِلۡكَ نِعۡمَةٞ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَيَّ أَنۡ عَبَّدتَّ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Watilka niAAmatun tamunnuha AAalayya an AAabbadta banee israeela
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And is this a favor of which you remind me - that you have enslaved the Children of Israel?"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: How can that be a ‘favour,’ of which you remind me, when ˹it was only because˺ you ˹have˺ enslaved the Children of Israel?”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ وَمَا رَبُّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala firAAawnu wama rabbu alAAalameena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Said Pharaoh, "And what is the Lord of the worlds?"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Pharaoh asked, “And what is ‘the Lord of all worlds’?”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala rabbu alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma in kuntum mooqineena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Moses] said, "The Lord of the heavens and earth and that between them, if you should be convinced."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Moses replied, “˹He is˺ the Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything in between, if only you had sure faith.”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ لِمَنۡ حَوۡلَهُۥٓ أَلَا تَسۡتَمِعُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala liman hawlahu ala tastamiAAoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Pharaoh] said to those around him, "Do you not hear?"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Pharaoh said to those around him, “Did you hear ˹what he said˺?”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ رَبُّكُمۡ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala rabbukum warabbu abaikumu alawwaleena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Moses] said, "Your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Moses added, “˹He is˺ your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers.”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ ٱلَّذِيٓ أُرۡسِلَ إِلَيۡكُمۡ لَمَجۡنُونٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala inna rasoolakumu allathee orsila ilaykum lamajnoonun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Pharaoh] said, "Indeed, your 'messenger' who has been sent to you is mad."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Pharaoh said ˹mockingly˺, “Your messenger, who has been sent to you, must be insane.”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقِ وَٱلۡمَغۡرِبِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآۖ إِن كُنتُمۡ تَعۡقِلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala rabbu almashriqi waalmaghribi wama baynahuma in kuntum taAAqiloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Moses] said, "Lord of the east and the west and that between them, if you were to reason."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Moses responded: “˹He is˺ the Lord of the east and west, and everything in between, if only you had any sense.”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ لَئِنِ ٱتَّخَذۡتَ إِلَٰهًا غَيۡرِي لَأَجۡعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلۡمَسۡجُونِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala laini ittakhathta ilahan ghayree laajAAalannaka mina almasjooneena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Pharaoh] said, "If you take a god other than me, I will surely place you among those imprisoned."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Pharaoh threatened, “If you take any other god besides me, I will certainly have you imprisoned.”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ أَوَلَوۡ جِئۡتُكَ بِشَيۡءٖ مُّبِينٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala awalaw jituka bishayin mubeenin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Moses] said, "Even if I brought you proof manifest?"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Moses responded, “Even if I bring you a clear proof?”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ فَأۡتِ بِهِۦٓ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala fati bihi in kunta mina alssadiqeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Pharaoh] said, "Then bring it, if you should be of the truthful."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Pharaoh demanded, “Bring it then, if what you say is true.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَأَلۡقَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ ثُعۡبَانٞ مُّبِينٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faalqa AAasahu faitha hiya thuAAbanun mubeenun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So [Moses] threw his staff, and suddenly it was a serpent manifest.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So he threw down his staff and—behold!—it became a real snake.

ayahs.textArabic: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُۥ فَإِذَا هِيَ بَيۡضَآءُ لِلنَّٰظِرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: WanazaAAa yadahu faitha hiya baydao lilnnathireena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And he drew out his hand; thereupon it was white for the observers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then he drew his hand ˹out of his collar˺ and it was ˹shining˺ white for all to see.

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ لِلۡمَلَإِ حَوۡلَهُۥٓ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَسَٰحِرٌ عَلِيمٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala lilmalai hawlahu inna hatha lasahirun AAaleemun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Pharaoh] said to the eminent ones around him, "Indeed, this is a learned magician.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Pharaoh said to the chiefs around him, “He is indeed a skilled magician,

ayahs.textArabic: يُرِيدُ أَن يُخۡرِجَكُم مِّنۡ أَرۡضِكُم بِسِحۡرِهِۦ فَمَاذَا تَأۡمُرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yureedu an yukhrijakum min ardikum bisihrihi famatha tamuroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He wants to drive you out of your land by his magic, so what do you advise?"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: who seeks to drive you from your land by his magic. So what do you propose?”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُوٓاْ أَرۡجِهۡ وَأَخَاهُ وَٱبۡعَثۡ فِي ٱلۡمَدَآئِنِ حَٰشِرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qaloo arjih waakhahu waibAAath fee almadaini hashireena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They said, "Postpone [the matter of] him and his brother and send among the cities gatherers
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They replied, “Let him and his brother wait and dispatch mobilizers to all cities

ayahs.textArabic: يَأۡتُوكَ بِكُلِّ سَحَّارٍ عَلِيمٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yatooka bikulli sahharin AAaleemin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Who will bring you every learned, skilled magician."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: to bring you every skilled magician.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَجُمِعَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ لِمِيقَٰتِ يَوۡمٖ مَّعۡلُومٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: FajumiAAa alssaharatu limeeqati yawmin maAAloomin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So the magicians were assembled for the appointment of a well-known day.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So the magicians were assembled at the set time on the appointed day.

ayahs.textArabic: وَقِيلَ لِلنَّاسِ هَلۡ أَنتُم مُّجۡتَمِعُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waqeela lilnnasi hal antum mujtamiAAoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And it was said to the people, "Will you congregate
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And the people were asked, “Will you join the gathering,

ayahs.textArabic: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ ٱلسَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُواْ هُمُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: LaAAallana nattabiAAu alssaharata in kanoo humu alghalibeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: That we might follow the magicians if they are the predominant?"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: so that we may follow the magicians if they prevail?”

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالُواْ لِفِرۡعَوۡنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجۡرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحۡنُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Falamma jaa alssaharatu qaloo lifirAAawna ainna lana laajran in kunna nahnu alghalibeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when the magicians arrived, they said to Pharaoh, "Is there indeed for us a reward if we are the predominant?"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: When the magicians came, they asked Pharaoh, “Shall we have a ˹suitable˺ reward if we prevail?”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ نَعَمۡ وَإِنَّكُمۡ إِذٗا لَّمِنَ ٱلۡمُقَرَّبِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala naAAam wainnakum ithan lamina almuqarrabeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He said, "Yes, and indeed, you will then be of those near [to me]."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He replied, “Yes, and you will then certainly be among those closest to me.”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلۡقُواْ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلۡقُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala lahum moosa alqoo ma antum mulqoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Moses said to them, "Throw whatever you will throw."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Moses said to them, “Cast whatever you wish to cast.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَأَلۡقَوۡاْ حِبَالَهُمۡ وَعِصِيَّهُمۡ وَقَالُواْ بِعِزَّةِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِنَّا لَنَحۡنُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faalqaw hibalahum waAAisiyyahum waqaloo biAAizzati firAAawna inna lanahnu alghaliboona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So they threw their ropes and their staffs and said, "By the might of Pharaoh, indeed it is we who are predominant."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So they cast down their ropes and staffs, saying, “By Pharaoh’s might, it is we who will surely prevail.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَأَلۡقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَلۡقَفُ مَا يَأۡفِكُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faalqa moosa AAasahu faitha hiya talqafu ma yafikoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then Moses threw his staff, and at once it devoured what they falsified.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then Moses threw down his staff, and—behold!—it devoured the objects of their illusion!

ayahs.textArabic: فَأُلۡقِيَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سَٰجِدِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faolqiya alssaharatu sajideena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So the magicians fell down in prostration [to Allah].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So the magicians fell down, prostrating.

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qaloo amanna birabbi alAAalameena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They said, "We have believed in the Lord of the worlds,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They declared, “We ˹now˺ believe in the Lord of all worlds—

ayahs.textArabic: رَبِّ مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Rabbi moosa waharoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The Lord of Moses and Aaron."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: the Lord of Moses and Aaron.”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمۡ لَهُۥ قَبۡلَ أَنۡ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمۡۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِي عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحۡرَ فَلَسَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُونَۚ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيۡدِيَكُمۡ وَأَرۡجُلَكُم مِّنۡ خِلَٰفٖ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala amantum lahu qabla an athana lakum innahu lakabeerukumu allathee AAallamakumu alssihra falasawfa taAAlamoona laoqattiAAanna aydiyakum waarjulakum min khilafin walaosallibannakum ajmaAAeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed Moses before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic, but you are going to know. I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will surely crucify you all."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Pharaoh threatened, “How dare you believe in him before I give you permission? He must be your master who taught you magic, but soon you will see. I will certainly cut off your hands and feet on opposite sides, then crucify you all.”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُواْ لَا ضَيۡرَۖ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qaloo la dayra inna ila rabbina munqaliboona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They said, "No harm. Indeed, to our Lord we will return.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They responded, “˹That would be˺ no harm! Surely to our Lord we will ˹all˺ return.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّا نَطۡمَعُ أَن يَغۡفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَٰيَٰنَآ أَن كُنَّآ أَوَّلَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna natmaAAu an yaghfira lana rabbuna khatayana an kunna awwala almumineena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, we aspire that our Lord will forgive us our sins because we were the first of the believers."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We really hope that our Lord will forgive our sins, as we are the first to believe.”

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ وَأَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنۡ أَسۡرِ بِعِبَادِيٓ إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waawhayna ila moosa an asri biAAibadee innakum muttabaAAoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants; indeed, you will be pursued."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And We inspired Moses, ˹saying,˺ “Leave with My servants at night, for you will surely be pursued.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَأَرۡسَلَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ فِي ٱلۡمَدَآئِنِ حَٰشِرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faarsala firAAawnu fee almadaini hashireena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then Pharaoh sent among the cities gatherers
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then Pharaoh sent mobilizers to all cities,

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَشِرۡذِمَةٞ قَلِيلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna haolai lashirthimatun qaleeloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [And said], "Indeed, those are but a small band,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹and said,˺ “These ˹outcasts˺ are just a handful of people,

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِنَّهُمۡ لَنَا لَغَآئِظُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wainnahum lana laghaithoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And indeed, they are enraging us,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: who have really enraged us,

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِنَّا لَجَمِيعٌ حَٰذِرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wainna lajameeAAun hathiroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And indeed, we are a cautious society... "
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: but we are all on the alert.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَأَخۡرَجۡنَٰهُم مِّن جَنَّٰتٖ وَعُيُونٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faakhrajnahum min jannatin waAAuyoonin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So We removed them from gardens and springs
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So We lured the tyrants out of ˹their˺ gardens, springs,

ayahs.textArabic: وَكُنُوزٖ وَمَقَامٖ كَرِيمٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wakunoozin wamaqamin kareemin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And treasures and honorable station -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: treasures, and splendid residences.

ayahs.textArabic: كَذَٰلِكَۖ وَأَوۡرَثۡنَٰهَا بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kathalika waawrathnaha banee israeela
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Thus. And We caused to inherit it the Children of Israel.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So it was. And We awarded it ˹all˺ to the Children of Israel.

ayahs.textArabic: فَأَتۡبَعُوهُم مُّشۡرِقِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: FaatbaAAoohum mushriqeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So they pursued them at sunrise.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And so they pursued them at sunrise.

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَمَّا تَرَٰٓءَا ٱلۡجَمۡعَانِ قَالَ أَصۡحَٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَمُدۡرَكُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Falamma taraa aljamAAani qala ashabu moosa inna lamudrakoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when the two companies saw one another, the companions of Moses said, "Indeed, we are to be overtaken!"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: When the two groups came face to face, the companions of Moses cried out, “We are overtaken for sure.”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ كـَلَّآۖ إِنَّ مَعِيَ رَبِّي سَيَهۡدِينِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala kalla inna maAAiya rabbee sayahdeeni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Moses] said, "No! Indeed, with me is my Lord; He will guide me."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Moses reassured ˹them˺, “Absolutely not! My Lord is certainly with me—He will guide me.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَأَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضۡرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلۡبَحۡرَۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرۡقٖ كَٱلطَّوۡدِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faawhayna ila moosa ani idrib biAAasaka albahra fainfalaqa fakana kullu firqin kaalttawdi alAAatheemi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then We inspired to Moses, "Strike with your staff the sea," and it parted, and each portion was like a great towering mountain.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So We inspired Moses: “Strike the sea with your staff,” and the sea was split, each part was like a huge mountain.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَزۡلَفۡنَا ثَمَّ ٱلۡأٓخَرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waazlafna thamma alakhareena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We advanced thereto the pursuers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We drew the pursuers to that place,

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَنجَيۡنَا مُوسَىٰ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥٓ أَجۡمَعِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waanjayna moosa waman maAAahu ajmaAAeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We saved Moses and those with him, all together.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and delivered Moses and those with him all together.

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ أَغۡرَقۡنَا ٱلۡأٓخَرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thumma aghraqna alakhareena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then We drowned the others.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then We drowned the others.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Surely in this is a sign. Yet most of them would not believe.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wainna rabbaka lahuwa alAAazeezu alrraheemu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And your Lord is certainly the Almighty, Most Merciful.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱتۡلُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ نَبَأَ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waotlu AAalayhim nabaa ibraheema
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And recite to them the news of Abraham,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Relate to them ˹O Prophet˺ the story of Abraham,

ayahs.textArabic: إِذۡ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوۡمِهِۦ مَا تَعۡبُدُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ith qala liabeehi waqawmihi ma taAAbudoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: When he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: when he questioned his father and his people, “What is that you worship ˹besides Allah˺?”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُواْ نَعۡبُدُ أَصۡنَامٗا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَٰكِفِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qaloo naAAbudu asnaman fanathallu laha AAakifeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They said, "We worship idols and remain to them devoted."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They replied, “We worship idols, to which we are fully devoted.”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ هَلۡ يَسۡمَعُونَكُمۡ إِذۡ تَدۡعُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala hal yasmaAAoonakum ith tadAAoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He said, "Do they hear you when you supplicate?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Abraham asked, “Can they hear you when you call upon them?

ayahs.textArabic: أَوۡ يَنفَعُونَكُمۡ أَوۡ يَضُرُّونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Aw yanfaAAoonakum aw yadurroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Or do they benefit you, or do they harm?"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Or can they benefit or harm you?”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُواْ بَلۡ وَجَدۡنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفۡعَلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qaloo bal wajadna abaana kathalika yafAAaloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They said, "But we found our fathers doing thus."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They replied, “No! But we found our forefathers doing the same.”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ أَفَرَءَيۡتُم مَّا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡبُدُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala afaraaytum ma kuntum taAAbudoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He said, "Then do you see what you have been worshipping,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Abraham responded, “Have you ˹really˺ considered what you have been worshipping—

ayahs.textArabic: أَنتُمۡ وَءَابَآؤُكُمُ ٱلۡأَقۡدَمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Antum waabaokumu alaqdamoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: You and your ancient forefathers?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: you and your ancestors?

ayahs.textArabic: فَإِنَّهُمۡ عَدُوّٞ لِّيٓ إِلَّا رَبَّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fainnahum AAaduwwun lee illa rabba alAAalameena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, they are enemies to me, except the Lord of the worlds,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They are ˹all˺ enemies to me, except the Lord of all worlds.

ayahs.textArabic: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَنِي فَهُوَ يَهۡدِينِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Allathee khalaqanee fahuwa yahdeeni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Who created me, and He [it is who] guides me.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹He is˺ the One Who created me, and He ˹alone˺ guides me.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلَّذِي هُوَ يُطۡعِمُنِي وَيَسۡقِينِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waallathee huwa yutAAimunee wayasqeeni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And it is He who feeds me and gives me drink.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹He is˺ the One Who provides me with food and drink.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِذَا مَرِضۡتُ فَهُوَ يَشۡفِينِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waitha maridtu fahuwa yashfeeni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when I am ill, it is He who cures me
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And He ˹alone˺ heals me when I am sick.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلَّذِي يُمِيتُنِي ثُمَّ يُحۡيِينِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waallathee yumeetunee thumma yuhyeeni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And who will cause me to die and then bring me to life
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And He ˹is the One Who˺ will cause me to die, and then bring me back to life.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلَّذِيٓ أَطۡمَعُ أَن يَغۡفِرَ لِي خَطِيٓـَٔتِي يَوۡمَ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waallathee atmaAAu an yaghfira lee khateeatee yawma alddeeni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And who I aspire that He will forgive me my sin on the Day of Recompense."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And He is ˹the One˺ Who, I hope, will forgive my flaws on Judgment Day.”

ayahs.textArabic: رَبِّ هَبۡ لِي حُكۡمٗا وَأَلۡحِقۡنِي بِٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Rabbi hab lee hukman waalhiqnee bialssaliheena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [And he said], "My Lord, grant me authority and join me with the righteous.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: “My Lord! Grant me wisdom, and join me with the righteous.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱجۡعَل لِّي لِسَانَ صِدۡقٖ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: WaijAAal lee lisana sidqin fee alakhireena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And grant me a reputation of honor among later generations.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Bless me with honourable mention among later generations.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱجۡعَلۡنِي مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: WaijAAalnee min warathati jannati alnnaAAeemi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Pleasure.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Make me one of those awarded the Garden of Bliss.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱغۡفِرۡ لِأَبِيٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waighfir liabee innahu kana mina alddalleena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And forgive my father. Indeed, he has been of those astray.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Forgive my father, for he is certainly one of the misguided.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَا تُخۡزِنِي يَوۡمَ يُبۡعَثُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wala tukhzinee yawma yubAAathoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And do not disgrace me on the Day they are [all] resurrected -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And do not disgrace me on the Day all will be resurrected—

ayahs.textArabic: يَوۡمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٞ وَلَا بَنُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yawma la yanfaAAu malun wala banoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The Day when there will not benefit [anyone] wealth or children
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: the Day when neither wealth nor children will be of any benefit.

ayahs.textArabic: إِلَّا مَنۡ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلۡبٖ سَلِيمٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Illa man ata Allaha biqalbin saleemin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But only one who comes to Allah with a sound heart."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Only those who come before Allah with a pure heart ˹will be saved˺.”

ayahs.textArabic: وَأُزۡلِفَتِ ٱلۡجَنَّةُ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waozlifati aljannatu lilmuttaqeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And Paradise will be brought near [that Day] to the righteous.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹On that Day˺ Paradise will be brought near to the God-fearing,

ayahs.textArabic: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلۡجَحِيمُ لِلۡغَاوِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waburrizati aljaheemu lilghaweena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And Hellfire will be brought forth for the deviators,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and the Hellfire will be displayed to the deviant.

ayahs.textArabic: وَقِيلَ لَهُمۡ أَيۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡبُدُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waqeela lahum ayna ma kuntum taAAbudoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And it will be said to them, "Where are those you used to worship
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And it will be said to them, “Where are those you used to worship

ayahs.textArabic: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ هَلۡ يَنصُرُونَكُمۡ أَوۡ يَنتَصِرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Min dooni Allahi hal yansuroonakum aw yantasiroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Other than Allah? Can they help you or help themselves?"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: besides Allah? Can they help you or even help themselves?”

ayahs.textArabic: فَكُبۡكِبُواْ فِيهَا هُمۡ وَٱلۡغَاوُۥنَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fakubkiboo feeha hum waalghawoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So they will be overturned into Hellfire, they and the deviators
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then the idols will be hurled headlong into Hell, along with the deviant

ayahs.textArabic: وَجُنُودُ إِبۡلِيسَ أَجۡمَعُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wajunoodu ibleesa ajmaAAoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the soldiers of Iblees, all together.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and the soldiers of Iblîs, all together.

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُواْ وَهُمۡ فِيهَا يَخۡتَصِمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qaloo wahum feeha yakhtasimoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They will say while they dispute therein,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: There the deviant will cry while disputing with their idols,

ayahs.textArabic: تَٱللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: TaAllahi in kunna lafee dalalin mubeenin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: "By Allah, we were indeed in manifest error
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: “By Allah! We were clearly mistaken,

ayahs.textArabic: إِذۡ نُسَوِّيكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ith nusawweekum birabbi alAAalameena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: When we equated you with the Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: when we made you equal to the Lord of all worlds.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَآ أَضَلَّنَآ إِلَّا ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama adallana illa almujrimoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And no one misguided us except the criminals.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And none led us astray other than the wicked.

ayahs.textArabic: فَمَا لَنَا مِن شَٰفِعِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fama lana min shafiAAeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So now we have no intercessors
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Now we have none to intercede for us,

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَا صَدِيقٍ حَمِيمٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wala sadeeqin hameemin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And not a devoted friend.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: nor a close friend.

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَوۡ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةٗ فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Falaw anna lana karratan fanakoona mina almumineena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then if we only had a return [to the world] and could be of the believers... "
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: If only we could have a second chance, then we would be believers.”

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Surely in this is a sign. Yet most of them would not believe.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wainna rabbaka lahuwa alAAazeezu alrraheemu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And your Lord is certainly the Almighty, Most Merciful.

ayahs.textArabic: كَذَّبَتۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحٍ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kaththabat qawmu noohin almursaleena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The people of Noah denied the messengers
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The people of Noah rejected the messengers

ayahs.textArabic: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ أَخُوهُمۡ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ith qala lahum akhoohum noohun ala tattaqoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: When their brother Noah said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: when their brother Noah said to them, “Will you not fear ˹Allah˺?

ayahs.textArabic: إِنِّي لَكُمۡ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innee lakum rasoolun ameenun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: I am truly a trustworthy messenger to you.

ayahs.textArabic: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faittaqoo Allaha waateeAAooni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So fear Allah and obey me.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So fear Allah, and obey me.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa AAala rabbi alAAalameena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: I do not ask you for any reward for this ˹message˺. My reward is only from the Lord of all worlds.

ayahs.textArabic: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faittaqoo Allaha waateeAAooni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So fear Allah and obey me."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So fear Allah, and obey me.”

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ قَالُوٓاْ أَنُؤۡمِنُ لَكَ وَٱتَّبَعَكَ ٱلۡأَرۡذَلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qaloo anuminu laka waittabaAAaka alarthaloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They said, "Should we believe you while you are followed by the lowest [class of people]?"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They argued, “How can we believe in you, when you are followed ˹only˺ by the lowest of the low?”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ وَمَا عِلۡمِي بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala wama AAilmee bima kanoo yaAAmaloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He said, "And what is my knowledge of what they used to do?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He responded, “And what knowledge do I have of what they do?

ayahs.textArabic: إِنۡ حِسَابُهُمۡ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّيۖ لَوۡ تَشۡعُرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: In hisabuhum illa AAala rabbee law tashAAuroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Their account is only upon my Lord, if you [could] perceive.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Their judgment is with my Lord, if you had any sense!

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِطَارِدِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama ana bitaridi almumineena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And I am not one to drive away the believers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: I am not going to expel the believers.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنۡ أَنَا۠ إِلَّا نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: In ana illa natheerun mubeenun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: I am only a clear warner."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: I am only sent with a clear warning.”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُواْ لَئِن لَّمۡ تَنتَهِ يَٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡمَرۡجُومِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qaloo lain lam tantahi ya noohu latakoonanna mina almarjoomeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They said, "If you do not desist, O Noah, you will surely be of those who are stoned."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They threatened, “If you do not desist, O Noah, you will surely be stoned ˹to death˺.”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوۡمِي كَذَّبُونِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala rabbi inna qawmee kaththabooni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He said, "My Lord, indeed my people have denied me.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Noah prayed, “My Lord! My people have truly rejected me.

ayahs.textArabic: فَٱفۡتَحۡ بَيۡنِي وَبَيۡنَهُمۡ فَتۡحٗا وَنَجِّنِي وَمَن مَّعِيَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faiftah baynee wabaynahum fathan wanajjinee waman maAAiya mina almumineena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then judge between me and them with decisive judgement and save me and those with me of the believers."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So judge between me and them decisively, and save me and the believers with me.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَأَنجَيۡنَٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِي ٱلۡفُلۡكِ ٱلۡمَشۡحُونِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faanjaynahu waman maAAahu fee alfulki almashhooni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So We saved him and those with him in the laden ship.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So We saved him and those with him in the fully loaded Ark.

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ أَغۡرَقۡنَا بَعۡدُ ٱلۡبَاقِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thumma aghraqna baAAdu albaqeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then We drowned thereafter the remaining ones.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then afterwards We drowned the rest.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Surely in this is a sign. Yet most of them would not believe.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wainna rabbaka lahuwa alAAazeezu alrraheemu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And your Lord is certainly the Almighty, Most Merciful.

ayahs.textArabic: كَذَّبَتۡ عَادٌ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kaththabat AAadun almursaleena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: 'Aad denied the messengers
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The people of ’Âd rejected the messengers

ayahs.textArabic: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ أَخُوهُمۡ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ith qala lahum akhoohum hoodun ala tattaqoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: When their brother Hud said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: when their brother Hûd said to them, “Will you not fear ˹Allah˺?

ayahs.textArabic: إِنِّي لَكُمۡ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innee lakum rasoolun ameenun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: I am truly a trustworthy messenger to you.

ayahs.textArabic: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faittaqoo Allaha waateeAAooni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So fear Allah and obey me.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So fear Allah, and obey me.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa AAala rabbi alAAalameena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: I do not ask you for any reward for this ˹message˺. My reward is only from the Lord of all worlds.

ayahs.textArabic: أَتَبۡنُونَ بِكُلِّ رِيعٍ ءَايَةٗ تَعۡبَثُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Atabnoona bikulli reeAAin ayatan taAAbathoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Do you construct on every elevation a sign, amusing yourselves,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Why˺ do you build a landmark on every high place in vanity,

ayahs.textArabic: وَتَتَّخِذُونَ مَصَانِعَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَخۡلُدُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Watattakhithoona masaniAAa laAAallakum takhludoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And take for yourselves palaces and fortresses that you might abide eternally?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and construct castles, as if you are going to live forever,

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِذَا بَطَشۡتُم بَطَشۡتُمۡ جَبَّارِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waitha batashtum batashtum jabbareena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when you strike, you strike as tyrants.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and act so viciously when you attack ˹others˺?

ayahs.textArabic: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faittaqoo Allaha waateeAAooni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So fear Allah and obey me.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So fear Allah, and obey me.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَمَدَّكُم بِمَا تَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waittaqoo allathee amaddakum bima taAAlamoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And fear He who provided you with that which you know,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Fear the One Who has provided you with ˹the good˺ things you know:

ayahs.textArabic: أَمَدَّكُم بِأَنۡعَٰمٖ وَبَنِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Amaddakum bianAAamin wabaneena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Provided you with grazing livestock and children
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He provided you with cattle, and children,

ayahs.textArabic: وَجَنَّٰتٖ وَعُيُونٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wajannatin waAAuyoonin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And gardens and springs.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and gardens, and springs.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innee akhafu AAalaykum AAathaba yawmin AAatheemin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day."
