ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: behaving arrogantly in the land and plotting evil. But evil plotting only backfires on those who plot. Are they awaiting anything but the fate of those ˹destroyed˺ before? You will find no change in the way of Allah, nor will you find it diverted ˹to someone else˺.

ayahs.textArabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَسِيرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَيَنظُرُواْ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ وَكَانُوٓاْ أَشَدَّ مِنۡهُمۡ قُوَّةٗۚ وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيُعۡجِزَهُۥ مِن شَيۡءٖ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَلَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَلِيمٗا قَدِيرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Awalam yaseeroo fee alardi fayanthuroo kayfa kana AAaqibatu allatheena min qablihim wakanoo ashadda minhum quwwatan wama kana Allahu liyuAAjizahu min shayin fee alssamawati wala fee alardi innahu kana AAaleeman qadeeran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Have they not traveled through the land and observed how was the end of those before them? And they were greater than them in power. But Allah is not to be caused failure by anything in the heavens or on the earth. Indeed, He is ever Knowing and Competent.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Have they not travelled throughout the land to see what was the end of those ˹destroyed˺ before them? They were far superior in might. But there is nothing that can escape Allah in the heavens or the earth. He is certainly All-Knowing, Most Capable.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَوۡ يُؤَاخِذُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلنَّاسَ بِمَا كَسَبُواْ مَا تَرَكَ عَلَىٰ ظَهۡرِهَا مِن دَآبَّةٖ وَلَٰكِن يُؤَخِّرُهُمۡ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٖ مُّسَمّٗىۖ فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَجَلُهُمۡ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهِۦ بَصِيرَۢا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walaw yuakhithu Allahu alnnasa bima kasaboo ma taraka AAala thahriha min dabbatin walakin yuakhkhiruhum ila ajalin musamman faitha jaa ajaluhum fainna Allaha kana biAAibadihi baseeran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And if Allah were to impose blame on the people for what they have earned, He would not leave upon the earth any creature. But He defers them for a specified term. And when their time comes, then indeed Allah has ever been, of His servants, Seeing.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: If Allah were to punish people ˹immediately˺ for what they have committed, He would not have left a single living being on earth. But He delays them for an appointed term. And when their time arrives, then surely Allah is All-Seeing of His servants.

ayahs.textArabic: يسٓ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yaseen
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Ya, Seen.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Yâ-Sĩn.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ ٱلۡحَكِيمِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalqurani alhakeemi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: By the wise Qur'an.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: By the Quran, rich in wisdom!

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innaka lamina almursaleena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed you, [O Muhammad], are from among the messengers,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: You ˹O Prophet˺ are truly one of the messengers

ayahs.textArabic: عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: AAala siratin mustaqeemin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: On a straight path.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: upon the Straight Path.

ayahs.textArabic: تَنزِيلَ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Tanzeela alAAazeezi alrraheemi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [This is] a revelation of the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹This is˺ a revelation from the Almighty, Most Merciful,

ayahs.textArabic: لِتُنذِرَ قَوۡمٗا مَّآ أُنذِرَ ءَابَآؤُهُمۡ فَهُمۡ غَٰفِلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Litunthira qawman ma onthira abaohum fahum ghafiloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: That you may warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, so they are unaware.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: so that you may warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, and so are heedless.

ayahs.textArabic: لَقَدۡ حَقَّ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ عَلَىٰٓ أَكۡثَرِهِمۡ فَهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Laqad haqqa alqawlu AAala aktharihim fahum la yuminoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Already the word has come into effect upon most of them, so they do not believe.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The decree ˹of torment˺ has already been justified against most of them, for they will never believe.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَا فِيٓ أَعۡنَٰقِهِمۡ أَغۡلَٰلٗا فَهِيَ إِلَى ٱلۡأَذۡقَانِ فَهُم مُّقۡمَحُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna jaAAalna fee aAAnaqihim aghlalan fahiya ila alathqani fahum muqmahoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, We have put shackles on their necks, and they are to their chins, so they are with heads [kept] aloft.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹It is as if˺ We have put shackles around their necks up to their chins, so their heads are forced up,

ayahs.textArabic: وَجَعَلۡنَا مِنۢ بَيۡنِ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ سَدّٗا وَمِنۡ خَلۡفِهِمۡ سَدّٗا فَأَغۡشَيۡنَٰهُمۡ فَهُمۡ لَا يُبۡصِرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: WajaAAalna min bayni aydeehim saddan wamin khalfihim saddan faaghshaynahum fahum la yubsiroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We have put before them a barrier and behind them a barrier and covered them, so they do not see.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and have placed a barrier before them and a barrier behind them and covered them ˹all˺ up, so they fail to see ˹the truth˺.

ayahs.textArabic: وَسَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَأَنذَرۡتَهُمۡ أَمۡ لَمۡ تُنذِرۡهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wasawaon AAalayhim aanthartahum am lam tunthirhum la yuminoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them - they will not believe.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: It is the same whether you warn them or not—they will never believe.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلذِّكۡرَ وَخَشِيَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنَ بِٱلۡغَيۡبِۖ فَبَشِّرۡهُ بِمَغۡفِرَةٖ وَأَجۡرٖ كَرِيمٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innama tunthiru mani ittabaAAa alththikra wakhashiya alrrahmana bialghaybi fabashshirhu bimaghfiratin waajrin kareemin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: You can only warn one who follows the message and fears the Most Merciful unseen. So give him good tidings of forgiveness and noble reward.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: You can only warn those who follow the Reminder and are in awe of the Most Compassionate without seeing Him. So give them good news of forgiveness and an honourable reward.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نُحۡيِ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰ وَنَكۡتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُواْ وَءَاثَٰرَهُمۡۚ وَكُلَّ شَيۡءٍ أَحۡصَيۡنَٰهُ فِيٓ إِمَامٖ مُّبِينٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna nahnu nuhyee almawta wanaktubu ma qaddamoo waatharahum wakulla shayin ahsaynahu fee imamin mubeenin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, it is We who bring the dead to life and record what they have put forth and what they left behind, and all things We have enumerated in a clear register.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: It is certainly We Who resurrect the dead, and write what they send forth and what they leave behind. Everything is listed by Us in a perfect Record.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱضۡرِبۡ لَهُم مَّثَلًا أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلۡقَرۡيَةِ إِذۡ جَآءَهَا ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waidrib lahum mathalan ashaba alqaryati ith jaaha almursaloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And present to them an example: the people of the city, when the messengers came to it -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Give them an example ˹O Prophet˺ of the residents of a town, when the messengers came to them.

ayahs.textArabic: إِذۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡهِمُ ٱثۡنَيۡنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزۡنَا بِثَالِثٖ فَقَالُوٓاْ إِنَّآ إِلَيۡكُم مُّرۡسَلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ith arsalna ilayhimu ithnayni fakaththaboohuma faAAazzazna bithalithin faqaloo inna ilaykum mursaloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened them with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We sent them two messengers, but they rejected both. So We reinforced ˹the two˺ with a third, and they declared, “We have indeed been sent to you ˹as messengers˺.”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُواْ مَآ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا بَشَرٞ مِّثۡلُنَا وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ مِن شَيۡءٍ إِنۡ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا تَكۡذِبُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qaloo ma antum illa basharun mithluna wama anzala alrrahmanu min shayin in antum illa takthiboona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They said, "You are not but human beings like us, and the Most Merciful has not revealed a thing. You are only telling lies."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The people replied, “You are only humans like us, and the Most Compassionate has not revealed anything. You are simply lying!”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُواْ رَبُّنَا يَعۡلَمُ إِنَّآ إِلَيۡكُمۡ لَمُرۡسَلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qaloo rabbuna yaAAlamu inna ilaykum lamursaloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They said, "Our Lord knows that we are messengers to you,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The messengers responded, “Our Lord knows that we have truly been sent to you.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا عَلَيۡنَآ إِلَّا ٱلۡبَلَٰغُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama AAalayna illa albalaghu almubeenu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And we are not responsible except for clear notification."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And our duty is only to deliver ˹the message˺ clearly.”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا تَطَيَّرۡنَا بِكُمۡۖ لَئِن لَّمۡ تَنتَهُواْ لَنَرۡجُمَنَّكُمۡ وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qaloo inna tatayyarna bikum lain lam tantahoo lanarjumannakum walayamassannakum minna AAathabun aleemun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They said, "Indeed, we consider you a bad omen. If you do not desist, we will surely stone you, and there will surely touch you, from us, a painful punishment."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The people replied, “We definitely see you as a bad omen for us. If you do not desist, we will certainly stone you ˹to death˺ and you will be touched with a painful punishment from us.”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُواْ طَٰٓئِرُكُم مَّعَكُمۡ أَئِن ذُكِّرۡتُمۚ بَلۡ أَنتُمۡ قَوۡمٞ مُّسۡرِفُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qaloo tairukum maAAakum ain thukkirtum bal antum qawmun musrifoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They said, "Your omen is with yourselves. Is it because you were reminded? Rather, you are a transgressing people."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The messengers said, “Your bad omen lies within yourselves. Are you saying this because you are reminded ˹of the truth˺? In fact, you are a transgressing people.”

ayahs.textArabic: وَجَآءَ مِنۡ أَقۡصَا ٱلۡمَدِينَةِ رَجُلٞ يَسۡعَىٰ قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ ٱتَّبِعُواْ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wajaa min aqsa almadeenati rajulun yasAAa qala ya qawmi ittabiAAoo almursaleena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And there came from the farthest end of the city a man, running. He said, "O my people, follow the messengers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then from the farthest end of the city a man came, rushing. He advised, “O my people! Follow the messengers.

ayahs.textArabic: ٱتَّبِعُواْ مَن لَّا يَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ أَجۡرٗا وَهُم مُّهۡتَدُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: IttabiAAoo man la yasalukum ajran wahum muhtadoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Follow those who do not ask of you [any] payment, and they are [rightly] guided.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Follow those who ask no reward of you, and are ˹rightly˺ guided.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَالِيَ لَآ أَعۡبُدُ ٱلَّذِي فَطَرَنِي وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama liya la aAAbudu allathee fataranee wailayhi turjaAAoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And why should I not worship He who created me and to whom you will be returned?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And why should I not worship the One Who has originated me, and to Whom you will be returned.

ayahs.textArabic: ءَأَتَّخِذُ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً إِن يُرِدۡنِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ بِضُرّٖ لَّا تُغۡنِ عَنِّي شَفَٰعَتُهُمۡ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا يُنقِذُونِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Aattakhithu min doonihi alihatan in yuridni alrrahmanu bidurrin la tughni AAannee shafaAAatuhum shayan wala yunqithooni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Should I take other than Him [false] deities [while], if the Most Merciful intends for me some adversity, their intercession will not avail me at all, nor can they save me?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: How could I take besides Him other gods whose intercession would not be of any benefit to me, nor could they save me if the Most Compassionate intended to harm me?

ayahs.textArabic: إِنِّيٓ إِذٗا لَّفِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innee ithan lafee dalalin mubeenin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, I would then be in manifest error.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, I would then be clearly astray.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنِّيٓ ءَامَنتُ بِرَبِّكُمۡ فَٱسۡمَعُونِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innee amantu birabbikum faismaAAooni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, I have believed in your Lord, so listen to me."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: I do believe in your Lord, so listen to me.”

ayahs.textArabic: قِيلَ ٱدۡخُلِ ٱلۡجَنَّةَۖ قَالَ يَٰلَيۡتَ قَوۡمِي يَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qeela odkhuli aljannata qala ya layta qawmee yaAAlamoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: It was said, "Enter Paradise." He said, "I wish my people could know
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹But they killed him, then˺ he was told ˹by the angels˺, “Enter Paradise!” He said, “If only my people knew

ayahs.textArabic: بِمَا غَفَرَ لِي رَبِّي وَجَعَلَنِي مِنَ ٱلۡمُكۡرَمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Bima ghafara lee rabbee wajaAAalanee mina almukrameena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Of how my Lord has forgiven me and placed me among the honored."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: of how my Lord has forgiven me, and made me one of the honourable.”

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ وَمَآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِۦ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦ مِن جُندٖ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا كُنَّا مُنزِلِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama anzalna AAala qawmihi min baAAdihi min jundin mina alssamai wama kunna munzileena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We did not send down upon his people after him any soldiers from the heaven, nor would We have done so.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We did not send any soldiers from the heavens against his people after his death, nor did We need to.

ayahs.textArabic: إِن كَانَتۡ إِلَّا صَيۡحَةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ فَإِذَا هُمۡ خَٰمِدُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: In kanat illa sayhatan wahidatan faitha hum khamidoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: It was not but one shout, and immediately they were extinguished.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: All it took was one ˹mighty˺ blast, and they were extinguished at once.

ayahs.textArabic: يَٰحَسۡرَةً عَلَى ٱلۡعِبَادِۚ مَا يَأۡتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ya hasratan AAala alAAibadi ma yateehim min rasoolin illa kanoo bihi yastahzioona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: How regretful for the servants. There did not come to them any messenger except that they used to ridicule him.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Oh pity, such beings! No messenger ever came to them without being mocked.

ayahs.textArabic: أَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ كَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡقُرُونِ أَنَّهُمۡ إِلَيۡهِمۡ لَا يَرۡجِعُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Alam yaraw kam ahlakna qablahum mina alqurooni annahum ilayhim la yarjiAAoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Have they not considered how many generations We destroyed before them - that they to them will not return?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Have the deniers not considered how many peoples We destroyed before them who never came back to life again?

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِن كُلّٞ لَّمَّا جَمِيعٞ لَّدَيۡنَا مُحۡضَرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wain kullun lamma jameeAAun ladayna muhdaroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And indeed, all of them will yet be brought present before Us.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Yet they will all be brought before Us.

ayahs.textArabic: وَءَايَةٞ لَّهُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ ٱلۡمَيۡتَةُ أَحۡيَيۡنَٰهَا وَأَخۡرَجۡنَا مِنۡهَا حَبّٗا فَمِنۡهُ يَأۡكُلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waayatun lahumu alardu almaytatu ahyaynaha waakhrajna minha habban faminhu yakuloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And a sign for them is the dead earth. We have brought it to life and brought forth from it grain, and from it they eat.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: There is a sign for them in the dead earth: We give it life, producing grain from it for them to eat.

ayahs.textArabic: وَجَعَلۡنَا فِيهَا جَنَّٰتٖ مِّن نَّخِيلٖ وَأَعۡنَٰبٖ وَفَجَّرۡنَا فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلۡعُيُونِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: WajaAAalna feeha jannatin min nakheelin waaAAnabin wafajjarna feeha mina alAAuyooni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We placed therein gardens of palm trees and grapevines and caused to burst forth therefrom some springs -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And We have placed in it gardens of palm trees and grapevines, and caused springs to gush forth in it,

ayahs.textArabic: لِيَأۡكُلُواْ مِن ثَمَرِهِۦ وَمَا عَمِلَتۡهُ أَيۡدِيهِمۡۚ أَفَلَا يَشۡكُرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Liyakuloo min thamarihi wama AAamilathu aydeehim afala yashkuroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: That they may eat of His fruit. And their hands have not produced it, so will they not be grateful?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: so that they may eat from its fruit, which they had no hand in making. Will they not then give thanks?

ayahs.textArabic: سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلۡأَزۡوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنۢبِتُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَمِنۡ أَنفُسِهِمۡ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Subhana allathee khalaqa alazwaja kullaha mimma tunbitu alardu wamin anfusihim wamimma la yaAAlamoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Exalted is He who created all pairs - from what the earth grows and from themselves and from that which they do not know.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Glory be to the One Who created all ˹things in˺ pairs—˹be it˺ what the earth produces, their genders, or what they do not know!

ayahs.textArabic: وَءَايَةٞ لَّهُمُ ٱلَّيۡلُ نَسۡلَخُ مِنۡهُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فَإِذَا هُم مُّظۡلِمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waayatun lahumu allaylu naslakhu minhu alnnahara faitha hum muthlimoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And a sign for them is the night. We remove from it [the light of] day, so they are [left] in darkness.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: There is also a sign for them in the night: We strip from it daylight, then—behold!—they are in darkness.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلشَّمۡسُ تَجۡرِي لِمُسۡتَقَرّٖ لَّهَاۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقۡدِيرُ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡعَلِيمِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalshshamsu tajree limustaqarrin laha thalika taqdeeru alAAazeezi alAAaleemi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the sun runs [on course] toward its stopping point. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The sun travels for its fixed term. That is the design of the Almighty, All-Knowing.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلۡقَمَرَ قَدَّرۡنَٰهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتَّىٰ عَادَ كَٱلۡعُرۡجُونِ ٱلۡقَدِيمِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalqamara qaddarnahu manazila hatta AAada kaalAAurjooni alqadeemi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the moon - We have determined for it phases, until it returns [appearing] like the old date stalk.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: As for the moon, We have ordained ˹precise˺ phases for it, until it ends up like an old, curved palm stalk.

ayahs.textArabic: لَا ٱلشَّمۡسُ يَنۢبَغِي لَهَآ أَن تُدۡرِكَ ٱلۡقَمَرَ وَلَا ٱلَّيۡلُ سَابِقُ ٱلنَّهَارِۚ وَكُلّٞ فِي فَلَكٖ يَسۡبَحُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: La alshshamsu yanbaghee laha an tudrika alqamara wala allaylu sabiqu alnnahari wakullun fee falakin yasbahoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: It is not allowable for the sun to reach the moon, nor does the night overtake the day, but each, in an orbit, is swimming.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: It is not for the sun to catch up with the moon, nor does the night outrun the day. Each is travelling in an orbit of their own.

ayahs.textArabic: وَءَايَةٞ لَّهُمۡ أَنَّا حَمَلۡنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡفُلۡكِ ٱلۡمَشۡحُونِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waayatun lahum anna hamalna thurriyyatahum fee alfulki almashhooni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And a sign for them is that We carried their forefathers in a laden ship.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Another sign for them is that We carried their ancestors ˹with Noah˺ in the fully loaded Ark,

ayahs.textArabic: وَخَلَقۡنَا لَهُم مِّن مِّثۡلِهِۦ مَا يَرۡكَبُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wakhalaqna lahum min mithlihi ma yarkaboona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We created for them from the likes of it that which they ride.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and created for them similar things to ride in.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِن نَّشَأۡ نُغۡرِقۡهُمۡ فَلَا صَرِيخَ لَهُمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يُنقَذُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wain nasha nughriqhum fala sareekha lahum wala hum yunqathoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And if We should will, We could drown them; then no one responding to a cry would there be for them, nor would they be saved
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: If We willed, We could drown them: then no one would respond to their cries, nor would they be rescued—

ayahs.textArabic: إِلَّا رَحۡمَةٗ مِّنَّا وَمَتَٰعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Illa rahmatan minna wamataAAan ila heenin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Except as a mercy from Us and provision for a time.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: except by mercy from Us, allowing them enjoyment for a ˹little˺ while.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّقُواْ مَا بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيكُمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُرۡحَمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waitha qeela lahumu ittaqoo ma bayna aydeekum wama khalfakum laAAallakum turhamoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But when it is said to them, "Beware of what is before you and what is behind you; perhaps you will receive mercy... "
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Still they turn away˺ when it is said to them, “Beware of what is ahead of you ˹in the Hereafter˺ and what is behind you ˹of destroyed nations˺ so you may be shown mercy.”

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا تَأۡتِيهِم مِّنۡ ءَايَةٖ مِّنۡ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ إِلَّا كَانُواْ عَنۡهَا مُعۡرِضِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama tateehim min ayatin min ayati rabbihim illa kanoo AAanha muAArideena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And no sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord except that they are from it turning away.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Whenever a sign comes to them from their Lord, they turn away from it.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمۡ أَنفِقُواْ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ أَنُطۡعِمُ مَن لَّوۡ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ أَطۡعَمَهُۥٓ إِنۡ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waitha qeela lahum anfiqoo mimma razaqakumu Allahu qala allatheena kafaroo lillatheena amanoo anutAAimu man law yashao Allahu atAAamahu in antum illa fee dalalin mubeenin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when it is said to them, "Spend from that which Allah has provided for you," those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Should we feed one whom, if Allah had willed, He would have fed? You are not but in clear error."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And when it is said to them, “Donate from what Allah has provided for you,” the disbelievers say to the believers, “Why should we feed those whom Allah could have fed if He wanted to? You are clearly astray!”

ayahs.textArabic: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلۡوَعۡدُ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wayaqooloona mata hatha alwaAAdu in kuntum sadiqeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And they ask ˹the believers˺, “When will this threat come to pass, if what you say is true?”

ayahs.textArabic: مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيۡحَةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ تَأۡخُذُهُمۡ وَهُمۡ يَخِصِّمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ma yanthuroona illa sayhatan wahidatan takhuthuhum wahum yakhissimoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They do not await except one blast which will seize them while they are disputing.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They must be awaiting a single Blast, which will seize them while they are ˹entrenched˺ in ˹worldly˺ disputes.

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ تَوۡصِيَةٗ وَلَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِمۡ يَرۡجِعُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fala yastateeAAoona tawsiyatan wala ila ahlihim yarjiAAoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And they will not be able [to give] any instruction, nor to their people can they return.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then they will not be able to make a ˹last˺ will, nor can they return to their own people.

ayahs.textArabic: وَنُفِخَ فِي ٱلصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَجۡدَاثِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمۡ يَنسِلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wanufikha fee alssoori faitha hum mina alajdathi ila rabbihim yansiloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the Horn will be blown; and at once from the graves to their Lord they will hasten.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The Trumpet will be blown ˹a second time˺, then—behold!—they will rush from the graves to their Lord.

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُواْ يَٰوَيۡلَنَا مَنۢ بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرۡقَدِنَاۜۗ هَٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَصَدَقَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qaloo ya waylana man baAAathana min marqadina hatha ma waAAada alrrahmanu wasadaqa almursaloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They will say, "O woe to us! Who has raised us up from our sleeping place?" [The reply will be], "This is what the Most Merciful had promised, and the messengers told the truth."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They will cry, “Woe to us! Who has raised us up from our place of rest? This must be what the Most Compassionate warned us of; the messengers told the truth!”

ayahs.textArabic: إِن كَانَتۡ إِلَّا صَيۡحَةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ فَإِذَا هُمۡ جَمِيعٞ لَّدَيۡنَا مُحۡضَرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: In kanat illa sayhatan wahidatan faitha hum jameeAAun ladayna muhdaroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: It will not be but one blast, and at once they are all brought present before Us.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: It will only take one Blast, then at once they will all be brought before Us.

ayahs.textArabic: فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ لَا تُظۡلَمُ نَفۡسٞ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faalyawma la tuthlamu nafsun shayan wala tujzawna illa ma kuntum taAAmaloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So today no soul will be wronged at all, and you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: On that Day no soul will be wronged in the least, nor will you be rewarded except for what you used to do.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ فِي شُغُلٖ فَٰكِهُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna ashaba aljannati alyawma fee shughulin fakihoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed the companions of Paradise, that Day, will be amused in [joyful] occupation -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, on that Day the residents of Paradise will be busy enjoying themselves.

ayahs.textArabic: هُمۡ وَأَزۡوَٰجُهُمۡ فِي ظِلَٰلٍ عَلَى ٱلۡأَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Hum waazwajuhum fee thilalin AAala alaraiki muttakioona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They and their spouses - in shade, reclining on adorned couches.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They and their spouses will be in ˹cool˺ shade, reclining on ˹canopied˺ couches.

ayahs.textArabic: لَهُمۡ فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٞ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Lahum feeha fakihatun walahum ma yaddaAAoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: For them therein is fruit, and for them is whatever they request [or wish]
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: There they will have fruits and whatever they desire.

ayahs.textArabic: سَلَٰمٞ قَوۡلٗا مِّن رَّبّٖ رَّحِيمٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Salamun qawlan min rabbin raheemin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [And] "Peace," a word from a Merciful Lord.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And “Peace!” will be ˹their˺ greeting from the Merciful Lord.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱمۡتَٰزُواْ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ أَيُّهَا ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waimtazoo alyawma ayyuha almujrimoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Then He will say], "But stand apart today, you criminals.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Then the disbelievers will be told,˺ “Step away ˹from the believers˺ this Day, O wicked ones!

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ أَلَمۡ أَعۡهَدۡ إِلَيۡكُمۡ يَٰبَنِيٓ ءَادَمَ أَن لَّا تَعۡبُدُواْ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنَۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمۡ عَدُوّٞ مُّبِينٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Alam aAAhad ilaykum ya banee adama an la taAAbudoo alshshaytana innahu lakum AAaduwwun mubeenun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Did I not enjoin upon you, O children of Adam, that you not worship Satan - [for] indeed, he is to you a clear enemy -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Did I not command you, O Children of Adam, not to follow Satan, for he is truly your sworn enemy,

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَنِ ٱعۡبُدُونِيۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٞ مُّسۡتَقِيمٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waani oAAbudoonee hatha siratun mustaqeemun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And that you worship [only] Me? This is a straight path.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: but to worship Me ˹alone˺? This is the Straight Path.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمۡ جِبِلّٗا كَثِيرًاۖ أَفَلَمۡ تَكُونُواْ تَعۡقِلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walaqad adalla minkum jibillan katheeran afalam takoonoo taAAqiloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And he had already led astray from among you much of creation, so did you not use reason?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Yet he already misled great multitudes of you. Did you not have any sense?

ayahs.textArabic: هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِي كُنتُمۡ تُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Hathihi jahannamu allatee kuntum tooAAadoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: This is the Hellfire which you were promised.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: This is the Hell you were warned of.

ayahs.textArabic: ٱصۡلَوۡهَا ٱلۡيَوۡمَ بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَكۡفُرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Islawha alyawma bima kuntum takfuroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Enter to] burn therein today for what you used to deny."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Burn in it Today for your disbelief.”

ayahs.textArabic: ٱلۡيَوۡمَ نَخۡتِمُ عَلَىٰٓ أَفۡوَٰهِهِمۡ وَتُكَلِّمُنَآ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَتَشۡهَدُ أَرۡجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Alyawma nakhtimu AAala afwahihim watukallimuna aydeehim watashhadu arjuluhum bima kanoo yaksiboona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: That Day, We will seal over their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify about what they used to earn.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: On this Day We will seal their mouths, their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify to what they used to commit.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسۡنَا عَلَىٰٓ أَعۡيُنِهِمۡ فَٱسۡتَبَقُواْ ٱلصِّرَٰطَ فَأَنَّىٰ يُبۡصِرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walaw nashao latamasna AAala aAAyunihim faistabaqoo alssirata faanna yubsiroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And if We willed, We could have obliterated their eyes, and they would race to [find] the path, and how could they see?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Had We willed, We could have easily blinded their eyes, so they would struggle to find their way. How then could they see?

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخۡنَٰهُمۡ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمۡ فَمَا ٱسۡتَطَٰعُواْ مُضِيّٗا وَلَا يَرۡجِعُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walaw nashao lamasakhnahum AAala makanatihim fama istataAAoo mudiyyan wala yarjiAAoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And if We willed, We could have deformed them, [paralyzing them] in their places so they would not be able to proceed, nor could they return.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And had We willed, We could have transfigured them on the spot, so they could neither progress forward nor turn back.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرۡهُ نُنَكِّسۡهُ فِي ٱلۡخَلۡقِۚ أَفَلَا يَعۡقِلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waman nuAAammirhu nunakkishu fee alkhalqi afala yaAAqiloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And he to whom We grant long life We reverse in creation; so will they not understand?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And whoever We grant a long life, We reverse them in development. Will they not then understand?

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا عَلَّمۡنَٰهُ ٱلشِّعۡرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِي لَهُۥٓۚ إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكۡرٞ وَقُرۡءَانٞ مُّبِينٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama AAallamnahu alshshiAAra wama yanbaghee lahu in huwa illa thikrun waquranun mubeenun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We did not give Prophet Muhammad, knowledge of poetry, nor is it befitting for him. It is not but a message and a clear Qur'an
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We have not taught him poetry, nor is it fitting for him. This ˹Book˺ is only a Reminder and a clear Quran

ayahs.textArabic: لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيّٗا وَيَحِقَّ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ عَلَى ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Liyunthira man kana hayyan wayahiqqa alqawlu AAala alkafireena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: To warn whoever is alive and justify the word against the disbelievers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: to warn whoever is ˹truly˺ alive and fulfil the decree ˹of torment˺ against the disbelievers.

ayahs.textArabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ أَنَّا خَلَقۡنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتۡ أَيۡدِينَآ أَنۡعَٰمٗا فَهُمۡ لَهَا مَٰلِكُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Awalam yaraw anna khalaqna lahum mimma AAamilat aydeena anAAaman fahum laha malikoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Do they not see that We have created for them from what Our hands have made, grazing livestock, and [then] they are their owners?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Do they not see that We singlehandedly created for them, among other things, cattle which are under their control?

ayahs.textArabic: وَذَلَّلۡنَٰهَا لَهُمۡ فَمِنۡهَا رَكُوبُهُمۡ وَمِنۡهَا يَأۡكُلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wathallalnaha lahum faminha rakoobuhum waminha yakuloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We have tamed them for them, so some of them they ride, and some of them they eat.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And We have subjected these ˹animals˺ to them, so they may ride some and eat others.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَهُمۡ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُۚ أَفَلَا يَشۡكُرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walahum feeha manafiAAu wamasharibu afala yashkuroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And for them therein are [other] benefits and drinks, so will they not be grateful?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And they derive from them other benefits and drinks. Will they not then give thanks?

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةٗ لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waittakhathoo min dooni Allahi alihatan laAAallahum yunsaroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But they have taken besides Allah [false] deities that perhaps they would be helped.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Still they have taken other gods besides Allah, hoping to be helped ˹by them˺.

ayahs.textArabic: لَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ نَصۡرَهُمۡ وَهُمۡ لَهُمۡ جُندٞ مُّحۡضَرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: La yastateeAAoona nasrahum wahum lahum jundun muhdaroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They are not able to help them, and they [themselves] are for them soldiers in attendance.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They cannot help the pagans, even though they serve the idols as dedicated guards.

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَا يَحۡزُنكَ قَوۡلُهُمۡۘ إِنَّا نَعۡلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعۡلِنُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fala yahzunka qawluhum inna naAAlamu ma yusirroona wama yuAAlinoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, We know what they conceal and what they declare.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So do not let their words grieve you ˹O Prophet˺. Indeed, We ˹fully˺ know what they conceal and what they reveal.

ayahs.textArabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰهُ مِن نُّطۡفَةٖ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٞ مُّبِينٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Awalam yara alinsanu anna khalaqnahu min nutfatin faitha huwa khaseemun mubeenun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Does man not consider that We created him from a [mere] sperm-drop - then at once he is a clear adversary?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Do people not see that We have created them from a sperm-drop, then—behold!—they openly challenge ˹Us˺?

ayahs.textArabic: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلٗا وَنَسِيَ خَلۡقَهُۥۖ قَالَ مَن يُحۡيِ ٱلۡعِظَٰمَ وَهِيَ رَمِيمٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wadaraba lana mathalan wanasiya khalqahu qala man yuhyee alAAithama wahiya rameemun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And he presents for Us an example and forgets his [own] creation. He says, "Who will give life to bones while they are disintegrated?"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And they argue with Us—forgetting they were created—saying, “Who will give life to decayed bones?”

ayahs.textArabic: قُلۡ يُحۡيِيهَا ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٖۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلۡقٍ عَلِيمٌ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qul yuhyeeha allathee anshaaha awwala marratin wahuwa bikulli khalqin AAaleemun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Say, "He will give them life who produced them the first time; and He is, of all creation, Knowing."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “They will be revived by the One Who produced them the first time, for He has ˹perfect˺ knowledge of every created being.

ayahs.textArabic: ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ ٱلۡأَخۡضَرِ نَارٗا فَإِذَآ أَنتُم مِّنۡهُ تُوقِدُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Allathee jaAAala lakum mina alshshajari alakhdari naran faitha antum minhu tooqidoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [It is] He who made for you from the green tree, fire, and then from it you ignite.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹He is the One˺ Who gives you fire from green trees, and—behold!—you kindle ˹fire˺ from them.

ayahs.textArabic: أَوَلَيۡسَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخۡلُقَ مِثۡلَهُمۚ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلۡخَلَّٰقُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Awalaysa allathee khalaqa alssamawati waalarda biqadirin AAala an yakhluqa mithlahum bala wahuwa alkhallaqu alAAaleemu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Is not He who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the likes of them? Yes, [it is so]; and He is the Knowing Creator.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Can the One Who created the heavens and the earth not ˹easily˺ resurrect these ˹deniers˺?” Yes ˹He can˺! For He is the Master Creator, All-Knowing.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّمَآ أَمۡرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيۡـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innama amruhu itha arada shayan an yaqoola lahu kun fayakoonu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: His command is only when He intends a thing that He says to it, "Be," and it is.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: All it takes, when He wills something ˹to be˺, is simply to say to it: “Be!” And it is!

ayahs.textArabic: فَسُبۡحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِي بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fasubhana allathee biyadihi malakootu kulli shayin wailayhi turjaAAoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So exalted is He in whose hand is the realm of all things, and to Him you will be returned.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So glory be to the One in Whose Hands is the authority over all things, and to Whom ˹alone˺ you will ˹all˺ be returned.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلصَّٰٓفَّٰتِ صَفّٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalssaffati saffan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: By those [angels] lined up in rows
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: By those ˹angels˺ lined up in ranks,

ayahs.textArabic: فَٱلزَّٰجِرَٰتِ زَجۡرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faalzzajirati zajran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And those who drive [the clouds]
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and those who diligently drive ˹the clouds˺,

ayahs.textArabic: فَٱلتَّٰلِيَٰتِ ذِكۡرًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faalttaliyati thikran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And those who recite the message,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and those who recite the Reminder!

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ إِلَٰهَكُمۡ لَوَٰحِدٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna ilahakum lawahidun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, your God is One,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Surely your God is One!

ayahs.textArabic: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ ٱلۡمَشَٰرِقِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Rabbu alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma warabbu almashariqi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them and Lord of the sunrises.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹He is˺ the Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything in between, and the Lord of all points of sunrise.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا بِزِينَةٍ ٱلۡكَوَاكِبِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna zayyanna alssamaa alddunya bizeenatin alkawakibi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, We have adorned the nearest heaven with an adornment of stars
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, We have adorned the lowest heaven with the stars for decoration

ayahs.textArabic: وَحِفۡظٗا مِّن كُلِّ شَيۡطَٰنٖ مَّارِدٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wahifthan min kulli shaytanin maridin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And as protection against every rebellious devil
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and ˹for˺ protection from every rebellious devil.

ayahs.textArabic: لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى ٱلۡمَلَإِ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ وَيُقۡذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: La yassammaAAoona ila almalai alaAAla wayuqthafoona min kulli janibin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [So] they may not listen to the exalted assembly [of angels] and are pelted from every side,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They cannot listen to the highest assembly ˹of angels˺ for they are pelted from every side,

ayahs.textArabic: دُحُورٗاۖ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ وَاصِبٌ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Duhooran walahum AAathabun wasibun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Repelled; and for them is a constant punishment,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹fiercely˺ driven away. And they will suffer an everlasting torment.

ayahs.textArabic: إِلَّا مَنۡ خَطِفَ ٱلۡخَطۡفَةَ فَأَتۡبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٞ ثَاقِبٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Illa man khatifa alkhatfata faatbaAAahu shihabun thaqibun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Except one who snatches [some words] by theft, but they are pursued by a burning flame, piercing [in brightness].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But whoever manages to stealthily eavesdrop is ˹instantly˺ pursued by a piercing flare.

ayahs.textArabic: فَٱسۡتَفۡتِهِمۡ أَهُمۡ أَشَدُّ خَلۡقًا أَم مَّنۡ خَلَقۡنَآۚ إِنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰهُم مِّن طِينٖ لَّازِبِۭ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faistaftihim ahum ashaddu khalqan am man khalaqna inna khalaqnahum min teenin lazibin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then inquire of them, [O Muhammad], "Are they a stronger [or more difficult] creation or those [others] We have created?" Indeed, We created men from sticky clay.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So ask them ˹O Prophet˺, which is harder to create: them or other marvels of Our creation? Indeed, We created them from a sticky clay.

ayahs.textArabic: بَلۡ عَجِبۡتَ وَيَسۡخَرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Bal AAajibta wayaskharoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But you wonder, while they mock,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: In fact, you are astonished ˹by their denial˺, while they ridicule ˹you˺.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِذَا ذُكِّرُواْ لَا يَذۡكُرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waitha thukkiroo la yathkuroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when they are reminded, they remember not.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: When they are reminded, they are never mindful.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِذَا رَأَوۡاْ ءَايَةٗ يَسۡتَسۡخِرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waitha raaw ayatan yastaskhiroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when they see a sign, they ridicule
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And whenever they see a sign, they make fun of it,

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالُوٓاْ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحۡرٞ مُّبِينٌ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waqaloo in hatha illa sihrun mubeenun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And say, "This is not but obvious magic.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: saying, “This is nothing but pure magic.

ayahs.textArabic: أَءِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابٗا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبۡعُوثُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Aitha mitna wakunna turaban waAAithaman ainna lamabAAoothoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: When we are dead and reduced to dust and bones, will we really be resurrected?

ayahs.textArabic: أَوَءَابَآؤُنَا ٱلۡأَوَّلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Awaabaona alawwaloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And our forefathers [as well]?"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And our forefathers as well?”

ayahs.textArabic: قُلۡ نَعَمۡ وَأَنتُمۡ دَٰخِرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qul naAAam waantum dakhiroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Say, "Yes, and you will be [rendered] contemptible."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Say, “Yes! And you will be fully humbled.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ زَجۡرَةٞ وَٰحِدَةٞ فَإِذَا هُمۡ يَنظُرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fainnama hiya zajratun wahidatun faitha hum yanthuroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: It will be only one shout, and at once they will be observing.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: It will only take one Blast, then at once they will see ˹it all˺.

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالُواْ يَٰوَيۡلَنَا هَٰذَا يَوۡمُ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waqaloo ya waylana hatha yawmu alddeeni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They will say, "O woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They will cry, “Oh, woe to us! This is the Day of Judgment!”

ayahs.textArabic: هَٰذَا يَوۡمُ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Hatha yawmu alfasli allathee kuntum bihi tukaththiboona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [They will be told], "This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹They will be told,˺ “This is the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision which you used to deny.”

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ ٱحۡشُرُواْ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ وَأَزۡوَٰجَهُمۡ وَمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡبُدُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ohshuroo allatheena thalamoo waazwajahum wama kanoo yaAAbudoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [The angels will be ordered], "Gather those who committed wrong, their kinds, and what they used to worship
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Allah will say to the angels,˺ “Gather ˹all˺ the wrongdoers along with their peers, and whatever they used to worship

ayahs.textArabic: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَٱهۡدُوهُمۡ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Min dooni Allahi faihdoohum ila sirati aljaheemi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Other than Allah, and guide them to the path of Hellfire
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: instead of Allah, then lead them ˹all˺ to the path of Hell.

ayahs.textArabic: وَقِفُوهُمۡۖ إِنَّهُم مَّسۡـُٔولُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waqifoohum innahum masooloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And stop them; indeed, they are to be questioned."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And detain them, for they must be questioned.”

ayahs.textArabic: مَا لَكُمۡ لَا تَنَاصَرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ma lakum la tanasaroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [They will be asked], "What is [wrong] with you? Why do you not help each other?"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Then they will be asked,˺ “What is the matter with you that you can no longer help each other?”

ayahs.textArabic: بَلۡ هُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ مُسۡتَسۡلِمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Bal humu alyawma mustaslimoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But they, that Day, are in surrender.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: In fact, on that Day they will be ˹fully˺ submissive.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَقۡبَلَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٖ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waaqbala baAAduhum AAala baAAdin yatasaaloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And they will approach one another blaming each other.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They will turn on each other, throwing blame.

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّكُمۡ كُنتُمۡ تَأۡتُونَنَا عَنِ ٱلۡيَمِينِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qaloo innakum kuntum tatoonana AAani alyameeni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They will say, "Indeed, you used to come at us from the right."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The misled will say, “It was you who deluded us away from what is right.”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُواْ بَل لَّمۡ تَكُونُواْ مُؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qaloo bal lam takoonoo mumineena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The oppressors will say, "Rather, you [yourselves] were not believers,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The misleaders will reply, “No! You disbelieved on your own.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيۡكُم مِّن سُلۡطَٰنِۭۖ بَلۡ كُنتُمۡ قَوۡمٗا طَٰغِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama kana lana AAalaykum min sultanin bal kuntum qawman tagheena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And we had over you no authority, but you were a transgressing people.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We had no authority over you. In fact, you yourselves were a transgressing people.

ayahs.textArabic: فَحَقَّ عَلَيۡنَا قَوۡلُ رَبِّنَآۖ إِنَّا لَذَآئِقُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fahaqqa AAalayna qawlu rabbina inna lathaiqoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So the word of our Lord has come into effect upon us; indeed, we will taste [punishment].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The decree of our Lord has come to pass against us ˹all˺: we will certainly taste ˹the punishment˺.

ayahs.textArabic: فَأَغۡوَيۡنَٰكُمۡ إِنَّا كُنَّا غَٰوِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faaghwaynakum inna kunna ghaweena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And we led you to deviation; indeed, we were deviators."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We caused you to deviate, for we ourselves were deviant.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَإِنَّهُمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٖ فِي ٱلۡعَذَابِ مُشۡتَرِكُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fainnahum yawmaithin fee alAAathabi mushtarikoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So indeed they, that Day, will be sharing in the punishment.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Surely on that Day they will ˹all˺ share in the punishment.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَفۡعَلُ بِٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna kathalika nafAAalu bialmujrimeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, that is how We deal with the criminals.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: That is certainly how We deal with the wicked.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوٓاْ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمۡ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ يَسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innahum kanoo itha qeela lahum la ilaha illa Allahu yastakbiroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed they, when it was said to them, "There is no deity but Allah," were arrogant
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: For whenever it was said to them ˹in the world˺, “There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Allah,” they acted arrogantly

ayahs.textArabic: وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُوٓاْ ءَالِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٖ مَّجۡنُونِۭ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wayaqooloona ainna latarikoo alihatina lishaAAirin majnoonin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And were saying, "Are we to leave our gods for a mad poet?"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and argued, “Should we really abandon our gods for a mad poet?”

ayahs.textArabic: بَلۡ جَآءَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَصَدَّقَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Bal jaa bialhaqqi wasaddaqa almursaleena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Rather, the Prophet has come with the truth and confirmed the [previous] messengers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: In fact, he came with the truth, confirming ˹earlier˺ messengers.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّكُمۡ لَذَآئِقُواْ ٱلۡعَذَابِ ٱلۡأَلِيمِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innakum lathaiqoo alAAathabi alaleemi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, you [disbelievers] will be tasters of the painful punishment,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: You will certainly taste the painful torment,

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama tujzawna illa ma kuntum taAAmaloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and will only be rewarded for what you used to do.

ayahs.textArabic: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Illa AAibada Allahi almukhlaseena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But not the chosen servants of Allah.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But not the chosen servants of Allah.

ayahs.textArabic: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ رِزۡقٞ مَّعۡلُومٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Olaika lahum rizqun maAAloomun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Those will have a provision determined -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They will have a known provision:

ayahs.textArabic: فَوَٰكِهُ وَهُم مُّكۡرَمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fawakihu wahum mukramoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Fruits; and they will be honored
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: fruits ˹of every type˺. And they will be honoured

ayahs.textArabic: فِي جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fee jannati alnnaAAeemi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: In gardens of pleasure
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: in the Gardens of Bliss,

ayahs.textArabic: عَلَىٰ سُرُرٖ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: AAala sururin mutaqabileena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: On thrones facing one another.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: facing each other on thrones.

ayahs.textArabic: يُطَافُ عَلَيۡهِم بِكَأۡسٖ مِّن مَّعِينِۭ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yutafu AAalayhim bikasin min maAAeenin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: There will be circulated among them a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: A drink ˹of pure wine˺ will be passed around to them from a flowing stream:

ayahs.textArabic: بَيۡضَآءَ لَذَّةٖ لِّلشَّٰرِبِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Baydaa laththatin lilshsharibeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: White and delicious to the drinkers;
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: crystal-white, delicious to drink.

ayahs.textArabic: لَا فِيهَا غَوۡلٞ وَلَا هُمۡ عَنۡهَا يُنزَفُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: La feeha ghawlun wala hum AAanha yunzafoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: No bad effect is there in it, nor from it will they be intoxicated.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: It will neither harm ˹them˺, nor will they be intoxicated by it.

ayahs.textArabic: وَعِندَهُمۡ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرۡفِ عِينٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: WaAAindahum qasiratu alttarfi AAeenun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances, with large, [beautiful] eyes,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And with them will be maidens of modest gaze and gorgeous eyes,

ayahs.textArabic: كَأَنَّهُنَّ بَيۡضٞ مَّكۡنُونٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kaannahunna baydun maknoonun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: As if they were [delicate] eggs, well-protected.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: as if they were pristine pearls.

ayahs.textArabic: فَأَقۡبَلَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٖ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faaqbala baAAduhum AAala baAAdin yatasaaloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then they will turn to one another inquisitively.

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ قَآئِلٞ مِّنۡهُمۡ إِنِّي كَانَ لِي قَرِينٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala qailun minhum innee kana lee qareenun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: A speaker among them will say, "Indeed, I had a companion [on earth]
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: One of them will say, “I once had a companion ˹in the world˺

ayahs.textArabic: يَقُولُ أَءِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلۡمُصَدِّقِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yaqoolu ainnaka lamina almusaddiqeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Who would say, 'Are you indeed of those who believe
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: who used to ask ˹me˺, ‘Do you actually believe ˹in resurrection˺?

ayahs.textArabic: أَءِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابٗا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Aitha mitna wakunna turaban waAAithaman ainna lamadeenoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: That when we have died and become dust and bones, we will indeed be recompensed?'"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: When we are dead and reduced to dust and bones, will we really be brought to judgment?’”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ هَلۡ أَنتُم مُّطَّلِعُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala hal antum muttaliAAoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He will say, "Would you [care to] look?"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He will ˹then˺ ask, “Would you care to see ˹his fate˺?”

ayahs.textArabic: فَٱطَّلَعَ فَرَءَاهُ فِي سَوَآءِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: FaittalaAAa faraahu fee sawai aljaheemi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And he will look and see him in the midst of the Hellfire.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then he ˹and the others˺ will look and spot him in the midst of the Hellfire.

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ تَٱللَّهِ إِن كِدتَّ لَتُرۡدِينِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala taAllahi in kidta laturdeeni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He will say, "By Allah, you almost ruined me.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He will ˹then˺ say, “By Allah! You nearly ruined me.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَوۡلَا نِعۡمَةُ رَبِّي لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلۡمُحۡضَرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walawla niAAmatu rabbee lakuntu mina almuhdareena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: If not for the favor of my Lord, I would have been of those brought in [to Hell].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Had it not been for the grace of my Lord, I ˹too˺ would have certainly been among those brought ˹to Hell˺.”

ayahs.textArabic: أَفَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمَيِّتِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Afama nahnu bimayyiteena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then, are we not to die
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Then he will ask his fellow believers,˺ “Can you imagine that we will never die,

ayahs.textArabic: إِلَّا مَوۡتَتَنَا ٱلۡأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Illa mawtatana aloola wama nahnu bimuAAaththabeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Except for our first death, and we will not be punished?"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: except our first death, nor be punished ˹like the others˺?”

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna hatha lahuwa alfawzu alAAatheemu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, this is the great attainment.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: This is truly the ultimate triumph.

ayahs.textArabic: لِمِثۡلِ هَٰذَا فَلۡيَعۡمَلِ ٱلۡعَٰمِلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Limithli hatha falyaAAmali alAAamiloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: For the like of this let the workers [on earth] work.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: For such ˹honour˺ all should strive.

ayahs.textArabic: أَذَٰلِكَ خَيۡرٞ نُّزُلًا أَمۡ شَجَرَةُ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Athalika khayrun nuzulan am shajaratu alzzaqqoomi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Is Paradise a better accommodation or the tree of zaqqum?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Is this ˹bliss˺ a better accommodation or the tree of Zaqqûm?

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَٰهَا فِتۡنَةٗ لِّلظَّٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna jaAAalnaha fitnatan lilththalimeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, We have made it a torment for the wrongdoers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We have surely made it a test for the wrongdoers.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٞ تَخۡرُجُ فِيٓ أَصۡلِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innaha shajaratun takhruju fee asli aljaheemi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, it is a tree issuing from the bottom of the Hellfire,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, it is a tree that grows in the depths of Hell,

ayahs.textArabic: طَلۡعُهَا كَأَنَّهُۥ رُءُوسُ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: TalAAuha kaannahu ruoosu alshshayateeni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Its emerging fruit as if it was heads of the devils.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: bearing fruit like devils’ heads.

ayahs.textArabic: فَإِنَّهُمۡ لَأٓكِلُونَ مِنۡهَا فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنۡهَا ٱلۡبُطُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fainnahum laakiloona minha famalioona minha albutoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And indeed, they will eat from it and fill with it their bellies.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The evildoers will certainly ˹be left to˺ eat from it, filling up their bellies with it.

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمۡ عَلَيۡهَا لَشَوۡبٗا مِّنۡ حَمِيمٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thumma inna lahum AAalayha lashawban min hameemin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then indeed, they will have after it a mixture of scalding water.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then on top of that they will be given a blend of boiling drink.

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ مَرۡجِعَهُمۡ لَإِلَى ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thumma inna marjiAAahum laila aljaheemi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then indeed, their return will be to the Hellfire.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then they will ultimately return to ˹their place in˺ Hell.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّهُمۡ أَلۡفَوۡاْ ءَابَآءَهُمۡ ضَآلِّينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innahum alfaw abaahum dalleena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed they found their fathers astray.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, they found their forefathers astray,

ayahs.textArabic: فَهُمۡ عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِمۡ يُهۡرَعُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fahum AAala atharihim yuhraAAoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So they hastened [to follow] in their footsteps.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: so they rushed in their footsteps!

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدۡ ضَلَّ قَبۡلَهُمۡ أَكۡثَرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walaqad dalla qablahum aktharu alawwaleena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And there had already strayed before them most of the former peoples,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And surely most of the earlier generations had strayed before them,

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا فِيهِم مُّنذِرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walaqad arsalna feehim munthireena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We had already sent among them warners.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: although We had certainly sent warners among them.

ayahs.textArabic: فَٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلۡمُنذَرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faonthur kayfa kana AAaqibatu almunthareena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then look how was the end of those who were warned -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: See then what was the end of those who had been warned.

ayahs.textArabic: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Illa AAibada Allahi almukhlaseena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But not the chosen servants of Allah.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But not the chosen servants of Allah.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدۡ نَادَىٰنَا نُوحٞ فَلَنِعۡمَ ٱلۡمُجِيبُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walaqad nadana noohun falaniAAma almujeeboona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And Noah had certainly called Us, and [We are] the best of responders.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, Noah cried out to Us, and how excellent are We in responding!

ayahs.textArabic: وَنَجَّيۡنَٰهُ وَأَهۡلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلۡكَرۡبِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wanajjaynahu waahlahu mina alkarbi alAAatheemi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We saved him and his family from the great affliction.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We delivered him and his family from the great distress,

ayahs.textArabic: وَجَعَلۡنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥ هُمُ ٱلۡبَاقِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: WajaAAalna thurriyyatahu humu albaqeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We made his descendants those remaining [on the earth]
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and made his descendants the sole survivors.

ayahs.textArabic: وَتَرَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Watarakna AAalayhi fee alakhireena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And We blessed him ˹with honourable mention˺ among later generations:

ayahs.textArabic: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ نُوحٖ فِي ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Salamun AAala noohin fee alAAalameena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: "Peace upon Noah among the worlds."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: “Peace be upon Noah among all peoples.”

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna kathalika najzee almuhsineena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, this is how We reward the good-doers.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّهُۥ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innahu min AAibadina almumineena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹For˺ he was truly one of Our faithful servants.

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ أَغۡرَقۡنَا ٱلۡأٓخَرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thumma aghraqna alakhareena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then We drowned the disbelievers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then We drowned the others.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ وَإِنَّ مِن شِيعَتِهِۦ لَإِبۡرَٰهِيمَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wainna min sheeAAatihi laibraheema
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And indeed, among his kind was Abraham,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And indeed, one of those who followed his way was Abraham.

ayahs.textArabic: إِذۡ جَآءَ رَبَّهُۥ بِقَلۡبٖ سَلِيمٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ith jaa rabbahu biqalbin saleemin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: When he came to his Lord with a sound heart
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Remember˺ when he came to his Lord with a pure heart,

ayahs.textArabic: إِذۡ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوۡمِهِۦ مَاذَا تَعۡبُدُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ith qala liabeehi waqawmihi matha taAAbudoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [And] when he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and said to his father and his people, “What are you worshipping?

ayahs.textArabic: أَئِفۡكًا ءَالِهَةٗ دُونَ ٱللَّهِ تُرِيدُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Aifkan alihatan doona Allahi tureedoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Is it falsehood [as] gods other than Allah you desire?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Is it false gods that you desire instead of Allah?

ayahs.textArabic: فَمَا ظَنُّكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fama thannukum birabbi alAAalameena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then what is your thought about the Lord of the worlds?"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: What then do you expect from the Lord of all worlds?”

ayahs.textArabic: فَنَظَرَ نَظۡرَةٗ فِي ٱلنُّجُومِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fanathara nathratan fee alnnujoomi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And he cast a look at the stars
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He later looked up to the stars ˹in contemplation˺,

ayahs.textArabic: فَقَالَ إِنِّي سَقِيمٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faqala innee saqeemun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And said, "Indeed, I am [about to be] ill."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: then said, “I am really sick.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَتَوَلَّوۡاْ عَنۡهُ مُدۡبِرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fatawallaw AAanhu mudbireena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So they turned away from him, departing.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So they turned their backs on him and went away.

ayahs.textArabic: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِهِمۡ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأۡكُلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faragha ila alihatihim faqala ala takuloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then he turned to their gods and said, "Do you not eat?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then he ˹stealthily˺ advanced towards their gods, and said ˹mockingly˺, “Will you not eat ˹your offerings˺?

ayahs.textArabic: مَا لَكُمۡ لَا تَنطِقُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ma lakum la tantiqoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: What is [wrong] with you that you do not speak?"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: What is wrong with you that you cannot speak?”

ayahs.textArabic: فَرَاغَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ضَرۡبَۢا بِٱلۡيَمِينِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faragha AAalayhim darban bialyameeni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And he turned upon them a blow with [his] right hand.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then he swiftly turned on them, striking ˹them˺ with his right hand.

ayahs.textArabic: فَأَقۡبَلُوٓاْ إِلَيۡهِ يَزِفُّونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faaqbaloo ilayhi yaziffoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then the people came toward him, hastening.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Later, his people came rushing towards him ˹furiously˺.

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ أَتَعۡبُدُونَ مَا تَنۡحِتُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala ataAAbudoona ma tanhitoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He said, "Do you worship that which you [yourselves] carve,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He argued, “How can you worship what you carve ˹with your own hands˺,

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمۡ وَمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: WaAllahu khalaqakum wama taAAmaloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: While Allah created you and that which you do?"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: when it is Allah Who created you and whatever you do?”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُواْ ٱبۡنُواْ لَهُۥ بُنۡيَٰنٗا فَأَلۡقُوهُ فِي ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qaloo ibnoo lahu bunyanan faalqoohu fee aljaheemi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They said, "Construct for him a furnace and throw him into the burning fire."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They said ˹to one another˺, “Build him a furnace and cast him into the blazing fire.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَأَرَادُواْ بِهِۦ كَيۡدٗا فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمُ ٱلۡأَسۡفَلِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faaradoo bihi kaydan fajaAAalnahumu alasfaleena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And they intended for him a plan, but We made them the most debased.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And so they sought to harm him, but We made them inferior.

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالَ إِنِّي ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّي سَيَهۡدِينِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waqala innee thahibun ila rabbee sayahdeeni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [then] he said, "Indeed, I will go to [where I am ordered by] my Lord; He will guide me.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He later said, “I am leaving ˹in obedience˺ to my Lord. He will guide me.

ayahs.textArabic: رَبِّ هَبۡ لِي مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Rabbi hab lee mina alssaliheena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: My Lord! Bless me with righteous offspring.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَبَشَّرۡنَٰهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ حَلِيمٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fabashsharnahu bighulamin haleemin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So We gave him good tidings of a forbearing boy.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So We gave him good news of a forbearing son.

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعۡيَ قَالَ يَٰبُنَيَّ إِنِّيٓ أَرَىٰ فِي ٱلۡمَنَامِ أَنِّيٓ أَذۡبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرۡ مَاذَا تَرَىٰۚ قَالَ يَٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفۡعَلۡ مَا تُؤۡمَرُۖ سَتَجِدُنِيٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Falamma balagha maAAahu alssaAAya qala ya bunayya innee ara fee almanami annee athbahuka faonthur matha tara qala ya abati ifAAal ma tumaru satajidunee in shaa Allahu mina alssabireena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allah wills, of the steadfast."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then when the boy reached the age to work with him, Abraham said, “O my dear son! I have seen in a dream that I ˹must˺ sacrifice you. So tell me what you think.” He replied, “O my dear father! Do as you are commanded. Allah willing, you will find me steadfast.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَمَّآ أَسۡلَمَا وَتَلَّهُۥ لِلۡجَبِينِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Falamma aslama watallahu liljabeeni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when they had both submitted and he put him down upon his forehead,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then when they submitted ˹to Allah’s Will˺, and Abraham laid him on his forehead ˹for sacrifice˺,

ayahs.textArabic: وَنَٰدَيۡنَٰهُ أَن يَٰٓإِبۡرَٰهِيمُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wanadaynahu an ya ibraheemu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: We called to him, "O Abraham,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We called out to him, “O Abraham!

ayahs.textArabic: قَدۡ صَدَّقۡتَ ٱلرُّءۡيَآۚ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qad saddaqta alrruya inna kathalika najzee almuhsineena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: You have fulfilled the vision." Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: You have already fulfilled the vision.” Indeed, this is how We reward the good-doers.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلۡبَلَٰٓؤُاْ ٱلۡمُبِينُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna hatha lahuwa albalao almubeenu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, this was the clear trial.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: That was truly a revealing test.

ayahs.textArabic: وَفَدَيۡنَٰهُ بِذِبۡحٍ عَظِيمٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wafadaynahu bithibhin AAatheemin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And We ransomed his son with a great sacrifice,

ayahs.textArabic: وَتَرَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Watarakna AAalayhi fee alakhireena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and blessed Abraham ˹with honourable mention˺ among later generations:

ayahs.textArabic: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Salamun AAala ibraheema
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: "Peace upon Abraham."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: “Peace be upon Abraham.”

ayahs.textArabic: كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kathalika najzee almuhsineena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: This is how We reward the good-doers.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّهُۥ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innahu min AAibadina almumineena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He was truly one of Our faithful servants.

ayahs.textArabic: وَبَشَّرۡنَٰهُ بِإِسۡحَٰقَ نَبِيّٗا مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wabashsharnahu biishaqa nabiyyan mina alssaliheena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We gave him good tidings of Isaac, a prophet from among the righteous.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We ˹later˺ gave him good news of Isaac—a prophet, and one of the righteous.

ayahs.textArabic: وَبَٰرَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ وَعَلَىٰٓ إِسۡحَٰقَۚ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحۡسِنٞ وَظَالِمٞ لِّنَفۡسِهِۦ مُبِينٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wabarakna AAalayhi waAAala ishaqa wamin thurriyyatihima muhsinun wathalimun linafsihi mubeenun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We blessed him and Isaac. But among their descendants is the doer of good and the clearly unjust to himself.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We blessed him and Isaac as well. Some of their descendants did good, while others clearly wronged themselves.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدۡ مَنَنَّا عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walaqad mananna AAala moosa waharoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We did certainly confer favor upon Moses and Aaron.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And We certainly showed favour to Moses and Aaron,

ayahs.textArabic: وَنَجَّيۡنَٰهُمَا وَقَوۡمَهُمَا مِنَ ٱلۡكَرۡبِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wanajjaynahuma waqawmahuma mina alkarbi alAAatheemi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We saved them and their people from the great affliction,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and delivered them and their people from the great distress.

ayahs.textArabic: وَنَصَرۡنَٰهُمۡ فَكَانُواْ هُمُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wanasarnahum fakanoo humu alghalibeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We supported them so it was they who overcame.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We helped them so it was they who prevailed.

ayahs.textArabic: وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمَا ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ ٱلۡمُسۡتَبِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waataynahuma alkitaba almustabeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We gave them the explicit Scripture,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We gave them the clear Scripture,

ayahs.textArabic: وَهَدَيۡنَٰهُمَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلۡمُسۡتَقِيمَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wahadaynahuma alssirata almustaqeema
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We guided them on the straight path.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and guided them to the Straight Path.

ayahs.textArabic: وَتَرَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمَا فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Watarakna AAalayhima fee alakhireena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We left for them [favorable mention] among later generations:
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And We blessed them ˹with honourable mention˺ among later generations:

ayahs.textArabic: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Salamun AAala moosa waharoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: "Peace upon Moses and Aaron."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: “Peace be upon Moses and Aaron.”

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna kathalika najzee almuhsineena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, this is how We reward the good-doers.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّهُمَا مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innahuma min AAibadina almumineena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, they were of Our believing servants.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They were truly ˹two˺ of Our faithful servants.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِنَّ إِلۡيَاسَ لَمِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wainna ilyasa lamina almursaleena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And indeed, Elias was from among the messengers,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And Elias was indeed one of the messengers.

ayahs.textArabic: إِذۡ قَالَ لِقَوۡمِهِۦٓ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ith qala liqawmihi ala tattaqoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: When he said to his people, "Will you not fear Allah?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Remember˺ when he said to his people, “Will you not fear ˹Allah˺?

ayahs.textArabic: أَتَدۡعُونَ بَعۡلٗا وَتَذَرُونَ أَحۡسَنَ ٱلۡخَٰلِقِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: AtadAAoona baAAlan watatharoona ahsana alkhaliqeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Do you call upon Ba'l and leave the best of creators -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Do you call upon ˹the idol of˺ Ba’l and abandon the Best of Creators—

ayahs.textArabic: ٱللَّهَ رَبَّكُمۡ وَرَبَّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Allaha rabbakum warabba abaikumu alawwaleena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Allah, your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers?"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Allah, your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers?”

ayahs.textArabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَإِنَّهُمۡ لَمُحۡضَرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fakaththaboohu fainnahum lamuhdaroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And they denied him, so indeed, they will be brought [for punishment],
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But they rejected him, so they will certainly be brought ˹for punishment˺.

ayahs.textArabic: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Illa AAibada Allahi almukhlaseena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Except the chosen servants of Allah.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But not the chosen servants of Allah.

ayahs.textArabic: وَتَرَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Watarakna AAalayhi fee alakhireena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We blessed him ˹with honourable mention˺ among later generations:

ayahs.textArabic: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِلۡ يَاسِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Salamun AAala il yaseena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: "Peace upon Elias."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: “Peace be upon Elias.”

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna kathalika najzee almuhsineena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, this is how We reward the good-doers.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّهُۥ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innahu min AAibadina almumineena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He was truly one of Our faithful servants.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِنَّ لُوطٗا لَّمِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wainna lootan lamina almursaleena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And indeed, Lot was among the messengers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And Lot was indeed one of the messengers.

ayahs.textArabic: إِذۡ نَجَّيۡنَٰهُ وَأَهۡلَهُۥٓ أَجۡمَعِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ith najjaynahu waahlahu ajmaAAeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [So mention] when We saved him and his family, all,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Remember˺ when We delivered him and all of his family,

ayahs.textArabic: إِلَّا عَجُوزٗا فِي ٱلۡغَٰبِرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Illa AAajoozan fee alghabireena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Except his wife among those who remained [with the evildoers].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: except an old woman, who was one of the doomed.

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ دَمَّرۡنَا ٱلۡأٓخَرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thumma dammarna alakhareena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then We destroyed the others.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then We ˹utterly˺ destroyed the rest.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِنَّكُمۡ لَتَمُرُّونَ عَلَيۡهِم مُّصۡبِحِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wainnakum latamurroona AAalayhim musbiheena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And indeed, you pass by them in the morning
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: You ˹Meccans˺ certainly pass by their ruins day

ayahs.textArabic: وَبِٱلَّيۡلِۚ أَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wabiallayli afala taAAqiloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And at night. Then will you not use reason?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and night. Will you not then understand?

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِنَّ يُونُسَ لَمِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
