ayahs.textTransliteration: Wainna yoonusa lamina almursaleena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And indeed, Jonah was among the messengers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And Jonah was indeed one of the messengers.

ayahs.textArabic: إِذۡ أَبَقَ إِلَى ٱلۡفُلۡكِ ٱلۡمَشۡحُونِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ith abaqa ila alfulki almashhooni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Mention] when he ran away to the laden ship.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Remember˺ when he fled to the overloaded ship.

ayahs.textArabic: فَسَاهَمَ فَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُدۡحَضِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fasahama fakana mina almudhadeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And he drew lots and was among the losers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then ˹to save it from sinking,˺ he drew straws ˹with other passengers˺. He lost ˹and was thrown overboard˺.

ayahs.textArabic: فَٱلۡتَقَمَهُ ٱلۡحُوتُ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Failtaqamahu alhootu wahuwa muleemun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then the fish swallowed him, while he was blameworthy.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then the whale engulfed him while he was blameworthy.

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَوۡلَآ أَنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُسَبِّحِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Falawla annahu kana mina almusabbiheena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And had he not been of those who exalt Allah,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Had he not ˹constantly˺ glorified ˹Allah˺,

ayahs.textArabic: لَلَبِثَ فِي بَطۡنِهِۦٓ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ يُبۡعَثُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Lalabitha fee batnihi ila yawmi yubAAathoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He would have remained inside its belly until the Day they are resurrected.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: he would have certainly remained in its belly until the Day of Resurrection.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ فَنَبَذۡنَٰهُ بِٱلۡعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ سَقِيمٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fanabathnahu bialAAarai wahuwa saqeemun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But We threw him onto the open shore while he was ill.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But We cast him onto the open ˹shore˺, ˹totally˺ worn out,

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَنۢبَتۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ شَجَرَةٗ مِّن يَقۡطِينٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waanbatna AAalayhi shajaratan min yaqteenin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We caused to grow over him a gourd vine.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and caused a squash plant to grow over him.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَرۡسَلۡنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِاْئَةِ أَلۡفٍ أَوۡ يَزِيدُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waarsalnahu ila miati alfin aw yazeedoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We sent him to [his people of] a hundred thousand or more.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We ˹later˺ sent him ˹back˺ to ˹his city of˺ at least one hundred thousand people,

ayahs.textArabic: فَـَٔامَنُواْ فَمَتَّعۡنَٰهُمۡ إِلَىٰ حِينٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faamanoo famattaAAnahum ila heenin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And they believed, so We gave them enjoyment [of life] for a time.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: who then believed ˹in him˺, so We allowed them enjoyment for a while.

ayahs.textArabic: فَٱسۡتَفۡتِهِمۡ أَلِرَبِّكَ ٱلۡبَنَاتُ وَلَهُمُ ٱلۡبَنُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faistaftihim alirabbika albanatu walahumu albanoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So inquire of them, [O Muhammad], "Does your Lord have daughters while they have sons?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Ask them ˹O Prophet˺ if your Lord has daughters, while the pagans ˹prefer to˺ have sons.

ayahs.textArabic: أَمۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ إِنَٰثٗا وَهُمۡ شَٰهِدُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Am khalaqna almalaikata inathan wahum shahidoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Or did We create the angels as females while they were witnesses?"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Or ˹ask them˺ if We created the angels as females right before their eyes.

ayahs.textArabic: أَلَآ إِنَّهُم مِّنۡ إِفۡكِهِمۡ لَيَقُولُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ala innahum min ifkihim layaqooloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Unquestionably, it is out of their [invented] falsehood that they say,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, it is one of their ˹outrageous˺ fabrications to say,

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَدَ ٱللَّهُ وَإِنَّهُمۡ لَكَٰذِبُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walada Allahu wainnahum lakathiboona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: " Allah has begotten," and indeed, they are liars.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: “Allah has children.” They are simply liars.

ayahs.textArabic: أَصۡطَفَى ٱلۡبَنَاتِ عَلَى ٱلۡبَنِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Astafa albanati AAala albaneena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Has He chosen daughters over sons?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Has He chosen daughters over sons?

ayahs.textArabic: مَا لَكُمۡ كَيۡفَ تَحۡكُمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ma lakum kayfa tahkumoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: What is [wrong] with you? How do you make judgement?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: What is the matter with you? How do you judge?

ayahs.textArabic: أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Afala tathakkaroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then will you not be reminded?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Will you not then be mindful?

ayahs.textArabic: أَمۡ لَكُمۡ سُلۡطَٰنٞ مُّبِينٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Am lakum sultanun mubeenun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Or do you have a clear authority?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Or do you have ˹any˺ compelling proof?

ayahs.textArabic: فَأۡتُواْ بِكِتَٰبِكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fatoo bikitabikum in kuntum sadiqeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then produce your scripture, if you should be truthful.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then bring ˹us˺ your scripture, if what you say is true!

ayahs.textArabic: وَجَعَلُواْ بَيۡنَهُۥ وَبَيۡنَ ٱلۡجِنَّةِ نَسَبٗاۚ وَلَقَدۡ عَلِمَتِ ٱلۡجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمۡ لَمُحۡضَرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: WajaAAaloo baynahu wabayna aljinnati nasaban walaqad AAalimati aljinnatu innahum lamuhdaroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And they have claimed between Him and the jinn a lineage, but the jinn have already known that they [who made such claims] will be brought to [punishment].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They have also established a ˹marital˺ relationship between Him and the jinn. Yet the jinn ˹themselves˺ know well that such people will certainly be brought ˹for punishment˺.

ayahs.textArabic: سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Subhana Allahi AAamma yasifoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Exalted is Allah above what they describe,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Glorified is Allah far above what they claim!

ayahs.textArabic: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Illa AAibada Allahi almukhlaseena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Except the chosen servants of Allah [who do not share in that sin].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But not the chosen servants of Allah.

ayahs.textArabic: فَإِنَّكُمۡ وَمَا تَعۡبُدُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fainnakum wama taAAbudoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So indeed, you [disbelievers] and whatever you worship,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Surely you ˹pagans˺ and whatever ˹idols˺ you worship

ayahs.textArabic: مَآ أَنتُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ بِفَٰتِنِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ma antum AAalayhi bifatineena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: You cannot tempt [anyone] away from Him
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: can never lure ˹anyone˺ away from Him

ayahs.textArabic: إِلَّا مَنۡ هُوَ صَالِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Illa man huwa sali aljaheemi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Except he who is to [enter and] burn in the Hellfire.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: except those ˹destined˺ to burn in Hell.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا مِنَّآ إِلَّا لَهُۥ مَقَامٞ مَّعۡلُومٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama minna illa lahu maqamun maAAloomun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [The angels say], "There is not among us any except that he has a known position.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹The angels respond,˺ “There is not one of us without an assigned station ˹of worship˺.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِنَّا لَنَحۡنُ ٱلصَّآفُّونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wainna lanahnu alssaffoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And indeed, we are those who line up [for prayer].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We are indeed the ones lined up in ranks ˹for Allah˺.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِنَّا لَنَحۡنُ ٱلۡمُسَبِّحُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wainna lanahnu almusabbihoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And indeed, we are those who exalt Allah."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And we are indeed the ones ˹constantly˺ glorifying ˹His praise˺.”

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِن كَانُواْ لَيَقُولُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wain kanoo layaqooloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And indeed, the disbelievers used to say,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They certainly used to say,

ayahs.textArabic: لَوۡ أَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكۡرٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Law anna AAindana thikran mina alawwaleena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: "If we had a message from [those of] the former peoples,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: “If only we had a Reminder like ˹those of˺ earlier peoples,

ayahs.textArabic: لَكُنَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Lakunna AAibada Allahi almukhlaseena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: We would have been the chosen servants of Allah."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: we would have truly been Allah’s devoted servants.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَكَفَرُواْ بِهِۦۖ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fakafaroo bihi fasawfa yaAAlamoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But they disbelieved in it, so they are going to know.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But ˹now˺ they reject it, so they will soon know.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدۡ سَبَقَتۡ كَلِمَتُنَا لِعِبَادِنَا ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walaqad sabaqat kalimatuna liAAibadina almursaleena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And Our word has already preceded for Our servants, the messengers,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Our Word has already gone forth to Our servants, the messengers,

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّهُمۡ لَهُمُ ٱلۡمَنصُورُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innahum lahumu almansooroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [That] indeed, they would be those given victory
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: that they would surely be helped,

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِنَّ جُندَنَا لَهُمُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wainna jundana lahumu alghaliboona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [that] indeed, Our soldiers will be those who overcome.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and that Our forces will certainly prevail.

ayahs.textArabic: فَتَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ حِينٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fatawalla AAanhum hatta heenin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So, [O Muhammad], leave them for a time.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So turn away from the deniers for a while ˹O Prophet˺.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَبۡصِرۡهُمۡ فَسَوۡفَ يُبۡصِرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waabsirhum fasawfa yubsiroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And see [what will befall] them, for they are going to see.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: You will see ˹what will happen to˺ them, and they too will see!

ayahs.textArabic: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: AfabiAAathabina yastaAAjiloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then for Our punishment are they impatient?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Do they ˹really˺ wish to hasten Our punishment?

ayahs.textArabic: فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمۡ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ ٱلۡمُنذَرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faitha nazala bisahatihim fasaa sabahu almunthareena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But when it descends in their territory, then evil is the morning of those who were warned.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Yet when it descends upon them: how evil will that morning be for those who had been warned!

ayahs.textArabic: وَتَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ حِينٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Watawalla AAanhum hatta heenin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And leave them for a time.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And turn away from them for a while.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَبۡصِرۡ فَسَوۡفَ يُبۡصِرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waabsir fasawfa yubsiroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And see, for they are going to see.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: You will see, and they too will see!

ayahs.textArabic: سُبۡحَٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلۡعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Subhana rabbika rabbi alAAizzati AAamma yasifoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Exalted is your Lord, the Lord of might, above what they describe.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Glorified is your Lord—the Lord of Honour and Power—above what they claim!

ayahs.textArabic: وَسَلَٰمٌ عَلَى ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wasalamun AAala almursaleena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And peace upon the messengers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Peace be upon the messengers.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalhamdu lillahi rabbi alAAalameena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And praise be to Allah—Lord of all worlds.

ayahs.textArabic: صٓۚ وَٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ ذِي ٱلذِّكۡرِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Sad waalqurani thee alththikri
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Sad. By the Qur'an containing reminder...
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Ṣãd. By the Quran, full of reminders!

ayahs.textArabic: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِي عِزَّةٖ وَشِقَاقٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Bali allatheena kafaroo fee AAizzatin washiqaqin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But those who disbelieve are in pride and dissension.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹This is the truth,˺ yet the disbelievers are ˹entrenched˺ in arrogance and opposition.

ayahs.textArabic: كَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِهِم مِّن قَرۡنٖ فَنَادَواْ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kam ahlakna min qablihim min qarnin fanadaw walata heena manasin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, and they [then] called out; but it was not a time for escape.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Imagine˺ how many peoples We destroyed before them, and they cried out when it was too late to escape.

ayahs.textArabic: وَعَجِبُوٓاْ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٞ مِّنۡهُمۡۖ وَقَالَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا سَٰحِرٞ كَذَّابٌ
ayahs.textTransliteration: WaAAajiboo an jaahum munthirun minhum waqala alkafiroona hatha sahirun kaththabun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, "This is a magician and a liar.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Now, the pagans are astonished that a warner has come to them from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, “This is a magician, a total liar!

ayahs.textArabic: أَجَعَلَ ٱلۡأٓلِهَةَ إِلَٰهٗا وَٰحِدًاۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَيۡءٌ عُجَابٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: AjaAAala alalihata ilahan wahidan inna hatha lashayon AAujabun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Has he made the gods [only] one God? Indeed, this is a curious thing."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Has he reduced ˹all˺ the gods to One God? Indeed, this is something totally astonishing.”

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلۡمَلَأُ مِنۡهُمۡ أَنِ ٱمۡشُواْ وَٱصۡبِرُواْ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمۡۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَيۡءٞ يُرَادُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waintalaqa almalao minhum ani imshoo waisbiroo AAala alihatikum inna hatha lashayon yuradu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the eminent among them went forth, [saying], "Continue, and be patient over [the defense of] your gods. Indeed, this is a thing intended.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The chiefs among them went forth saying, “Carry on, and stand firm in devotion to your gods. Certainly this is just a scheme ˹for power˺.

ayahs.textArabic: مَا سَمِعۡنَا بِهَٰذَا فِي ٱلۡمِلَّةِ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخۡتِلَٰقٌ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ma samiAAna bihatha fee almillati alakhirati in hatha illa ikhtilaqun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: We have not heard of this in the latest religion. This is not but a fabrication.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We have never heard of this in the previous faith. This is nothing but a fabrication.

ayahs.textArabic: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيۡهِ ٱلذِّكۡرُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِنَاۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ فِي شَكّٖ مِّن ذِكۡرِيۚ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Aonzila AAalayhi alththikru min baynina bal hum fee shakkin min thikree bal lamma yathooqoo AAathabi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Has the message been revealed to him out of [all of] us?" Rather, they are in doubt about My message. Rather, they have not yet tasted My punishment.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Has the Reminder been revealed ˹only˺ to him out of ˹all of˺ us?” In fact, they are ˹only˺ in doubt of My ˹revealed˺ Reminder. In fact, ˹they do so because˺ they have not yet tasted My punishment.

ayahs.textArabic: أَمۡ عِندَهُمۡ خَزَآئِنُ رَحۡمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡوَهَّابِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Am AAindahum khazainu rahmati rabbika alAAazeezi alwahhabi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Or do they have the depositories of the mercy of your Lord, the Exalted in Might, the Bestower?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Or ˹is it because˺ they possess the treasuries of the mercy of your Lord—the Almighty, the Giver ˹of all bounties˺.

ayahs.textArabic: أَمۡ لَهُم مُّلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَاۖ فَلۡيَرۡتَقُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَسۡبَٰبِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Am lahum mulku alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma falyartaqoo fee alasbabi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Or is theirs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and what is between them? Then let them ascend through [any] ways of access.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Or ˹is it because˺ the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and everything in between belongs to them? Let them then climb their way ˹to heaven, if their claim is true˺.

ayahs.textArabic: جُندٞ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهۡزُومٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Jundun ma hunalika mahzoomun mina alahzabi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [They are but] soldiers [who will be] defeated there among the companies [of disbelievers].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: This is just another ˹enemy˺ force bound for defeat out there.

ayahs.textArabic: كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحٖ وَعَادٞ وَفِرۡعَوۡنُ ذُو ٱلۡأَوۡتَادِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kaththabat qablahum qawmu noohin waAAadun wafirAAawnu thoo alawtadi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The people of Noah denied before them, and [the tribe of] 'Aad and Pharaoh, the owner of stakes,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Before them, the people of Noah denied ˹the truth˺, as did ’Âd, Pharaoh of the mighty structures,

ayahs.textArabic: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوۡمُ لُوطٖ وَأَصۡحَٰبُ لۡـَٔيۡكَةِۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wathamoodu waqawmu lootin waashabu alaykati olaika alahzabu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [the tribe of] Thamud and the people of Lot and the companions of the thicket. Those are the companies.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Thamûd, the people of Lot, and the residents of the Forest. These were ˹all˺ enemy forces.

ayahs.textArabic: إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: In kullun illa kaththaba alrrusula fahaqqa AAiqabi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Each of them denied the messengers, so My penalty was justified.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Each rejected their messenger, so My punishment was justified.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا صَيۡحَةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama yanthuru haolai illa sayhatan wahidatan ma laha min fawaqin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And these [disbelievers] await not but one blast [of the Horn]; for it there will be no delay.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: These ˹pagans˺ are awaiting nothing but a single Blast that cannot be stopped.

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالُواْ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبۡلَ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡحِسَابِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waqaloo rabbana AAajjil lana qittana qabla yawmi alhisabi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And they say, "Our Lord, hasten for us our share [of the punishment] before the Day of Account"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They say ˹mockingly˺, “Our Lord! Hasten for us our share ˹of the punishment˺ before the Day of Reckoning.”

ayahs.textArabic: ٱصۡبِرۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذۡكُرۡ عَبۡدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلۡأَيۡدِۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Isbir AAala ma yaqooloona waothkur AAabdana dawooda tha alaydi innahu awwabun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Be patient over what they say and remember Our servant, David, the possessor of strength; indeed, he was one who repeatedly turned back [to Allah].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Be patient ˹O Prophet˺ with what they say. And remember Our servant, David, the man of strength. Indeed, he ˹constantly˺ turned ˹to Allah˺.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّا سَخَّرۡنَا ٱلۡجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحۡنَ بِٱلۡعَشِيِّ وَٱلۡإِشۡرَاقِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna sakhkharna aljibala maAAahu yusabbihna bialAAashiyyi waalishraqi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allah] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We truly subjected the mountains to hymn ˹Our praises˺ along with him in the evening and after sunrise.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلطَّيۡرَ مَحۡشُورَةٗۖ كُلّٞ لَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalttayra mahshooratan kullun lahu awwabun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the birds were assembled, all with him repeating [praises].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And ˹We subjected˺ the birds, flocking together. All turned to him ˹echoing his hymns˺.

ayahs.textArabic: وَشَدَدۡنَا مُلۡكَهُۥ وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ ٱلۡحِكۡمَةَ وَفَصۡلَ ٱلۡخِطَابِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Washadadna mulkahu waataynahu alhikmata wafasla alkhitabi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We strengthened his kingdom and gave him wisdom and discernment in speech.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We strengthened his kingship, and gave him wisdom and sound judgment.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ وَهَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ نَبَؤُاْ ٱلۡخَصۡمِ إِذۡ تَسَوَّرُواْ ٱلۡمِحۡرَابَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wahal ataka nabao alkhasmi ith tasawwaroo almihraba
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And has there come to you the news of the adversaries, when they climbed over the wall of [his] prayer chamber -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Has the story of the two plaintiffs, who scaled the ˹wall of David’s˺ sanctuary, reached you ˹O Prophet˺?

ayahs.textArabic: إِذۡ دَخَلُواْ عَلَىٰ دَاوُۥدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنۡهُمۡۖ قَالُواْ لَا تَخَفۡۖ خَصۡمَانِ بَغَىٰ بَعۡضُنَا عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٖ فَٱحۡكُم بَيۡنَنَا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَا تُشۡطِطۡ وَٱهۡدِنَآ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ith dakhaloo AAala dawooda fafaziAAa minhum qaloo la takhaf khasmani bagha baAAduna AAala baAAdin faohkum baynana bialhaqqi wala tushtit waihdina ila sawai alssirati
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: When they entered upon David and he was alarmed by them? They said, "Fear not. [We are] two adversaries, one of whom has wronged the other, so judge between us with truth and do not exceed [it] and guide us to the sound path.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: When they came into David’s presence, he was startled by them. They said, “Have no fear. ˹We are merely˺ two in a dispute: one of us has wronged the other. So judge between us with truth—do not go beyond ˹it˺—and guide us to the right way.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَآ أَخِي لَهُۥ تِسۡعٞ وَتِسۡعُونَ نَعۡجَةٗ وَلِيَ نَعۡجَةٞ وَٰحِدَةٞ فَقَالَ أَكۡفِلۡنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِي فِي ٱلۡخِطَابِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna hatha akhee lahu tisAAun watisAAoona naAAjatan waliya naAAjatun wahidatun faqala akfilneeha waAAazzanee fee alkhitabi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed this, my brother, has ninety-nine ewes, and I have one ewe; so he said, 'Entrust her to me,' and he overpowered me in speech."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: This is my brother. He has ninety-nine sheep while I have ˹only˺ one. ˹Still˺ he asked me to give it up to him, overwhelming me with ˹his˺ argument.”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ لَقَدۡ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعۡجَتِكَ إِلَىٰ نِعَاجِهِۦۖ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡخُلَطَآءِ لَيَبۡغِي بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٍ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَقَلِيلٞ مَّا هُمۡۗ وَظَنَّ دَاوُۥدُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّٰهُ فَٱسۡتَغۡفَرَ رَبَّهُۥ وَخَرَّۤ رَاكِعٗاۤ وَأَنَابَ۩
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala laqad thalamaka bisuali naAAjatika ila niAAajihi wainna katheeran mina alkhulatai layabghee baAAduhum AAala baAAdin illa allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati waqaleelun ma hum wathanna dawoodu annama fatannahu faistaghfara rabbahu wakharra rakiAAan waanaba
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [David] said, "He has certainly wronged you in demanding your ewe [in addition] to his ewes. And indeed, many associates oppress one another, except for those who believe and do righteous deeds - and few are they." And David became certain that We had tried him, and he asked forgiveness of his Lord and fell down bowing [in prostration] and turned in repentance [to Allah].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: David ˹eventually˺ ruled, “He has definitely wronged you in demanding ˹to add˺ your sheep to his. And certainly many partners wrong each other, except those who believe and do good—but how few are they!” Then David realized that We had tested him so he asked for his Lord’s forgiveness, fell down in prostration, and turned ˹to Him in repentance˺.

ayahs.textArabic: فَغَفَرۡنَا لَهُۥ ذَٰلِكَۖ وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلۡفَىٰ وَحُسۡنَ مَـَٔابٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faghafarna lahu thalika wainna lahu AAindana lazulfa wahusna maabin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So We forgave him that; and indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So We forgave that for him. And he will indeed have ˹a status of˺ closeness to Us and an honourable destination!

ayahs.textArabic: يَٰدَاوُۥدُ إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَٰكَ خَلِيفَةٗ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَٱحۡكُم بَيۡنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ ٱلۡهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ شَدِيدُۢ بِمَا نَسُواْ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡحِسَابِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ya dawoodu inna jaAAalnaka khaleefatan fee alardi faohkum bayna alnnasi bialhaqqi wala tattabiAAi alhawa fayudillaka AAan sabeeli Allahi inna allatheena yadilloona AAan sabeeli Allahi lahum AAathabun shadeedun bima nasoo yawma alhisabi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [We said], "O David, indeed We have made you a successor upon the earth, so judge between the people in truth and do not follow [your own] desire, as it will lead you astray from the way of Allah." Indeed, those who go astray from the way of Allah will have a severe punishment for having forgotten the Day of Account.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹We instructed him:˺ “O David! We have surely made you an authority in the land, so judge between people with truth. And do not follow ˹your˺ desires or they will lead you astray from Allah’s Way. Surely those who go astray from Allah’s Way will suffer a severe punishment for neglecting the Day of Reckoning.”

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا بَٰطِلٗاۚ ذَٰلِكَ ظَنُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْۚ فَوَيۡلٞ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama khalaqna alssamaa waalarda wama baynahuma batilan thalika thannu allatheena kafaroo fawaylun lillatheena kafaroo mina alnnari
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We did not create the heaven and the earth and that between them aimlessly. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve, so woe to those who disbelieve from the Fire.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We have not created the heavens and earth and everything in between without purpose—as the disbelievers think. So woe to the disbelievers because of the Fire!

ayahs.textArabic: أَمۡ نَجۡعَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ كَٱلۡمُفۡسِدِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَمۡ نَجۡعَلُ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ كَٱلۡفُجَّارِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Am najAAalu allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati kaalmufsideena fee alardi am najAAalu almuttaqeena kaalfujjari
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Or should we treat those who believe and do righteous deeds like corrupters in the land? Or should We treat those who fear Allah like the wicked?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Or should We treat those who believe and do good like those who make mischief throughout the land? Or should We treat the righteous like the wicked?

ayahs.textArabic: كِتَٰبٌ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ إِلَيۡكَ مُبَٰرَكٞ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوٓاْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kitabun anzalnahu ilayka mubarakun liyaddabbaroo ayatihi waliyatathakkara oloo alalbabi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [This is] a blessed Book which We have revealed to you, [O Muhammad], that they might reflect upon its verses and that those of understanding would be reminded.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹This is˺ a blessed Book which We have revealed to you ˹O Prophet˺ so that they may contemplate its verses, and people of reason may be mindful.

ayahs.textArabic: وَوَهَبۡنَا لِدَاوُۥدَ سُلَيۡمَٰنَۚ نِعۡمَ ٱلۡعَبۡدُ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wawahabna lidawooda sulaymana niAAma alAAabdu innahu awwabun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And to David We gave Solomon. An excellent servant, indeed he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allah].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And We blessed David with Solomon—what an excellent servant ˹he was˺! Indeed, he ˹constantly˺ turned ˹to Allah˺.

ayahs.textArabic: إِذۡ عُرِضَ عَلَيۡهِ بِٱلۡعَشِيِّ ٱلصَّٰفِنَٰتُ ٱلۡجِيَادُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ith AAurida AAalayhi bialAAashiyyi alssafinatu aljiyadu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Mention] when there were exhibited before him in the afternoon the poised [standing] racehorses.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Remember˺ when the well-trained, swift horses were paraded before him in the evening.

ayahs.textArabic: فَقَالَ إِنِّيٓ أَحۡبَبۡتُ حُبَّ ٱلۡخَيۡرِ عَن ذِكۡرِ رَبِّي حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتۡ بِٱلۡحِجَابِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faqala innee ahbabtu hubba alkhayri AAan thikri rabbee hatta tawarat bialhijabi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until the sun disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He then proclaimed, “I am truly in love with ˹these˺ fine things out of remembrance for Allah,” until they went out of sight.

ayahs.textArabic: رُدُّوهَا عَلَيَّۖ فَطَفِقَ مَسۡحَۢا بِٱلسُّوقِ وَٱلۡأَعۡنَاقِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ruddooha AAalayya fatafiqa mashan bialssooqi waalaAAnaqi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [He said], "Return them to me," and set about striking [their] legs and necks.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹He ordered,˺ “Bring them back to me!” Then he began to rub down their legs and necks.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدۡ فَتَنَّا سُلَيۡمَٰنَ وَأَلۡقَيۡنَا عَلَىٰ كُرۡسِيِّهِۦ جَسَدٗا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walaqad fatanna sulaymana waalqayna AAala kursiyyihi jasadan thumma anaba
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We certainly tried Solomon and placed on his throne a body; then he returned.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And indeed, We tested Solomon, placing a ˹deformed˺ body on his throne, then he turned ˹to Allah in repentance˺.

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ لِي وَهَبۡ لِي مُلۡكٗا لَّا يَنۢبَغِي لِأَحَدٖ مِّنۢ بَعۡدِيٓۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡوَهَّابُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala rabbi ighfir lee wahab lee mulkan la yanbaghee liahadin min baAAdee innaka anta alwahhabu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He said, "My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me. Indeed, You are the Bestower."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He prayed, “My Lord! Forgive me, and grant me an authority that will never be matched by anyone after me. You are indeed the Giver ˹of all bounties˺.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَسَخَّرۡنَا لَهُ ٱلرِّيحَ تَجۡرِي بِأَمۡرِهِۦ رُخَآءً حَيۡثُ أَصَابَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fasakhkharna lahu alrreeha tajree biamrihi rukhaan haythu asaba
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So We subjected to him the wind blowing by his command, gently, wherever he directed,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So We subjected to him the wind, blowing gently at his command to wherever he pleased.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ كُلَّ بَنَّآءٖ وَغَوَّاصٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalshshayateena kulla bannain waghawwasin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [also] the devils [of jinn] - every builder and diver
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And ˹We subjected to him˺ every builder and diver of the jinn,

ayahs.textArabic: وَءَاخَرِينَ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَصۡفَادِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waakhareena muqarraneena fee alasfadi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And others bound together in shackles.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and others bound together in chains.

ayahs.textArabic: هَٰذَا عَطَآؤُنَا فَٱمۡنُنۡ أَوۡ أَمۡسِكۡ بِغَيۡرِ حِسَابٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Hatha AAataona faomnun aw amsik bighayri hisabin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [We said], "This is Our gift, so grant or withhold without account."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Allah said,˺ “This is Our gift, so give or withhold ˹as you wish˺, never to be called to account.”

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلۡفَىٰ وَحُسۡنَ مَـَٔابٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wainna lahu AAindana lazulfa wahusna maabin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And he will indeed have ˹a status of˺ closeness to Us and an honourable destination!

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱذۡكُرۡ عَبۡدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذۡ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ بِنُصۡبٖ وَعَذَابٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waothkur AAabdana ayyooba ith nada rabbahu annee massaniya alshshaytanu binusbin waAAathabin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And remember Our servant Job, when he cried out to his Lord, “Satan has afflicted me with distress and suffering.”

ayahs.textArabic: ٱرۡكُضۡ بِرِجۡلِكَۖ هَٰذَا مُغۡتَسَلُۢ بَارِدٞ وَشَرَابٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Orkud birijlika hatha mughtasalun baridun washarabun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [So he was told], "Strike [the ground] with your foot; this is a [spring for] a cool bath and drink."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹We responded,˺ “Stomp your foot: ˹now˺ here is a cool ˹and refreshing˺ spring for washing and drinking.”

ayahs.textArabic: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهۡلَهُۥ وَمِثۡلَهُم مَّعَهُمۡ رَحۡمَةٗ مِّنَّا وَذِكۡرَىٰ لِأُوْلِي ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wawahabna lahu ahlahu wamithlahum maAAahum rahmatan minna wathikra liolee alalbabi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We granted him his family and a like [number] with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for those of understanding.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And We gave him back his family, twice as many, as a mercy from Us and a lesson for people of reason.

ayahs.textArabic: وَخُذۡ بِيَدِكَ ضِغۡثٗا فَٱضۡرِب بِّهِۦ وَلَا تَحۡنَثۡۗ إِنَّا وَجَدۡنَٰهُ صَابِرٗاۚ نِّعۡمَ ٱلۡعَبۡدُ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wakhuth biyadika dighthan faidrib bihi wala tahnath inna wajadnahu sabiran niAAma alAAabdu innahu awwabun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [We said], "And take in your hand a bunch [of grass] and strike with it and do not break your oath." Indeed, We found him patient, an excellent servant. Indeed, he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allah].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹And We said to him,˺ “Take in your hand a bundle of grass, and strike ˹your wife˺ with it, and do not break your oath.” We truly found him patient. What an excellent servant ˹he was˺! Indeed, he ˹constantly˺ turned ˹to Allah˺.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱذۡكُرۡ عِبَٰدَنَآ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسۡحَٰقَ وَيَعۡقُوبَ أُوْلِي ٱلۡأَيۡدِي وَٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waothkur AAibadana ibraheema waishaqa wayaAAqooba olee alaydee waalabsari
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And remember Our servants, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob - those of strength and [religious] vision.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And remember Our servants: Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—the men of strength and insight.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّآ أَخۡلَصۡنَٰهُم بِخَالِصَةٖ ذِكۡرَى ٱلدَّارِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna akhlasnahum bikhalisatin thikra alddari
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, We chose them for an exclusive quality: remembrance of the home [of the Hereafter].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We truly chose them for the honour of proclaiming the Hereafter.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِنَّهُمۡ عِندَنَا لَمِنَ ٱلۡمُصۡطَفَيۡنَ ٱلۡأَخۡيَارِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wainnahum AAindana lamina almustafayna alakhyari
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And indeed they are, to Us, among the chosen and outstanding.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And in Our sight they are truly among the chosen and the finest.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱذۡكُرۡ إِسۡمَٰعِيلَ وَٱلۡيَسَعَ وَذَا ٱلۡكِفۡلِۖ وَكُلّٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَخۡيَارِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waothkur ismaAAeela wailyasaAAa watha alkifli wakullun mina alakhyari
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And remember Ishmael, Elisha and Dhul-Kifl, and all are among the outstanding.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Also remember Ishmael, Elisha, and Ⱬul-Kifl. All are among the best.

ayahs.textArabic: هَٰذَا ذِكۡرٞۚ وَإِنَّ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ لَحُسۡنَ مَـَٔابٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Hatha thikrun wainna lilmuttaqeena lahusna maabin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: This is a reminder. And indeed, for the righteous is a good place of return
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: This is ˹all˺ a reminder. And the righteous will certainly have an honourable destination:

ayahs.textArabic: جَنَّٰتِ عَدۡنٖ مُّفَتَّحَةٗ لَّهُمُ ٱلۡأَبۡوَٰبُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Jannati AAadnin mufattahatan lahumu alabwabu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Gardens of perpetual residence, whose doors will be opened to them.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: the Gardens of Eternity, whose gates will be open for them.

ayahs.textArabic: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا يَدۡعُونَ فِيهَا بِفَٰكِهَةٖ كَثِيرَةٖ وَشَرَابٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Muttakieena feeha yadAAoona feeha bifakihatin katheeratin washarabin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Reclining within them, they will call therein for abundant fruit and drink.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: There they will recline, calling for abundant fruit and drink.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ وَعِندَهُمۡ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرۡفِ أَتۡرَابٌ
ayahs.textTransliteration: WaAAindahum qasiratu alttarfi atrabun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances and of equal age.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And with them will be maidens of modest gaze and equal age.

ayahs.textArabic: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِيَوۡمِ ٱلۡحِسَابِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Hatha ma tooAAadoona liyawmi alhisabi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: This is what you, [the righteous], are promised for the Day of Account.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: This is what you are promised for the Day of Reckoning.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَرِزۡقُنَا مَا لَهُۥ مِن نَّفَادٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna hatha larizquna ma lahu min nafadin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, this is Our provision; for it there is no depletion.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: This is indeed Our provision that will never end.

ayahs.textArabic: هَٰذَاۚ وَإِنَّ لِلطَّٰغِينَ لَشَرَّ مَـَٔابٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Hatha wainna lilttagheena lasharra maabin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: This [is so]. But indeed, for the transgressors is an evil place of return -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: That is that. And the transgressors will certainly have the worst destination:

ayahs.textArabic: جَهَنَّمَ يَصۡلَوۡنَهَا فَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمِهَادُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Jahannama yaslawnaha fabisa almihadu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the resting place.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Hell, where they will burn. What an evil place to rest!

ayahs.textArabic: هَٰذَا فَلۡيَذُوقُوهُ حَمِيمٞ وَغَسَّاقٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Hatha falyathooqoohu hameemun waghassaqun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: This - so let them taste it - is scalding water and [foul] purulence.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Let them then taste this: boiling water and ˹oozing˺ pus,

ayahs.textArabic: وَءَاخَرُ مِن شَكۡلِهِۦٓ أَزۡوَٰجٌ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waakharu min shaklihi azwajun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And other [punishments] of its type [in various] kinds.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and other torments of the same sort!

ayahs.textArabic: هَٰذَا فَوۡجٞ مُّقۡتَحِمٞ مَّعَكُمۡ لَا مَرۡحَبَۢا بِهِمۡۚ إِنَّهُمۡ صَالُواْ ٱلنَّارِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Hatha fawjun muqtahimun maAAakum la marhaban bihim innahum saloo alnnari
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Its inhabitants will say], "This is a company bursting in with you. No welcome for them. Indeed, they will burn in the Fire."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹The misleaders will say to one another,˺ “Here is a crowd ˹of followers˺ being thrown in with us. They are not welcome, ˹for˺ they ˹too˺ will burn in the Fire.”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُواْ بَلۡ أَنتُمۡ لَا مَرۡحَبَۢا بِكُمۡۖ أَنتُمۡ قَدَّمۡتُمُوهُ لَنَاۖ فَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡقَرَارُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qaloo bal antum la marhaban bikum antum qaddamtumoohu lana fabisa alqararu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They will say, "Nor you! No welcome for you. You, [our leaders], brought this upon us, and wretched is the settlement."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The followers will respond, “No! You are not welcome! You brought this upon us. What an evil place for settlement!”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُواْ رَبَّنَا مَن قَدَّمَ لَنَا هَٰذَا فَزِدۡهُ عَذَابٗا ضِعۡفٗا فِي ٱلنَّارِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qaloo rabbana man qaddama lana hatha fazidhu AAathaban diAAfan fee alnnari
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They will say, "Our Lord, whoever brought this upon us - increase for him double punishment in the Fire."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Adding, “Our Lord! Whoever brought this upon us, double their punishment in the Fire.”

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالُواْ مَا لَنَا لَا نَرَىٰ رِجَالٗا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَشۡرَارِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waqaloo ma lana la nara rijalan kunna naAAudduhum mina alashrari
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And they will say, "Why do we not see men whom we used to count among the worst?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The tyrants will ask ˹one another˺, “But why do we not see those we considered to be lowly?

ayahs.textArabic: أَتَّخَذۡنَٰهُمۡ سِخۡرِيًّا أَمۡ زَاغَتۡ عَنۡهُمُ ٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Attakhathnahum sikhriyyan am zaghat AAanhumu alabsaru
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Is it [because] we took them in ridicule, or has [our] vision turned away from them?"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Were we wrong in mocking them ˹in the world˺? Or do our eyes ˹just˺ fail to see them ˹in the Fire˺?”

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَحَقّٞ تَخَاصُمُ أَهۡلِ ٱلنَّارِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna thalika lahaqqun takhasumu ahli alnnari
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, that is truth - the quarreling of the people of the Fire.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: This dispute between the residents of the Fire will certainly come to pass.

ayahs.textArabic: قُلۡ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ مُنذِرٞۖ وَمَا مِنۡ إِلَٰهٍ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡوَٰحِدُ ٱلۡقَهَّارُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qul innama ana munthirun wama min ilahin illa Allahu alwahidu alqahharu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Say, [O Muhammad], "I am only a warner, and there is not any deity except Allah, the One, the Prevailing.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I am only a warner. And there is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Allah—the One, the Supreme.

ayahs.textArabic: رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡغَفَّٰرُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Rabbu alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma alAAazeezu alghaffaru
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹He is the˺ Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything in between—the Almighty, Most Forgiving.”

ayahs.textArabic: قُلۡ هُوَ نَبَؤٌاْ عَظِيمٌ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qul huwa nabaon AAatheemun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Say, "It is great news
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Say, “This ˹Quran˺ is momentous news,

ayahs.textArabic: أَنتُمۡ عَنۡهُ مُعۡرِضُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Antum AAanhu muAAridoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: From which you turn away.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: from which you ˹pagans˺ are turning away.”

ayahs.textArabic: مَا كَانَ لِيَ مِنۡ عِلۡمِۭ بِٱلۡمَلَإِ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰٓ إِذۡ يَخۡتَصِمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ma kana liya min AAilmin bialmalai alaAAla ith yakhtasimoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: I had no knowledge of the exalted assembly [of angels] when they were disputing [the creation of Adam].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹And say,˺ “I had no knowledge of the highest assembly ˹in heaven˺ when they differed ˹concerning Adam˺.

ayahs.textArabic: إِن يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيَّ إِلَّآ أَنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٌ
ayahs.textTransliteration: In yooha ilayya illa annama ana natheerun mubeenun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: It has not been revealed to me except that I am a clear warner."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: What is revealed to me is that I am only sent with a clear warning.”

ayahs.textArabic: إِذۡ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّي خَٰلِقُۢ بَشَرٗا مِّن طِينٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ith qala rabbuka lilmalaikati innee khaliqun basharan min teenin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [So mention] when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I am going to create a human being from clay.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Remember, O Prophet˺ when your Lord said to the angels, “I am going to create a human being from clay.

ayahs.textArabic: فَإِذَا سَوَّيۡتُهُۥ وَنَفَخۡتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِي فَقَعُواْ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faitha sawwaytuhu wanafakhtu feehi min roohee faqaAAoo lahu sajideena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So when I have fashioned him and had a spirit of My Own ˹creation˺ breathed into him, fall down in prostration to him.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَسَجَدَ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمۡ أَجۡمَعُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fasajada almalaikatu kulluhum ajmaAAoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So the angels prostrated all together—

ayahs.textArabic: إِلَّآ إِبۡلِيسَ ٱسۡتَكۡبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Illa ibleesa istakbara wakana mina alkafireena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Except Iblees; he was arrogant and became among the disbelievers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: but not Iblîs, who acted arrogantly, becoming unfaithful.

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ يَٰٓإِبۡلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَن تَسۡجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقۡتُ بِيَدَيَّۖ أَسۡتَكۡبَرۡتَ أَمۡ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلۡعَالِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala ya ibleesu ma manaAAaka an tasjuda lima khalaqtu biyadayya astakbarta am kunta mina alAAaleena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Allah] said, "O Iblees, what prevented you from prostrating to that which I created with My hands? Were you arrogant [then], or were you [already] among the haughty?"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Allah asked, “O Iblîs! What prevented you from prostrating to what I created with My Own Hands? Did you ˹just˺ become proud? Or have you always been arrogant?”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ أَنَا۠ خَيۡرٞ مِّنۡهُ خَلَقۡتَنِي مِن نَّارٖ وَخَلَقۡتَهُۥ مِن طِينٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala ana khayrun minhu khalaqtanee min narin wakhalaqtahu min teenin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He said, "I am better than him. You created me from fire and created him from clay."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He replied, “I am better than he is: You created me from fire and him from clay.”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ فَٱخۡرُجۡ مِنۡهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala faokhruj minha fainnaka rajeemun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Allah] said, "Then get out of Paradise, for indeed, you are expelled.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Allah commanded, “Then get out of Paradise, for you are truly cursed.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِنَّ عَلَيۡكَ لَعۡنَتِيٓ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wainna AAalayka laAAnatee ila yawmi alddeeni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And indeed, upon you is My curse until the Day of Recompense."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And surely upon you is My condemnation until the Day of Judgment.”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرۡنِيٓ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ يُبۡعَثُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala rabbi faanthirnee ila yawmi yubAAathoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Satan appealed, “My Lord! Then delay my end until the Day of their resurrection.”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُنظَرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala fainnaka mina almunthareena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Allah] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Allah said, “You will be delayed

ayahs.textArabic: إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡوَقۡتِ ٱلۡمَعۡلُومِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ila yawmi alwaqti almaAAloomi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Until the Day of the time well-known."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: until the appointed Day.”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَأُغۡوِيَنَّهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala fabiAAizzatika laoghwiyannahum ajmaAAeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Iblees] said, "By your might, I will surely mislead them all
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Satan said, “By Your Glory! I will certainly mislead them all,

ayahs.textArabic: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنۡهُمُ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Illa AAibadaka minhumu almukhlaseena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Except, among them, Your chosen servants."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: except Your chosen servants among them.”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ فَٱلۡحَقُّ وَٱلۡحَقَّ أَقُولُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala faalhaqqu waalhaqqa aqoolu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Allah] said, "The truth [is My oath], and the truth I say -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Allah concluded, “The truth is—and I ˹only˺ say the truth—:

ayahs.textArabic: لَأَمۡلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنكَ وَمِمَّن تَبِعَكَ مِنۡهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Laamlaanna jahannama minka wamimman tabiAAaka minhum ajmaAAeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [That] I will surely fill Hell with you and those of them that follow you all together."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: I will surely fill up Hell with you and whoever follows you from among them, all together.”

ayahs.textArabic: قُلۡ مَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٖ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلۡمُتَكَلِّفِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qul ma asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin wama ana mina almutakallifeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Say, [O Muhammad], "I do not ask you for the Qur'an any payment, and I am not of the pretentious
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I do not ask you for any reward for this ˹Quran˺, nor do I pretend to be someone I am not.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكۡرٞ لِّلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: In huwa illa thikrun lilAAalameena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: It is but a reminder to the worlds.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: It is only a reminder to the whole world.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَتَعۡلَمُنَّ نَبَأَهُۥ بَعۡدَ حِينِۭ
ayahs.textTransliteration: WalataAAlamunna nabaahu baAAda heenin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And you will surely know [the truth of] its information after a time."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And you will certainly know its truth before long.”

ayahs.textArabic: تَنزِيلُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡحَكِيمِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Tanzeelu alkitabi mina Allahi alAAazeezi alhakeemi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The revelation of the Qur'an is from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The revelation of this Book is from Allah—the Almighty, All-Wise.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّآ أَنزَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ فَٱعۡبُدِ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصٗا لَّهُ ٱلدِّينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna anzalna ilayka alkitaba bialhaqqi faoAAbudi Allaha mukhlisan lahu alddeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, We have sent down to you the Book, [O Muhammad], in truth. So worship Allah, [being] sincere to Him in religion.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, We have sent down the Book to you ˹O Prophet˺ in truth, so worship Allah ˹alone˺, being sincerely devoted to Him.

ayahs.textArabic: أَلَا لِلَّهِ ٱلدِّينُ ٱلۡخَالِصُۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوۡلِيَآءَ مَا نَعۡبُدُهُمۡ إِلَّا لِيُقَرِّبُونَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ زُلۡفَىٰٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَحۡكُمُ بَيۡنَهُمۡ فِي مَا هُمۡ فِيهِ يَخۡتَلِفُونَۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهۡدِي مَنۡ هُوَ كَٰذِبٞ كَفَّارٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ala lillahi alddeenu alkhalisu waallatheena ittakhathoo min doonihi awliyaa ma naAAbuduhum illa liyuqarriboona ila Allahi zulfa inna Allaha yahkumu baynahum fee ma hum feehi yakhtalifoona inna Allaha la yahdee man huwa kathibun kaffarun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Unquestionably, for Allah is the pure religion. And those who take protectors besides Him [say], "We only worship them that they may bring us nearer to Allah in position." Indeed, Allah will judge between them concerning that over which they differ. Indeed, Allah does not guide he who is a liar and [confirmed] disbeliever.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, sincere devotion is due ˹only˺ to Allah. As for those who take other lords besides Him, ˹saying,˺ “We worship them only so they may bring us closer to Allah,” surely Allah will judge between all regarding what they differed about. Allah certainly does not guide whoever persists in lying and disbelief.

ayahs.textArabic: لَّوۡ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدٗا لَّٱصۡطَفَىٰ مِمَّا يَخۡلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُۚ سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥۖ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡوَٰحِدُ ٱلۡقَهَّارُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Law arada Allahu an yattakhitha waladan laistafa mimma yakhluqu ma yashao subhanahu huwa Allahu alwahidu alqahharu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: If Allah had intended to take a son, He could have chosen from what He creates whatever He willed. Exalted is He; He is Allah, the One, the Prevailing.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Had it been Allah’s Will to have offspring, He could have chosen whatever He willed of His creation. Glory be to Him! He is Allah—the One, the Supreme.

ayahs.textArabic: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ يُكَوِّرُ ٱلَّيۡلَ عَلَى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُكَوِّرُ ٱلنَّهَارَ عَلَى ٱلَّيۡلِۖ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَۖ كُلّٞ يَجۡرِي لِأَجَلٖ مُّسَمًّىۗ أَلَا هُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡغَفَّٰرُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Khalaqa alssamawati waalarda bialhaqqi yukawwiru allayla AAala alnnahari wayukawwiru alnnahara AAala allayli wasakhkhara alshshamsa waalqamara kullun yajree liajalin musamman ala huwa alAAazeezu alghaffaru
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He created the heavens and earth in truth. He wraps the night over the day and wraps the day over the night and has subjected the sun and the moon, each running [its course] for a specified term. Unquestionably, He is the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He created the heavens and the earth for a purpose. He wraps the night around the day, and wraps the day around the night. And He has subjected the sun and the moon, each orbiting for an appointed term. He is truly the Almighty, Most Forgiving.

ayahs.textArabic: خَلَقَكُم مِّن نَّفۡسٖ وَٰحِدَةٖ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنۡهَا زَوۡجَهَا وَأَنزَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ ثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَزۡوَٰجٖۚ يَخۡلُقُكُمۡ فِي بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمۡ خَلۡقٗا مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ خَلۡقٖ فِي ظُلُمَٰتٖ ثَلَٰثٖۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمۡ لَهُ ٱلۡمُلۡكُۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُصۡرَفُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Khalaqakum min nafsin wahidatin thumma jaAAala minha zawjaha waanzala lakum mina alanAAami thamaniyata azwajin yakhluqukum fee butooni ommahatikum khalqan min baAAdi khalqin fee thulumatin thalathin thalikumu Allahu rabbukum lahu almulku la ilaha illa huwa faanna tusrafoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He created you from one soul. Then He made from it its mate, and He produced for you from the grazing livestock eight mates. He creates you in the wombs of your mothers, creation after creation, within three darknesses. That is Allah, your Lord; to Him belongs dominion. There is no deity except Him, so how are you averted?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He created you ˹all˺ from a single soul, then from it He made its mate. And He produced for you four pairs of cattle. He creates you in the wombs of your mothers ˹in stages˺, one development after another, in three layers of darkness. That is Allah—your Lord! All authority belongs to Him. There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him. How can you then be turned away?

ayahs.textArabic: إِن تَكۡفُرُواْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِيٌّ عَنكُمۡۖ وَلَا يَرۡضَىٰ لِعِبَادِهِ ٱلۡكُفۡرَۖ وَإِن تَشۡكُرُواْ يَرۡضَهُ لَكُمۡۗ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٞ وِزۡرَ أُخۡرَىٰۚ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُم مَّرۡجِعُكُمۡ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمُۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: In takfuroo fainna Allaha ghaniyyun AAankum wala yarda liAAibadihi alkufra wain tashkuroo yardahu lakum wala taziru waziratun wizra okhra thumma ila rabbikum marjiAAukum fayunabbiokum bima kuntum taAAmaloona innahu AAaleemun bithati alssudoori
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: If you disbelieve - indeed, Allah is Free from need of you. And He does not approve for His servants disbelief. And if you are grateful, He approves it for you; and no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. Then to your Lord is your return, and He will inform you about what you used to do. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: If you disbelieve, then ˹know that˺ Allah is truly not in need of you, nor does He approve of disbelief from His servants. But if you become grateful ˹through faith˺, He will appreciate that from you. No soul burdened with sin will bear the burden of another. Then to your Lord is your return, and He will inform you of what you used to do. He certainly knows best what is ˹hidden˺ in the heart.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ وَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ ضُرّٞ دَعَا رَبَّهُۥ مُنِيبًا إِلَيۡهِ ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلَهُۥ نِعۡمَةٗ مِّنۡهُ نَسِيَ مَا كَانَ يَدۡعُوٓاْ إِلَيۡهِ مِن قَبۡلُ وَجَعَلَ لِلَّهِ أَندَادٗا لِّيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦۚ قُلۡ تَمَتَّعۡ بِكُفۡرِكَ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكَ مِنۡ أَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلنَّارِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waitha massa alinsana durrun daAAa rabbahu muneeban ilayhi thumma itha khawwalahu niAAmatan minhu nasiya ma kana yadAAoo ilayhi min qablu wajaAAala lillahi andadan liyudilla AAan sabeelihi qul tamattaAA bikufrika qaleelan innaka min ashabi alnnari
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when adversity touches man, he calls upon his Lord, turning to Him [alone]; then when He bestows on him a favor from Himself, he forgets Him whom he called upon before, and he attributes to Allah equals to mislead [people] from His way. Say, "Enjoy your disbelief for a little; indeed, you are of the companions of the Fire."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: When one is touched with hardship, they cry out to their Lord, turning to Him ˹alone˺. But as soon as He showers them with blessings from Him, they ˹totally˺ forget the One they had cried to earlier, and set up equals to Allah to mislead ˹others˺ from His Way. Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Enjoy your disbelief for a little while! You will certainly be one of the inmates of the Fire.”

ayahs.textArabic: أَمَّنۡ هُوَ قَٰنِتٌ ءَانَآءَ ٱلَّيۡلِ سَاجِدٗا وَقَآئِمٗا يَحۡذَرُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةَ وَيَرۡجُواْ رَحۡمَةَ رَبِّهِۦۗ قُلۡ هَلۡ يَسۡتَوِي ٱلَّذِينَ يَعۡلَمُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَۗ إِنَّمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Amman huwa qanitun anaa allayli sajidan waqaiman yahtharu alakhirata wayarjoo rahmata rabbihi qul hal yastawee allatheena yaAAlamoona waallatheena la yaAAlamoona innama yatathakkaru oloo alalbabi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Is one who is devoutly obedient during periods of the night, prostrating and standing [in prayer], fearing the Hereafter and hoping for the mercy of his Lord, [like one who does not]? Say, "Are those who know equal to those who do not know?" Only they will remember [who are] people of understanding.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Are they better˺ or those who worship ˹their Lord˺ devoutly in the hours of the night, prostrating and standing, fearing the Hereafter and hoping for the mercy of their Lord? Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Are those who know equal to those who do not know?” None will be mindful ˹of this˺ except people of reason.

ayahs.textArabic: قُلۡ يَٰعِبَادِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱتَّقُواْ رَبَّكُمۡۚ لِلَّذِينَ أَحۡسَنُواْ فِي هَٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا حَسَنَةٞۗ وَأَرۡضُ ٱللَّهِ وَٰسِعَةٌۗ إِنَّمَا يُوَفَّى ٱلصَّٰبِرُونَ أَجۡرَهُم بِغَيۡرِ حِسَابٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qul ya AAibadi allatheena amanoo ittaqoo rabbakum lillatheena ahsanoo fee hathihi alddunya hasanatun waardu Allahi wasiAAatun innama yuwaffa alssabiroona ajrahum bighayri hisabin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Say, "O My servants who have believed, fear your Lord. For those who do good in this world is good, and the earth of Allah is spacious. Indeed, the patient will be given their reward without account."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Say ˹O Prophet, that Allah says˺, “O My servants who believe! Be mindful of your Lord. Those who do good in this world will have a good reward. And Allah’s earth is spacious. Only those who endure patiently will be given their reward without limit.”

ayahs.textArabic: قُلۡ إِنِّيٓ أُمِرۡتُ أَنۡ أَعۡبُدَ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصٗا لَّهُ ٱلدِّينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qul innee omirtu an aAAbuda Allaha mukhlisan lahu alddeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Say, [O Muhammad], "Indeed, I have been commanded to worship Allah, [being] sincere to Him in religion.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Say, “I am commanded to worship Allah, being sincerely devoted to Him ˹alone˺.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأُمِرۡتُ لِأَنۡ أَكُونَ أَوَّلَ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waomirtu lian akoona awwala almuslimeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And I have been commanded to be the first [among you] of the Muslims."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And I am commanded to be the first of those who submit ˹to His Will˺.”

ayahs.textArabic: قُلۡ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ إِنۡ عَصَيۡتُ رَبِّي عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qul innee akhafu in AAasaytu rabbee AAathaba yawmin AAatheemin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Say, "Indeed I fear, if I should disobey my Lord, the punishment of a tremendous Day."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Say, “I truly fear—if I were to disobey my Lord—the torment of a tremendous Day.”

ayahs.textArabic: قُلِ ٱللَّهَ أَعۡبُدُ مُخۡلِصٗا لَّهُۥ دِينِي
ayahs.textTransliteration: Quli Allaha aAAbudu mukhlisan lahu deenee
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Say, "Allah [alone] do I worship, sincere to Him in my religion,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Say, “It is ˹only˺ Allah that I worship, being sincere in my devotion to Him.

ayahs.textArabic: فَٱعۡبُدُواْ مَا شِئۡتُم مِّن دُونِهِۦۗ قُلۡ إِنَّ ٱلۡخَٰسِرِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ وَأَهۡلِيهِمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۗ أَلَا ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡخُسۡرَانُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: FaoAAbudoo ma shitum min doonihi qul inna alkhasireena allatheena khasiroo anfusahum waahleehim yawma alqiyamati ala thalika huwa alkhusranu almubeenu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So worship what you will besides Him." Say, "Indeed, the losers are the ones who will lose themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, that is the manifest loss."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Worship then whatever ˹gods˺ you want instead of Him.” Say, “The ˹true˺ losers are those who will lose themselves and their families on Judgment Day. That is indeed the clearest loss.”

ayahs.textArabic: لَهُم مِّن فَوۡقِهِمۡ ظُلَلٞ مِّنَ ٱلنَّارِ وَمِن تَحۡتِهِمۡ ظُلَلٞۚ ذَٰلِكَ يُخَوِّفُ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦ عِبَادَهُۥۚ يَٰعِبَادِ فَٱتَّقُونِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Lahum min fawqihim thulalun mina alnnari wamin tahtihim thulalun thalika yukhawwifu Allahu bihi AAibadahu ya AAibadi faittaqooni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They will have canopies of fire above them and below them, canopies. By that Allah threatens His servants. O My servants, then fear Me.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They will have layers of fire above and below them. That is what Allah warns His servants with. So fear Me, O My servants!

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱجۡتَنَبُواْ ٱلطَّٰغُوتَ أَن يَعۡبُدُوهَا وَأَنَابُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ لَهُمُ ٱلۡبُشۡرَىٰۚ فَبَشِّرۡ عِبَادِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waallatheena ijtanaboo alttaghoota an yaAAbudooha waanaboo ila Allahi lahumu albushra fabashshir AAibadi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But those who have avoided Taghut, lest they worship it, and turned back to Allah - for them are good tidings. So give good tidings to My servants
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And those who shun the worship of false gods, turning to Allah ˹alone˺, will have good news. So give good news to My servants ˹O Prophet˺—

ayahs.textArabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَسۡتَمِعُونَ ٱلۡقَوۡلَ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ أَحۡسَنَهُۥٓۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ هَدَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُۖ وَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمۡ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Allatheena yastamiAAoona alqawla fayattabiAAoona ahsanahu olaika allatheena hadahumu Allahu waolaika hum oloo alalbabi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Who listen to speech and follow the best of it. Those are the ones Allah has guided, and those are people of understanding.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: those who listen to what is said and follow the best of it. These are the ones ˹rightly˺ guided by Allah, and these are ˹truly˺ the people of reason.

ayahs.textArabic: أَفَمَنۡ حَقَّ عَلَيۡهِ كَلِمَةُ ٱلۡعَذَابِ أَفَأَنتَ تُنقِذُ مَن فِي ٱلنَّارِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Afaman haqqa AAalayhi kalimatu alAAathabi afaanta tunqithu man fee alnnari
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then, is one who has deserved the decree of punishment [to be guided]? Then, can you save one who is in the Fire?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: What about those against whom the decree of torment has been justified? Is it you ˹O Prophet˺ who will then save those bound for the Fire?

ayahs.textArabic: لَٰكِنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوۡاْ رَبَّهُمۡ لَهُمۡ غُرَفٞ مِّن فَوۡقِهَا غُرَفٞ مَّبۡنِيَّةٞ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۖ وَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ لَا يُخۡلِفُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡمِيعَادَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Lakini allatheena ittaqaw rabbahum lahum ghurafun min fawqiha ghurafun mabniyyatun tajree min tahtiha alanharu waAAda Allahi la yukhlifu Allahu almeeAAada
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But those who have feared their Lord - for them are chambers, above them chambers built high, beneath which rivers flow. [This is] the promise of Allah. Allah does not fail in [His] promise.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But those mindful of their Lord will have ˹elevated˺ mansions, built one above the other, under which rivers flow. ˹That is˺ the promise of Allah. ˹And˺ Allah never fails in ˹His˺ promise.

ayahs.textArabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَسَلَكَهُۥ يَنَٰبِيعَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ ثُمَّ يُخۡرِجُ بِهِۦ زَرۡعٗا مُّخۡتَلِفًا أَلۡوَٰنُهُۥ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَىٰهُ مُصۡفَرّٗا ثُمَّ يَجۡعَلُهُۥ حُطَٰمًاۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكۡرَىٰ لِأُوْلِي ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Alam tara anna Allaha anzala mina alssamai maan fasalakahu yanabeeAAa fee alardi thumma yukhriju bihi zarAAan mukhtalifan alwanuhu thumma yaheeju fatarahu musfarran thumma yajAAaluhu hutaman inna fee thalika lathikra liolee alalbabi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Do you not see that Allah sends down rain from the sky and makes it flow as springs [and rivers] in the earth; then He produces thereby crops of varying colors; then they dry and you see them turned yellow; then He makes them [scattered] debris. Indeed in that is a reminder for those of understanding.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Do you not see that Allah sends down rain from the sky—channelling it through streams in the earth—then produces with it crops of various colours, then they dry up and you see them wither, and then He reduces them to chaff? Surely in this is a reminder for people of reason.

ayahs.textArabic: أَفَمَن شَرَحَ ٱللَّهُ صَدۡرَهُۥ لِلۡإِسۡلَٰمِ فَهُوَ عَلَىٰ نُورٖ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦۚ فَوَيۡلٞ لِّلۡقَٰسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُم مِّن ذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Afaman sharaha Allahu sadrahu lilislami fahuwa AAala noorin min rabbihi fawaylun lilqasiyati quloobuhum min thikri Allahi olaika fee dalalin mubeenin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So is one whose breast Allah has expanded to [accept] Islam and he is upon a light from his Lord [like one whose heart rejects it]? Then woe to those whose hearts are hardened against the remembrance of Allah. Those are in manifest error.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Can ˹the misguided be like˺ those whose hearts Allah has opened to Islam, so they are enlightened by their Lord? So woe to those whose hearts are hardened at the remembrance of Allah! It is they who are clearly astray.

ayahs.textArabic: ٱللَّهُ نَزَّلَ أَحۡسَنَ ٱلۡحَدِيثِ كِتَٰبٗا مُّتَشَٰبِهٗا مَّثَانِيَ تَقۡشَعِرُّ مِنۡهُ جُلُودُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخۡشَوۡنَ رَبَّهُمۡ ثُمَّ تَلِينُ جُلُودُهُمۡ وَقُلُوبُهُمۡ إِلَىٰ ذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُدَى ٱللَّهِ يَهۡدِي بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَمَن يُضۡلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنۡ هَادٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Allahu nazzala ahsana alhadeethi kitaban mutashabihan mathaniya taqshaAAirru minhu juloodu allatheena yakhshawna rabbahum thumma taleenu julooduhum waquloobuhum ila thikri Allahi thalika huda Allahi yahdee bihi man yashao waman yudlili Allahu fama lahu min hadin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Allah has sent down the best statement: a consistent Book wherein is reiteration. The skins shiver therefrom of those who fear their Lord; then their skins and their hearts relax at the remembrance of Allah. That is the guidance of Allah by which He guides whom He wills. And one whom Allah leaves astray - for him there is no guide.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹It is˺ Allah ˹Who˺ has sent down the best message—a Book of perfect consistency and repeated lessons—which causes the skin ˹and hearts˺ of those who fear their Lord to tremble, then their skin and hearts soften at the mention of ˹the mercy of˺ Allah. That is the guidance of Allah, through which He guides whoever He wills. But whoever Allah leaves to stray will be left with no guide.

ayahs.textArabic: أَفَمَن يَتَّقِي بِوَجۡهِهِۦ سُوٓءَ ٱلۡعَذَابِ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۚ وَقِيلَ لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ ذُوقُواْ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَكۡسِبُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Afaman yattaqee biwajhihi sooa alAAathabi yawma alqiyamati waqeela lilththalimeena thooqoo ma kuntum taksiboona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then is he who will shield with his face the worst of the punishment on the Day of Resurrection [like one secure from it]? And it will be said to the wrongdoers, "Taste what you used to earn."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Are those who will only have their ˹bare˺ faces to shield themselves from the awful torment on Judgment Day ˹better than those in Paradise˺? It will ˹then˺ be said to the wrongdoers: “Reap what you sowed!”

ayahs.textArabic: كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ فَأَتَىٰهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ مِنۡ حَيۡثُ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kaththaba allatheena min qablihim faatahumu alAAathabu min haythu la yashAAuroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Those before them denied, and punishment came upon them from where they did not perceive.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Those before them ˹also˺ rejected ˹the truth˺, then the torment came upon them from where they least expected.

ayahs.textArabic: فَأَذَاقَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡخِزۡيَ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ أَكۡبَرُۚ لَوۡ كَانُواْ يَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faathaqahumu Allahu alkhizya fee alhayati alddunya walaAAathabu alakhirati akbaru law kanoo yaAAlamoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So Allah made them taste disgrace in worldly life. But the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So Allah made them taste humiliation in this worldly life, but far worse is the punishment of the Hereafter, if only they knew.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدۡ ضَرَبۡنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِي هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٖ لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walaqad darabna lilnnasi fee hatha alqurani min kulli mathalin laAAallahum yatathakkaroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We have certainly presented for the people in this Qur'an from every [kind of] example - that they might remember.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We have certainly set forth every ˹kind of˺ lesson for people in this Quran, so perhaps they will be mindful.

ayahs.textArabic: قُرۡءَانًا عَرَبِيًّا غَيۡرَ ذِي عِوَجٖ لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Quranan AAarabiyyan ghayra thee AAiwajin laAAallahum yattaqoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [It is] an Arabic Qur'an, without any deviance that they might become righteous.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹It is˺ a Quran ˹revealed˺ in Arabic without any crookedness, so perhaps they will be conscious ˹of Allah˺.

ayahs.textArabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلٗا رَّجُلٗا فِيهِ شُرَكَآءُ مُتَشَٰكِسُونَ وَرَجُلٗا سَلَمٗا لِّرَجُلٍ هَلۡ يَسۡتَوِيَانِ مَثَلًاۚ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِۚ بَلۡ أَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Daraba Allahu mathalan rajulan feehi shurakao mutashakisoona warajulan salaman lirajulin hal yastawiyani mathalan alhamdu lillahi bal aktharuhum la yaAAlamoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Allah presents an example: a slave owned by quarreling partners and another belonging exclusively to one man - are they equal in comparison? Praise be to Allah! But most of them do not know.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Allah sets forth the parable of a slave owned by several quarrelsome masters, and a slave owned by only one master. Are they equal in condition? Praise be to Allah! In fact, most of them do not know.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّكَ مَيِّتٞ وَإِنَّهُم مَّيِّتُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innaka mayyitun wainnahum mayyitoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, you are to die, and indeed, they are to die.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: You ˹O Prophet˺ will certainly die, and they will die too.

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ عِندَ رَبِّكُمۡ تَخۡتَصِمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thumma innakum yawma alqiyamati AAinda rabbikum takhtasimoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, before your Lord, will dispute.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then on the Day of Judgment you will ˹all settle your˺ dispute before your Lord.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ فَمَنۡ أَظۡلَمُ مِمَّن كَذَبَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلصِّدۡقِ إِذۡ جَآءَهُۥٓۚ أَلَيۡسَ فِي جَهَنَّمَ مَثۡوٗى لِّلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faman athlamu mimman kathaba AAala Allahi wakaththaba bialssidqi ith jaahu alaysa fee jahannama mathwan lilkafireena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So who is more unjust than one who lies about Allah and denies the truth when it has come to him? Is there not in Hell a residence for the disbelievers?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Who then does more wrong than those who lie about Allah and reject the truth after it has reached them? Is Hell not a ˹fitting˺ home for the disbelievers?

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلَّذِي جَآءَ بِٱلصِّدۡقِ وَصَدَّقَ بِهِۦٓ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡمُتَّقُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waallathee jaa bialssidqi wasaddaqa bihi olaika humu almuttaqoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the one who has brought the truth and [they who] believed in it - those are the righteous.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And the one who has brought the truth and those who embrace it—it is they who are the righteous.

ayahs.textArabic: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡۚ ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Lahum ma yashaoona AAinda rabbihim thalika jazao almuhsineena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They will have whatever they desire with their Lord. That is the reward of the doers of good -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They will have whatever they desire with their Lord. That is the reward of the good-doers.

ayahs.textArabic: لِيُكَفِّرَ ٱللَّهُ عَنۡهُمۡ أَسۡوَأَ ٱلَّذِي عَمِلُواْ وَيَجۡزِيَهُمۡ أَجۡرَهُم بِأَحۡسَنِ ٱلَّذِي كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Liyukaffira Allahu AAanhum aswaa allathee AAamiloo wayajziyahum ajrahum biahsani allathee kanoo yaAAmaloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: That Allah may remove from them the worst of what they did and reward them their due for the best of what they used to do.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: As such, Allah will absolve them of ˹even˺ the worst of what they did and reward them according to the best of what they used to do.

ayahs.textArabic: أَلَيۡسَ ٱللَّهُ بِكَافٍ عَبۡدَهُۥۖ وَيُخَوِّفُونَكَ بِٱلَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِۦۚ وَمَن يُضۡلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنۡ هَادٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Alaysa Allahu bikafin AAabdahu wayukhawwifoonaka biallatheena min doonihi waman yudlili Allahu fama lahu min hadin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Is not Allah sufficient for His Servant [Prophet Muhammad]? And [yet], they threaten you with those [they worship] other than Him. And whoever Allah leaves astray - for him there is no guide.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Is Allah not sufficient for His servant? Yet they threaten you with other ˹powerless˺ gods besides Him! Whoever Allah leaves to stray will be left with no guide.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَن يَهۡدِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن مُّضِلٍّۗ أَلَيۡسَ ٱللَّهُ بِعَزِيزٖ ذِي ٱنتِقَامٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waman yahdi Allahu fama lahu min mudillin alaysa Allahu biAAazeezin thee intiqamin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And whoever Allah guides - for him there is no misleader. Is not Allah Exalted in Might and Owner of Retribution?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And whoever Allah guides, none can lead astray. Is Allah not Almighty, capable of punishment?

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَئِن سَأَلۡتَهُم مَّنۡ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُۚ قُلۡ أَفَرَءَيۡتُم مَّا تَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ إِنۡ أَرَادَنِيَ ٱللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ هَلۡ هُنَّ كَٰشِفَٰتُ ضُرِّهِۦٓ أَوۡ أَرَادَنِي بِرَحۡمَةٍ هَلۡ هُنَّ مُمۡسِكَٰتُ رَحۡمَتِهِۦۚ قُلۡ حَسۡبِيَ ٱللَّهُۖ عَلَيۡهِ يَتَوَكَّلُ ٱلۡمُتَوَكِّلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walain saaltahum man khalaqa alssamawati waalarda layaqoolunna Allahu qul afaraaytum ma tadAAoona min dooni Allahi in aradaniya Allahu bidurrin hal hunna kashifatu durrihi aw aradanee birahmatin hal hunna mumsikatu rahmatihi qul hasbiya Allahu AAalayhi yatawakkalu almutawakkiloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And if you asked them, "Who created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "Allah." Say, "Then have you considered what you invoke besides Allah? If Allah intended me harm, are they removers of His harm; or if He intended me mercy, are they withholders of His mercy?" Say, "Sufficient for me is Allah; upon Him [alone] rely the [wise] reliers."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: If you ask them ˹O Prophet˺ who created the heavens and the earth, they will certainly say, “Allah!” Ask ˹them˺, “Consider then whatever ˹idols˺ you invoke besides Allah: if it was Allah’s Will to harm me, could they undo that harm? Or if He willed ˹some˺ mercy for me, could they withhold His mercy?” Say, “Allah is sufficient for me. In Him ˹alone˺ the faithful put their trust.”

ayahs.textArabic: قُلۡ يَٰقَوۡمِ ٱعۡمَلُواْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِكُمۡ إِنِّي عَٰمِلٞۖ فَسَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qul ya qawmi iAAmaloo AAala makanatikum innee AAamilun fasawfa taAAlamoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Say, "O my people, work according to your position, [for] indeed, I am working; and you are going to know
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “O my people! Persist in your ways, for I ˹too˺ will persist in mine. You will soon come to know

ayahs.textArabic: مَن يَأۡتِيهِ عَذَابٞ يُخۡزِيهِ وَيَحِلُّ عَلَيۡهِ عَذَابٞ مُّقِيمٌ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Man yateehi AAathabun yukhzeehi wayahillu AAalayhi AAathabun muqeemun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: To whom will come a torment disgracing him and on whom will descend an enduring punishment."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: who will be visited by a humiliating torment ˹in this life˺ and overwhelmed by an everlasting punishment ˹in the next˺.”

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ لِلنَّاسِ بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ فَمَنِ ٱهۡتَدَىٰ فَلِنَفۡسِهِۦۖ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَإِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيۡهَاۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيۡهِم بِوَكِيلٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna anzalna AAalayka alkitaba lilnnasi bialhaqqi famani ihtada falinafsihi waman dalla fainnama yadillu AAalayha wama anta AAalayhim biwakeelin
