ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Or has He taken, out of what He has created, daughters and chosen you for [having] sons?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Has He taken ˹angels as His˺ daughters from what He created, and favoured you ˹O pagans˺ with sons?

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُم بِمَا ضَرَبَ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ مَثَلٗا ظَلَّ وَجۡهُهُۥ مُسۡوَدّٗا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waitha bushshira ahaduhum bima daraba lilrrahmani mathalan thalla wajhuhu muswaddan wahuwa katheemun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when one of them is given good tidings of that which he attributes to the Most Merciful in comparison, his face becomes dark, and he suppresses grief.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Whenever one of them is given the good news of what they attribute to the Most Compassionate, his face grows gloomy, as he suppresses his rage.

ayahs.textArabic: أَوَمَن يُنَشَّؤُاْ فِي ٱلۡحِلۡيَةِ وَهُوَ فِي ٱلۡخِصَامِ غَيۡرُ مُبِينٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Awaman yunashshao fee alhilyati wahuwa fee alkhisami ghayru mubeenin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So is one brought up in ornaments while being during conflict unevident [attributed to Allah]?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Do they attribute to Him˺ those who are brought up in fineries and are not commanding in disputes?

ayahs.textArabic: وَجَعَلُواْ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ عِبَٰدُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ إِنَٰثًاۚ أَشَهِدُواْ خَلۡقَهُمۡۚ سَتُكۡتَبُ شَهَٰدَتُهُمۡ وَيُسۡـَٔلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: WajaAAaloo almalaikata allatheena hum AAibadu alrrahmani inathan ashahidoo khalqahum satuktabu shahadatuhum wayusaloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And they have made the angels, who are servants of the Most Merciful, females. Did they witness their creation? Their testimony will be recorded, and they will be questioned.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Still they have labelled the angels, who are servants of the Most Compassionate, as female. Did they witness their creation? Their statement will be recorded, and they will be questioned!

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالُواْ لَوۡ شَآءَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ مَا عَبَدۡنَٰهُمۗ مَّا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنۡ عِلۡمٍۖ إِنۡ هُمۡ إِلَّا يَخۡرُصُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waqaloo law shaa alrrahmanu ma AAabadnahum ma lahum bithalika min AAilmin in hum illa yakhrusoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And they said, "If the Most Merciful had willed, we would not have worshipped them." They have of that no knowledge. They are not but falsifying.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And they argue, “Had the Most Compassionate willed, we would have never worshipped them.” They have no knowledge ˹in support˺ of this ˹claim˺. They do nothing but lie.

ayahs.textArabic: أَمۡ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمۡ كِتَٰبٗا مِّن قَبۡلِهِۦ فَهُم بِهِۦ مُسۡتَمۡسِكُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Am ataynahum kitaban min qablihi fahum bihi mustamsikoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Or have We given them a book before the Qur'an to which they are adhering?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Or have We given them a Book ˹for proof˺, before this ˹Quran˺, to which they are holding firm?

ayahs.textArabic: بَلۡ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا وَجَدۡنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٖ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِم مُّهۡتَدُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Bal qaloo inna wajadna abaana AAala ommatin wainna AAala atharihim muhtadoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Rather, they say, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are in their footsteps [rightly] guided."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: In fact, they say, “We found our forefathers following a ˹particular˺ way, and we are following in their footsteps.”

ayahs.textArabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِكَ فِي قَرۡيَةٖ مِّن نَّذِيرٍ إِلَّا قَالَ مُتۡرَفُوهَآ إِنَّا وَجَدۡنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٖ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِم مُّقۡتَدُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wakathalika ma arsalna min qablika fee qaryatin min natheerin illa qala mutrafooha inna wajadna abaana AAala ommatin wainna AAala atharihim muqtadoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And similarly, We did not send before you any warner into a city except that its affluent said, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are, in their footsteps, following."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Similarly, whenever We sent a warner to a society before you ˹O Prophet˺, its ˹spoiled˺ elite would say, “We found our forefathers following a ˹particular˺ way, and we are walking in their footsteps.”

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ قَٰلَ أَوَلَوۡ جِئۡتُكُم بِأَهۡدَىٰ مِمَّا وَجَدتُّمۡ عَلَيۡهِ ءَابَآءَكُمۡۖ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا بِمَآ أُرۡسِلۡتُم بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala awalaw jitukum biahda mimma wajadtum AAalayhi abaakum qaloo inna bima orsiltum bihi kafiroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Each warner] said, "Even if I brought you better guidance than that [religion] upon which you found your fathers?" They said, "Indeed we, in that with which you were sent, are disbelievers."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Each ˹warner˺ asked, “Even if what I brought you is better guidance than what you found your forefathers practicing?” They replied, “We totally reject whatever you have been sent with.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَٱنتَقَمۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡۖ فَٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faintaqamna minhum faonthur kayfa kana AAaqibatu almukaththibeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So we took retribution from them; then see how was the end of the deniers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So We inflicted punishment upon them. See then what was the fate of the deniers!

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِذۡ قَالَ إِبۡرَٰهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوۡمِهِۦٓ إِنَّنِي بَرَآءٞ مِّمَّا تَعۡبُدُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waith qala ibraheemu liabeehi waqawmihi innanee baraon mimma taAAbudoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [mention, O Muhammad], when Abraham said to his father and his people, "Indeed, I am disassociated from that which you worship
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Remember, O Prophet˺ when Abraham declared to his father and his people, “I am totally free of whatever ˹gods˺ you worship,

ayahs.textArabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِي فَطَرَنِي فَإِنَّهُۥ سَيَهۡدِينِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Illa allathee fataranee fainnahu sayahdeeni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Except for He who created me; and indeed, He will guide me."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: except the One Who originated me, and He will surely guide me.”

ayahs.textArabic: وَجَعَلَهَا كَلِمَةَۢ بَاقِيَةٗ فِي عَقِبِهِۦ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡجِعُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: WajaAAalaha kalimatan baqiyatan fee AAaqibihi laAAallahum yarjiAAoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And he made it a word remaining among his descendants that they might return [to it].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And he left this enduring declaration among his descendants, so they may ˹always˺ turn back ˹to Allah˺.

ayahs.textArabic: بَلۡ مَتَّعۡتُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡحَقُّ وَرَسُولٞ مُّبِينٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Bal mattaAAtu haolai waabaahum hatta jaahumu alhaqqu warasoolun mubeenun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: However, I gave enjoyment to these [people of Mecca] and their fathers until there came to them the truth and a clear Messenger.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: In fact, I had allowed enjoyment for these ˹Meccans˺ and their forefathers, until the truth came to them along with a messenger making things clear.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡحَقُّ قَالُواْ هَٰذَا سِحۡرٞ وَإِنَّا بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walamma jaahumu alhaqqu qaloo hatha sihrun wainna bihi kafiroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But when the truth came to them, they said, "This is magic, and indeed we are, concerning it, disbelievers."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹But˺ when the truth came to them, they said, “This is magic, and we totally reject it.”

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالُواْ لَوۡلَا نُزِّلَ هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانُ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡقَرۡيَتَيۡنِ عَظِيمٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waqaloo lawla nuzzila hatha alquranu AAala rajulin mina alqaryatayni AAatheemun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And they said, "Why was this Qur'an not sent down upon a great man from [one of] the two cities?"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And they exclaimed, “If only this Quran was revealed to a great man from ˹one of˺ the two cities!”

ayahs.textArabic: أَهُمۡ يَقۡسِمُونَ رَحۡمَتَ رَبِّكَۚ نَحۡنُ قَسَمۡنَا بَيۡنَهُم مَّعِيشَتَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۚ وَرَفَعۡنَا بَعۡضَهُمۡ فَوۡقَ بَعۡضٖ دَرَجَٰتٖ لِّيَتَّخِذَ بَعۡضُهُم بَعۡضٗا سُخۡرِيّٗاۗ وَرَحۡمَتُ رَبِّكَ خَيۡرٞ مِّمَّا يَجۡمَعُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ahum yaqsimoona rahmata rabbika nahnu qasamna baynahum maAAeeshatahum fee alhayati alddunya warafaAAna baAAdahum fawqa baAAdin darajatin liyattakhitha baAAduhum baAAdan sukhriyyan warahmatu rabbika khayrun mimma yajmaAAoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Do they distribute the mercy of your Lord? It is We who have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of this world and have raised some of them above others in degrees [of rank] that they may make use of one another for service. But the mercy of your Lord is better than whatever they accumulate.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Is it they who distribute your Lord’s mercy? We ˹alone˺ have distributed their ˹very˺ livelihood among them in this worldly life and raised some of them in rank above others so that some may employ others in service. ˹But˺ your Lord’s mercy is far better than whatever ˹wealth˺ they amass.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَوۡلَآ أَن يَكُونَ ٱلنَّاسُ أُمَّةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ لَّجَعَلۡنَا لِمَن يَكۡفُرُ بِٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ لِبُيُوتِهِمۡ سُقُفٗا مِّن فِضَّةٖ وَمَعَارِجَ عَلَيۡهَا يَظۡهَرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walawla an yakoona alnnasu ommatan wahidatan lajaAAalna liman yakfuru bialrrahmani libuyootihim suqufan min fiddatin wamaAAarija AAalayha yathharoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And if it were not that the people would become one community [of disbelievers], We would have made for those who disbelieve in the Most Merciful - for their houses - ceilings and stairways of silver upon which to mount
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Were it not that people might ˹be tempted to˺ become one community ˹of disbelievers˺, We would have supplied the homes of ˹only˺ those who disbelieve in the Most Compassionate with silver roofs and ˹silver˺ stairways to ascend,

ayahs.textArabic: وَلِبُيُوتِهِمۡ أَبۡوَٰبٗا وَسُرُرًا عَلَيۡهَا يَتَّكِـُٔونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walibuyootihim abwaban wasururan AAalayha yattakioona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And for their houses - doors and couches [of silver] upon which to recline
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: as well as ˹silver˺ gates and thrones to recline on,

ayahs.textArabic: وَزُخۡرُفٗاۚ وَإِن كُلُّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَّا مَتَٰعُ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۚ وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةُ عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wazukhrufan wain kullu thalika lamma mataAAu alhayati alddunya waalakhiratu AAinda rabbika lilmuttaqeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And gold ornament. But all that is not but the enjoyment of worldly life. And the Hereafter with your Lord is for the righteous.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and ornaments ˹of gold˺. Yet all this is no more than a ˹fleeting˺ enjoyment in this worldly life. ˹But˺ the Hereafter with your Lord is ˹only˺ for those mindful ˹of Him˺.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَن يَعۡشُ عَن ذِكۡرِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ نُقَيِّضۡ لَهُۥ شَيۡطَٰنٗا فَهُوَ لَهُۥ قَرِينٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waman yaAAshu AAan thikri alrrahmani nuqayyid lahu shaytanan fahuwa lahu qareenun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And whoever is blinded from remembrance of the Most Merciful - We appoint for him a devil, and he is to him a companion.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And whoever turns a blind eye to the Reminder of the Most Compassionate, We place at the disposal of each a devilish one as their close associate,

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِنَّهُمۡ لَيَصُدُّونَهُمۡ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَيَحۡسَبُونَ أَنَّهُم مُّهۡتَدُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wainnahum layasuddoonahum AAani alssabeeli wayahsaboona annahum muhtadoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And indeed, the devils avert them from the way [of guidance] while they think that they are [rightly] guided
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: who will certainly hinder them from the ˹Right˺ Way while they think they are ˹rightly˺ guided.

ayahs.textArabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَنَا قَالَ يَٰلَيۡتَ بَيۡنِي وَبَيۡنَكَ بُعۡدَ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقَيۡنِ فَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡقَرِينُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Hatta itha jaana qala ya layta baynee wabaynaka buAAda almashriqayni fabisa alqareenu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Until, when he comes to Us [at Judgement], he says [to his companion], "Oh, I wish there was between me and you the distance between the east and west - how wretched a companion."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But when such a person comes to Us, one will say ˹to their associate˺, “I wish you were as distant from me as the east is from the west! What an evil associate ˹you were˺!”

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَن يَنفَعَكُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ إِذ ظَّلَمۡتُمۡ أَنَّكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡعَذَابِ مُشۡتَرِكُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walan yanfaAAakumu alyawma ith thalamtum annakum fee alAAathabi mushtarikoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And never will it benefit you that Day, when you have wronged, that you are [all] sharing in the punishment.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹It will be said to both,˺ “Since you all did wrong, sharing in the punishment will be of no benefit to you this Day.”

ayahs.textArabic: أَفَأَنتَ تُسۡمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ أَوۡ تَهۡدِي ٱلۡعُمۡيَ وَمَن كَانَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Afaanta tusmiAAu alssumma aw tahdee alAAumya waman kana fee dalalin mubeenin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then will you make the deaf hear, [O Muhammad], or guide the blind or he who is in clear error?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Can you make the deaf hear, or guide the blind or those clearly astray?

ayahs.textArabic: فَإِمَّا نَذۡهَبَنَّ بِكَ فَإِنَّا مِنۡهُم مُّنتَقِمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faimma nathhabanna bika fainna minhum muntaqimoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And whether [or not] We take you away [in death], indeed, We will take retribution upon them.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Even if We take you away ˹from this world˺, We will surely inflict punishment upon them.

ayahs.textArabic: أَوۡ نُرِيَنَّكَ ٱلَّذِي وَعَدۡنَٰهُمۡ فَإِنَّا عَلَيۡهِم مُّقۡتَدِرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Aw nuriyannaka allathee waAAadnahum fainna AAalayhim muqtadiroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Or whether [or not] We show you that which We have promised them, indeed, We are Perfect in Ability.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Or if We show you what We threaten them with, We certainly have full power over them.

ayahs.textArabic: فَٱسۡتَمۡسِكۡ بِٱلَّذِيٓ أُوحِيَ إِلَيۡكَۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faistamsik biallathee oohiya ilayka innaka AAala siratin mustaqeemin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So adhere to that which is revealed to you. Indeed, you are on a straight path.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So hold firmly to what has been revealed to you ˹O Prophet˺. You are truly on the Straight Path.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَذِكۡرٞ لَّكَ وَلِقَوۡمِكَۖ وَسَوۡفَ تُسۡـَٔلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wainnahu lathikrun laka waliqawmika wasawfa tusaloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And indeed, it is a remembrance for you and your people, and you [all] are going to be questioned.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Surely this ˹Quran˺ is a glory for you and your people. And you will ˹all˺ be questioned ˹about it˺.

ayahs.textArabic: وَسۡـَٔلۡ مَنۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِكَ مِن رُّسُلِنَآ أَجَعَلۡنَا مِن دُونِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ءَالِهَةٗ يُعۡبَدُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waisal man arsalna min qablika min rusulina ajaAAalna min dooni alrrahmani alihatan yuAAbadoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And ask those We sent before you of Our messengers; have We made besides the Most Merciful deities to be worshipped?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Ask ˹the followers of˺ the messengers that We already sent before you if We ˹ever˺ appointed ˹other˺ gods to be worshipped besides the Most Compassionate.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَمَلَإِيْهِۦ فَقَالَ إِنِّي رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walaqad arsalna moosa biayatina ila firAAawna wamalaihi faqala innee rasoolu rabbi alAAalameena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And certainly did We send Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his establishment, and he said, "Indeed, I am the messenger of the Lord of the worlds."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, We sent Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his chiefs, and he said: “I am a messenger of the Lord of all worlds.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنۡهَا يَضۡحَكُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Falamma jaahum biayatina itha hum minha yadhakoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But when he brought them Our signs, at once they laughed at them.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But as soon as he came to them with Our signs, they laughed at them,

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا نُرِيهِم مِّنۡ ءَايَةٍ إِلَّا هِيَ أَكۡبَرُ مِنۡ أُخۡتِهَاۖ وَأَخَذۡنَٰهُم بِٱلۡعَذَابِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡجِعُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama nureehim min ayatin illa hiya akbaru min okhtiha waakhathnahum bialAAathabi laAAallahum yarjiAAoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We showed them not a sign except that it was greater than its sister, and We seized them with affliction that perhaps they might return [to faith].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: although every sign We showed them was greater than the one before. Ultimately, We seized them with torments so that they might return ˹to the Right Path˺.

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالُواْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَ ٱلسَّاحِرُ ٱدۡعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِندَكَ إِنَّنَا لَمُهۡتَدُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waqaloo ya ayyuha alsahiru odAAu lana rabbaka bima AAahida AAindaka innana lamuhtadoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And they said [to Moses], "O magician, invoke for us your Lord by what He has promised you. Indeed, we will be guided."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Then˺ they pleaded, “O ˹mighty˺ magician! Pray to your Lord on our behalf, by virtue of the covenant He made with you. We will certainly accept guidance.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَمَّا كَشَفۡنَا عَنۡهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابَ إِذَا هُمۡ يَنكُثُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Falamma kashafna AAanhumu alAAathaba itha hum yankuthoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But when We removed from them the affliction, at once they broke their word.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But as soon as We removed the torments from them, they broke their promise.

ayahs.textArabic: وَنَادَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنُ فِي قَوۡمِهِۦ قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ أَلَيۡسَ لِي مُلۡكُ مِصۡرَ وَهَٰذِهِ ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِيٓۚ أَفَلَا تُبۡصِرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wanada firAAawnu fee qawmihi qala ya qawmi alaysa lee mulku misra wahathihi alanharu tajree min tahtee afala tubsiroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And Pharaoh called out among his people; he said, "O my people, does not the kingdom of Egypt belong to me, and these rivers flowing beneath me; then do you not see?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And Pharaoh called out to his people, boasting, “O my people! Am I not sovereign over Egypt as well as ˹all˺ these streams flowing at my feet? Can you not see?

ayahs.textArabic: أَمۡ أَنَا۠ خَيۡرٞ مِّنۡ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي هُوَ مَهِينٞ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُبِينُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Am ana khayrun min hatha allathee huwa maheenun wala yakadu yubeenu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Or am I [not] better than this one who is insignificant and hardly makes himself clear?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Am I not better than this nobody who can hardly express himself?

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَوۡلَآ أُلۡقِيَ عَلَيۡهِ أَسۡوِرَةٞ مِّن ذَهَبٍ أَوۡ جَآءَ مَعَهُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ مُقۡتَرِنِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Falawla olqiya AAalayhi aswiratun min thahabin aw jaa maAAahu almalaikatu muqtarineena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then why have there not been placed upon him bracelets of gold or come with him the angels in conjunction?"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Why then have no golden bracelets ˹of kingship˺ been granted to him or angels come with him as escorts!”

ayahs.textArabic: فَٱسۡتَخَفَّ قَوۡمَهُۥ فَأَطَاعُوهُۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَوۡمٗا فَٰسِقِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faistakhaffa qawmahu faataAAoohu innahum kanoo qawman fasiqeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So he bluffed his people, and they obeyed him. Indeed, they were [themselves] a people defiantly disobedient [of Allah].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And so he fooled his people, and they obeyed him. They were truly a rebellious people.

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَمَّآ ءَاسَفُونَا ٱنتَقَمۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡ فَأَغۡرَقۡنَٰهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Falamma asafoona intaqamna minhum faaghraqnahum ajmaAAeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when they angered Us, We took retribution from them and drowned them all.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So when they enraged Us, We inflicted punishment upon them, drowning them all.

ayahs.textArabic: فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمۡ سَلَفٗا وَمَثَلٗا لِّلۡأٓخِرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: FajaAAalnahum salafan wamathalan lilakhireena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We made them a precedent and an example for the later peoples.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And We made them an example and a lesson for those after them.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ وَلَمَّا ضُرِبَ ٱبۡنُ مَرۡيَمَ مَثَلًا إِذَا قَوۡمُكَ مِنۡهُ يَصِدُّونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walamma duriba ibnu maryama mathalan itha qawmuka minhu yasiddoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when the son of Mary was presented as an example, immediately your people laughed aloud.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: When the son of Mary was cited as an example ˹in argument˺, your people ˹O Prophet˺ broke into ˹joyful˺ applause.

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالُوٓاْ ءَأَٰلِهَتُنَا خَيۡرٌ أَمۡ هُوَۚ مَا ضَرَبُوهُ لَكَ إِلَّا جَدَلَۢاۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمٌ خَصِمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waqaloo aalihatuna khayrun am huwa ma daraboohu laka illa jadalan bal hum qawmun khasimoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And they said, "Are your gods better, or is he?" They did not present the comparison except for [mere] argument. But, [in fact], they are a people prone to dispute.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They exclaimed, “Which is better: our gods or Jesus?” They cite him only to argue. In fact, they are a people prone to dispute.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا عَبۡدٌ أَنۡعَمۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ وَجَعَلۡنَٰهُ مَثَلٗا لِّبَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: In huwa illa AAabdun anAAamna AAalayhi wajaAAalnahu mathalan libanee israeela
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Jesus was not but a servant upon whom We bestowed favor, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He was only a servant We showed favour to, and made as an example for the Children of Israel.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلۡنَا مِنكُم مَّلَٰٓئِكَةٗ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ يَخۡلُفُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walaw nashao lajaAAalna minkum malaikatan fee alardi yakhlufoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And if We willed, We could have made [instead] of you angels succeeding [one another] on the earth.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Had We willed, We could have easily replaced you ˹all˺ with angels, succeeding one another on earth.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَعِلۡمٞ لِّلسَّاعَةِ فَلَا تَمۡتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَٱتَّبِعُونِۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٞ مُّسۡتَقِيمٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wainnahu laAAilmun lilssaAAati fala tamtarunna biha waittabiAAooni hatha siratun mustaqeemun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And indeed, Jesus will be [a sign for] knowledge of the Hour, so be not in doubt of it, and follow Me. This is a straight path.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And his ˹second˺ coming is truly a sign for the Hour. So have no doubt about it, and follow me. This is the Straight Path.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكُمُ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمۡ عَدُوّٞ مُّبِينٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wala yasuddannakumu alshshaytanu innahu lakum AAaduwwun mubeenun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And never let Satan avert you. Indeed, he is to you a clear enemy.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And do not let Satan hinder you, ˹for˺ he is certainly your sworn enemy.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ عِيسَىٰ بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ قَالَ قَدۡ جِئۡتُكُم بِٱلۡحِكۡمَةِ وَلِأُبَيِّنَ لَكُم بَعۡضَ ٱلَّذِي تَخۡتَلِفُونَ فِيهِۖ فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walamma jaa AAeesa bialbayyinati qala qad jitukum bialhikmati waliobayyina lakum baAAda allathee takhtalifoona feehi faittaqoo Allaha waateeAAooni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when Jesus brought clear proofs, he said, "I have come to you with wisdom and to make clear to you some of that over which you differ, so fear Allah and obey me.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: When Jesus came with clear proofs, he declared, “I have come to you with wisdom, and to clarify to you some of what you differ about. So fear Allah, and obey me.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكُمۡ فَٱعۡبُدُوهُۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٞ مُّسۡتَقِيمٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna Allaha huwa rabbee warabbukum faoAAbudoohu hatha siratun mustaqeemun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. This is a straight path."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Surely Allah ˹alone˺ is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him ˹alone˺. This is the Straight Path.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَٱخۡتَلَفَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِهِمۡۖ فَوَيۡلٞ لِّلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ مِنۡ عَذَابِ يَوۡمٍ أَلِيمٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faikhtalafa alahzabu min baynihim fawaylun lillatheena thalamoo min AAathabi yawmin aleemin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But the denominations from among them differed [and separated], so woe to those who have wronged from the punishment of a painful Day.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Yet their ˹various˺ groups have differed among themselves ˹about him˺, so woe to the wrongdoers when they face the torment of a painful Day!

ayahs.textArabic: هَلۡ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ أَن تَأۡتِيَهُم بَغۡتَةٗ وَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Hal yanthuroona illa alssaAAata an tatiyahum baghtatan wahum la yashAAuroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Are they waiting except for the Hour to come upon them suddenly while they perceive not?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Are they waiting for the Hour to take them by surprise when they least expect ˹it˺?

ayahs.textArabic: ٱلۡأَخِلَّآءُ يَوۡمَئِذِۭ بَعۡضُهُمۡ لِبَعۡضٍ عَدُوٌّ إِلَّا ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Alakhillao yawmaithin baAAduhum libaAAdin AAaduwwun illa almuttaqeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Close friends, that Day, will be enemies to each other, except for the righteous
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Close friends will be enemies to one another on that Day, except the righteous,

ayahs.textArabic: يَٰعِبَادِ لَا خَوۡفٌ عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ وَلَآ أَنتُمۡ تَحۡزَنُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ya AAibadi la khawfun AAalaykumu alyawma wala antum tahzanoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [To whom Allah will say], "O My servants, no fear will there be concerning you this Day, nor will you grieve,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹who will be told,˺ “O My servants! There is no fear for you Today, nor will you grieve—

ayahs.textArabic: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَكَانُواْ مُسۡلِمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Allatheena amanoo biayatina wakanoo muslimeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [You] who believed in Our verses and were Muslims.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹those˺ who believed in Our signs and ˹fully˺ submitted ˹to Us˺.

ayahs.textArabic: ٱدۡخُلُواْ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ أَنتُمۡ وَأَزۡوَٰجُكُمۡ تُحۡبَرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Odkhuloo aljannata antum waazwajukum tuhbaroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Enter Paradise, you and your kinds, delighted."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Enter Paradise, you and your spouses, rejoicing.”

ayahs.textArabic: يُطَافُ عَلَيۡهِم بِصِحَافٖ مِّن ذَهَبٖ وَأَكۡوَابٖۖ وَفِيهَا مَا تَشۡتَهِيهِ ٱلۡأَنفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ ٱلۡأَعۡيُنُۖ وَأَنتُمۡ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yutafu AAalayhim bisihafin min thahabin waakwabin wafeeha ma tashtaheehi alanfusu watalaththu alaAAyunu waantum feeha khalidoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Circulated among them will be plates and vessels of gold. And therein is whatever the souls desire and [what] delights the eyes, and you will abide therein eternally.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Golden trays and cups will be passed around to them. There will be whatever the souls desire and the eyes delight in. And you will be there forever.

ayahs.textArabic: وَتِلۡكَ ٱلۡجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِيٓ أُورِثۡتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Watilka aljannatu allatee oorithtumooha bima kuntum taAAmaloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And that is Paradise which you are made to inherit for what you used to do.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: That is the Paradise which you will be awarded for what you used to do.

ayahs.textArabic: لَكُمۡ فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٞ كَثِيرَةٞ مِّنۡهَا تَأۡكُلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Lakum feeha fakihatun katheeratun minha takuloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: For you therein is much fruit from which you will eat.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: There you will have abundant fruit to eat from.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ فِي عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna almujrimeena fee AAathabi jahannama khalidoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, the criminals will be in the punishment of Hell, abiding eternally.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, the wicked will be in the torment of Hell forever.

ayahs.textArabic: لَا يُفَتَّرُ عَنۡهُمۡ وَهُمۡ فِيهِ مُبۡلِسُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: La yufattaru AAanhum wahum feehi mublisoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: It will not be allowed to subside for them, and they, therein, are in despair.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: It will never be lightened for them, and there they will be overwhelmed with despair.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا ظَلَمۡنَٰهُمۡ وَلَٰكِن كَانُواْ هُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama thalamnahum walakin kanoo humu alththalimeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We did not wrong them, but it was they who were the wrongdoers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We did not wrong them, but it was they who were the wrongdoers.

ayahs.textArabic: وَنَادَوۡاْ يَٰمَٰلِكُ لِيَقۡضِ عَلَيۡنَا رَبُّكَۖ قَالَ إِنَّكُم مَّٰكِثُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wanadaw ya maliku liyaqdi AAalayna rabbuka qala innakum makithoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And they will call, "O Malik, let your Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Indeed, you will remain."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They will cry, “O Mâlik! Let your Lord finish us off.” He will answer, “You are definitely here to stay.”

ayahs.textArabic: لَقَدۡ جِئۡنَٰكُم بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَكُمۡ لِلۡحَقِّ كَٰرِهُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Laqad jinakum bialhaqqi walakinna aktharakum lilhaqqi karihoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: We had certainly brought you the truth, but most of you, to the truth, were averse.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We certainly brought the truth to you, but most of you were resentful of the truth.

ayahs.textArabic: أَمۡ أَبۡرَمُوٓاْ أَمۡرٗا فَإِنَّا مُبۡرِمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Am abramoo amran fainna mubrimoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Or have they devised [some] affair? But indeed, We are devising [a plan].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Or have they mastered some ˹evil˺ plan? Then We ˹too˺ are surely planning.

ayahs.textArabic: أَمۡ يَحۡسَبُونَ أَنَّا لَا نَسۡمَعُ سِرَّهُمۡ وَنَجۡوَىٰهُمۚ بَلَىٰ وَرُسُلُنَا لَدَيۡهِمۡ يَكۡتُبُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Am yahsaboona anna la nasmaAAu sirrahum wanajwahum bala warusuluna ladayhim yaktuboona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Or do they think that We hear not their secrets and their private conversations? Yes, [We do], and Our messengers are with them recording.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Or do they think that We do not hear their ˹evil˺ thoughts and secret talks? Yes ˹We do˺! And Our messenger-angels are in their presence, recording ˹it all˺.

ayahs.textArabic: قُلۡ إِن كَانَ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ وَلَدٞ فَأَنَا۠ أَوَّلُ ٱلۡعَٰبِدِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qul in kana lilrrahmani waladun faana awwalu alAAabideena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Say, [O Muhammad], "If the Most Merciful had a son, then I would be the first of [his] worshippers."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “If the Most Compassionate ˹really˺ had offspring, I would be the first worshipper.”

ayahs.textArabic: سُبۡحَٰنَ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَرۡشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Subhana rabbi alssamawati waalardi rabbi alAAarshi AAamma yasifoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Exalted is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Glorified is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne, far above what they claim.

ayahs.textArabic: فَذَرۡهُمۡ يَخُوضُواْ وَيَلۡعَبُواْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُواْ يَوۡمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fatharhum yakhoodoo wayalAAaboo hatta yulaqoo yawmahumu allathee yooAAadoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So let them indulge ˹in falsehood˺ and amuse ˹themselves˺ until they face their Day, which they have been warned of.

ayahs.textArabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِلَٰهٞ وَفِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِلَٰهٞۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wahuwa allathee fee alssamai ilahun wafee alardi ilahun wahuwa alhakeemu alAAaleemu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And it is Allah who is [the only] deity in the heaven, and on the earth [the only] deity. And He is the Wise, the Knowing.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: It is He Who is ˹the only˺ God in the heavens and ˹the only˺ God on the earth. For He is the All-Wise, All-Knowing.

ayahs.textArabic: وَتَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِي لَهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا وَعِندَهُۥ عِلۡمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Watabaraka allathee lahu mulku alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma waAAindahu AAilmu alssaAAati wailayhi turjaAAoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And blessed is He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them and with whom is knowledge of the Hour and to whom you will be returned.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And Blessed is the One to Whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and everything in between! With Him ˹alone˺ is the knowledge of the Hour. And to Him you will ˹all˺ be returned.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَا يَمۡلِكُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَن شَهِدَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَهُمۡ يَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wala yamliku allatheena yadAAoona min doonihi alshshafaAAata illa man shahida bialhaqqi wahum yaAAlamoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And those they invoke besides Him do not possess [power of] intercession; but only those who testify to the truth [can benefit], and they know.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹But˺ those ˹objects of worship˺ they invoke besides Him have no power to intercede, except those who testify to the truth knowingly.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَئِن سَأَلۡتَهُم مَّنۡ خَلَقَهُمۡ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُۖ فَأَنَّىٰ يُؤۡفَكُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walain saaltahum man khalaqahum layaqoolunna Allahu faanna yufakoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And if you asked them who created them, they would surely say, "Allah." So how are they deluded?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: If you ask them ˹O Prophet˺ who created them, they will certainly say, “Allah!” How can they then be deluded ˹from the truth˺?

ayahs.textArabic: وَقِيلِهِۦ يَٰرَبِّ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوۡمٞ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waqeelihi yarabbi inna haolai qawmun la yuminoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [Allah acknowledges] his saying, "O my Lord, indeed these are a people who do not believe."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Allah is Aware of˺ the Prophet’s cry: “O my Lord! Indeed, these are a people who persist in disbelief.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَٱصۡفَحۡ عَنۡهُمۡ وَقُلۡ سَلَٰمٞۚ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faisfah AAanhum waqul salamun fasawfa yaAAlamoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So turn aside from them and say, "Peace." But they are going to know.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So bear with them and respond with peace. They will soon come to know.

ayahs.textArabic: حمٓ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Hameem
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Ha, Meem.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Ḥâ-Mĩm.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلۡكِتَٰبِ ٱلۡمُبِينِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalkitabi almubeeni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: By the clear Book,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: By the clear Book!

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّآ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ فِي لَيۡلَةٖ مُّبَٰرَكَةٍۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna anzalnahu fee laylatin mubarakatin inna kunna munthireena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, We sent it down during a blessed night. Indeed, We were to warn [mankind].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, We sent it down on a blessed night, for We always warn ˹against evil˺.

ayahs.textArabic: فِيهَا يُفۡرَقُ كُلُّ أَمۡرٍ حَكِيمٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Feeha yufraqu kullu amrin hakeemin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: On that night is made distinct every precise matter -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: On that night every matter of wisdom is ordained

ayahs.textArabic: أَمۡرٗا مِّنۡ عِندِنَآۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرۡسِلِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Amran min AAindina inna kunna mursileena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Every] matter [proceeding] from Us. Indeed, We were to send [a messenger]
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: by a command from Us, for We have always sent ˹messengers˺

ayahs.textArabic: رَحۡمَةٗ مِّن رَّبِّكَۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Rahmatan min rabbika innahu huwa alssameeAAu alAAaleemu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: As mercy from your Lord. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: as a mercy from your Lord. He ˹alone˺ is truly the All-Hearing, All-Knowing—

ayahs.textArabic: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Rabbi alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma in kuntum mooqineena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them, if you would be certain.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything in between, if only you had sure faith.

ayahs.textArabic: لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحۡيِۦ وَيُمِيتُۖ رَبُّكُمۡ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: La ilaha illa huwa yuhyee wayumeetu rabbukum warabbu abaikumu alawwaleena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: There is no deity except Him; He gives life and causes death. [He is] your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him. He ˹alone˺ gives life and causes death. ˹He is˺ your Lord, and the Lord of your forefathers.

ayahs.textArabic: بَلۡ هُمۡ فِي شَكّٖ يَلۡعَبُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Bal hum fee shakkin yalAAaboona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But they are in doubt, amusing themselves.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: In fact, they are in doubt, amusing themselves.

ayahs.textArabic: فَٱرۡتَقِبۡ يَوۡمَ تَأۡتِي ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٖ مُّبِينٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fairtaqib yawma tatee alssamao bidukhanin mubeenin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then watch for the Day when the sky will bring a visible smoke.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Wait then ˹O Prophet˺ for the day ˹when˺ the sky will be veiled in haze, clearly visible,

ayahs.textArabic: يَغۡشَى ٱلنَّاسَۖ هَٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yaghsha alnnasa hatha AAathabun aleemun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Covering the people; this is a painful torment.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: overwhelming the people. ˹They will cry,˺ “This is a painful torment.

ayahs.textArabic: رَّبَّنَا ٱكۡشِفۡ عَنَّا ٱلۡعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤۡمِنُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Rabbana ikshif AAanna alAAathaba inna muminoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [They will say], "Our Lord, remove from us the torment; indeed, we are believers."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Our Lord! Remove ˹this˺ torment from us, ˹and˺ we will certainly believe.”

ayahs.textArabic: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ وَقَدۡ جَآءَهُمۡ رَسُولٞ مُّبِينٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Anna lahumu alththikra waqad jaahum rasoolun mubeenun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: How will there be for them a reminder [at that time]? And there had come to them a clear Messenger.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: How can they be reminded when a messenger has already come to them, making things clear,

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوۡاْ عَنۡهُ وَقَالُواْ مُعَلَّمٞ مَّجۡنُونٌ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thumma tawallaw AAanhu waqaloo muAAallamun majnoonun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then they turned away from him and said, "[He was] taught [and is] a madman."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: then they turned away from him, saying, “A madman, taught by others!”?

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّا كَاشِفُواْ ٱلۡعَذَابِ قَلِيلًاۚ إِنَّكُمۡ عَآئِدُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna kashifoo alAAathabi qaleelan innakum AAaidoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, We will remove the torment for a little. Indeed, you [disbelievers] will return [to disbelief].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, We will remove ˹that˺ torment for a while, and you ˹Meccans˺ will return ˹to disbelief˺.

ayahs.textArabic: يَوۡمَ نَبۡطِشُ ٱلۡبَطۡشَةَ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yawma nabtishu albatshata alkubra inna muntaqimoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The Day We will strike with the greatest assault, indeed, We will take retribution.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Then˺ on the Day We will deal ˹you˺ the fiercest blow, We will surely inflict punishment.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ وَلَقَدۡ فَتَنَّا قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَجَآءَهُمۡ رَسُولٞ كَرِيمٌ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walaqad fatanna qablahum qawma firAAawna wajaahum rasoolun kareemun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We had already tried before them the people of Pharaoh, and there came to them a noble messenger,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, before them We tested Pharaoh’s people: a noble messenger came to them,

ayahs.textArabic: أَنۡ أَدُّوٓاْ إِلَيَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِۖ إِنِّي لَكُمۡ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: An addoo ilayya AAibada Allahi innee lakum rasoolun ameenun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Saying], "Render to me the servants of Allah. Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger,"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹proclaiming,˺ “Hand over the servants of Allah to me. I am truly a trustworthy messenger to you.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَن لَّا تَعۡلُواْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِۖ إِنِّيٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلۡطَٰنٖ مُّبِينٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waan la taAAloo AAala Allahi innee ateekum bisultanin mubeenin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [saying], "Be not haughty with Allah. Indeed, I have come to you with clear authority.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And do not be arrogant with Allah. I have certainly come to you with a compelling proof.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِنِّي عُذۡتُ بِرَبِّي وَرَبِّكُمۡ أَن تَرۡجُمُونِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wainnee AAuthtu birabbee warabbikum an tarjumooni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And indeed, I seek refuge with my Lord and your Lord so you do not stone me ˹to death˺.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِن لَّمۡ تُؤۡمِنُواْ لِي فَٱعۡتَزِلُونِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wain lam tuminoo lee faiAAtazilooni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But if you do not believe me, then leave me alone."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹But˺ if you do not believe me, then let me be.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوۡمٞ مُّجۡرِمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: FadaAAa rabbahu anna haolai qawmun mujrimoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [finally] he called to his Lord that these were a criminal people.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Ultimately, he cried out to his Lord, “These are a wicked people!”

ayahs.textArabic: فَأَسۡرِ بِعِبَادِي لَيۡلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faasri biAAibadee laylan innakum muttabaAAoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Allah said], "Then set out with My servants by night. Indeed, you are to be pursued.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Allah responded,˺ “Leave with My servants at night, for you will surely be pursued.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱتۡرُكِ ٱلۡبَحۡرَ رَهۡوًاۖ إِنَّهُمۡ جُندٞ مُّغۡرَقُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waotruki albahra rahwan innahum jundun mughraqoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And leave the sea in stillness. Indeed, they are an army to be drowned."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And leave the sea parted, for they are certainly an army bound to drown.”

ayahs.textArabic: كَمۡ تَرَكُواْ مِن جَنَّٰتٖ وَعُيُونٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kam tarakoo min jannatin waAAuyoonin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: How much they left behind of gardens and springs
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Imagine˺ how many gardens and springs the tyrants left behind,

ayahs.textArabic: وَزُرُوعٖ وَمَقَامٖ كَرِيمٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: WazurooAAin wamaqamin kareemin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And crops and noble sites
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: as well as ˹various˺ crops and splendid residences,

ayahs.textArabic: وَنَعۡمَةٖ كَانُواْ فِيهَا فَٰكِهِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: WanaAAmatin kanoo feeha fakiheena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And comfort wherein they were amused.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and luxuries which they fully enjoyed.

ayahs.textArabic: كَذَٰلِكَۖ وَأَوۡرَثۡنَٰهَا قَوۡمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kathalika waawrathnaha qawman akhareena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Thus. And We caused to inherit it another people.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So it was. And We awarded it ˹all˺ to another people.

ayahs.textArabic: فَمَا بَكَتۡ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَمَا كَانُواْ مُنظَرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fama bakat AAalayhimu alssamao waalardu wama kanoo munthareena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the heaven and earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Neither heaven nor earth wept over them, nor was their fate delayed.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدۡ نَجَّيۡنَا بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلۡعَذَابِ ٱلۡمُهِينِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walaqad najjayna banee israeela mina alAAathabi almuheeni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We certainly saved the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And We certainly delivered the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment

ayahs.textArabic: مِن فِرۡعَوۡنَۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡمُسۡرِفِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Min firAAawna innahu kana AAaliyan mina almusrifeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: From Pharaoh. Indeed, he was a haughty one among the transgressors.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: of Pharaoh. He was truly a tyrant, a transgressor.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدِ ٱخۡتَرۡنَٰهُمۡ عَلَىٰ عِلۡمٍ عَلَى ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walaqadi ikhtarnahum AAala AAilmin AAala alAAalameena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We certainly chose them by knowledge over [all] the worlds.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And indeed, We chose the Israelites knowingly above the others.

ayahs.textArabic: وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَٰٓؤٞاْ مُّبِينٌ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waataynahum mina alayati ma feehi balaon mubeenun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We gave them of signs that in which there was a clear trial.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And We showed them signs in which there was a clear test.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna haolai layaqooloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, these [disbelievers] are saying,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, these ˹Meccans˺ say,

ayahs.textArabic: إِنۡ هِيَ إِلَّا مَوۡتَتُنَا ٱلۡأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: In hiya illa mawtatuna aloola wama nahnu bimunshareena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: "There is not but our first death, and we will not be resurrected.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: “There is nothing beyond our first death, and we will never be resurrected.

ayahs.textArabic: فَأۡتُواْ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fatoo biabaina in kuntum sadiqeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Bring ˹back˺ our forefathers, if what you say is true.”

ayahs.textArabic: أَهُمۡ خَيۡرٌ أَمۡ قَوۡمُ تُبَّعٖ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَٰهُمۡۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ مُجۡرِمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ahum khayrun am qawmu tubbaAAin waallatheena min qablihim ahlaknahum innahum kanoo mujrimeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Are they better or the people of Tubba' and those before them? We destroyed them, [for] indeed, they were criminals.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Are they superior to the people of Tubba’ and those before them? We destroyed them ˹all˺, ˹for˺ they were truly wicked.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا لَٰعِبِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama khalaqna alssamawati waalarda wama baynahuma laAAibeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We did not create the heavens and earth and that between them in play.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We did not create the heavens and the earth and everything in between for sport.

ayahs.textArabic: مَا خَلَقۡنَٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ma khalaqnahuma illa bialhaqqi walakinna aktharahum la yaAAlamoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: We did not create them except in truth, but most of them do not know.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We only created them for a purpose, but most of these ˹pagans˺ do not know.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ مِيقَٰتُهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna yawma alfasli meeqatuhum ajmaAAeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is the appointed time for them all -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Surely the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision is the time appointed for all—

ayahs.textArabic: يَوۡمَ لَا يُغۡنِي مَوۡلًى عَن مَّوۡلٗى شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا هُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yawma la yughnee mawlan AAan mawlan shayan wala hum yunsaroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The Day when no relation will avail a relation at all, nor will they be helped -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: the Day no kith or kin will be of benefit to another whatsoever, nor will they be helped,

ayahs.textArabic: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Illa man rahima Allahu innahu huwa alAAazeezu alrraheemu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Except those [believers] on whom Allah has mercy. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: except those shown mercy by Allah. He is truly the Almighty, Most Merciful.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna shajarata alzzaqqoomi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, the tree of zaqqum
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Surely ˹the fruit of˺ the tree of Zaqqûm

ayahs.textArabic: طَعَامُ ٱلۡأَثِيمِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: TaAAamu alatheemi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Is food for the sinful.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: will be the food of the evildoer.

ayahs.textArabic: كَٱلۡمُهۡلِ يَغۡلِي فِي ٱلۡبُطُونِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kaalmuhli yaghlee fee albutooni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Like murky oil, it boils within bellies
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Like molten metal, it will boil in the bellies

ayahs.textArabic: كَغَلۡيِ ٱلۡحَمِيمِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kaghalyi alhameemi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Like the boiling of scalding water.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: like the boiling of hot water.

ayahs.textArabic: خُذُوهُ فَٱعۡتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Khuthoohu faiAAtiloohu ila sawai aljaheemi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [It will be commanded], "Seize him and drag him into the midst of the Hellfire,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹It will be said,˺ “Seize them and drag them into the depths of the Hellfire.

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ صُبُّواْ فَوۡقَ رَأۡسِهِۦ مِنۡ عَذَابِ ٱلۡحَمِيمِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thumma subboo fawqa rasihi min AAathabi alhameemi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then pour over his head from the torment of scalding water."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then pour over their heads the torment of boiling water.”

ayahs.textArabic: ذُقۡ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡكَرِيمُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thuq innaka anta alAAazeezu alkareemu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [It will be said], "Taste! Indeed, you are the honored, the noble!
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹The wicked will be told,˺ “Taste this. You mighty, noble one!

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمۡتَرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna hatha ma kuntum bihi tamtaroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, this is what you used to dispute."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: This is truly what you ˹all˺ used to doubt.”

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي مَقَامٍ أَمِينٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna almuttaqeena fee maqamin ameenin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, the righteous will be in a secure place;
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, the righteous will be in a secure place,

ayahs.textArabic: فِي جَنَّٰتٖ وَعُيُونٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fee jannatin waAAuyoonin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Within gardens and springs,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: amid Gardens and springs,

ayahs.textArabic: يَلۡبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٖ وَإِسۡتَبۡرَقٖ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yalbasoona min sundusin waistabraqin mutaqabileena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Wearing [garments of] fine silk and brocade, facing each other.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: dressed in fine silk and rich brocade, facing one another.

ayahs.textArabic: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجۡنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kathalika wazawwajnahum bihoorin AAeenin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Thus. And We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So it will be. And We will pair them to maidens with gorgeous eyes.

ayahs.textArabic: يَدۡعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: YadAAoona feeha bikulli fakihatin amineena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They will call therein for every [kind of] fruit - safe and secure.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: There they will call for every fruit in serenity.

ayahs.textArabic: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلۡمَوۡتَ إِلَّا ٱلۡمَوۡتَةَ ٱلۡأُولَىٰۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: La yathooqoona feeha almawta illa almawtata aloola wawaqahum AAathaba aljaheemi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They will not taste death therein except the first death, and He will have protected them from the punishment of Hellfire
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: There they will never taste death, beyond the first death. And He will protect them from the punishment of the Hellfire—

ayahs.textArabic: فَضۡلٗا مِّن رَّبِّكَۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fadlan min rabbika thalika huwa alfawzu alAAatheemu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: As bounty from your Lord. That is what is the great attainment.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: as ˹an act of˺ grace from your Lord. That is ˹truly˺ the ultimate triumph.

ayahs.textArabic: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرۡنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fainnama yassarnahu bilisanika laAAallahum yatathakkaroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And indeed, We have eased the Qur'an in your tongue that they might be reminded.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, We have made this ˹Quran˺ easy in your own language ˹O Prophet˺ so perhaps they will be mindful.

ayahs.textArabic: فَٱرۡتَقِبۡ إِنَّهُم مُّرۡتَقِبُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fairtaqib innahum murtaqiboona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So watch, [O Muhammad]; indeed, they are watching [for your end].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Wait then! They too are certainly waiting.

ayahs.textArabic: حمٓ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Hameem
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Ha, Meem.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Ḥâ-Mĩm.

ayahs.textArabic: تَنزِيلُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡحَكِيمِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Tanzeelu alkitabi mina Allahi alAAazeezi alhakeemi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The revelation of the Book is from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The revelation of this Book is from Allah—the Almighty, All-Wise.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna fee alssamawati waalardi laayatin lilmumineena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, within the heavens and earth are signs for the believers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Surely in ˹the creation of˺ the heavens and the earth are signs for the believers.

ayahs.textArabic: وَفِي خَلۡقِكُمۡ وَمَا يَبُثُّ مِن دَآبَّةٍ ءَايَٰتٞ لِّقَوۡمٖ يُوقِنُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wafee khalqikum wama yabuththu min dabbatin ayatun liqawmin yooqinoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And in the creation of yourselves and what He disperses of moving creatures are signs for people who are certain [in faith].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And in your own creation, and whatever living beings He dispersed, are signs for people of sure faith.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱخۡتِلَٰفِ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مِن رِّزۡقٖ فَأَحۡيَا بِهِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ مَوۡتِهَا وَتَصۡرِيفِ ٱلرِّيَٰحِ ءَايَٰتٞ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَعۡقِلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waikhtilafi allayli waalnnahari wama anzala Allahu mina alssamai min rizqin faahya bihi alarda baAAda mawtiha watasreefi alrriyahi ayatun liqawmin yaAAqiloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [in] the alternation of night and day and [in] what Allah sends down from the sky of provision and gives life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness and [in His] directing of the winds are signs for a people who reason.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And ˹in˺ the alternation of the day and the night, the provision sent down from the skies by Allah—reviving the earth after its death—and the shifting of the winds, are signs for people of understanding.

ayahs.textArabic: تِلۡكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱللَّهِ نَتۡلُوهَا عَلَيۡكَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ فَبِأَيِّ حَدِيثِۭ بَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ وَءَايَٰتِهِۦ يُؤۡمِنُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Tilka ayatu Allahi natlooha AAalayka bialhaqqi fabiayyi hadeethin baAAda Allahi waayatihi yuminoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: These are the verses of Allah which We recite to you in truth. Then in what statement after Allah and His verses will they believe?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: These are Allah’s revelations which We recite to you ˹O Prophet˺ in truth. So what message will they believe in after ˹denying˺ Allah and His revelations?

ayahs.textArabic: وَيۡلٞ لِّكُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waylun likulli affakin atheemin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Woe to every sinful liar
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Woe to every sinful liar.

ayahs.textArabic: يَسۡمَعُ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ ثُمَّ يُصِرُّ مُسۡتَكۡبِرٗا كَأَن لَّمۡ يَسۡمَعۡهَاۖ فَبَشِّرۡهُ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: YasmaAAu ayati Allahi tutla AAalayhi thumma yusirru mustakbiran kaan lam yasmaAAha fabashshirhu biAAathabin aleemin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Who hears the verses of Allah recited to him, then persists arrogantly as if he had not heard them. So give him tidings of a painful punishment.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They hear Allah’s revelations recited to them, then persist ˹in denial˺ arrogantly as if they did not hear them. So give them good news of a painful punishment.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِذَا عَلِمَ مِنۡ ءَايَٰتِنَا شَيۡـًٔا ٱتَّخَذَهَا هُزُوًاۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ مُّهِينٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waitha AAalima min ayatina shayan ittakhathaha huzuwan olaika lahum AAathabun muheenun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when he knows anything of Our verses, he takes them in ridicule. Those will have a humiliating punishment.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And whenever they learn anything of Our revelations, they make a mockery of it. It is they who will suffer a humiliating punishment.

ayahs.textArabic: مِّن وَرَآئِهِمۡ جَهَنَّمُۖ وَلَا يُغۡنِي عَنۡهُم مَّا كَسَبُواْ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا مَا ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوۡلِيَآءَۖ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Min waraihim jahannamu wala yughnee AAanhum ma kasaboo shayan wala ma ittakhathoo min dooni Allahi awliyaa walahum AAathabun AAatheemun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Before them is Hell, and what they had earned will not avail them at all nor what they had taken besides Allah as allies. And they will have a great punishment.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Awaiting them is Hell. Their ˹worldly˺ gains will not be of any benefit to them whatsoever, nor will those protectors they have taken besides Allah. And they will suffer a tremendous punishment.

ayahs.textArabic: هَٰذَا هُدٗىۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ مِّن رِّجۡزٍ أَلِيمٌ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Hatha hudan waallatheena kafaroo biayati rabbihim lahum AAathabun min rijzin aleemin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: This [Qur'an] is guidance. And those who have disbelieved in the verses of their Lord will have a painful punishment of foul nature.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: This ˹Quran˺ is ˹true˺ guidance. And those who deny their Lord’s revelations will suffer the ˹worst˺ torment of agonizing pain.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡبَحۡرَ لِتَجۡرِيَ ٱلۡفُلۡكُ فِيهِ بِأَمۡرِهِۦ وَلِتَبۡتَغُواْ مِن فَضۡلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Allahu allathee sakhkhara lakumu albahra litajriya alfulku feehi biamrihi walitabtaghoo min fadlihi walaAAallakum tashkuroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: It is Allah who subjected to you the sea so that ships may sail upon it by His command and that you may seek of His bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Allah is the One Who has subjected the sea for you so that ships may sail upon it by His command, and that you may seek His bounty, and that perhaps you will be grateful.

ayahs.textArabic: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ جَمِيعٗا مِّنۡهُۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wasakhkhara lakum ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi jameeAAan minhu inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yatafakkaroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And He has subjected to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth - all from Him. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He ˹also˺ subjected for you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth—all by His grace. Surely in this are signs for people who reflect.

ayahs.textArabic: قُل لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ يَغۡفِرُواْ لِلَّذِينَ لَا يَرۡجُونَ أَيَّامَ ٱللَّهِ لِيَجۡزِيَ قَوۡمَۢا بِمَا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qul lillatheena amanoo yaghfiroo lillatheena la yarjoona ayyama Allahi liyajziya qawman bima kanoo yaksiboona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Say, [O Muhammad], to those who have believed that they [should] forgive those who expect not the days of Allah so that He may recompense a people for what they used to earn.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹O Prophet!˺ Tell the believers to forgive those who do not fear Allah’s days ˹of torment˺, so that He will reward each group for what they used to commit.

ayahs.textArabic: مَنۡ عَمِلَ صَٰلِحٗا فَلِنَفۡسِهِۦۖ وَمَنۡ أَسَآءَ فَعَلَيۡهَاۖ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمۡ تُرۡجَعُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Man AAamila salihan falinafsihi waman asaa faAAalayha thumma ila rabbikum turjaAAoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Whoever does a good deed - it is for himself; and whoever does evil - it is against the self. Then to your Lord you will be returned.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Whoever does good, it is to their own benefit. And whoever does evil, it is to their own loss. Then to your Lord you will ˹all˺ be returned.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَٱلۡحُكۡمَ وَٱلنُّبُوَّةَ وَرَزَقۡنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ وَفَضَّلۡنَٰهُمۡ عَلَى ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walaqad atayna banee israeela alkitaba waalhukma waalnnubuwwata warazaqnahum mina alttayyibati wafaddalnahum AAala alAAalameena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We did certainly give the Children of Israel the Scripture and judgement and prophethood, and We provided them with good things and preferred them over the worlds.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, We gave the Children of Israel the Scripture, wisdom, and prophethood; granted them good, lawful provisions; and favoured them above the others.

ayahs.textArabic: وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُم بَيِّنَٰتٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَمۡرِۖ فَمَا ٱخۡتَلَفُوٓاْ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡعِلۡمُ بَغۡيَۢا بَيۡنَهُمۡۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقۡضِي بَيۡنَهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُواْ فِيهِ يَخۡتَلِفُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waataynahum bayyinatin mina alamri fama ikhtalafoo illa min baAAdi ma jaahumu alAAilmu baghyan baynahum inna rabbaka yaqdee baynahum yawma alqiyamati feema kanoo feehi yakhtalifoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We gave them clear proofs of the matter [of religion]. And they did not differ except after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We ˹also˺ gave them clear commandments regarding ˹their˺ faith. But it was not until knowledge came to them that they differed out of mutual envy. Surely your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Judgment regarding their differences.

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ جَعَلۡنَٰكَ عَلَىٰ شَرِيعَةٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَمۡرِ فَٱتَّبِعۡهَا وَلَا تَتَّبِعۡ أَهۡوَآءَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thumma jaAAalnaka AAala shareeAAatin mina alamri faittabiAAha wala tattabiAA ahwaa allatheena la yaAAlamoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then We put you, [O Muhammad], on an ordained way concerning the matter [of religion]; so follow it and do not follow the inclinations of those who do not know.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Now We have set you ˹O Prophet˺ on the ˹clear˺ Way of faith. So follow it, and do not follow the desires of those who do not know ˹the truth˺.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّهُمۡ لَن يُغۡنُواْ عَنكَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيۡـٔٗاۚ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ أَوۡلِيَآءُ بَعۡضٖۖ وَٱللَّهُ وَلِيُّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innahum lan yughnoo AAanka mina Allahi shayan wainna alththalimeena baAAduhum awliyao baAAdin waAllahu waliyyu almuttaqeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, they will never avail you against Allah at all. And indeed, the wrongdoers are allies of one another; but Allah is the protector of the righteous.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They certainly can be of no benefit to you against Allah whatsoever. Surely the wrongdoers are patrons of each other, whereas Allah is the Patron of the righteous.

ayahs.textArabic: هَٰذَا بَصَٰٓئِرُ لِلنَّاسِ وَهُدٗى وَرَحۡمَةٞ لِّقَوۡمٖ يُوقِنُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Hatha basairu lilnnasi wahudan warahmatun liqawmin yooqinoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: This [Qur'an] is enlightenment for mankind and guidance and mercy for a people who are certain [in faith].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: This ˹Quran˺ is an insight for humanity—a guide and mercy for people of sure faith.

ayahs.textArabic: أَمۡ حَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱجۡتَرَحُواْ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ أَن نَّجۡعَلَهُمۡ كَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ سَوَآءٗ مَّحۡيَاهُمۡ وَمَمَاتُهُمۡۚ سَآءَ مَا يَحۡكُمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Am hasiba allatheena ijtarahoo alssayyiati an najAAalahum kaallatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati sawaan mahyahum wamamatuhum saa ma yahkumoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Or do those who commit evils think We will make them like those who have believed and done righteous deeds - [make them] equal in their life and their death? Evil is that which they judge.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Or do those who commit evil deeds ˹simply˺ think that We will make them equal—in their life and after their death—to those who believe and do good? How wrong is their judgment!

ayahs.textArabic: وَخَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلِتُجۡزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفۡسِۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتۡ وَهُمۡ لَا يُظۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wakhalaqa Allahu alssamawati waalarda bialhaqqi walitujza kullu nafsin bima kasabat wahum la yuthlamoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And Allah created the heavens and earth in truth and so that every soul may be recompensed for what it has earned, and they will not be wronged.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: For Allah created the heavens and the earth for a purpose, so that every soul may be paid back for what it has committed. And none will be wronged.

ayahs.textArabic: أَفَرَءَيۡتَ مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَٰهَهُۥ هَوَىٰهُ وَأَضَلَّهُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ عِلۡمٖ وَخَتَمَ عَلَىٰ سَمۡعِهِۦ وَقَلۡبِهِۦ وَجَعَلَ عَلَىٰ بَصَرِهِۦ غِشَٰوَةٗ فَمَن يَهۡدِيهِ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ ٱللَّهِۚ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Afaraayta mani ittakhatha ilahahu hawahu waadallahu Allahu AAala AAilmin wakhatama AAala samAAihi waqalbihi wajaAAala AAala basarihi ghishawatan faman yahdeehi min baAAdi Allahi afala tathakkaroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Have you seen he who has taken as his god his [own] desire, and Allah has sent him astray due to knowledge and has set a seal upon his hearing and his heart and put over his vision a veil? So who will guide him after Allah? Then will you not be reminded?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Have you seen ˹O Prophet˺ those who have taken their own desires as their god? ˹And so˺ Allah left them to stray knowingly, sealed their hearing and hearts, and placed a cover on their sight. Who then can guide them after Allah? Will you ˹all˺ not then be mindful?

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالُواْ مَا هِيَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنۡيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحۡيَا وَمَا يُهۡلِكُنَآ إِلَّا ٱلدَّهۡرُۚ وَمَا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنۡ عِلۡمٍۖ إِنۡ هُمۡ إِلَّا يَظُنُّونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waqaloo ma hiya illa hayatuna alddunya namootu wanahya wama yuhlikuna illa alddahru wama lahum bithalika min AAilmin in hum illa yathunnoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And they say, "There is not but our worldly life; we die and live, and nothing destroys us except time." And they have of that no knowledge; they are only assuming.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And they argue, “There is nothing beyond our worldly life. We die; others are born. And nothing destroys us but ˹the passage of˺ time.” Yet they have no knowledge ˹in support˺ of this ˹claim˺. They only speculate.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٖ مَّا كَانَ حُجَّتَهُمۡ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُواْ ٱئۡتُواْ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waitha tutla AAalayhim ayatuna bayyinatin ma kana hujjatahum illa an qaloo itoo biabaina in kuntum sadiqeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, their argument is only that they say, "Bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And whenever Our clear revelations are recited to them, their only argument is to say: “Bring our forefathers back, if what you say is true!”

ayahs.textArabic: قُلِ ٱللَّهُ يُحۡيِيكُمۡ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمۡ ثُمَّ يَجۡمَعُكُمۡ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ لَا رَيۡبَ فِيهِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Quli Allahu yuhyeekum thumma yumeetukum thumma yajmaAAukum ila yawmi alqiyamati la rayba feehi walakinna akthara alnnasi la yaAAlamoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Say, "Allah causes you to live, then causes you to die; then He will assemble you for the Day of Resurrection, about which there is no doubt, but most of the people do not know."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “˹It is˺ Allah ˹Who˺ gives you life, then causes you to die, then will gather you ˹all˺ on the Day of Judgment, about which there is no doubt. But most people do not know.”

ayahs.textArabic: وَلِلَّهِ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَيَوۡمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَخۡسَرُ ٱلۡمُبۡطِلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walillahi mulku alssamawati waalardi wayawma taqoomu alssaAAatu yawmaithin yakhsaru almubtiloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And the Day the Hour appears - that Day the falsifiers will lose.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: To Allah ˹alone˺ belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. On the Day the Hour will be established, the people of falsehood will then be in ˹total˺ loss.

ayahs.textArabic: وَتَرَىٰ كُلَّ أُمَّةٖ جَاثِيَةٗۚ كُلُّ أُمَّةٖ تُدۡعَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ كِتَٰبِهَا ٱلۡيَوۡمَ تُجۡزَوۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Watara kulla ommatin jathiyatan kullu ommatin tudAAa ila kitabiha alyawma tujzawna ma kuntum taAAmaloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And you will see every nation kneeling [from fear]. Every nation will be called to its record [and told], "Today you will be recompensed for what you used to do.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And you will see every faith-community on its knees. Every community will be summoned to its record ˹of deeds˺. ˹They all will be told,˺ “This Day you will be rewarded for what you used to do.

ayahs.textArabic: هَٰذَا كِتَٰبُنَا يَنطِقُ عَلَيۡكُم بِٱلۡحَقِّۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا نَسۡتَنسِخُ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Hatha kitabuna yantiqu AAalaykum bialhaqqi inna kunna nastansikhu ma kuntum taAAmaloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: This, Our record, speaks about you in truth. Indeed, We were having transcribed whatever you used to do."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: This record of Ours speaks the truth about you. Indeed, We always had your deeds recorded ˹by the angels˺.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَيُدۡخِلُهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ فِي رَحۡمَتِهِۦۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faamma allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati fayudkhiluhum rabbuhum fee rahmatihi thalika huwa alfawzu almubeenu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So as for those who believed and did righteous deeds, their Lord will admit them into His mercy. That is what is the clear attainment.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: As for those who believed and did good, their Lord will admit them into His mercy. That is ˹truly˺ the absolute triumph.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ أَفَلَمۡ تَكُنۡ ءَايَٰتِي تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡكُمۡ فَٱسۡتَكۡبَرۡتُمۡ وَكُنتُمۡ قَوۡمٗا مُّجۡرِمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waamma allatheena kafaroo afalam takun ayatee tutla AAalaykum faistakbartum wakuntum qawman mujrimeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But as for those who disbelieved, [it will be said], "Were not Our verses recited to you, but you were arrogant and became a people of criminals?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And as for those who disbelieved, ˹they will be told,˺ “Were My revelations not recited to you, yet you acted arrogantly and were a wicked people?

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ إِنَّ وَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقّٞ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ لَا رَيۡبَ فِيهَا قُلۡتُم مَّا نَدۡرِي مَا ٱلسَّاعَةُ إِن نَّظُنُّ إِلَّا ظَنّٗا وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُسۡتَيۡقِنِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waitha qeela inna waAAda Allahi haqqun waalssaAAatu la rayba feeha qultum ma nadree ma alssaAAatu in nathunnu illa thannan wama nahnu bimustayqineena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when it was said, 'Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth and the Hour [is coming] - no doubt about it,' you said, 'We know not what is the Hour. We assume only assumption, and we are not convinced.' "
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And whenever it was said ˹to you˺, ‘Surely Allah’s promise ˹of judgment˺ is true and there is no doubt about the Hour,’ you said ˹mockingly˺, ‘We do not know what the Hour is! We think it is no more than speculation, and we are not convinced ˹that it will ever come˺.’”

ayahs.textArabic: وَبَدَا لَهُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا عَمِلُواْ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wabada lahum sayyiatu ma AAamiloo wahaqa bihim ma kanoo bihi yastahzioona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the evil consequences of what they did will appear to them, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And the evil ˹consequences˺ of their deeds will unfold before them, and they will be overwhelmed by what they used to ridicule.

ayahs.textArabic: وَقِيلَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ نَنسَىٰكُمۡ كَمَا نَسِيتُمۡ لِقَآءَ يَوۡمِكُمۡ هَٰذَا وَمَأۡوَىٰكُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن نَّٰصِرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waqeela alyawma nansakum kama naseetum liqaa yawmikum hatha wamawakumu alnnaru wama lakum min nasireena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And it will be said, "Today We will forget you as you forgot the meeting of this Day of yours, and your refuge is the Fire, and for you there are no helpers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: It will be said, “This Day We will neglect you as you neglected the meeting of this Day of yours! Your home will be the Fire, and you will have no helpers.

ayahs.textArabic: ذَٰلِكُم بِأَنَّكُمُ ٱتَّخَذۡتُمۡ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ هُزُوٗا وَغَرَّتۡكُمُ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۚ فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ لَا يُخۡرَجُونَ مِنۡهَا وَلَا هُمۡ يُسۡتَعۡتَبُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thalikum biannakumu ittakhathtum ayati Allahi huzuwan wagharratkumu alhayatu alddunya faalyawma la yukhrajoona minha wala hum yustaAAtaboona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: That is because you took the verses of Allah in ridicule, and worldly life deluded you." So that Day they will not be removed from it, nor will they be asked to appease [Allah].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: This is because you made a mockery of Allah’s revelations, and were deluded by ˹your˺ worldly life.” So ˹from˺ that Day ˹on˺ they will not be taken out of the Fire, nor will they be allowed to appease ˹their Lord˺.

ayahs.textArabic: فَلِلَّهِ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَرَبِّ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Falillahi alhamdu rabbi alssamawati warabbi alardi rabbi alAAalameena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then, to Allah belongs [all] praise - Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So all praise is for Allah—Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, Lord of all worlds.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَهُ ٱلۡكِبۡرِيَآءُ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walahu alkibriyao fee alssamawati waalardi wahuwa alAAazeezu alhakeemu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And to Him belongs [all] grandeur within the heavens and the earth, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: To Him belongs ˹all˺ Majesty in the heavens and the earth. And He is the Almighty, All-Wise.

ayahs.textArabic: حمٓ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Hameem
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Ha, Meem.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Ḥâ-Mĩm.

ayahs.textArabic: تَنزِيلُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡحَكِيمِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Tanzeelu alkitabi mina Allahi alAAazeezi alhakeemi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The revelation of the Book is from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The revelation of this Book is from Allah—the Almighty, All-Wise.

ayahs.textArabic: مَا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَأَجَلٖ مُّسَمّٗىۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ عَمَّآ أُنذِرُواْ مُعۡرِضُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ma khalaqna alssamawati waalarda wama baynahuma illa bialhaqqi waajalin musamman waallatheena kafaroo AAamma onthiroo muAAridoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: We did not create the heavens and earth and what is between them except in truth and [for] a specified term. But those who disbelieve, from that of which they are warned, are turning away.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We only created the heavens and the earth and everything in between for a purpose and an appointed term. Yet the disbelievers are turning away from what they have been warned about.

ayahs.textArabic: قُلۡ أَرَءَيۡتُم مَّا تَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَرُونِي مَاذَا خَلَقُواْ مِنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَمۡ لَهُمۡ شِرۡكٞ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِۖ ٱئۡتُونِي بِكِتَٰبٖ مِّن قَبۡلِ هَٰذَآ أَوۡ أَثَٰرَةٖ مِّنۡ عِلۡمٍ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
