ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna allatheena yaghuddoona aswatahum AAinda rasooli Allahi olaika allatheena imtahana Allahu quloobahum lilttaqwa lahum maghfiratun waajrun AAatheemun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, those who lower their voices before the Messenger of Allah - they are the ones whose hearts Allah has tested for righteousness. For them is forgiveness and great reward.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, those who lower their voices in the presence of Allah’s Messenger are the ones whose hearts Allah has refined for righteousness. They will have forgiveness and a great reward.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُنَادُونَكَ مِن وَرَآءِ ٱلۡحُجُرَٰتِ أَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡقِلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna allatheena yunadoonaka min warai alhujurati aktharuhum la yaAAqiloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, those who call you, [O Muhammad], from behind the chambers - most of them do not use reason.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, most of those who call out to you ˹O Prophet˺ from outside ˹your˺ private quarters have no understanding ˹of manners˺.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَوۡ أَنَّهُمۡ صَبَرُواْ حَتَّىٰ تَخۡرُجَ إِلَيۡهِمۡ لَكَانَ خَيۡرٗا لَّهُمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walaw annahum sabaroo hatta takhruja ilayhim lakana khayran lahum waAllahu ghafoorun raheemun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And if they had been patient until you [could] come out to them, it would have been better for them. But Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Had they been patient until you could come out to them, it would have certainly been better for them. And Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

ayahs.textArabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِن جَآءَكُمۡ فَاسِقُۢ بِنَبَإٖ فَتَبَيَّنُوٓاْ أَن تُصِيبُواْ قَوۡمَۢا بِجَهَٰلَةٖ فَتُصۡبِحُواْ عَلَىٰ مَا فَعَلۡتُمۡ نَٰدِمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo in jaakum fasiqun binabain fatabayyanoo an tuseeboo qawman bijahalatin fatusbihoo AAala ma faAAaltum nadimeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: O you who have believed, if there comes to you a disobedient one with information, investigate, lest you harm a people out of ignorance and become, over what you have done, regretful.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: O believers, if an evildoer brings you any news, verify ˹it˺ so you do not harm people unknowingly, becoming regretful for what you have done.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّ فِيكُمۡ رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِۚ لَوۡ يُطِيعُكُمۡ فِي كَثِيرٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَمۡرِ لَعَنِتُّمۡ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ حَبَّبَ إِلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡإِيمَٰنَ وَزَيَّنَهُۥ فِي قُلُوبِكُمۡ وَكَرَّهَ إِلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡكُفۡرَ وَٱلۡفُسُوقَ وَٱلۡعِصۡيَانَۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلرَّٰشِدُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: WaiAAlamoo anna feekum rasoola Allahi law yuteeAAukum fee katheerin mina alamri laAAanittum walakinna Allaha habbaba ilaykumu aleemana wazayyanahu fee quloobikum wakarraha ilaykumu alkufra waalfusooqa waalAAisyana olaika humu alrrashidoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And know that among you is the Messenger of Allah. If he were to obey you in much of the matter, you would be in difficulty, but Allah has endeared to you the faith and has made it pleasing in your hearts and has made hateful to you disbelief, defiance and disobedience. Those are the [rightly] guided.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And keep in mind that Allah’s Messenger is ˹still˺ in your midst. If he were to yield to you in many matters, you would surely suffer ˹the consequences˺. But Allah has endeared faith to you, making it appealing in your hearts. And He has made disbelief, rebelliousness, and disobedience detestable to you. Those are the ones rightly guided.

ayahs.textArabic: فَضۡلٗا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَنِعۡمَةٗۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fadlan mina Allahi waniAAmatan waAllahu AAaleemun hakeemun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [It is] as bounty from Allah and favor. And Allah is Knowing and Wise.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹This is˺ a bounty and a blessing from Allah. And Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِن طَآئِفَتَانِ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ ٱقۡتَتَلُواْ فَأَصۡلِحُواْ بَيۡنَهُمَاۖ فَإِنۢ بَغَتۡ إِحۡدَىٰهُمَا عَلَى ٱلۡأُخۡرَىٰ فَقَٰتِلُواْ ٱلَّتِي تَبۡغِي حَتَّىٰ تَفِيٓءَ إِلَىٰٓ أَمۡرِ ٱللَّهِۚ فَإِن فَآءَتۡ فَأَصۡلِحُواْ بَيۡنَهُمَا بِٱلۡعَدۡلِ وَأَقۡسِطُوٓاْۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلۡمُقۡسِطِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wain taifatani mina almumineena iqtataloo faaslihoo baynahuma fain baghat ihdahuma AAala alokhra faqatiloo allatee tabghee hatta tafeea ila amri Allahi fain faat faaslihoo baynahuma bialAAadli waaqsitoo inna Allaha yuhibbu almuqsiteena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And if two factions among the believers should fight, then make settlement between the two. But if one of them oppresses the other, then fight against the one that oppresses until it returns to the ordinance of Allah. And if it returns, then make settlement between them in justice and act justly. Indeed, Allah loves those who act justly.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And if two groups of believers fight each other, then make peace between them. But if one of them transgresses against the other, then fight against the transgressing group until they ˹are willing to˺ submit to the rule of Allah. If they do so, then make peace between both ˹groups˺ in all fairness and act justly. Surely Allah loves those who uphold justice.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّمَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ إِخۡوَةٞ فَأَصۡلِحُواْ بَيۡنَ أَخَوَيۡكُمۡۚ وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُرۡحَمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innama almuminoona ikhwatun faaslihoo bayna akhawaykum waittaqoo Allaha laAAallakum turhamoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The believers are but brothers, so make settlement between your brothers. And fear Allah that you may receive mercy.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The believers are but one brotherhood, so make peace between your brothers. And be mindful of Allah so you may be shown mercy.

ayahs.textArabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا يَسۡخَرۡ قَوۡمٞ مِّن قَوۡمٍ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونُواْ خَيۡرٗا مِّنۡهُمۡ وَلَا نِسَآءٞ مِّن نِّسَآءٍ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُنَّ خَيۡرٗا مِّنۡهُنَّۖ وَلَا تَلۡمِزُوٓاْ أَنفُسَكُمۡ وَلَا تَنَابَزُواْ بِٱلۡأَلۡقَٰبِۖ بِئۡسَ ٱلِٱسۡمُ ٱلۡفُسُوقُ بَعۡدَ ٱلۡإِيمَٰنِۚ وَمَن لَّمۡ يَتُبۡ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la yaskhar qawmun min qawmin AAasa an yakoonoo khayran minhum wala nisaon min nisain AAasa an yakunna khayran minhunna wala talmizoo anfusakum wala tanabazoo bialalqabi bisa alismu alfusooqu baAAda aleemani waman lam yatub faolaika humu alththalimoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: O you who have believed, let not a people ridicule [another] people; perhaps they may be better than them; nor let women ridicule [other] women; perhaps they may be better than them. And do not insult one another and do not call each other by [offensive] nicknames. Wretched is the name of disobedience after [one's] faith. And whoever does not repent - then it is those who are the wrongdoers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: O believers! Do not let some ˹men˺ ridicule others, they may be better than them, nor let ˹some˺ women ridicule other women, they may be better than them. Do not defame one another, nor call each other by offensive nicknames. How evil it is to act rebelliously after having faith! And whoever does not repent, it is they who are the ˹true˺ wrongdoers.

ayahs.textArabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱجۡتَنِبُواْ كَثِيرٗا مِّنَ ٱلظَّنِّ إِنَّ بَعۡضَ ٱلظَّنِّ إِثۡمٞۖ وَلَا تَجَسَّسُواْ وَلَا يَغۡتَب بَّعۡضُكُم بَعۡضًاۚ أَيُحِبُّ أَحَدُكُمۡ أَن يَأۡكُلَ لَحۡمَ أَخِيهِ مَيۡتٗا فَكَرِهۡتُمُوهُۚ وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ تَوَّابٞ رَّحِيمٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo ijtaniboo katheeran mina alththanni inna baAAda alththanni ithmun wala tajassasoo wala yaghtab baAAdukum baAAdan ayuhibbu ahadukum an yakula lahma akheehi maytan fakarihtumoohu waittaqoo Allaha inna Allaha tawwabun raheemun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: O you who have believed, avoid much [negative] assumption. Indeed, some assumption is sin. And do not spy or backbite each other. Would one of you like to eat the flesh of his brother when dead? You would detest it. And fear Allah; indeed, Allah is Accepting of repentance and Merciful.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: O believers! Avoid many suspicions, ˹for˺ indeed, some suspicions are sinful. And do not spy, nor backbite one another. Would any of you like to eat the flesh of their dead brother? You would despise that! And fear Allah. Surely Allah is ˹the˺ Accepter of Repentance, Most Merciful.

ayahs.textArabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰكُم مِّن ذَكَرٖ وَأُنثَىٰ وَجَعَلۡنَٰكُمۡ شُعُوبٗا وَقَبَآئِلَ لِتَعَارَفُوٓاْۚ إِنَّ أَكۡرَمَكُمۡ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ أَتۡقَىٰكُمۡۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ خَبِيرٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ya ayyuha alnnasu inna khalaqnakum min thakarin waontha wajaAAalnakum shuAAooban waqabaila litaAAarafoo inna akramakum AAinda Allahi atqakum inna Allaha AAaleemun khabeerun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: O mankind, indeed We have created you from male and female and made you peoples and tribes that you may know one another. Indeed, the most noble of you in the sight of Allah is the most righteous of you. Indeed, Allah is Knowing and Acquainted.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: O humanity! Indeed, We created you from a male and a female, and made you into peoples and tribes so that you may ˹get to˺ know one another. Surely the most noble of you in the sight of Allah is the most righteous among you. Allah is truly All-Knowing, All-Aware.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ قَالَتِ ٱلۡأَعۡرَابُ ءَامَنَّاۖ قُل لَّمۡ تُؤۡمِنُواْ وَلَٰكِن قُولُوٓاْ أَسۡلَمۡنَا وَلَمَّا يَدۡخُلِ ٱلۡإِيمَٰنُ فِي قُلُوبِكُمۡۖ وَإِن تُطِيعُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ لَا يَلِتۡكُم مِّنۡ أَعۡمَٰلِكُمۡ شَيۡـًٔاۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٌ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qalati alaAArabu amanna qul lam tuminoo walakin qooloo aslamna walamma yadkhuli aleemanu fee quloobikum wain tuteeAAoo Allaha warasoolahu la yalitkum min aAAmalikum shayan inna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The bedouins say, "We have believed." Say, "You have not [yet] believed; but say [instead], 'We have submitted,' for faith has not yet entered your hearts. And if you obey Allah and His Messenger, He will not deprive you from your deeds of anything. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Some of˺ the nomadic Arabs say, “We believe.” Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “You have not believed. But say, ‘We have submitted,’ for faith has not yet entered your hearts. But if you obey Allah and His Messenger ˹wholeheartedly˺, He will not discount anything from ˹the reward of˺ your deeds. Allah is truly All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.”

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّمَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ ثُمَّ لَمۡ يَرۡتَابُواْ وَجَٰهَدُواْ بِأَمۡوَٰلِهِمۡ وَأَنفُسِهِمۡ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلصَّٰدِقُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innama almuminoona allatheena amanoo biAllahi warasoolihi thumma lam yartaboo wajahadoo biamwalihim waanfusihim fee sabeeli Allahi olaika humu alssadiqoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The believers are only the ones who have believed in Allah and His Messenger and then doubt not but strive with their properties and their lives in the cause of Allah. It is those who are the truthful.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The ˹true˺ believers are only those who believe in Allah and His Messenger—never doubting—and strive with their wealth and their lives in the cause of Allah. They are the ones true in faith.

ayahs.textArabic: قُلۡ أَتُعَلِّمُونَ ٱللَّهَ بِدِينِكُمۡ وَٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qul atuAAallimoona Allaha bideenikum waAllahu yaAAlamu ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi waAllahu bikulli shayin AAaleemun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Say, "Would you acquaint Allah with your religion while Allah knows whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth, and Allah is Knowing of all things?"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Say, “Do you inform Allah of your faith, when Allah ˹already˺ knows whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth? And Allah has ˹perfect˺ knowledge of all things.”

ayahs.textArabic: يَمُنُّونَ عَلَيۡكَ أَنۡ أَسۡلَمُواْۖ قُل لَّا تَمُنُّواْ عَلَيَّ إِسۡلَٰمَكُمۖ بَلِ ٱللَّهُ يَمُنُّ عَلَيۡكُمۡ أَنۡ هَدَىٰكُمۡ لِلۡإِيمَٰنِ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yamunnoona AAalayka an aslamoo qul la tamunnoo AAalayya islamakum bali Allahu yamunnu AAalaykum an hadakum lileemani in kuntum sadiqeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They consider it a favor to you that they have accepted Islam. Say, "Do not consider your Islam a favor to me. Rather, Allah has conferred favor upon you that He has guided you to the faith, if you should be truthful."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They regard their acceptance of Islam as a favour to you. Tell ˹them, O Prophet˺, “Do not regard your Islam as a favour to me. Rather, it is Allah Who has done you a favour by guiding you to the faith, if ˹indeed˺ you are faithful.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعۡلَمُ غَيۡبَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرُۢ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna Allaha yaAAlamu ghayba alssamawati waalardi waAllahu baseerun bima taAAmaloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, Allah knows the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth. And Allah is Seeing of what you do.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Surely Allah knows the unseen of the heavens and earth. And Allah is All-Seeing of what you do.”

ayahs.textArabic: قٓۚ وَٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ ٱلۡمَجِيدِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qaf waalqurani almajeedi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Qaf. By the honored Qur'an...
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Qãf. By the glorious Quran!

ayahs.textArabic: بَلۡ عَجِبُوٓاْ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٞ مِّنۡهُمۡ فَقَالَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا شَيۡءٌ عَجِيبٌ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Bal AAajiboo an jaahum munthirun minhum faqala alkafiroona hatha shayon AAajeebun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves, and the disbelievers say, "This is an amazing thing.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹All will be resurrected,˺ yet the deniers are astonished that a warner has come to them from among themselves ˹warning of resurrection˺. So the disbelievers say, “This is an astonishing thing!

ayahs.textArabic: أَءِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابٗاۖ ذَٰلِكَ رَجۡعُۢ بَعِيدٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Aitha mitna wakunna turaban thalika rajAAun baAAeedun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: When we have died and have become dust, [we will return to life]? That is a distant return."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Will we be returned to life,˺ when we are dead and reduced to dust? Such a return is impossible.”

ayahs.textArabic: قَدۡ عَلِمۡنَا مَا تَنقُصُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ مِنۡهُمۡۖ وَعِندَنَا كِتَٰبٌ حَفِيظُۢ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qad AAalimna ma tanqusu alardu minhum waAAindana kitabun hafeethun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: We know what the earth diminishes of them, and with Us is a retaining record.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We certainly know what the earth consumes of them ˹after their death˺, and with us is a well-preserved Record.

ayahs.textArabic: بَلۡ كَذَّبُواْ بِٱلۡحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمۡ فَهُمۡ فِيٓ أَمۡرٖ مَّرِيجٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Bal kaththaboo bialhaqqi lamma jaahum fahum fee amrin mareejin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But they denied the truth when it came to them, so they are in a confused condition.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: In fact, they reject the truth when it has come to them, so they are in a confused state.

ayahs.textArabic: أَفَلَمۡ يَنظُرُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَوۡقَهُمۡ كَيۡفَ بَنَيۡنَٰهَا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِن فُرُوجٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Afalam yanthuroo ila alssamai fawqahum kayfa banaynaha wazayyannaha wama laha min furoojin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Have they not looked at the heaven above them - how We structured it and adorned it and [how] it has no rifts?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Have they not then looked at the sky above them: how We built it and adorned it ˹with stars˺, leaving it flawless?

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ مَدَدۡنَٰهَا وَأَلۡقَيۡنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِيَ وَأَنۢبَتۡنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوۡجِۭ بَهِيجٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalarda madadnaha waalqayna feeha rawasiya waanbatna feeha min kulli zawjin baheejin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the earth - We spread it out and cast therein firmly set mountains and made grow therein [something] of every beautiful kind,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: As for the earth, We spread it out and placed upon it firm mountains, and produced in it every type of pleasant plant—

ayahs.textArabic: تَبۡصِرَةٗ وَذِكۡرَىٰ لِكُلِّ عَبۡدٖ مُّنِيبٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Tabsiratan wathikra likulli AAabdin muneebin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Giving insight and a reminder for every servant who turns [to Allah].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹all as˺ an insight and a reminder to every servant who turns ˹to Allah˺.

ayahs.textArabic: وَنَزَّلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ مُّبَٰرَكٗا فَأَنۢبَتۡنَا بِهِۦ جَنَّٰتٖ وَحَبَّ ٱلۡحَصِيدِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wanazzalna mina alssamai maan mubarakan faanbatna bihi jannatin wahabba alhaseedi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We have sent down blessed rain from the sky and made grow thereby gardens and grain from the harvest
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And We send down blessed rain from the sky, bringing forth gardens and grains for harvest,

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلنَّخۡلَ بَاسِقَٰتٖ لَّهَا طَلۡعٞ نَّضِيدٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalnnakhla basiqatin laha talAAun nadeedun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And lofty palm trees having fruit arranged in layers -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and towering palm trees ˹loaded˺ with clustered fruit,

ayahs.textArabic: رِّزۡقٗا لِّلۡعِبَادِۖ وَأَحۡيَيۡنَا بِهِۦ بَلۡدَةٗ مَّيۡتٗاۚ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡخُرُوجُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Rizqan lilAAibadi waahyayna bihi baldatan maytan kathalika alkhurooju
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: As provision for the servants, and We have given life thereby to a dead land. Thus is the resurrection.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹as˺ a provision for ˹Our˺ servants. And with this ˹rain˺ We revive a lifeless land. Similar is the emergence ˹from the graves˺.

ayahs.textArabic: كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحٖ وَأَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلرَّسِّ وَثَمُودُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kaththabat qablahum qawmu noohin waashabu alrrassi wathamoodu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The people of Noah denied before them, and the companions of the well and Thamud
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Before them, the people of Noah denied ˹the truth,˺ as did the people of the Water-pit, Thamûd,

ayahs.textArabic: وَعَادٞ وَفِرۡعَوۡنُ وَإِخۡوَٰنُ لُوطٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: WaAAadun wafirAAawnu waikhwanu lootin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And 'Aad and Pharaoh and the brothers of Lot
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ’Ȃd, Pharaoh, the kinfolk of Lot,

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡأَيۡكَةِ وَقَوۡمُ تُبَّعٖۚ كُلّٞ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waashabu alaykati waqawmu tubbaAAin kullun kaththaba alrrusula fahaqqa waAAeedi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubba'. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: the residents of the Forest, and the people of Tubba’. Each rejected ˹their˺ messenger, so My warning was fulfilled.

ayahs.textArabic: أَفَعَيِينَا بِٱلۡخَلۡقِ ٱلۡأَوَّلِۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ فِي لَبۡسٖ مِّنۡ خَلۡقٖ جَدِيدٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: AfaAAayeena bialkhalqi alawwali bal hum fee labsin min khalqin jadeedin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Did We fail in the first creation? But they are in confusion over a new creation.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Were We incapable of creating ˹them˺ the first time? In fact, they are in doubt about ˹their˺ re-creation.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ وَنَعۡلَمُ مَا تُوَسۡوِسُ بِهِۦ نَفۡسُهُۥۖ وَنَحۡنُ أَقۡرَبُ إِلَيۡهِ مِنۡ حَبۡلِ ٱلۡوَرِيدِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walaqad khalaqna alinsana wanaAAlamu ma tuwaswisu bihi nafsuhu wanahnu aqrabu ilayhi min habli alwareedi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We have already created man and know what his soul whispers to him, and We are closer to him than [his] jugular vein
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, ˹it is˺ We ˹Who˺ created humankind and ˹fully˺ know what their souls whisper to them, and We are closer to them than ˹their˺ jugular vein.

ayahs.textArabic: إِذۡ يَتَلَقَّى ٱلۡمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ ٱلۡيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ قَعِيدٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ith yatalaqqa almutalaqqiyani AAani alyameeni waAAani alshshimali qaAAeedun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: When the two receivers receive, seated on the right and on the left.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: As the two recording-angels—˹one˺ sitting to the right, and ˹the other to˺ the left—note ˹everything˺,

ayahs.textArabic: مَّا يَلۡفِظُ مِن قَوۡلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيۡهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ma yalfithu min qawlin illa ladayhi raqeebun AAateedun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Man does not utter any word except that with him is an observer prepared [to record].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: not a word does a person utter without having a ˹vigilant˺ observer ready ˹to write it down˺.

ayahs.textArabic: وَجَآءَتۡ سَكۡرَةُ ٱلۡمَوۡتِ بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنۡهُ تَحِيدُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wajaat sakratu almawti bialhaqqi thalika ma kunta minhu taheedu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the intoxication of death will bring the truth; that is what you were trying to avoid.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Ultimately,˺ with the throes of death will come the truth. This is what you were trying to escape!

ayahs.textArabic: وَنُفِخَ فِي ٱلصُّورِۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوۡمُ ٱلۡوَعِيدِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wanufikha fee alssoori thalika yawmu alwaAAeedi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the Horn will be blown. That is the Day of [carrying out] the threat.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And the Trumpet will be blown. This is the Day ˹you were˺ warned of.

ayahs.textArabic: وَجَآءَتۡ كُلُّ نَفۡسٖ مَّعَهَا سَآئِقٞ وَشَهِيدٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wajaat kullu nafsin maAAaha saiqun washaheedun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And every soul will come, with it a driver and a witness.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Each soul will come forth with an angel to drive it and another to testify.

ayahs.textArabic: لَّقَدۡ كُنتَ فِي غَفۡلَةٖ مِّنۡ هَٰذَا فَكَشَفۡنَا عَنكَ غِطَآءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ حَدِيدٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Laqad kunta fee ghaflatin min hatha fakashafna AAanka ghitaaka fabasaruka alyawma hadeedun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [It will be said], "You were certainly in unmindfulness of this, and We have removed from you your cover, so your sight, this Day, is sharp."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹It will be said to the denier,˺ “You were totally heedless of this. Now We have lifted this veil of yours, so Today your sight is sharp!”

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ هَٰذَا مَا لَدَيَّ عَتِيدٌ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waqala qareenuhu hatha ma ladayya AAateedun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And his companion, [the angel], will say, "This [record] is what is with me, prepared."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And one’s accompanying-angel will say, “Here is the record ready with me.”

ayahs.textArabic: أَلۡقِيَا فِي جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Alqiya fee jahannama kulla kaffarin AAaneedin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Allah will say], "Throw into Hell every obstinate disbeliever,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹It will be said to both angels,˺ “Throw into Hell every stubborn disbeliever,

ayahs.textArabic: مَّنَّاعٖ لِّلۡخَيۡرِ مُعۡتَدٖ مُّرِيبٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: MannaAAin lilkhayri muAAtadin mureebin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Preventer of good, aggressor, and doubter,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: withholder of good, transgressor, and doubter,

ayahs.textArabic: ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَأَلۡقِيَاهُ فِي ٱلۡعَذَابِ ٱلشَّدِيدِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Allathee jaAAala maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara faalqiyahu fee alAAathabi alshshadeedi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Who made [as equal] with Allah another deity; then throw him into the severe punishment."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: who set up another god with Allah. So cast them into the severe punishment.”

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ قَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ رَبَّنَا مَآ أَطۡغَيۡتُهُۥ وَلَٰكِن كَانَ فِي ضَلَٰلِۭ بَعِيدٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala qareenuhu rabbana ma atghaytuhu walakin kana fee dalalin baAAeedin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: His [devil] companion will say, "Our Lord, I did not make him transgress, but he [himself] was in extreme error."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: One’s ˹devilish˺ associate will say, “Our Lord! I did not make them transgress. Rather, they were far astray ˹on their own˺.”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ لَا تَخۡتَصِمُواْ لَدَيَّ وَقَدۡ قَدَّمۡتُ إِلَيۡكُم بِٱلۡوَعِيدِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala la takhtasimoo ladayya waqad qaddamtu ilaykum bialwaAAeedi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Allah] will say, "Do not dispute before Me, while I had already presented to you the warning.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Allah will respond, “Do not dispute in My presence, since I had already given you a warning.

ayahs.textArabic: مَا يُبَدَّلُ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ لَدَيَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِظَلَّٰمٖ لِّلۡعَبِيدِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ma yubaddalu alqawlu ladayya wama ana bithallamin lilAAabeedi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The word will not be changed with Me, and never will I be unjust to the servants."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: My Word cannot be changed, nor am I unjust to ˹My˺ servants.”

ayahs.textArabic: يَوۡمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ ٱمۡتَلَأۡتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلۡ مِن مَّزِيدٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yawma naqoolu lijahannama hali imtalati wataqoolu hal min mazeedin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: On the Day We will say to Hell, "Have you been filled?" and it will say, "Are there some more,"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Beware of˺ the Day We will ask Hell, “Are you full ˹yet˺?” And it will respond, “Are there any more?”

ayahs.textArabic: وَأُزۡلِفَتِ ٱلۡجَنَّةُ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ غَيۡرَ بَعِيدٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waozlifati aljannatu lilmuttaqeena ghayra baAAeedin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And Paradise will be brought near to the righteous, not far,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And Paradise will be brought near to the righteous, not far off.

ayahs.textArabic: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Hatha ma tooAAadoona likulli awwabin hafeethin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [It will be said], "This is what you were promised - for every returner [to Allah] and keeper [of His covenant]
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹And it will be said to them,˺ “This is what you were promised, for whoever ˹constantly˺ turned ˹to Allah˺ and kept up ˹His commandments˺—

ayahs.textArabic: مَّنۡ خَشِيَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنَ بِٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَجَآءَ بِقَلۡبٖ مُّنِيبٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Man khashiya alrrahmana bialghaybi wajaa biqalbin muneebin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Who feared the Most Merciful unseen and came with a heart returning [in repentance].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: who were in awe of the Most Compassionate without seeing ˹Him˺, and have come with a heart turning ˹only to Him˺.

ayahs.textArabic: ٱدۡخُلُوهَا بِسَلَٰمٖۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوۡمُ ٱلۡخُلُودِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Odkhulooha bisalamin thalika yawmu alkhuloodi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of Eternity."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of eternal life!”

ayahs.textArabic: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيۡنَا مَزِيدٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Lahum ma yashaoona feeha waladayna mazeedun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They will have whatever they wish therein, and with Us is more.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: There they will have whatever they desire, and with Us is ˹even˺ more.

ayahs.textArabic: وَكَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُم مِّن قَرۡنٍ هُمۡ أَشَدُّ مِنۡهُم بَطۡشٗا فَنَقَّبُواْ فِي ٱلۡبِلَٰدِ هَلۡ مِن مَّحِيصٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wakam ahlakna qablahum min qarnin hum ashaddu minhum batshan fanaqqaboo fee albiladi hal min maheesin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And how many a generation before them did We destroy who were greater than them in [striking] power and had explored throughout the lands. Is there any place of escape?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Imagine˺ how many peoples We destroyed before them, who were far mightier than them. Then ˹when the torment came,˺ they ˹desperately˺ sought refuge in the land. ˹But˺ was there any escape?

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكۡرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلۡبٌ أَوۡ أَلۡقَى ٱلسَّمۡعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna fee thalika lathikra liman kana lahu qalbun aw alqa alssamAAa wahuwa shaheedun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed in that is a reminder for whoever has a heart or who listens while he is present [in mind].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Surely in this is a reminder for whoever has a ˹mindful˺ heart and lends an attentive ear.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٖ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walaqad khalaqna alssamawati waalarda wama baynahuma fee sittati ayyamin wama massana min lughoobin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We did certainly create the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days, and there touched Us no weariness.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, We created the heavens and the earth and everything in between in six Days, and We were not ˹even˺ touched with fatigue.

ayahs.textArabic: فَٱصۡبِرۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ قَبۡلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمۡسِ وَقَبۡلَ ٱلۡغُرُوبِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faisbir AAala ma yaqooloona wasabbih bihamdi rabbika qabla tulooAAi alshshamsi waqabla alghuroobi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So be patient, [O Muhammad], over what they say and exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So be patient ˹O Prophet˺ with what they say. And glorify the praises of your Lord before sunrise and before sunset.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ فَسَبِّحۡهُ وَأَدۡبَٰرَ ٱلسُّجُودِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wamina allayli fasabbihhu waadbara alssujoodi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [in part] of the night exalt Him and after prostration.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And glorify Him during part of the night and after the prayers.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱسۡتَمِعۡ يَوۡمَ يُنَادِ ٱلۡمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٖ قَرِيبٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: WaistamiAA yawma yunadi almunadi min makanin qareebin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And listen on the Day when the Caller will call out from a place that is near -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And listen! On the Day the caller will call out from a near place,

ayahs.textArabic: يَوۡمَ يَسۡمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيۡحَةَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوۡمُ ٱلۡخُرُوجِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yawma yasmaAAoona alssayhata bialhaqqi thalika yawmu alkhurooji
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The Day they will hear the blast [of the Horn] in truth. That is the Day of Emergence [from the graves].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: the Day all will hear the ˹mighty˺ Blast in ˹all˺ truth, that will be the Day of emergence ˹from the graves˺.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نُحۡيِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيۡنَا ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna nahnu nuhyee wanumeetu wailayna almaseeru
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and to Us is the destination
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: It is certainly We Who give life and cause death. And to Us is the final return.

ayahs.textArabic: يَوۡمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ عَنۡهُمۡ سِرَاعٗاۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشۡرٌ عَلَيۡنَا يَسِيرٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yawma tashaqqaqu alardu AAanhum siraAAan thalika hashrun AAalayna yaseerun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: On the Day the earth breaks away from them [and they emerge] rapidly; that is a gathering easy for Us.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Beware of˺ the Day the earth will split open, letting them rush forth. That will be an easy gathering for Us.

ayahs.textArabic: نَّحۡنُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيۡهِم بِجَبَّارٖۖ فَذَكِّرۡ بِٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Nahnu aAAlamu bima yaqooloona wama anta AAalayhim bijabbarin fathakkir bialqurani man yakhafu waAAeedi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: We are most knowing of what they say, and you are not over them a tyrant. But remind by the Qur'an whoever fears My threat.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We know best what they say. And you ˹O Prophet˺ are not ˹there˺ to compel them ˹to believe˺. So remind with the Quran ˹only˺ those who fear My warning.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلذَّٰرِيَٰتِ ذَرۡوٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalththariyati tharwan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: By those [winds] scattering [dust] dispersing
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: By the winds scattering ˹dust˺,

ayahs.textArabic: فَٱلۡحَٰمِلَٰتِ وِقۡرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faalhamilati wiqran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And those [clouds] carrying a load [of water]
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and ˹the clouds˺ loaded with rain,

ayahs.textArabic: فَٱلۡجَٰرِيَٰتِ يُسۡرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faaljariyati yusran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And those [ships] sailing with ease
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and ˹the ships˺ gliding with ease,

ayahs.textArabic: فَٱلۡمُقَسِّمَٰتِ أَمۡرًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faalmuqassimati amran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And those [angels] apportioning [each] matter,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and ˹the angels˺ administering affairs by ˹Allah’s˺ command!

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innama tooAAadoona lasadiqun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, what you are promised is true.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, what you are promised is true.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wainna alddeena lawaqiAAun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And indeed, the recompense is to occur.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And the Judgment will certainly come to pass.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلۡحُبُكِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalssamai thati alhubuki
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: By the heaven containing pathways,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹And˺ by the heavens in their marvellous design!

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّكُمۡ لَفِي قَوۡلٖ مُّخۡتَلِفٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innakum lafee qawlin mukhtalifin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, you are in differing speech.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Surely you are ˹lost˺ in conflicting views ˹regarding the truth˺.

ayahs.textArabic: يُؤۡفَكُ عَنۡهُ مَنۡ أُفِكَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yufaku AAanhu man ofika
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Deluded away from the Qur'an is he who is deluded.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Only those ˹destined to be˺ deluded are turned away from it.

ayahs.textArabic: قُتِلَ ٱلۡخَرَّٰصُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qutila alkharrasoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Destroyed are the falsifiers
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Condemned are the liars—

ayahs.textArabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ فِي غَمۡرَةٖ سَاهُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Allatheena hum fee ghamratin sahoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Who are within a flood [of confusion] and heedless.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: those who are ˹steeped˺ in ignorance, totally heedless.

ayahs.textArabic: يَسۡـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوۡمُ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yasaloona ayyana yawmu alddeeni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They ask, "When is the Day of Recompense?"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They ask ˹mockingly˺, “When is this Day of Judgment?”

ayahs.textArabic: يَوۡمَ هُمۡ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفۡتَنُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yawma hum AAala alnnari yuftanoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [It is] the Day they will be tormented over the Fire
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹It is˺ the Day they will be tormented over the Fire.

ayahs.textArabic: ذُوقُواْ فِتۡنَتَكُمۡ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thooqoo fitnatakum hatha allathee kuntum bihi tastaAAjiloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [And will be told], "Taste your torment. This is that for which you were impatient."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹They will be told,˺ “Taste your torment! This is what you sought to hasten.”

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّٰتٖ وَعُيُونٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna almuttaqeena fee jannatin waAAuyoonin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and springs,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, the righteous will be amid Gardens and springs,

ayahs.textArabic: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَبۡلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحۡسِنِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Akhitheena ma atahum rabbuhum innahum kanoo qabla thalika muhsineena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Accepting what their Lord has given them. Indeed, they were before that doers of good.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹joyfully˺ receiving what their Lord will grant them. Before this ˹reward˺ they were truly good-doers ˹in the world˺:

ayahs.textArabic: كَانُواْ قَلِيلٗا مِّنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ مَا يَهۡجَعُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kanoo qaleelan mina allayli ma yahjaAAoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They used to sleep but little of the night,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: they used to sleep only little in the night,

ayahs.textArabic: وَبِٱلۡأَسۡحَارِ هُمۡ يَسۡتَغۡفِرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wabialashari hum yastaghfiroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and pray for forgiveness before dawn.

ayahs.textArabic: وَفِيٓ أَمۡوَٰلِهِمۡ حَقّٞ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلۡمَحۡرُومِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wafee amwalihim haqqun lilssaili waalmahroomi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And from their properties was [given] the right of the [needy] petitioner and the deprived.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And in their wealth there was a rightful share ˹fulfilled˺ for the beggar and the poor.

ayahs.textArabic: وَفِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ ءَايَٰتٞ لِّلۡمُوقِنِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wafee alardi ayatun lilmooqineena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And on the earth are signs for the certain [in faith]
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: There are ˹countless˺ signs on earth for those with sure faith,

ayahs.textArabic: وَفِيٓ أَنفُسِكُمۡۚ أَفَلَا تُبۡصِرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wafee anfusikum afala tubsiroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And in yourselves. Then will you not see?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: as there are within yourselves. Can you not see?

ayahs.textArabic: وَفِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزۡقُكُمۡ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wafee alssamai rizqukum wama tooAAadoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: In heaven is your sustenance and whatever you are promised.

ayahs.textArabic: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقّٞ مِّثۡلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمۡ تَنطِقُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fawarabbi alssamai waalardi innahu lahaqqun mithla ma annakum tantiqoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then by the Lord of the heaven and earth, indeed, it is truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then by the Lord of heaven and earth! ˹All˺ this is certainly as true as ˹the fact that˺ you can speak!

ayahs.textArabic: هَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيۡفِ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ ٱلۡمُكۡرَمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Hal ataka hadeethu dayfi ibraheema almukrameena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Has there reached you the story of the honored guests of Abraham? -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Has the story of Abraham’s honoured guests reached you ˹O Prophet˺?

ayahs.textArabic: إِذۡ دَخَلُواْ عَلَيۡهِ فَقَالُواْ سَلَٰمٗاۖ قَالَ سَلَٰمٞ قَوۡمٞ مُّنكَرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ith dakhaloo AAalayhi faqaloo salaman qala salamun qawmun munkaroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: When they entered upon him and said, "[We greet you with] peace." He answered, "[And upon you] peace, [you are] a people unknown.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Remember˺ when they entered his presence and greeted ˹him with˺, “Peace!” He replied, “Peace ˹be upon you˺!” ˹Then he said to himself,˺ “˹These are˺ an unfamiliar people.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجۡلٖ سَمِينٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faragha ila ahlihi fajaa biAAijlin sameenin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then he went to his family and came with a fat [roasted] calf
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then he slipped off to his family and brought a fat ˹roasted˺ calf,

ayahs.textArabic: فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيۡهِمۡ قَالَ أَلَا تَأۡكُلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faqarrabahu ilayhim qala ala takuloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And placed it near them; he said, "Will you not eat?"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and placed it before them, asking, “Will you not eat?”

ayahs.textArabic: فَأَوۡجَسَ مِنۡهُمۡ خِيفَةٗۖ قَالُواْ لَا تَخَفۡۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faawjasa minhum kheefatan qaloo la takhaf wabashsharoohu bighulamin AAaleemin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And he felt from them apprehension. They said, "Fear not," and gave him good tidings of a learned boy.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹They did not eat,˺ so he grew fearful of them. They reassured ˹him˺, “Do not be afraid,” and gave him good news of a knowledgeable son.

ayahs.textArabic: فَأَقۡبَلَتِ ٱمۡرَأَتُهُۥ فِي صَرَّةٖ فَصَكَّتۡ وَجۡهَهَا وَقَالَتۡ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faaqbalati imraatuhu fee sarratin fasakkat wajhaha waqalat AAajoozun AAaqeemun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And his wife approached with a cry [of alarm] and struck her face and said, "[I am] a barren old woman!"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then his wife came forward with a cry, clasping her forehead ˹in astonishment˺, exclaiming, “˹A baby from˺ a barren, old woman!”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُواْ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qaloo kathaliki qala rabbuki innahu huwa alhakeemu alAAaleemu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They said, "Thus has said your Lord; indeed, He is the Wise, the Knowing."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They replied, “Such has your Lord decreed. He is truly the All-Wise, All-Knowing.”

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ قَالَ فَمَا خَطۡبُكُمۡ أَيُّهَا ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala fama khatbukum ayyuha almursaloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Later,˺ Abraham asked, “What is your mission, O messengers?”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّآ أُرۡسِلۡنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوۡمٖ مُّجۡرِمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qaloo inna orsilna ila qawmin mujrimeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They replied, “We have actually been sent to a wicked people,

ayahs.textArabic: لِنُرۡسِلَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ حِجَارَةٗ مِّن طِينٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Linursila AAalayhim hijaratan min teenin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: To send down upon them stones of clay,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: to send upon them stones of ˹baked˺ clay,

ayahs.textArabic: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلۡمُسۡرِفِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Musawwamatan AAinda rabbika lilmusrifeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Marked in the presence of your Lord for the transgressors."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: marked by your Lord for the transgressors.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَأَخۡرَجۡنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faakhrajna man kana feeha mina almumineena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So We brought out whoever was in the cities of the believers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then ˹before the torment˺ We evacuated the believers from the city.

ayahs.textArabic: فَمَا وَجَدۡنَا فِيهَا غَيۡرَ بَيۡتٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fama wajadna feeha ghayra baytin mina almuslimeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We found not within them other than a [single] house of Muslims.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But We only found one family that had submitted ˹to Allah˺.

ayahs.textArabic: وَتَرَكۡنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةٗ لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلۡعَذَابَ ٱلۡأَلِيمَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Watarakna feeha ayatan lillatheena yakhafoona alAAathaba alaleema
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We left therein a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And We have left a sign there ˹as a lesson˺ for those who fear the painful punishment.

ayahs.textArabic: وَفِي مُوسَىٰٓ إِذۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ بِسُلۡطَٰنٖ مُّبِينٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wafee moosa ith arsalnahu ila firAAawna bisultanin mubeenin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And in Moses [was a sign], when We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And in ˹the story of˺ Moses ˹was another lesson,˺ when We sent him to Pharaoh with compelling proof,

ayahs.textArabic: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكۡنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَٰحِرٌ أَوۡ مَجۡنُونٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fatawalla biruknihi waqala sahirun aw majnoonun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But he turned away with his supporters and said," A magician or a madman."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: but Pharaoh was carried away by his power, saying ˹of Moses˺, “A magician or a madman!”

ayahs.textArabic: فَأَخَذۡنَٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذۡنَٰهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faakhathnahu wajunoodahu fanabathnahum fee alyammi wahuwa muleemun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So We seized him and his soldiers, casting them into the sea while he was blameworthy.

ayahs.textArabic: وَفِي عَادٍ إِذۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلۡعَقِيمَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wafee AAadin ith arsalna AAalayhimu alrreeha alAAaqeema
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And in 'Aad [was a sign], when We sent against them the barren wind.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And in ˹the story of˺ ’Âd ˹was another lesson,˺ when We sent against them the devastating wind.

ayahs.textArabic: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَيۡءٍ أَتَتۡ عَلَيۡهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتۡهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ma tatharu min shayin atat AAalayhi illa jaAAalathu kaalrrameemi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: It left nothing of what it came upon but that it made it like disintegrated ruins.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: There was nothing it came upon that it did not reduce to ashes.

ayahs.textArabic: وَفِي ثَمُودَ إِذۡ قِيلَ لَهُمۡ تَمَتَّعُواْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wafee thamooda ith qeela lahum tamattaAAoo hatta heenin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And in Thamud, when it was said to them, "Enjoy yourselves for a time."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And in ˹the story of˺ Thamûd ˹was another lesson,˺ when they were told, “Enjoy yourselves ˹only˺ for a ˹short˺ while.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَعَتَوۡاْ عَنۡ أَمۡرِ رَبِّهِمۡ فَأَخَذَتۡهُمُ ٱلصَّٰعِقَةُ وَهُمۡ يَنظُرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: FaAAataw AAan amri rabbihim faakhathathumu alssaAAiqatu wahum yanthuroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But they were insolent toward the command of their Lord, so the thunderbolt seized them while they were looking on.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Still they persisted in defying the commands of their Lord, so they were overtaken by a ˹mighty˺ blast while they were looking on.

ayahs.textArabic: فَمَا ٱسۡتَطَٰعُواْ مِن قِيَامٖ وَمَا كَانُواْ مُنتَصِرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fama istataAAoo min qiyamin wama kanoo muntasireena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And they were unable to arise, nor could they defend themselves.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then they were not able to rise up, nor were they helped.

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَوۡمَ نُوحٖ مِّن قَبۡلُۖ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَوۡمٗا فَٰسِقِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waqawma noohin min qablu innahum kanoo qawman fasiqeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [We destroyed] the people of Noah before; indeed, they were a people defiantly disobedient.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And the people of Noah ˹had also been destroyed˺ earlier. They were truly a rebellious people.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيۡنَٰهَا بِأَيۡيْدٖ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalssamaa banaynaha biaydin wainna lamoosiAAoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the heaven We constructed with strength, and indeed, We are [its] expander.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We built the universe with ˹great˺ might, and We are certainly expanding ˹it˺.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ فَرَشۡنَٰهَا فَنِعۡمَ ٱلۡمَٰهِدُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalarda farashnaha faniAAma almahidoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the earth We have spread out, and excellent is the preparer.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: As for the earth, We spread it out. How superbly did We smooth it out!

ayahs.textArabic: وَمِن كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ خَلَقۡنَا زَوۡجَيۡنِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَذَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wamin kulli shayin khalaqna zawjayni laAAallakum tathakkaroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And of all things We created two mates; perhaps you will remember.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And We created pairs of all things so perhaps you would be mindful.

ayahs.textArabic: فَفِرُّوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِۖ إِنِّي لَكُم مِّنۡهُ نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fafirroo ila Allahi innee lakum minhu natheerun mubeenun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So flee to Allah. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So ˹proclaim, O Prophet˺: “Flee to Allah! I am truly sent by Him with a clear warning to you.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَا تَجۡعَلُواْ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَۖ إِنِّي لَكُم مِّنۡهُ نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wala tajAAaloo maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara innee lakum minhu natheerun mubeenun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And do not make [as equal] with Allah another deity. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And do not set up another god with Allah. I am truly sent by Him with a clear warning to you.”

ayahs.textArabic: كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُواْ سَاحِرٌ أَوۡ مَجۡنُونٌ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kathalika ma ata allatheena min qablihim min rasoolin illa qaloo sahirun aw majnoonun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Similarly, there came not to those before them any messenger except that they said, "A magician or a madman."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Similarly, no messenger came to those before them without being told: “A magician or a madman!”

ayahs.textArabic: أَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِهِۦۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمٞ طَاغُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Atawasaw bihi bal hum qawmun taghoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Did they suggest it to them? Rather, they [themselves] are a transgressing people.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Have they passed this ˹cliché˺ down to one another? In fact, they have ˹all˺ been a transgressing people.

ayahs.textArabic: فَتَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِمَلُومٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fatawalla AAanhum fama anta bimaloomin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So leave them, [O Muhammad], for you are not to be blamed.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So ˹now˺ turn away from them ˹O Prophet˺, for you will not be blamed.

ayahs.textArabic: وَذَكِّرۡ فَإِنَّ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ تَنفَعُ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wathakkir fainna alththikra tanfaAAu almumineena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And remind, for indeed, the reminder benefits the believers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But ˹continue to˺ remind. For certainly reminders benefit the believers.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا خَلَقۡتُ ٱلۡجِنَّ وَٱلۡإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعۡبُدُونِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama khalaqtu aljinna waalinsa illa liyaAAbudooni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: I did not create jinn and humans except to worship Me.

ayahs.textArabic: مَآ أُرِيدُ مِنۡهُم مِّن رِّزۡقٖ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَن يُطۡعِمُونِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ma oreedu minhum min rizqin wama oreedu an yutAAimooni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: I do not want from them any provision, nor do I want them to feed Me.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: I seek no provision from them, nor do I need them to feed Me.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلۡقُوَّةِ ٱلۡمَتِينُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna Allaha huwa alrrazzaqu thoo alquwwati almateenu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, it is Allah who is the [continual] Provider, the firm possessor of strength.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, Allah ˹alone˺ is the Supreme Provider—Lord of all Power, Ever Mighty.

ayahs.textArabic: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ ذَنُوبٗا مِّثۡلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصۡحَٰبِهِمۡ فَلَا يَسۡتَعۡجِلُونِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fainna lillatheena thalamoo thanooban mithla thanoobi ashabihim fala yastaAAjiloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a portion [of punishment] like the portion of their predecessors, so let them not impatiently urge Me.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The wrongdoers will certainly have a share ˹of the torment˺ like that of their predecessors. So do not let them ask Me to hasten ˹it˺.

ayahs.textArabic: فَوَيۡلٞ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِن يَوۡمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fawaylun lillatheena kafaroo min yawmihimu allathee yooAAadoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And woe to those who have disbelieved from their Day which they are promised.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Woe then to the disbelievers when they face their Day which they are warned of!

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلطُّورِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalttoori
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: By the mount
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: By Mount Ṭûr!

ayahs.textArabic: وَكِتَٰبٖ مَّسۡطُورٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wakitabin mastoorin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [by] a Book inscribed
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And by the Book written

ayahs.textArabic: فِي رَقّٖ مَّنشُورٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fee raqqin manshoorin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: In parchment spread open
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: on open pages ˹for all to read˺!

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلۡبَيۡتِ ٱلۡمَعۡمُورِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalbayti almaAAmoori
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [by] the frequented House
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And by the ˹Sacred˺ House frequently visited!

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلسَّقۡفِ ٱلۡمَرۡفُوعِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalssaqfi almarfooAAi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [by] the heaven raised high
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And by the canopy raised ˹high˺!

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلۡبَحۡرِ ٱلۡمَسۡجُورِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalbahri almasjoori
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [by] the sea filled [with fire],
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And by the seas set on fire!

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَٰقِعٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna AAathaba rabbika lawaqiAAun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will occur.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will come to pass—

ayahs.textArabic: مَّا لَهُۥ مِن دَافِعٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ma lahu min dafiAAin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Of it there is no preventer.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: none will avert it—

ayahs.textArabic: يَوۡمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوۡرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yawma tamooru alssamao mawran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: On the Day the heaven will sway with circular motion
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: on the Day the heavens will be shaken violently,

ayahs.textArabic: وَتَسِيرُ ٱلۡجِبَالُ سَيۡرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wataseeru aljibalu sayran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the mountains will pass on, departing -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and the mountains will be blown away entirely.

ayahs.textArabic: فَوَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fawaylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then woe on that Day to the deniers—

ayahs.textArabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ فِي خَوۡضٖ يَلۡعَبُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Allatheena hum fee khawdin yalAAaboona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Who are in [empty] discourse amusing themselves.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: those who amuse themselves with falsehood!

ayahs.textArabic: يَوۡمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yawma yudaAAAAoona ila nari jahannama daAAAAan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The Day they are thrust toward the fire of Hell with a [violent] thrust, [its angels will say],
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹It is˺ the Day they will be fiercely shoved into the Fire of Hell.

ayahs.textArabic: هَٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِي كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Hathihi alnnaru allatee kuntum biha tukaththiboona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: "This is the Fire which you used to deny.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹They will be told,˺ “This is the Fire which you used to deny.

ayahs.textArabic: أَفَسِحۡرٌ هَٰذَآ أَمۡ أَنتُمۡ لَا تُبۡصِرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Afasihrun hatha am antum la tubsiroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then is this magic, or do you not see?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Is this magic, or do you not see?

ayahs.textArabic: ٱصۡلَوۡهَا فَٱصۡبِرُوٓاْ أَوۡ لَا تَصۡبِرُواْ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡكُمۡۖ إِنَّمَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Islawha faisbiroo aw la tasbiroo sawaon AAalaykum innama tujzawna ma kuntum taAAmaloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Enter to] burn therein; then be patient or impatient - it is all the same for you. You are only being recompensed [for] what you used to do."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Burn in it! It is the same whether you endure ˹it˺ patiently or not. You are only rewarded for what you used to do.”

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّٰتٖ وَنَعِيمٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna almuttaqeena fee jannatin wanaAAeemin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and pleasure,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, the righteous will be in Gardens and bliss,

ayahs.textArabic: فَٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ وَوَقَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fakiheena bima atahum rabbuhum wawaqahum rabbuhum AAathaba aljaheemi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: enjoying whatever their Lord will have granted them. And their Lord will have protected them from the torment of the Hellfire.

ayahs.textArabic: كُلُواْ وَٱشۡرَبُواْ هَنِيٓـَٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kuloo waishraboo haneean bima kuntum taAAmaloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹They will be told,˺ “Eat and drink happily for what you used to do.”

ayahs.textArabic: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٖ مَّصۡفُوفَةٖۖ وَزَوَّجۡنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Muttakieena AAala sururin masfoofatin wazawwajnahum bihoorin AAeenin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They will be reclining on thrones lined up, and We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They will be reclining on thrones, ˹neatly˺ lined up ˹facing each other˺. And We will pair them to maidens with gorgeous eyes.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَٱتَّبَعَتۡهُمۡ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَٰنٍ أَلۡحَقۡنَا بِهِمۡ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمۡ وَمَآ أَلَتۡنَٰهُم مِّنۡ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَيۡءٖۚ كُلُّ ٱمۡرِيِٕۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waallatheena amanoo waittabaAAathum thurriyyatuhum bieemanin alhaqna bihim thurriyyatahum wama alatnahum min AAamalihim min shayin kullu imriin bima kasaba raheenun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And those who believed and whose descendants followed them in faith - We will join with them their descendants, and We will not deprive them of anything of their deeds. Every person, for what he earned, is retained.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: As for those who believe and whose descendants follow them in faith, We will elevate their descendants to their rank, never discounting anything ˹of the reward˺ of their deeds. Every person will reap only what they sowed.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَمۡدَدۡنَٰهُم بِفَٰكِهَةٖ وَلَحۡمٖ مِّمَّا يَشۡتَهُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waamdadnahum bifakihatin walahmin mimma yashtahoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We will provide them with fruit and meat from whatever they desire.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And We will ˹continually˺ provide them with whatever fruit or meat they desire.

ayahs.textArabic: يَتَنَٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأۡسٗا لَّا لَغۡوٞ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأۡثِيمٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: YatanazaAAoona feeha kasan la laghwun feeha wala tatheemun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They will exchange with one another a cup [of wine] wherein [results] no ill speech or commission of sin.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They will pass around to each other a drink ˹of pure wine,˺ which leads to no idle talk or sinfulness.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ غِلۡمَانٞ لَّهُمۡ كَأَنَّهُمۡ لُؤۡلُؤٞ مَّكۡنُونٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wayatoofu AAalayhim ghilmanun lahum kaannahum luluon maknoonun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: There will circulate among them [servant] boys [especially] for them, as if they were pearls well-protected.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And they will be waited on by their youthful servants like spotless pearls.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَقۡبَلَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٖ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waaqbala baAAduhum AAala baAAdin yatasaaloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They will turn to one another inquisitively.

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبۡلُ فِيٓ أَهۡلِنَا مُشۡفِقِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qaloo inna kunna qablu fee ahlina mushfiqeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They will say, "Indeed, we were previously among our people fearful [of displeasing Allah].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They will say, “Before ˹this reward˺ we used to be in awe ˹of Allah˺ in the midst of our people.

ayahs.textArabic: فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Famanna Allahu AAalayna wawaqana AAathaba alssamoomi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So Allah conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So Allah has graced us and protected us from the torment of ˹Hell’s˺ scorching heat.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبۡلُ نَدۡعُوهُۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna kunna min qablu nadAAoohu innahu huwa albarru alrraheemu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, we used to supplicate Him before. Indeed, it is He who is the Beneficent, the Merciful."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, we used to call upon Him ˹alone˺ before. He is truly the Most Kind, Most Merciful.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَذَكِّرۡ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعۡمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٖ وَلَا مَجۡنُونٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fathakkir fama anta biniAAmati rabbika bikahin wala majnoonin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So remind [O Muhammad], for you are not, by the favor of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So ˹continue to˺ remind ˹all, O Prophet˺. For you, by the grace of your Lord, are not a fortune-teller or a madman.

ayahs.textArabic: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٞ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيۡبَ ٱلۡمَنُونِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Am yaqooloona shaAAirun natarabbasu bihi rayba almanooni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Or do they say [of you], "A poet for whom we await a misfortune of time?"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Or do they say, “˹He is˺ a poet, for whom we ˹eagerly˺ await an ill-fate!”?

ayahs.textArabic: قُلۡ تَرَبَّصُواْ فَإِنِّي مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡمُتَرَبِّصِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qul tarabbasoo fainnee maAAakum mina almutarabbiseena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Say, "Wait, for indeed I am, with you, among the waiters."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Say, “Keep waiting! I too am waiting with you.”

ayahs.textArabic: أَمۡ تَأۡمُرُهُمۡ أَحۡلَٰمُهُم بِهَٰذَآۚ أَمۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمٞ طَاغُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Am tamuruhum ahlamuhum bihatha am hum qawmun taghoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Or do their minds command them to [say] this, or are they a transgressing people?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Or do their ˹intelligent˺ minds prompt them to this ˹paradox˺? Or are they ˹just˺ a transgressing people?

ayahs.textArabic: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥۚ بَل لَّا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Am yaqooloona taqawwalahu bal la yuminoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Or do they say, "He has made it up"? Rather, they do not believe.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Or do they say, “He made this ˹Quran˺ up!”? In fact, they have no faith.

ayahs.textArabic: فَلۡيَأۡتُواْ بِحَدِيثٖ مِّثۡلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُواْ صَٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Falyatoo bihadeethin mithlihi in kanoo sadiqeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then let them produce a statement like it, if they should be truthful.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Let them then produce something like it, if what they say is true!

ayahs.textArabic: أَمۡ خُلِقُواْ مِنۡ غَيۡرِ شَيۡءٍ أَمۡ هُمُ ٱلۡخَٰلِقُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Am khuliqoo min ghayri shayin am humu alkhaliqoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators [of themselves]?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Or were they created by nothing, or are they ˹their own˺ creators?

ayahs.textArabic: أَمۡ خَلَقُواْ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Am khalaqoo alssamawati waalarda bal la yooqinoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they are not certain.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? In fact, they have no firm belief ˹in Allah˺.

ayahs.textArabic: أَمۡ عِندَهُمۡ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمۡ هُمُ ٱلۡمُصَۜيۡطِرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Am AAindahum khazainu rabbika am humu almusaytiroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Or have they the depositories [containing the provision] of your Lord? Or are they the controllers [of them]?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Or do they possess the treasuries of your Lord, or are they in control ˹of everything˺?

ayahs.textArabic: أَمۡ لَهُمۡ سُلَّمٞ يَسۡتَمِعُونَ فِيهِۖ فَلۡيَأۡتِ مُسۡتَمِعُهُم بِسُلۡطَٰنٖ مُّبِينٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Am lahum sullamun yastamiAAoona feehi falyati mustamiAAuhum bisultanin mubeenin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Or have they a stairway [into the heaven] upon which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear authority.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Or do they have a stairway, by which they eavesdrop ˹on the heavens˺? Then let those who do so bring a compelling proof.

ayahs.textArabic: أَمۡ لَهُ ٱلۡبَنَٰتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلۡبَنُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Am lahu albanatu walakumu albanoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Or has He daughters while you have sons?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Or does He have daughters ˹as you claim˺, while you ˹prefer to˺ have sons?

ayahs.textArabic: أَمۡ تَسۡـَٔلُهُمۡ أَجۡرٗا فَهُم مِّن مَّغۡرَمٖ مُّثۡقَلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Am tasaluhum ajran fahum min maghramin muthqaloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Or do you, [O Muhammad], ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Or are you ˹O Prophet˺ asking them for a reward ˹for the message˺ so that they are overburdened by debt?

ayahs.textArabic: أَمۡ عِندَهُمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبُ فَهُمۡ يَكۡتُبُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Am AAindahumu alghaybu fahum yaktuboona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Or do they have access to ˹the Record in˺ the unseen, so they copy it ˹for all to see˺?

ayahs.textArabic: أَمۡ يُرِيدُونَ كَيۡدٗاۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ هُمُ ٱلۡمَكِيدُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Am yureedoona kaydan faallatheena kafaroo humu almakeedoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Or do they intend a plan? But those who disbelieve - they are the object of a plan.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Or do they intend to scheme ˹against the Prophet˺? Then it is the disbelievers who will fall victim to ˹their˺ schemes.

ayahs.textArabic: أَمۡ لَهُمۡ إِلَٰهٌ غَيۡرُ ٱللَّهِۚ سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Am lahum ilahun ghayru Allahi subhana Allahi AAamma yushrikoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Or have they a deity other than Allah? Exalted is Allah above whatever they associate with Him.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Or do they have a god other than Allah? Glorified is Allah far above what they associate ˹with Him˺!

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِن يَرَوۡاْ كِسۡفٗا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطٗا يَقُولُواْ سَحَابٞ مَّرۡكُومٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wain yaraw kisfan mina alssamai saqitan yaqooloo sahabun markoomun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And if they were to see a fragment from the sky falling, they would say, "[It is merely] clouds heaped up."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: If they were to see a ˹deadly˺ piece of the sky fall down ˹upon them˺, still they would say, “˹This is just˺ a pile of clouds.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَذَرۡهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُواْ يَوۡمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي فِيهِ يُصۡعَقُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fatharhum hatta yulaqoo yawmahumu allathee feehi yusAAaqoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be struck insensible -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So leave them until they face their Day in which they will be struck dead—

ayahs.textArabic: يَوۡمَ لَا يُغۡنِي عَنۡهُمۡ كَيۡدُهُمۡ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا هُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yawma la yughnee AAanhum kayduhum shayan wala hum yunsaroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The Day their plan will not avail them at all, nor will they be helped.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: the Day their scheming will be of no benefit to them whatsoever, nor will they be helped.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ عَذَابٗا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wainna lillatheena thalamoo AAathaban doona thalika walakinna aktharahum la yaAAlamoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a punishment before that, but most of them do not know.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Also, the wrongdoers will certainly have another torment before that ˹Day˺, but most of them do not know.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعۡيُنِنَاۖ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waisbir lihukmi rabbika fainnaka biaAAyunina wasabbih bihamdi rabbika heena taqoomu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And be patient, [O Muhammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes. And exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord when you arise.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So be patient with your Lord’s decree, for you are truly under Our ˹watchful˺ Eyes. And glorify the praises of your Lord when you rise.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ فَسَبِّحۡهُ وَإِدۡبَٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wamina allayli fasabbihhu waidbara alnnujoomi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And in a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And glorify Him during part of the night and at the fading of the stars.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلنَّجۡمِ إِذَا هَوَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalnnajmi itha hawa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: By the star when it descends,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: By the stars when they fade away!

ayahs.textArabic: مَا ضَلَّ صَاحِبُكُمۡ وَمَا غَوَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ma dalla sahibukum wama ghawa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Your companion [Muhammad] has not strayed, nor has he erred,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Your fellow man is neither misguided nor astray.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا يَنطِقُ عَنِ ٱلۡهَوَىٰٓ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama yantiqu AAani alhawa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Nor does he speak from [his own] inclination.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Nor does he speak of his own whims.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا وَحۡيٞ يُوحَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: In huwa illa wahyun yooha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: It is not but a revelation revealed,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: It is only a revelation sent down ˹to him˺.

ayahs.textArabic: عَلَّمَهُۥ شَدِيدُ ٱلۡقُوَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: AAallamahu shadeedu alquwa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Taught to him by one intense in strength -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He has been taught by one ˹angel˺ of mighty power

ayahs.textArabic: ذُو مِرَّةٖ فَٱسۡتَوَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thoo mirratin faistawa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: One of soundness. And he rose to [his] true form
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and great perfection, who once rose to ˹his˺ true form

ayahs.textArabic: وَهُوَ بِٱلۡأُفُقِ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wahuwa bialofuqi alaAAla
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: While he was in the higher [part of the] horizon.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: while on the highest point above the horizon,

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ دَنَا فَتَدَلَّىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thumma dana fatadalla
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then he approached and descended
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: then he approached ˹the Prophet˺, coming so close

ayahs.textArabic: فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوۡسَيۡنِ أَوۡ أَدۡنَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fakana qaba qawsayni aw adna
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And was at a distance of two bow lengths or nearer.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: that he was only two arms-lengths away or even less.

ayahs.textArabic: فَأَوۡحَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ عَبۡدِهِۦ مَآ أَوۡحَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faawha ila AAabdihi ma awha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And he revealed to His Servant what he revealed.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then Allah revealed to His servant what He revealed ˹through Gabriel˺.

ayahs.textArabic: مَا كَذَبَ ٱلۡفُؤَادُ مَا رَأَىٰٓ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ma kathaba alfuadu ma raa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The heart did not lie [about] what it saw.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The ˹Prophet’s˺ heart did not doubt what he saw.

ayahs.textArabic: أَفَتُمَٰرُونَهُۥ عَلَىٰ مَا يَرَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Afatumaroonahu AAala ma yara
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So will you dispute with him over what he saw?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: How can you ˹O pagans˺ then dispute with him regarding what he saw?

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدۡ رَءَاهُ نَزۡلَةً أُخۡرَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walaqad raahu nazlatan okhra
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And he certainly saw him in another descent
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And he certainly saw that ˹angel descend˺ a second time

ayahs.textArabic: عِندَ سِدۡرَةِ ٱلۡمُنتَهَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: AAinda sidrati almuntaha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: At the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: at the Lote Tree of the most extreme limit ˹in the seventh heaven˺—

ayahs.textArabic: عِندَهَا جَنَّةُ ٱلۡمَأۡوَىٰٓ
ayahs.textTransliteration: AAindaha jannatu almawa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Near it is the Garden of Refuge -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: near which is the Garden of ˹Eternal˺ Residence—

ayahs.textArabic: إِذۡ يَغۡشَى ٱلسِّدۡرَةَ مَا يَغۡشَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ith yaghsha alssidrata ma yaghsha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: When there covered the Lote Tree that which covered [it].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: while the Lote Tree was overwhelmed with ˹heavenly˺ splendours!

ayahs.textArabic: مَا زَاغَ ٱلۡبَصَرُ وَمَا طَغَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ma zagha albasaru wama tagha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The sight [of the Prophet] did not swerve, nor did it transgress [its limit].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The ˹Prophet’s˺ sight never wandered, nor did it overreach.

ayahs.textArabic: لَقَدۡ رَأَىٰ مِنۡ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰٓ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Laqad raa min ayati rabbihi alkubra
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He certainly saw of the greatest signs of his Lord.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He certainly saw some of his Lord’s greatest signs.

ayahs.textArabic: أَفَرَءَيۡتُمُ ٱللَّٰتَ وَٱلۡعُزَّىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Afaraaytumu allata waalAAuzza
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So have you considered al-Lat and al-'Uzza?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Now, have you considered ˹the idols of˺ Lât and ’Uzza,

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَنَوٰةَ ٱلثَّالِثَةَ ٱلۡأُخۡرَىٰٓ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wamanata alththalithata alokhra
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And Manat, the third - the other one?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and the third one, Manât, as well?

ayahs.textArabic: أَلَكُمُ ٱلذَّكَرُ وَلَهُ ٱلۡأُنثَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Alakumu alththakaru walahu alontha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Is the male for you and for Him the female?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Do you ˹prefer to˺ have sons while ˹you attribute˺ to Him daughters?

ayahs.textArabic: تِلۡكَ إِذٗا قِسۡمَةٞ ضِيزَىٰٓ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Tilka ithan qismatun deeza
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: That, then, is an unjust division.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then this is ˹truly˺ a biased distribution!

ayahs.textArabic: إِنۡ هِيَ إِلَّآ أَسۡمَآءٞ سَمَّيۡتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمۡ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلۡطَٰنٍۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهۡوَى ٱلۡأَنفُسُۖ وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ
ayahs.textTransliteration: In hiya illa asmaon sammaytumooha antum waabaokum ma anzala Allahu biha min sultanin in yattabiAAoona illa alththanna wama tahwa alanfusu walaqad jaahum min rabbihimu alhuda
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They are not but [mere] names you have named them - you and your forefathers - for which Allah has sent down no authority. They follow not except assumption and what [their] souls desire, and there has already come to them from their Lord guidance.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: These ˹idols˺ are mere names that you and your forefathers have made up—a practice Allah has never authorized. They follow nothing but ˹inherited˺ assumptions and whatever ˹their˺ souls desire, although ˹true˺ guidance has already come to them from their Lord.

ayahs.textArabic: أَمۡ لِلۡإِنسَٰنِ مَا تَمَنَّىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Am lilinsani ma tamanna
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Or is there for man whatever he wishes?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Or should every person ˹simply˺ have whatever ˹intercessors˺ they desire?

ayahs.textArabic: فَلِلَّهِ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةُ وَٱلۡأُولَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Falillahi alakhiratu waaloola
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Rather, to Allah belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: In fact, to Allah ˹alone˺ belongs this world and the next.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكٖ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ لَا تُغۡنِي شَفَٰعَتُهُمۡ شَيۡـًٔا إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ أَن يَأۡذَنَ ٱللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرۡضَىٰٓ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wakam min malakin fee alssamawati la tughnee shafaAAatuhum shayan illa min baAAdi an yathana Allahu liman yashao wayarda
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And how many angels there are in the heavens whose intercession will not avail at all except [only] after Allah has permitted [it] to whom He wills and approves.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Imagine˺ how many ˹noble˺ angels are in the heavens! ˹Even˺ their intercession would be of no benefit whatsoever, until Allah gives permission to whoever He wills and ˹only for the people He˺ approves.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ تَسۡمِيَةَ ٱلۡأُنثَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna allatheena la yuminoona bialakhirati layusammoona almalaikata tasmiyata alontha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter name the angels female names,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter label angels as female,

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنۡ عِلۡمٍۖ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّۖ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا يُغۡنِي مِنَ ٱلۡحَقِّ شَيۡـٔٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama lahum bihi min AAilmin in yattabiAAoona illa alththanna wainna alththanna la yughnee mina alhaqqi shayan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And they have thereof no knowledge. They follow not except assumption, and indeed, assumption avails not against the truth at all.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: although they have no knowledge ˹in support˺ of this. They follow nothing but ˹inherited˺ assumptions. And surely assumptions can in no way replace the truth.

ayahs.textArabic: فَأَعۡرِضۡ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكۡرِنَا وَلَمۡ يُرِدۡ إِلَّا ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا
