ayahs.textTransliteration: FaaAArid AAan man tawalla AAan thikrina walam yurid illa alhayata alddunya
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So turn away from whoever turns his back on Our message and desires not except the worldly life.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So turn away ˹O Prophet˺ from whoever has shunned Our Reminder, only seeking the ˹fleeting˺ life of this world.

ayahs.textArabic: ذَٰلِكَ مَبۡلَغُهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡعِلۡمِۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱهۡتَدَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thalika mablaghuhum mina alAAilmi inna rabbaka huwa aAAlamu biman dalla AAan sabeelihi wahuwa aAAlamu bimani ihtada
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: That is their sum of knowledge. Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who strays from His way, and He is most knowing of who is guided.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: This is the extent of their knowledge. Surely your Lord knows best who has strayed from His Way and who is ˹rightly˺ guided.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ لِيَجۡزِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَٰٓـُٔواْ بِمَا عَمِلُواْ وَيَجۡزِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحۡسَنُواْ بِٱلۡحُسۡنَى
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walillahi ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi liyajziya allatheena asaoo bima AAamiloo wayajziya allatheena ahsanoo bialhusna
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth - that He may recompense those who do evil with [the penalty of] what they have done and recompense those who do good with the best [reward] -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: To Allah ˹alone˺ belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth so that He may reward the evildoers according to what they did, and reward the good-doers with the finest reward—

ayahs.textArabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجۡتَنِبُونَ كَبَٰٓئِرَ ٱلۡإِثۡمِ وَٱلۡفَوَٰحِشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّمَمَۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ ٱلۡمَغۡفِرَةِۚ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِكُمۡ إِذۡ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَإِذۡ أَنتُمۡ أَجِنَّةٞ فِي بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمۡۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓاْ أَنفُسَكُمۡۖ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰٓ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Allatheena yajtaniboona kabaira alithmi waalfawahisha illa allamama inna rabbaka wasiAAu almaghfirati huwa aAAlamu bikum ith anshaakum mina alardi waith antum ajinnatun fee butooni ommahatikum fala tuzakkoo anfusakum huwa aAAlamu bimani ittaqa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, only [committing] slight ones. Indeed, your Lord is vast in forgiveness. He was most knowing of you when He produced you from the earth and when you were fetuses in the wombs of your mothers. So do not claim yourselves to be pure; He is most knowing of who fears Him.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: those who avoid major sins and shameful deeds, despite ˹stumbling on˺ minor sins. Surely your Lord is infinite in forgiveness. He knew well what would become of you as He created you from the earth and while you were ˹still˺ fetuses in the wombs of your mothers. So do not ˹falsely˺ elevate yourselves. He knows best who is ˹truly˺ righteous.

ayahs.textArabic: أَفَرَءَيۡتَ ٱلَّذِي تَوَلَّىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Afaraayta allathee tawalla
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Have you seen the one who turned away
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Have you seen the one who turned away ˹from Islam,˺

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَعۡطَىٰ قَلِيلٗا وَأَكۡدَىٰٓ
ayahs.textTransliteration: WaaAAta qaleelan waakda
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And gave a little and [then] refrained?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and ˹initially˺ paid a little ˹for his salvation˺, and then stopped?

ayahs.textArabic: أَعِندَهُۥ عِلۡمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ فَهُوَ يَرَىٰٓ
ayahs.textTransliteration: aAAindahu AAilmu alghaybi fahuwa yara
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Does he have knowledge of the unseen, so he sees?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Does he have the knowledge of the unseen so that he sees ˹the Hereafter˺?

ayahs.textArabic: أَمۡ لَمۡ يُنَبَّأۡ بِمَا فِي صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Am lam yunabba bima fee suhufi moosa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Or has he not been informed of what was in the scriptures of Moses
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Or has he not been informed of what is in the Scripture of Moses,

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِبۡرَٰهِيمَ ٱلَّذِي وَفَّىٰٓ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waibraheema allathee waffa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [of] Abraham, who fulfilled [his obligations] -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and ˹that of˺ Abraham, who ˹perfectly˺ fulfilled ˹his covenant˺?

ayahs.textArabic: أَلَّا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٞ وِزۡرَ أُخۡرَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Alla taziru waziratun wizra okhra
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: That no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹They state˺ that no soul burdened with sin will bear the burden of another,

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَن لَّيۡسَ لِلۡإِنسَٰنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waan laysa lilinsani illa ma saAAa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And that there is not for man except that [good] for which he strives
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and that each person will only have what they endeavoured towards,

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَنَّ سَعۡيَهُۥ سَوۡفَ يُرَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waanna saAAyahu sawfa yura
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And that his effort is going to be seen -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and that ˹the outcome of˺ their endeavours will be seen ˹in their record˺,

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ يُجۡزَىٰهُ ٱلۡجَزَآءَ ٱلۡأَوۡفَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thumma yujzahu aljazaa alawfa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then he will be recompensed for it with the fullest recompense
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: then they will be fully rewarded,

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡمُنتَهَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waanna ila rabbika almuntaha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And that to your Lord is the finality
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and that to your Lord ˹alone˺ is the ultimate return ˹of all things˺.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَضۡحَكَ وَأَبۡكَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waannahu huwa adhaka waabka
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And that it is He who makes [one] laugh and weep
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Moreover, He is the One Who brings about joy and sadness.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَمَاتَ وَأَحۡيَا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waannahu huwa amata waahya
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And that it is He who causes death and gives life
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And He is the One Who gives life and causes death.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ خَلَقَ ٱلزَّوۡجَيۡنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلۡأُنثَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waannahu khalaqa alzzawjayni alththakara waalontha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And that He creates the two mates - the male and female -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And He created the pairs—males and females—

ayahs.textArabic: مِن نُّطۡفَةٍ إِذَا تُمۡنَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Min nutfatin itha tumna
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: From a sperm-drop when it is emitted
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: from a sperm-drop when it is emitted.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَنَّ عَلَيۡهِ ٱلنَّشۡأَةَ ٱلۡأُخۡرَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waanna AAalayhi alnnashata alokhra
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And that [incumbent] upon Him is the next creation
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And it is upon Him to bring about re-creation.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَغۡنَىٰ وَأَقۡنَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waannahu huwa aghna waaqna
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And that it is He who enriches and suffices
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And He is the One Who enriches and impoverishes.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلشِّعۡرَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waannahu huwa rabbu alshshiAAra
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And that it is He who is the Lord of Sirius
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And He alone is the Lord of Sirius.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَنَّهُۥٓ أَهۡلَكَ عَادًا ٱلۡأُولَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waannahu ahlaka AAadan aloola
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And that He destroyed the first [people of] 'Aad
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And He destroyed the first ˹people of˺ ’Ȃd,

ayahs.textArabic: وَثَمُودَاْ فَمَآ أَبۡقَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wathamooda fama abqa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And Thamud - and He did not spare [them] -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and ˹then˺ Thamûd, sparing no one.

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَوۡمَ نُوحٖ مِّن قَبۡلُۖ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ هُمۡ أَظۡلَمَ وَأَطۡغَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waqawma noohin min qablu innahum kanoo hum athlama waatgha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the people of Noah before. Indeed, it was they who were [even] more unjust and oppressing.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And before ˹that He destroyed˺ the people of Noah, who were truly far worse in wrongdoing and transgression.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلۡمُؤۡتَفِكَةَ أَهۡوَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalmutafikata ahwa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the overturned towns He hurled down
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And ˹it was˺ He ˹Who˺ turned the cities ˹of Sodom and Gomorrah˺ upside down.

ayahs.textArabic: فَغَشَّىٰهَا مَا غَشَّىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faghashshaha ma ghashsha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And covered them by that which He covered.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: How overwhelming was what covered ˹them˺!

ayahs.textArabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكَ تَتَمَارَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbika tatamara
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then which of the favors of your Lord do you doubt?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Now, which of your Lord’s favours will you dispute?

ayahs.textArabic: هَٰذَا نَذِيرٞ مِّنَ ٱلنُّذُرِ ٱلۡأُولَىٰٓ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Hatha natheerun mina alnnuthuri aloola
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: This [Prophet] is a warner like the former warners.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: This ˹Prophet˺ is a warner like earlier ones.

ayahs.textArabic: أَزِفَتِ ٱلۡأٓزِفَةُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Azifati alazifatu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The Approaching Day has approached.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The approaching ˹Hour˺ has drawn near.

ayahs.textArabic: لَيۡسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Laysa laha min dooni Allahi kashifatun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Of it, [from those] besides Allah, there is no remover.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: None but Allah can disclose it.

ayahs.textArabic: أَفَمِنۡ هَٰذَا ٱلۡحَدِيثِ تَعۡجَبُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Afamin hatha alhadeethi taAAjaboona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then at this statement do you wonder?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Do you find this revelation astonishing,

ayahs.textArabic: وَتَضۡحَكُونَ وَلَا تَبۡكُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Watadhakoona wala tabkoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And you laugh and do not weep
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: laughing ˹at it˺ and not weeping ˹in awe˺,

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَنتُمۡ سَٰمِدُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waantum samidoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: While you are proudly sporting?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: while persisting in heedlessness?

ayahs.textArabic: فَٱسۡجُدُواْۤ لِلَّهِۤ وَٱعۡبُدُواْ۩
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faosjudoo lillahi waoAAbudoo
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So prostrate to Allah and worship [Him].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Instead, prostrate to Allah and worship ˹Him alone˺!

ayahs.textArabic: ٱقۡتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلۡقَمَرُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Iqtarabati alssaAAatu wainshaqqa alqamaru
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The Hour has come near, and the moon has split [in two].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The Hour has drawn near and the moon was split ˹in two˺.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِن يَرَوۡاْ ءَايَةٗ يُعۡرِضُواْ وَيَقُولُواْ سِحۡرٞ مُّسۡتَمِرّٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wain yaraw ayatan yuAAridoo wayaqooloo sihrun mustamirrun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And if they see a miracle, they turn away and say, "Passing magic."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Yet, whenever they see a sign, they turn away, saying, “Same old magic!”

ayahs.textArabic: وَكَذَّبُواْ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓاْ أَهۡوَآءَهُمۡۚ وَكُلُّ أَمۡرٖ مُّسۡتَقِرّٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wakaththaboo waittabaAAoo ahwaahum wakullu amrin mustaqirrun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And they denied and followed their inclinations. But for every matter is a [time of] settlement.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They rejected ˹the truth˺ and followed their own desires—and every matter will be settled—

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزۡدَجَرٌ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walaqad jaahum mina alanbai ma feehi muzdajarun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And there has already come to them of information that in which there is deterrence -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: even though the stories ˹of destroyed nations˺ that have already come to them are a sufficient deterrent.

ayahs.textArabic: حِكۡمَةُۢ بَٰلِغَةٞۖ فَمَا تُغۡنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Hikmatun balighatun fama tughnee alnnuthuru
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Extensive wisdom - but warning does not avail [them].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹This Quran is˺ profound ˹in˺ wisdom, but warnings are of no benefit ˹to them˺.

ayahs.textArabic: فَتَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡۘ يَوۡمَ يَدۡعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَيۡءٖ نُّكُرٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fatawalla AAanhum yawma yadAAu alddaAAi ila shayin nukurin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So leave them, [O Muhammad]. The Day the Caller calls to something forbidding,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So turn away from them ˹O Prophet˺. ˹And wait for˺ the Day ˹when˺ the caller will summon ˹them˺ for something horrifying.

ayahs.textArabic: خُشَّعًا أَبۡصَٰرُهُمۡ يَخۡرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡأَجۡدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمۡ جَرَادٞ مُّنتَشِرٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: KhushshaAAan absaruhum yakhrujoona mina alajdathi kaannahum jaradun muntashirun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Their eyes humbled, they will emerge from the graves as if they were locusts spreading,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: With eyes downcast, they will come forth from the graves as if they were swarming locusts,

ayahs.textArabic: مُّهۡطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِۖ يَقُولُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا يَوۡمٌ عَسِرٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: MuhtiAAeena ila alddaAAi yaqoolu alkafiroona hatha yawmun AAasirun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Racing ahead toward the Caller. The disbelievers will say, "This is a difficult Day."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: rushing towards the caller. The disbelievers will cry, “This is a difficult Day!”

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحٖ فَكَذَّبُواْ عَبۡدَنَا وَقَالُواْ مَجۡنُونٞ وَٱزۡدُجِرَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kaththabat qablahum qawmu noohin fakaththaboo AAabdana waqaloo majnoonun waizdujira
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The people of Noah denied before them, and they denied Our servant and said, "A madman," and he was repelled.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Before them, the people of Noah denied ˹the truth˺ and rejected Our servant, calling ˹him˺ insane. And he was intimidated.

ayahs.textArabic: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّي مَغۡلُوبٞ فَٱنتَصِرۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: FadaAAa rabbahu annee maghloobun faintasir
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So he invoked his Lord, "Indeed, I am overpowered, so help."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So he cried out to his Lord, “I am helpless, so help ˹me˺!”

ayahs.textArabic: فَفَتَحۡنَآ أَبۡوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٖ مُّنۡهَمِرٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fafatahna abwaba alssamai bimain munhamirin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then We opened the gates of the heaven with rain pouring down
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So We opened the gates of the sky with pouring rain,

ayahs.textArabic: وَفَجَّرۡنَا ٱلۡأَرۡضَ عُيُونٗا فَٱلۡتَقَى ٱلۡمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمۡرٖ قَدۡ قُدِرَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wafajjarna alarda AAuyoonan failtaqa almao AAala amrin qad qudira
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And caused the earth to burst with springs, and the waters met for a matter already predestined.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and caused the earth to burst with springs, so the waters met for a fate already set.

ayahs.textArabic: وَحَمَلۡنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلۡوَٰحٖ وَدُسُرٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wahamalnahu AAala thati alwahin wadusurin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We carried him on a [construction of] planks and nails,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We carried him on that ˹Ark made˺ of planks and nails,

ayahs.textArabic: تَجۡرِي بِأَعۡيُنِنَا جَزَآءٗ لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Tajree biaAAyunina jazaan liman kana kufira
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Sailing under Our observation as reward for he who had been denied.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: sailing under Our ˹watchful˺ Eyes—a ˹fair˺ punishment on behalf of the one ˹they˺ denied.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَد تَّرَكۡنَٰهَآ ءَايَةٗ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walaqad taraknaha ayatan fahal min muddakirin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We left it as a sign, so is there any who will remember?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We certainly left this as a sign. So is there anyone who will be mindful?

ayahs.textArabic: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fakayfa kana AAathabee wanuthuri
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then how ˹dreadful˺ were My punishment and warnings!

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walaqad yassarna alqurana lilththikri fahal min muddakirin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful?

ayahs.textArabic: كَذَّبَتۡ عَادٞ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kaththabat AAadun fakayfa kana AAathabee wanuthuri
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: 'Aad denied; and how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ’Ȃd ˹also˺ rejected ˹the truth˺. Then how ˹dreadful˺ were My punishment and warnings!

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ رِيحٗا صَرۡصَرٗا فِي يَوۡمِ نَحۡسٖ مُّسۡتَمِرّٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna arsalna AAalayhim reehan sarsaran fee yawmi nahsin mustamirrin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, We sent upon them a screaming wind on a day of continuous misfortune,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, We sent against them a furious wind, on a day of unrelenting misery,

ayahs.textArabic: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمۡ أَعۡجَازُ نَخۡلٖ مُّنقَعِرٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: TanziAAu alnnasa kaannahum aAAjazu nakhlin munqaAAirin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Extracting the people as if they were trunks of palm trees uprooted.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: that snatched people up, leaving them like trunks of uprooted palm trees.

ayahs.textArabic: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fakayfa kana AAathabee wanuthuri
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then how ˹dreadful˺ were My punishment and warnings!

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walaqad yassarna alqurana lilththikri fahal min muddakirin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful?

ayahs.textArabic: كَذَّبَتۡ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kaththabat thamoodu bialnnuthuri
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Thamud denied the warning
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Thamûd rejected the warnings ˹as well˺,

ayahs.textArabic: فَقَالُوٓاْ أَبَشَرٗا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدٗا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذٗا لَّفِي ضَلَٰلٖ وَسُعُرٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faqaloo abasharan minna wahidan nattabiAAuhu inna ithan lafee dalalin wasuAAurin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And said, "Is it one human being among us that we should follow? Indeed, we would then be in error and madness.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: arguing, “How can we follow one ˹average˺ human being from among us? We would then truly be misguided and insane.

ayahs.textArabic: أَءُلۡقِيَ ٱلذِّكۡرُ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۢ بَيۡنِنَا بَلۡ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Aolqiya alththikru AAalayhi min baynina bal huwa kaththabun ashirun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Has the message been sent down upon him from among us? Rather, he is an insolent liar."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Has the revelation been sent down ˹only˺ to him out of ˹all of˺ us? In fact, he is a boastful liar.”

ayahs.textArabic: سَيَعۡلَمُونَ غَدٗا مَّنِ ٱلۡكَذَّابُ ٱلۡأَشِرُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: SayaAAlamoona ghadan mani alkaththabu alashiru
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They will know tomorrow who is the insolent liar.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹It was revealed to Ṣâliḥ,˺ “They will soon know who the boastful liar is.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّا مُرۡسِلُواْ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتۡنَةٗ لَّهُمۡ فَٱرۡتَقِبۡهُمۡ وَٱصۡطَبِرۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna mursiloo alnnaqati fitnatan lahum fairtaqibhum waistabir
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, We are sending the she-camel as trial for them, so watch them and be patient.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We are sending the she-camel as a test for them. So watch them ˹closely˺, and have patience.

ayahs.textArabic: وَنَبِّئۡهُمۡ أَنَّ ٱلۡمَآءَ قِسۡمَةُۢ بَيۡنَهُمۡۖ كُلُّ شِرۡبٖ مُّحۡتَضَرٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wanabbihum anna almaa qismatun baynahum kullu shirbin muhtadarun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And inform them that the water is shared between them, each [day of] drink attended [by turn].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And tell them that the ˹drinking˺ water must be divided between them ˹and her˺, each taking a turn to drink ˹every other day˺.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَنَادَوۡاْ صَاحِبَهُمۡ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fanadaw sahibahum fataAAata faAAaqara
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But they called their companion, and he dared and hamstrung [her].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But they roused a companion of theirs, so he dared to kill ˹her˺.

ayahs.textArabic: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fakayfa kana AAathabee wanuthuri
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then how ˹dreadful˺ were My punishment and warnings!

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ صَيۡحَةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ فَكَانُواْ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلۡمُحۡتَظِرِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna arsalna AAalayhim sayhatan wahidatan fakanoo kahasheemi almuhtathiri
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, We sent upon them one blast from the sky, and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, We sent against them ˹only˺ one ˹mighty˺ blast, leaving them like the twigs of fence-builders.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walaqad yassarna alqurana lilththikri fahal min muddakirin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful?

ayahs.textArabic: كَذَّبَتۡ قَوۡمُ لُوطِۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kaththabat qawmu lootin bialnnuthuri
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The people of Lot denied the warning.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The people of Lot ˹also˺ rejected the warnings.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٖۖ نَّجَّيۡنَٰهُم بِسَحَرٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna arsalna AAalayhim hasiban illa ala lootin najjaynahum bisaharin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, We sent upon them a storm of stones, except the family of Lot - We saved them before dawn
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We unleashed upon them a storm of stones. As for ˹the believers of˺ Lot’s family, We delivered them before dawn

ayahs.textArabic: نِّعۡمَةٗ مِّنۡ عِندِنَاۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي مَن شَكَرَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: NiAAmatan min AAindina kathalika najzee man shakara
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: As favor from us. Thus do We reward he who is grateful.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: as a blessing from Us. This is how We reward whoever gives thanks.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَنذَرَهُم بَطۡشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوۡاْ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walaqad antharahum batshatana fatamaraw bialnnuthuri
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And he had already warned them of Our assault, but they disputed the warning.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He had already warned them of Our ˹crushing˺ blow but they disputed the warnings.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدۡ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيۡفِهِۦ فَطَمَسۡنَآ أَعۡيُنَهُمۡ فَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walaqad rawadoohu AAan dayfihi fatamasna aAAyunahum fathooqoo AAathabee wanuthuri
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And they had demanded from him his guests, but We obliterated their eyes, [saying], "Taste My punishment and warning."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And they even demanded his angel-guests from him, so We blinded their eyes. ˹And they were told,˺ “Taste then My punishment and warnings!”

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدۡ صَبَّحَهُم بُكۡرَةً عَذَابٞ مُّسۡتَقِرّٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walaqad sabbahahum bukratan AAathabun mustaqirrun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And there came upon them by morning an abiding punishment.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And indeed, by the early morning they were overwhelmed by an unrelenting torment.

ayahs.textArabic: فَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fathooqoo AAathabee wanuthuri
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So taste My punishment and warning.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Again they were told,˺ “Taste now My punishment and warnings!”

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walaqad yassarna alqurana lilththikri fahal min muddakirin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful?

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walaqad jaa ala firAAawna alnnuthuru
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And there certainly came to the people of Pharaoh warning.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And indeed, the warnings ˹also˺ came to the people of Pharaoh.

ayahs.textArabic: كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذۡنَٰهُمۡ أَخۡذَ عَزِيزٖ مُّقۡتَدِرٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kaththaboo biayatina kulliha faakhathnahum akhtha AAazeezin muqtadirin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They denied Our signs, all of them, so We seized them with a seizure of one Exalted in Might and Perfect in Ability.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹But˺ they rejected all of Our signs, so We seized them with the ˹crushing˺ grip of the Almighty, Most Powerful.

ayahs.textArabic: أَكُفَّارُكُمۡ خَيۡرٞ مِّنۡ أُوْلَٰٓئِكُمۡ أَمۡ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٞ فِي ٱلزُّبُرِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Akuffarukum khayrun min olaikum am lakum baraatun fee alzzuburi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Are your disbelievers better than those [former ones], or have you immunity in the scripture?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Now, are you ˹Meccan˺ disbelievers superior to those ˹destroyed peoples˺? Or have you ˹been granted˺ immunity ˹from punishment˺ in divine Books?

ayahs.textArabic: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ نَحۡنُ جَمِيعٞ مُّنتَصِرٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Am yaqooloona nahnu jameeAAun muntasirun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Or do they say, "We are an assembly supporting [each other]"?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Or do they say, “We are all ˹a˺ united ˹front˺, bound to prevail.”?

ayahs.textArabic: سَيُهۡزَمُ ٱلۡجَمۡعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Sayuhzamu aljamAAu wayuwalloona alddubura
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Their] assembly will be defeated, and they will turn their backs [in retreat].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Soon˺ their united front will be defeated and ˹forced to˺ flee.

ayahs.textArabic: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوۡعِدُهُمۡ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدۡهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Bali alssaAAatu mawAAiduhum waalssaAAatu adha waamarru
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But the Hour is their appointment [for due punishment], and the Hour is more disastrous and more bitter.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Better yet, the Hour is their appointed time—and the Hour will be most catastrophic and most bitter.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ وَسُعُرٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna almujrimeena fee dalalin wasuAAurin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, the criminals are in error and madness.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, the wicked are ˹entrenched˺ in misguidance, and ˹are bound for˺ blazes.

ayahs.textArabic: يَوۡمَ يُسۡحَبُونَ فِي ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمۡ ذُوقُواْ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yawma yushaboona fee alnnari AAala wujoohihim thooqoo massa saqara
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The Day they are dragged into the Fire on their faces [it will be said], "Taste the touch of Saqar."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: On the Day they will be dragged into the Fire on their faces, ˹they will be told,˺ “Taste the touch of Hell!”

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ خَلَقۡنَٰهُ بِقَدَرٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna kulla shayin khalaqnahu biqadarin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, all things We created with predestination.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, We have created everything, perfectly preordained.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَآ أَمۡرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٞ كَلَمۡحِۭ بِٱلۡبَصَرِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama amruna illa wahidatun kalamhin bialbasari
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And Our command is but one, like a glance of the eye.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Our command is but a single word, done in the blink of an eye.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَآ أَشۡيَاعَكُمۡ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walaqad ahlakna ashyaAAakum fahal min muddakirin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We have already destroyed your kinds, so is there any who will remember?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We have already destroyed the likes of you. So will any ˹of you˺ be mindful?

ayahs.textArabic: وَكُلُّ شَيۡءٖ فَعَلُوهُ فِي ٱلزُّبُرِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wakullu shayin faAAaloohu fee alzzuburi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And everything they did is in written records.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Everything they have done is ˹listed˺ in ˹their˺ records.

ayahs.textArabic: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٖ وَكَبِيرٖ مُّسۡتَطَرٌ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wakullu sagheerin wakabeerin mustatarun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And every small and great [thing] is inscribed.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Every matter, small and large, is written ˹precisely˺.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّٰتٖ وَنَهَرٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna almuttaqeena fee jannatin wanaharin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and rivers,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, the righteous will be amid Gardens and rivers,

ayahs.textArabic: فِي مَقۡعَدِ صِدۡقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٖ مُّقۡتَدِرِۭ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fee maqAAadi sidqin AAinda maleekin muqtadirin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: In a seat of honor near a Sovereign, Perfect in Ability.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: at the Seat of Honour in the presence of the Most Powerful Sovereign.

ayahs.textArabic: ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Alrrahmanu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The Most Merciful
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The Most Compassionate

ayahs.textArabic: عَلَّمَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: AAallama alqurana
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Taught the Qur'an,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: taught the Quran,

ayahs.textArabic: خَلَقَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Khalaqa alinsana
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Created man,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: created humanity,

ayahs.textArabic: عَلَّمَهُ ٱلۡبَيَانَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: AAallamahu albayana
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [And] taught him eloquence.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹and˺ taught them speech.

ayahs.textArabic: ٱلشَّمۡسُ وَٱلۡقَمَرُ بِحُسۡبَانٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Alshshamsu waalqamaru bihusbanin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The sun and the moon [move] by precise calculation,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The sun and the moon ˹travel˺ with precision.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلنَّجۡمُ وَٱلشَّجَرُ يَسۡجُدَانِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalnnajmu waalshshajaru yasjudani
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the stars and trees prostrate.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The stars and the trees bow down ˹in submission˺.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ رَفَعَهَا وَوَضَعَ ٱلۡمِيزَانَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalssamaa rafaAAaha wawadaAAa almeezana
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the heaven He raised and imposed the balance
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: As for the sky, He raised it ˹high˺, and set the balance ˹of justice˺

ayahs.textArabic: أَلَّا تَطۡغَوۡاْ فِي ٱلۡمِيزَانِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Alla tatghaw fee almeezani
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: That you not transgress within the balance.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: so that you do not defraud the scales.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلۡوَزۡنَ بِٱلۡقِسۡطِ وَلَا تُخۡسِرُواْ ٱلۡمِيزَانَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waaqeemoo alwazna bialqisti wala tukhsiroo almeezana
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And establish weight in justice and do not make deficient the balance.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Weigh with justice, and do not give short measure.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَضَعَهَا لِلۡأَنَامِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalarda wadaAAaha lilanami
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the earth He laid [out] for the creatures.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He laid out the earth for all beings.

ayahs.textArabic: فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٞ وَٱلنَّخۡلُ ذَاتُ ٱلۡأَكۡمَامِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Feeha fakihatun waalnnakhlu thatu alakmami
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Therein is fruit and palm trees having sheaths [of dates]
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: In it are fruit, palm trees with date stalks,

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلۡحَبُّ ذُو ٱلۡعَصۡفِ وَٱلرَّيۡحَانُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalhabbu thoo alAAasfi waalrrayhani
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And grain having husks and scented plants.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and grain with husks, and aromatic plants.

ayahs.textArabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you ˹humans and jinn˺ both deny?

ayahs.textArabic: خَلَقَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِن صَلۡصَٰلٖ كَٱلۡفَخَّارِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Khalaqa alinsana min salsalin kaalfakhkhari
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He created man from clay like [that of] pottery.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He created humankind from ˹sounding˺ clay like pottery,

ayahs.textArabic: وَخَلَقَ ٱلۡجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجٖ مِّن نَّارٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wakhalaqa aljanna min marijin min narin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And He created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and created jinn from a ˹smokeless˺ flame of fire.

ayahs.textArabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

ayahs.textArabic: رَبُّ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقَيۡنِ وَرَبُّ ٱلۡمَغۡرِبَيۡنِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Rabbu almashriqayni warabbu almaghribayni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [He is] Lord of the two sunrises and Lord of the two sunsets.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹He is˺ Lord of the two easts and the two wests.

ayahs.textArabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

ayahs.textArabic: مَرَجَ ٱلۡبَحۡرَيۡنِ يَلۡتَقِيَانِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Maraja albahrayni yaltaqiyani
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He released the two seas, meeting [side by side];
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He merges the two bodies of ˹fresh and salt˺ water,

ayahs.textArabic: بَيۡنَهُمَا بَرۡزَخٞ لَّا يَبۡغِيَانِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Baynahuma barzakhun la yabghiyani
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Between them is a barrier [so] neither of them transgresses.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: yet between them is a barrier they never cross.

ayahs.textArabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

ayahs.textArabic: يَخۡرُجُ مِنۡهُمَا ٱللُّؤۡلُؤُ وَٱلۡمَرۡجَانُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yakhruju minhuma alluluo waalmarjanu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: From both of them emerge pearl and coral.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Out of both ˹waters˺ come forth pearls and coral.

ayahs.textArabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَهُ ٱلۡجَوَارِ ٱلۡمُنشَـَٔاتُ فِي ٱلۡبَحۡرِ كَٱلۡأَعۡلَٰمِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walahu aljawari almunshaatu fee albahri kaalaAAlami
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And to Him belong the ships [with sails] elevated in the sea like mountains.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: To Him belong the ships with raised sails, sailing through the seas like mountains.

ayahs.textArabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

ayahs.textArabic: كُلُّ مَنۡ عَلَيۡهَا فَانٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kullu man AAalayha fanin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Everyone upon the earth will perish,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Every being on earth is bound to perish.

ayahs.textArabic: وَيَبۡقَىٰ وَجۡهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو ٱلۡجَلَٰلِ وَٱلۡإِكۡرَامِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wayabqa wajhu rabbika thoo aljalali waalikrami
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And there will remain the Face of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Only your Lord Himself, full of Majesty and Honour, will remain ˹forever˺.

ayahs.textArabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

ayahs.textArabic: يَسۡـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ كُلَّ يَوۡمٍ هُوَ فِي شَأۡنٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yasaluhu man fee alssamawati waalardi kulla yawmin huwa fee shanin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Whoever is within the heavens and earth asks Him; every day He is bringing about a matter.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: All those in the heavens and the earth are dependent on Him. Day in and day out He has something to bring about.

ayahs.textArabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

ayahs.textArabic: سَنَفۡرُغُ لَكُمۡ أَيُّهَ ٱلثَّقَلَانِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Sanafrughu lakum ayyuha alththaqalani
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: We will attend to you, O prominent beings.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We will soon attend to you ˹for judgment˺, O two multitudes ˹of jinn and humans˺!

ayahs.textArabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

ayahs.textArabic: يَٰمَعۡشَرَ ٱلۡجِنِّ وَٱلۡإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسۡتَطَعۡتُمۡ أَن تَنفُذُواْ مِنۡ أَقۡطَارِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَٱنفُذُواْۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلۡطَٰنٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ya maAAshara aljinni waalinsi ini istataAAtum an tanfuthoo min aqtari alssamawati waalardi faonfuthoo la tanfuthoona illa bisultanin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: O company of jinn and mankind, if you are able to pass beyond the regions of the heavens and the earth, then pass. You will not pass except by authority [from Allah].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: O assembly of jinn and humans! If you can penetrate beyond the realms of the heavens and the earth, then do so. ˹But˺ you cannot do that without ˹Our˺ authority.

ayahs.textArabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

ayahs.textArabic: يُرۡسَلُ عَلَيۡكُمَا شُوَاظٞ مِّن نَّارٖ وَنُحَاسٞ فَلَا تَنتَصِرَانِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yursalu AAalaykuma shuwathun min narin wanuhasun fala tantasirani
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: There will be sent upon you a flame of fire and smoke, and you will not defend yourselves.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Flames of fire and ˹molten˺ copper will be sent against you, and you will not be able to defend one another.

ayahs.textArabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

ayahs.textArabic: فَإِذَا ٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتۡ وَرۡدَةٗ كَٱلدِّهَانِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faitha inshaqqati alssamao fakanat wardatan kaalddihani
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when the heaven is split open and becomes rose-colored like oil -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹How horrible will it be˺ when the heavens will split apart, becoming rose-red like ˹burnt˺ oil!

ayahs.textArabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

ayahs.textArabic: فَيَوۡمَئِذٖ لَّا يُسۡـَٔلُ عَن ذَنۢبِهِۦٓ إِنسٞ وَلَا جَآنّٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fayawmaithin la yusalu AAan thanbihi insun wala jannun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then on that Day none will be asked about his sin among men or jinn.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: On that Day there will be no need for any human or jinn to be asked about their sins.

ayahs.textArabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

ayahs.textArabic: يُعۡرَفُ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ بِسِيمَٰهُمۡ فَيُؤۡخَذُ بِٱلنَّوَٰصِي وَٱلۡأَقۡدَامِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: YuAArafu almujrimoona biseemahum fayukhathu bialnnawasee waalaqdami
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The criminals will be known by their marks, and they will be seized by the forelocks and the feet.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The wicked will be recognized by their appearance, then will be seized by ˹their˺ forelocks and feet.

ayahs.textArabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

ayahs.textArabic: هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِي يُكَذِّبُ بِهَا ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Hathihi jahannamu allatee yukaththibu biha almujrimoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: This is Hell, which the criminals deny.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹They will be told,˺ “This is the Hell which the wicked denied.”

ayahs.textArabic: يَطُوفُونَ بَيۡنَهَا وَبَيۡنَ حَمِيمٍ ءَانٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yatoofoona baynaha wabayna hameemin anin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They will go around between it and scalding water, heated [to the utmost degree].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They will alternate between its flames and scalding water.

ayahs.textArabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

ayahs.textArabic: وَلِمَنۡ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ جَنَّتَانِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waliman khafa maqama rabbihi jannatani
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But for he who has feared the position of his Lord are two gardens -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And whoever is in awe of standing before their Lord will have two Gardens.

ayahs.textArabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

ayahs.textArabic: ذَوَاتَآ أَفۡنَانٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thawata afnanin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Having [spreading] branches.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Both will be˺ with lush branches.

ayahs.textArabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

ayahs.textArabic: فِيهِمَا عَيۡنَانِ تَجۡرِيَانِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Feehima AAaynani tajriyani
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: In both of them are two springs, flowing.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: In each ˹Garden˺ will be two flowing springs.

ayahs.textArabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

ayahs.textArabic: فِيهِمَا مِن كُلِّ فَٰكِهَةٖ زَوۡجَانِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Feehima min kulli fakihatin zawjani
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: In both of them are of every fruit, two kinds.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: In each will be two types of every fruit.

ayahs.textArabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

ayahs.textArabic: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ فُرُشِۭ بَطَآئِنُهَا مِنۡ إِسۡتَبۡرَقٖۚ وَجَنَى ٱلۡجَنَّتَيۡنِ دَانٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Muttakieena AAala furushin batainuha min istabraqin wajana aljannatayni danin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [They are] reclining on beds whose linings are of silk brocade, and the fruit of the two gardens is hanging low.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Those ˹believers˺ will recline on furnishings lined with rich brocade. And the fruit of both Gardens will hang within reach.

ayahs.textArabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

ayahs.textArabic: فِيهِنَّ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرۡفِ لَمۡ يَطۡمِثۡهُنَّ إِنسٞ قَبۡلَهُمۡ وَلَا جَآنّٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Feehinna qasiratu alttarfi lam yatmithhunna insun qablahum wala jannun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: In them are women limiting [their] glances, untouched before them by man or jinni -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: In both ˹Gardens˺ will be maidens of modest gaze, who no human or jinn has ever touched before.

ayahs.textArabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

ayahs.textArabic: كَأَنَّهُنَّ ٱلۡيَاقُوتُ وَٱلۡمَرۡجَانُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kaannahunna alyaqootu waalmarjanu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: As if they were rubies and coral.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Those ˹maidens˺ will be ˹as elegant˺ as rubies and coral.

ayahs.textArabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

ayahs.textArabic: هَلۡ جَزَآءُ ٱلۡإِحۡسَٰنِ إِلَّا ٱلۡإِحۡسَٰنُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Hal jazao alihsani illa alihsanu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Is the reward for good [anything] but good?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Is there any reward for goodness except goodness?

ayahs.textArabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

ayahs.textArabic: وَمِن دُونِهِمَا جَنَّتَانِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wamin doonihima jannatani
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And below them both [in excellence] are two [other] gardens -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And below these two ˹Gardens˺ will be two others.

ayahs.textArabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

ayahs.textArabic: مُدۡهَآمَّتَانِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Mudhammatani
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Dark green [in color].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Both will be dark green.

ayahs.textArabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

ayahs.textArabic: فِيهِمَا عَيۡنَانِ نَضَّاخَتَانِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Feehima AAaynani naddakhatani
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: In both of them are two springs, spouting.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: In each will be two gushing springs.

ayahs.textArabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

ayahs.textArabic: فِيهِمَا فَٰكِهَةٞ وَنَخۡلٞ وَرُمَّانٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Feehima fakihatun wanakhlun warummanun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: In both of them are fruit and palm trees and pomegranates.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: In both will be fruit, palm trees, and pomegranates.

ayahs.textArabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

ayahs.textArabic: فِيهِنَّ خَيۡرَٰتٌ حِسَانٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Feehinna khayratun hisanun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: In them are good and beautiful women -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: In all Gardens will be noble, pleasant mates.

ayahs.textArabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

ayahs.textArabic: حُورٞ مَّقۡصُورَٰتٞ فِي ٱلۡخِيَامِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Hoorun maqsooratun fee alkhiyami
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Fair ones reserved in pavilions -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹They will be˺ maidens with gorgeous eyes, reserved in pavilions.

ayahs.textArabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

ayahs.textArabic: لَمۡ يَطۡمِثۡهُنَّ إِنسٞ قَبۡلَهُمۡ وَلَا جَآنّٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Lam yatmithhunna insun qablahum wala jannun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Untouched before them by man or jinni -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: No human or jinn has ever touched these ˹maidens˺ before.

ayahs.textArabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

ayahs.textArabic: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ رَفۡرَفٍ خُضۡرٖ وَعَبۡقَرِيٍّ حِسَانٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Muttakieena AAala rafrafin khudrin waAAabqariyyin hisanin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Reclining on green cushions and beautiful fine carpets.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: All ˹believers˺ will be reclining on green cushions and splendid carpets.

ayahs.textArabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?

ayahs.textArabic: تَبَٰرَكَ ٱسۡمُ رَبِّكَ ذِي ٱلۡجَلَٰلِ وَٱلۡإِكۡرَامِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Tabaraka ismu rabbika thee aljalali waalikrami
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Blessed is the name of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Blessed is the Name of your Lord, full of Majesty and Honour.

ayahs.textArabic: إِذَا وَقَعَتِ ٱلۡوَاقِعَةُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Itha waqaAAati alwaqiAAatu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: When the Occurrence occurs,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: When the Inevitable Event takes place,

ayahs.textArabic: لَيۡسَ لِوَقۡعَتِهَا كَاذِبَةٌ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Laysa liwaqAAatiha kathibatun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: There is, at its occurrence, no denial.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: then no one can deny it has come.

ayahs.textArabic: خَافِضَةٞ رَّافِعَةٌ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Khafidatun rafiAAatun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: It will bring down [some] and raise up [others].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: It will debase ˹some˺ and elevate ˹others˺.

ayahs.textArabic: إِذَا رُجَّتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ رَجّٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Itha rujjati alardu rajjan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: When the earth is shaken with convulsion
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: When the earth will be violently shaken,

ayahs.textArabic: وَبُسَّتِ ٱلۡجِبَالُ بَسّٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wabussati aljibalu bassan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the mountains are broken down, crumbling
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and the mountains will be crushed to pieces,

ayahs.textArabic: فَكَانَتۡ هَبَآءٗ مُّنۢبَثّٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fakanat habaan munbaththan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And become dust dispersing.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: becoming scattered ˹particles of˺ dust,

ayahs.textArabic: وَكُنتُمۡ أَزۡوَٰجٗا ثَلَٰثَةٗ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wakuntum azwajan thalathatan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And you become [of] three kinds:
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: you will ˹all˺ be ˹divided into˺ three groups:

ayahs.textArabic: فَأَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَيۡمَنَةِ مَآ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَيۡمَنَةِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faashabu almaymanati ma ashabu almaymanati
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then the companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: the people of the right, how ˹blessed˺ will they be;

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَشۡـَٔمَةِ مَآ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَشۡـَٔمَةِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waashabu almashamati ma ashabu almashamati
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: the people of the left, how ˹miserable˺ will they be;

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلسَّٰبِقُونَ ٱلسَّٰبِقُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalssabiqoona alssabiqoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the forerunners, the forerunners -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and the foremost ˹in faith˺ will be the foremost ˹in Paradise˺.

ayahs.textArabic: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلۡمُقَرَّبُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Olaika almuqarraboona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Those are the ones brought near [to Allah]
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They are the ones nearest ˹to Allah˺,

ayahs.textArabic: فِي جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fee jannati alnnaAAeemi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: In the Gardens of Pleasure,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: in the Gardens of Bliss.

ayahs.textArabic: ثُلَّةٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thullatun mina alawwaleena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: A [large] company of the former peoples
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹They will be˺ a multitude from earlier generations

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَلِيلٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waqaleelun mina alakhireena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And a few of the later peoples,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and a few from later generations.

ayahs.textArabic: عَلَىٰ سُرُرٖ مَّوۡضُونَةٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: AAala sururin mawdoonatin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: On thrones woven [with ornament],
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹All will be˺ on jewelled thrones,

ayahs.textArabic: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَيۡهَا مُتَقَٰبِلِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Muttakieena AAalayha mutaqabileena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Reclining on them, facing each other.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: reclining face to face.

ayahs.textArabic: يَطُوفُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وِلۡدَٰنٞ مُّخَلَّدُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yatoofu AAalayhim wildanun mukhalladoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They will be waited on by eternal youths

ayahs.textArabic: بِأَكۡوَابٖ وَأَبَارِيقَ وَكَأۡسٖ مِّن مَّعِينٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Biakwabin waabareeqa wakasin min maAAeenin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: With vessels, pitchers and a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: with cups, pitchers, and a drink ˹of pure wine˺ from a flowing stream,

ayahs.textArabic: لَّا يُصَدَّعُونَ عَنۡهَا وَلَا يُنزِفُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: La yusaddaAAoona AAanha wala yunzifoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: No headache will they have therefrom, nor will they be intoxicated -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: that will cause them neither headache nor intoxication.

ayahs.textArabic: وَفَٰكِهَةٖ مِّمَّا يَتَخَيَّرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wafakihatin mimma yatakhayyaroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And fruit of what they select
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹They will also be served˺ any fruit they choose

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَحۡمِ طَيۡرٖ مِّمَّا يَشۡتَهُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walahmi tayrin mimma yashtahoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the meat of fowl, from whatever they desire.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and meat from any bird they desire.

ayahs.textArabic: وَحُورٌ عِينٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wahoorun AAeenun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [for them are] fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And ˹they will have˺ maidens with gorgeous eyes,

ayahs.textArabic: كَأَمۡثَٰلِ ٱللُّؤۡلُوِٕ ٱلۡمَكۡنُونِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kaamthali allului almaknooni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The likenesses of pearls well-protected,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: like pristine pearls,

ayahs.textArabic: جَزَآءَۢ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Jazaan bima kanoo yaAAmaloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: As reward for what they used to do.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹all˺ as a reward for what they used to do.

ayahs.textArabic: لَا يَسۡمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغۡوٗا وَلَا تَأۡثِيمًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: La yasmaAAoona feeha laghwan wala tatheeman
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They will not hear therein ill speech or commission of sin -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: There they will never hear any idle or sinful talk—

ayahs.textArabic: إِلَّا قِيلٗا سَلَٰمٗا سَلَٰمٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Illa qeelan salaman salaman
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Only a saying: "Peace, peace."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: only good and virtuous speech.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡيَمِينِ مَآ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡيَمِينِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waashabu alyameeni ma ashabu alyameeni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And the people of the right—how ˹blessed˺ will they be!

ayahs.textArabic: فِي سِدۡرٖ مَّخۡضُودٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fee sidrin makhdoodin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [They will be] among lote trees with thorns removed
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹They will be˺ amid thornless lote trees,

ayahs.textArabic: وَطَلۡحٖ مَّنضُودٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Watalhin mandoodin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [banana] trees layered [with fruit]
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: clusters of bananas,

ayahs.textArabic: وَظِلّٖ مَّمۡدُودٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wathillin mamdoodin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And shade extended
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: extended shade,

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَآءٖ مَّسۡكُوبٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wamain maskoobin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And water poured out
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: flowing water,

ayahs.textArabic: وَفَٰكِهَةٖ كَثِيرَةٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wafakihatin katheeratin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And fruit, abundant [and varied],
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: abundant fruit—

ayahs.textArabic: لَّا مَقۡطُوعَةٖ وَلَا مَمۡنُوعَةٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: La maqtooAAatin wala mamnooAAatin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Neither limited [to season] nor forbidden,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: never out of season nor forbidden—

ayahs.textArabic: وَفُرُشٖ مَّرۡفُوعَةٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wafurushin marfooAAatin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [upon] beds raised high.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and elevated furnishings.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّآ أَنشَأۡنَٰهُنَّ إِنشَآءٗ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna anshanahunna inshaan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, We have produced the women of Paradise in a [new] creation
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, We will have perfectly created their mates,

ayahs.textArabic: فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُنَّ أَبۡكَارًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: FajaAAalnahunna abkaran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And made them virgins,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: making them virgins,

ayahs.textArabic: عُرُبًا أَتۡرَابٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: AAuruban atraban
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Devoted [to their husbands] and of equal age,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: loving and of equal age,

ayahs.textArabic: لِّأَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلۡيَمِينِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Liashabi alyameeni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: For the companions of the right [who are]
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: for the people of the right,

ayahs.textArabic: ثُلَّةٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thullatun mina alawwaleena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: A company of the former peoples
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹who will be˺ a multitude from earlier generations

ayahs.textArabic: وَثُلَّةٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wathullatun mina alakhireena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And a company of the later peoples.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and a multitude from later generations.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلشِّمَالِ مَآ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلشِّمَالِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waashabu alshshimali ma ashabu alshshimali
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And the people of the left—how ˹miserable˺ will they be!

ayahs.textArabic: فِي سَمُومٖ وَحَمِيمٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fee samoomin wahameemin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [They will be] in scorching fire and scalding water
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹They will be˺ in scorching heat and boiling water,

ayahs.textArabic: وَظِلّٖ مِّن يَحۡمُومٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wathillin min yahmoomin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And a shade of black smoke,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: in the shade of black smoke,

ayahs.textArabic: لَّا بَارِدٖ وَلَا كَرِيمٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: La baridin wala kareemin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Neither cool nor beneficial.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: neither cool nor refreshing.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَبۡلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُتۡرَفِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innahum kanoo qabla thalika mutrafeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed they were, before that, indulging in affluence,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, before this ˹torment˺ they were spoiled by luxury,

ayahs.textArabic: وَكَانُواْ يُصِرُّونَ عَلَى ٱلۡحِنثِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wakanoo yusirroona AAala alhinthi alAAatheemi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And they used to persist in the great violation,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and persisted in the worst of sin.

ayahs.textArabic: وَكَانُواْ يَقُولُونَ أَئِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابٗا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبۡعُوثُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wakanoo yaqooloona aitha mitna wakunna turaban waAAithaman ainna lamabAAoothoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And they used to say, "When we die and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They used to ask ˹mockingly˺, “When we are dead and reduced to dust and bones, will we really be resurrected?

ayahs.textArabic: أَوَءَابَآؤُنَا ٱلۡأَوَّلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Awa abaona alawwaloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And our forefathers [as well]?"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And our forefathers as well?”

ayahs.textArabic: قُلۡ إِنَّ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ وَٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qul inna alawwaleena waalakhireena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Say, [O Muhammad], "Indeed, the former and the later peoples
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Most certainly, earlier and later generations

ayahs.textArabic: لَمَجۡمُوعُونَ إِلَىٰ مِيقَٰتِ يَوۡمٖ مَّعۡلُومٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: LamajmooAAoona ila meeqati yawmin maAAloomin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Are to be gathered together for the appointment of a known Day."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: will surely be gathered ˹together˺ for the appointed Day.

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمۡ أَيُّهَا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ ٱلۡمُكَذِّبُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thumma innakum ayyuha alddalloona almukaththiboona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then indeed you, O those astray [who are] deniers,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then you, O misguided deniers,

ayahs.textArabic: لَأٓكِلُونَ مِن شَجَرٖ مِّن زَقُّومٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Laakiloona min shajarin min zaqqoomin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Will be eating from trees of zaqqum
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: will certainly eat from ˹the fruit of˺ the trees of Zaqqûm,

ayahs.textArabic: فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنۡهَا ٱلۡبُطُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Famalioona minha albutoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And filling with it your bellies
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: filling up ˹your˺ bellies with it.

ayahs.textArabic: فَشَٰرِبُونَ عَلَيۡهِ مِنَ ٱلۡحَمِيمِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fashariboona AAalayhi mina alhameemi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And drinking on top of it from scalding water
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then on top of that you will drink boiling water—

ayahs.textArabic: فَشَٰرِبُونَ شُرۡبَ ٱلۡهِيمِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fashariboona shurba alheemi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And will drink as the drinking of thirsty camels.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and you will drink ˹it˺ like thirsty camels do.”

ayahs.textArabic: هَٰذَا نُزُلُهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Hatha nuzuluhum yawma alddeeni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: That is their accommodation on the Day of Recompense.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: This will be their accommodation on the Day of Judgment.

ayahs.textArabic: نَحۡنُ خَلَقۡنَٰكُمۡ فَلَوۡلَا تُصَدِّقُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Nahnu khalaqnakum falawla tusaddiqoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: We have created you, so why do you not believe?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: It is We Who created you. Will you not then believe ˹in resurrection˺?

ayahs.textArabic: أَفَرَءَيۡتُم مَّا تُمۡنُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Afaraaytum ma tumnoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Have you seen that which you emit?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Have you considered what you ejaculate?

ayahs.textArabic: ءَأَنتُمۡ تَخۡلُقُونَهُۥٓ أَمۡ نَحۡنُ ٱلۡخَٰلِقُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Aantum takhluqoonahu am nahnu alkhaliqoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Is it you who creates it, or are We the Creator?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Is it you who create ˹a child out of˺ it, or is it We Who do so?

ayahs.textArabic: نَحۡنُ قَدَّرۡنَا بَيۡنَكُمُ ٱلۡمَوۡتَ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمَسۡبُوقِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Nahnu qaddarna baynakumu almawta wama nahnu bimasbooqeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: We have decreed death among you, and We are not to be outdone
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We have ordained death for ˹all of˺ you, and We cannot be prevented

ayahs.textArabic: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ أَمۡثَٰلَكُمۡ وَنُنشِئَكُمۡ فِي مَا لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: AAala an nubaddila amthalakum wanunshiakum fee ma la taAAlamoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: In that We will change your likenesses and produce you in that [form] which you do not know.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: from transforming and recreating you in forms unknown to you.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدۡ عَلِمۡتُمُ ٱلنَّشۡأَةَ ٱلۡأُولَىٰ فَلَوۡلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walaqad AAalimtumu alnnashata aloola falawla tathakkaroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And you have already known the first creation, so will you not remember?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: You already know how you were first created. Will you not then be mindful?

ayahs.textArabic: أَفَرَءَيۡتُم مَّا تَحۡرُثُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Afaraaytum ma tahruthoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And have you seen that [seed] which you sow?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Have you considered what you sow?

ayahs.textArabic: ءَأَنتُمۡ تَزۡرَعُونَهُۥٓ أَمۡ نَحۡنُ ٱلزَّٰرِعُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Aantum tazraAAoonahu am nahnu alzzariAAoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Is it you who makes it grow, or are We the grower?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Is it you who cause it to grow, or is it We Who do so?

ayahs.textArabic: لَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلۡنَٰهُ حُطَٰمٗا فَظَلۡتُمۡ تَفَكَّهُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Law nashao lajaAAalnahu hutaman fathaltum tafakkahoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: If We willed, We could make it [dry] debris, and you would remain in wonder,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: If We willed, We could simply reduce this ˹harvest˺ to chaff, leaving you to lament,

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّا لَمُغۡرَمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna lamughramoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Saying], "Indeed, we are [now] in debt;
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: “We have truly suffered a ˹great˺ loss.

ayahs.textArabic: بَلۡ نَحۡنُ مَحۡرُومُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Bal nahnu mahroomoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Rather, we have been deprived."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: In fact, we have been deprived ˹of our livelihood˺.”

ayahs.textArabic: أَفَرَءَيۡتُمُ ٱلۡمَآءَ ٱلَّذِي تَشۡرَبُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Afaraaytumu almaa allathee tashraboona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And have you seen the water that you drink?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Have you considered the water you drink?

ayahs.textArabic: ءَأَنتُمۡ أَنزَلۡتُمُوهُ مِنَ ٱلۡمُزۡنِ أَمۡ نَحۡنُ ٱلۡمُنزِلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Aantum anzaltumoohu mina almuzni am nahnu almunziloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Is it you who brought it down from the clouds, or is it We who bring it down?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Is it you who bring it down from the clouds, or is it We Who do so?

ayahs.textArabic: لَوۡ نَشَآءُ جَعَلۡنَٰهُ أُجَاجٗا فَلَوۡلَا تَشۡكُرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Law nashao jaAAalnahu ojajan falawla tashkuroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: If We willed, We could make it bitter, so why are you not grateful?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: If We willed, We could make it salty. Will you not then give thanks?

ayahs.textArabic: أَفَرَءَيۡتُمُ ٱلنَّارَ ٱلَّتِي تُورُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Afaraaytumu alnnara allatee tooroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And have you seen the fire that you ignite?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Have you considered the fire you kindle?

ayahs.textArabic: ءَأَنتُمۡ أَنشَأۡتُمۡ شَجَرَتَهَآ أَمۡ نَحۡنُ ٱلۡمُنشِـُٔونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Aantum anshatum shajarataha am nahnu almunshioona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Is it you who produced its tree, or are We the producer?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Is it you who produce its trees, or is it We Who do so?

ayahs.textArabic: نَحۡنُ جَعَلۡنَٰهَا تَذۡكِرَةٗ وَمَتَٰعٗا لِّلۡمُقۡوِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Nahnu jaAAalnaha tathkiratan wamataAAan lilmuqweena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: We have made it a reminder and provision for the travelers,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We have made it ˹as˺ a reminder ˹of the Hellfire˺ and a provision for the travellers.

ayahs.textArabic: فَسَبِّحۡ بِٱسۡمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fasabbih biismi rabbika alAAatheemi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So glorify the Name of your Lord, the Greatest.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ فَلَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِمَوَٰقِعِ ٱلنُّجُومِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fala oqsimu bimawaqiAAi alnnujoomi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then I swear by the setting of the stars,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So I do swear by the positions of the stars—

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَقَسَمٞ لَّوۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ عَظِيمٌ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wainnahu laqasamun law taAAlamoona AAatheemun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And indeed, it is an oath - if you could know - [most] great.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and this, if only you knew, is indeed a great oath—

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّهُۥ لَقُرۡءَانٞ كَرِيمٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innahu laquranun kareemun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, it is a noble Qur'an
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: that this is truly a noble Quran,

ayahs.textArabic: فِي كِتَٰبٖ مَّكۡنُونٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fee kitabin maknoonin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: In a Register well-protected;
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: in a well-preserved Record,

ayahs.textArabic: لَّا يَمَسُّهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلۡمُطَهَّرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: La yamassuhu illa almutahharoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: None touch it except the purified.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: touched by none except the purified ˹angels˺.

ayahs.textArabic: تَنزِيلٞ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Tanzeelun min rabbi alAAalameena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹It is˺ a revelation from the Lord of all worlds.

ayahs.textArabic: أَفَبِهَٰذَا ٱلۡحَدِيثِ أَنتُم مُّدۡهِنُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Afabihatha alhadeethi antum mudhinoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then is it to this statement that you are indifferent
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: How can you then take this message lightly,

ayahs.textArabic: وَتَجۡعَلُونَ رِزۡقَكُمۡ أَنَّكُمۡ تُكَذِّبُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: WatajAAaloona rizqakum annakum tukaththiboona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And make [the thanks for] your provision that you deny [the Provider]?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and repay ˹Allah for˺ your provisions with denial?

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَوۡلَآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلۡحُلۡقُومَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Falawla itha balaghati alhulqooma
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then why, when the soul at death reaches the throat
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Why then ˹are you helpless˺ when the soul ˹of a dying person˺ reaches ˹their˺ throat,

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَنتُمۡ حِينَئِذٖ تَنظُرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waantum heenaithin tanthuroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And you are at that time looking on -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: while you are looking on?

ayahs.textArabic: وَنَحۡنُ أَقۡرَبُ إِلَيۡهِ مِنكُمۡ وَلَٰكِن لَّا تُبۡصِرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wanahnu aqrabu ilayhi minkum walakin la tubsiroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And Our angels are nearer to him than you, but you do not see -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And We are nearer to such a person than you, but you cannot see.

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَوۡلَآ إِن كُنتُمۡ غَيۡرَ مَدِينِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Falawla in kuntum ghayra madeeneena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then why do you not, if you are not to be recompensed,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Now, if you are not subject to Our Will ˹as you claim˺,

ayahs.textArabic: تَرۡجِعُونَهَآ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: TarjiAAoonaha in kuntum sadiqeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Bring it back, if you should be truthful?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: bring that soul back, if what you say is true.

ayahs.textArabic: فَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُقَرَّبِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faamma in kana mina almuqarrabeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And if the deceased was of those brought near to Allah,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So, if the deceased is one of those brought near ˹to Us˺,

ayahs.textArabic: فَرَوۡحٞ وَرَيۡحَانٞ وَجَنَّتُ نَعِيمٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Farawhun warayhanun wajannatu naAAeemin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then [for him is] rest and bounty and a garden of pleasure.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: then ˹such a person will have˺ serenity, fragrance, and a Garden of Bliss.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنۡ أَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلۡيَمِينِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waamma in kana min ashabi alyameeni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And if he was of the companions of the right,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And if the deceased is one of the people of the right,

ayahs.textArabic: فَسَلَٰمٞ لَّكَ مِنۡ أَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلۡيَمِينِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fasalamun laka min ashabi alyameeni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then [the angels will say], "Peace for you; [you are] from the companions of the right."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: then ˹they will be told,˺ “Greetings to you from the people of the right.”

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waamma in kana mina almukaththibeena alddalleena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But if he was of the deniers [who were] astray,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But if such person is one of the misguided deniers,

ayahs.textArabic: فَنُزُلٞ مِّنۡ حَمِيمٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fanuzulun min hameemin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then [for him is] accommodation of scalding water
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: then their accommodation will be boiling water ˹to drink˺

ayahs.textArabic: وَتَصۡلِيَةُ جَحِيمٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Watasliyatu jaheemin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And burning in Hellfire
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and burning in Hellfire.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ حَقُّ ٱلۡيَقِينِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna hatha lahuwa haqqu alyaqeeni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, this is the true certainty,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, this is the absolute truth.

ayahs.textArabic: فَسَبِّحۡ بِٱسۡمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fasabbih biismi rabbika alAAatheemi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So glorify the Name of your Lord, the Greatest.

ayahs.textArabic: سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Sabbaha lillahi ma fee alssamawati waalardi wahuwa alAAazeezu alhakeemu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Whatever is in the heavens and earth exalts Allah, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Whatever is in the heavens and the earth glorifies Allah, for He is the Almighty, All-Wise.
