ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna rabbaka huwa aAAlamu biman dalla AAan sabeelihi wahuwa aAAlamu bialmuhtadeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who has gone astray from His way, and He is most knowing of the [rightly] guided.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Surely your Lord ˹alone˺ knows best who has strayed from His Way and who is ˹rightly˺ guided.

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fala tutiAAi almukaththibeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then do not obey the deniers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So do not give in to the deniers.

ayahs.textArabic: وَدُّواْ لَوۡ تُدۡهِنُ فَيُدۡهِنُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waddoo law tudhinu fayudhinoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They wish that you would soften [in your position], so they would soften [toward you].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They wish you would compromise so they would yield ˹to you˺.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَا تُطِعۡ كُلَّ حَلَّافٖ مَّهِينٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wala tutiAA kulla hallafin maheenin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And do not obey every worthless habitual swearer
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And do not obey the despicable, vain oath-taker,

ayahs.textArabic: هَمَّازٖ مَّشَّآءِۭ بِنَمِيمٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Hammazin mashshain binameemin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [And] scorner, going about with malicious gossip -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: slanderer, gossip-monger,

ayahs.textArabic: مَّنَّاعٖ لِّلۡخَيۡرِ مُعۡتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: MannaAAin lilkhayri muAAtadin atheemin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: A preventer of good, transgressing and sinful,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: withholder of good, transgressor, evildoer,

ayahs.textArabic: عُتُلِّۭ بَعۡدَ ذَٰلِكَ زَنِيمٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: AAutullin baAAda thalika zaneemin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Cruel, moreover, and an illegitimate pretender.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: brute, and—on top of all that—an illegitimate child.

ayahs.textArabic: أَن كَانَ ذَا مَالٖ وَبَنِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: An kana tha malin wabaneena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Because he is a possessor of wealth and children,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Now, ˹simply˺ because he has been blessed with ˹abundant˺ wealth and children,

ayahs.textArabic: إِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Itha tutla AAalayhi ayatuna qala asateeru alawwaleena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: whenever Our revelations are recited to him, he says, “Ancient fables!”

ayahs.textArabic: سَنَسِمُهُۥ عَلَى ٱلۡخُرۡطُومِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Sanasimuhu AAala alkhurtoomi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: We will brand him upon the snout.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We will soon mark his snout.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّا بَلَوۡنَٰهُمۡ كَمَا بَلَوۡنَآ أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ إِذۡ أَقۡسَمُواْ لَيَصۡرِمُنَّهَا مُصۡبِحِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna balawnahum kama balawna ashaba aljannati ith aqsamoo layasrimunnaha musbiheena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, We have tested those ˹Meccans˺ as We tested the owners of the garden—when they swore they would surely harvest ˹all˺ its fruit in the early morning,

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَا يَسۡتَثۡنُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wala yastathnoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Without making exception.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: leaving no thought for Allah’s Will.

ayahs.textArabic: فَطَافَ عَلَيۡهَا طَآئِفٞ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمۡ نَآئِمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fatafa AAalayha taifun min rabbika wahum naimoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So there came upon the garden an affliction from your Lord while they were asleep.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then it was struck by a torment from your Lord while they slept,

ayahs.textArabic: فَأَصۡبَحَتۡ كَٱلصَّرِيمِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faasbahat kaalssareemi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And it became as though reaped.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: so it was reduced to ashes.

ayahs.textArabic: فَتَنَادَوۡاْ مُصۡبِحِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fatanadaw musbiheena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And they called one another at morning,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then by daybreak they called out to each other,

ayahs.textArabic: أَنِ ٱغۡدُواْ عَلَىٰ حَرۡثِكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰرِمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ani ighdoo AAala harthikum in kuntum sarimeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Saying], "Go early to your crop if you would cut the fruit."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹saying,˺ “Go early to your harvest, if you want to pick ˹all˺ the fruit.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَٱنطَلَقُواْ وَهُمۡ يَتَخَٰفَتُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faintalaqoo wahum yatakhafatoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So they set out, while lowering their voices,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So they went off, whispering to one another,

ayahs.textArabic: أَن لَّا يَدۡخُلَنَّهَا ٱلۡيَوۡمَ عَلَيۡكُم مِّسۡكِينٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: An la yadkhulannaha alyawma AAalaykum miskeenun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Saying], "There will surely not enter it today upon you [any] poor person."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: “Do not let any poor person enter your garden today.”

ayahs.textArabic: وَغَدَوۡاْ عَلَىٰ حَرۡدٖ قَٰدِرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waghadaw AAala hardin qadireena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And they went early in determination, [assuming themselves] able.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And they proceeded early, totally fixated on their purpose.

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَمَّا رَأَوۡهَا قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا لَضَآلُّونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Falamma raawha qaloo inna ladalloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But when they saw it, they said, "Indeed, we are lost;
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But when they saw it ˹devastated˺, they cried, “We must have lost ˹our˺ way!

ayahs.textArabic: بَلۡ نَحۡنُ مَحۡرُومُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Bal nahnu mahroomoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Rather, we have been deprived."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: In fact, we have been deprived ˹of our livelihood˺.”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ أَوۡسَطُهُمۡ أَلَمۡ أَقُل لَّكُمۡ لَوۡلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala awsatuhum alam aqul lakum lawla tusabbihoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The most moderate of them said, "Did I not say to you, 'Why do you not exalt [Allah]?' "
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The most sensible of them said, “Did I not urge you to say, ‘Allah willing.’?”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُواْ سُبۡحَٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qaloo subhana rabbina inna kunna thalimeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They said, "Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, we were wrongdoers."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They replied, “Glory be to our Lord! We have truly been wrongdoers.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَأَقۡبَلَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٖ يَتَلَٰوَمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faaqbala baAAduhum AAala baAAdin yatalawamoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then they approached one another, blaming each other.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then they turned on each other, throwing blame.

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُواْ يَٰوَيۡلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا طَٰغِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qaloo ya waylana inna kunna tagheena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They said, "O woe to us; indeed we were transgressors.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They said, “Woe to us! We have certainly been transgressors.

ayahs.textArabic: عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَآ أَن يُبۡدِلَنَا خَيۡرٗا مِّنۡهَآ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَٰغِبُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: AAasa rabbuna an yubdilana khayran minha inna ila rabbina raghiboona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Perhaps our Lord will substitute for us [one] better than it. Indeed, we are toward our Lord desirous."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We trust our Lord will give us a better garden than this, ˹for˺ we are indeed turning to our Lord with hope.”

ayahs.textArabic: كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡعَذَابُۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ أَكۡبَرُۚ لَوۡ كَانُواْ يَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kathalika alAAathabu walaAAathabu alakhirati akbaru law kanoo yaAAlamoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Such is the punishment [of this world]. And the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: That is the ˹way of Our˺ punishment ˹in this world˺. But the punishment of the Hereafter is certainly far worse, if only they knew.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna lilmuttaqeena AAinda rabbihim jannati alnnaAAeemi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, for the righteous with their Lord are the Gardens of Pleasure.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, the righteous will have the Gardens of Bliss with their Lord.

ayahs.textArabic: أَفَنَجۡعَلُ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ كَٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: AfanajAAalu almuslimeena kaalmujrimeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then will We treat the Muslims like the criminals?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Should We then treat those who have submitted like the wicked?

ayahs.textArabic: مَا لَكُمۡ كَيۡفَ تَحۡكُمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ma lakum kayfa tahkumoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: What is [the matter] with you? How do you judge?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: What is the matter with you? How do you judge?

ayahs.textArabic: أَمۡ لَكُمۡ كِتَٰبٞ فِيهِ تَدۡرُسُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Am lakum kitabun feehi tadrusoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Or do you have a scripture in which you learn
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Or do you have a scripture, in which you read

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ لَكُمۡ فِيهِ لَمَا تَخَيَّرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna lakum feehi lama takhayyaroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: That indeed for you is whatever you choose?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: that you will have whatever you choose?

ayahs.textArabic: أَمۡ لَكُمۡ أَيۡمَٰنٌ عَلَيۡنَا بَٰلِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ إِنَّ لَكُمۡ لَمَا تَحۡكُمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Am lakum aymanun AAalayna balighatun ila yawmi alqiyamati inna lakum lama tahkumoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Or do you have oaths [binding] upon Us, extending until the Day of Resurrection, that indeed for you is whatever you judge?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Or do you have oaths binding on Us until the Day of Judgment that you will have whatever you decide?

ayahs.textArabic: سَلۡهُمۡ أَيُّهُم بِذَٰلِكَ زَعِيمٌ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Salhum ayyuhum bithalika zaAAeemun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Ask them which of them, for that [claim], is responsible.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Ask them ˹O Prophet˺ which of them can guarantee all that.

ayahs.textArabic: أَمۡ لَهُمۡ شُرَكَآءُ فَلۡيَأۡتُواْ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمۡ إِن كَانُواْ صَٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Am lahum shurakao falyatoo bishurakaihim in kanoo sadiqeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Or do they have partners? Then let them bring their partners, if they should be truthful.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Or do they have associate-gods ˹supporting this claim˺? Then let them bring forth their associate-gods, if what they say is true.

ayahs.textArabic: يَوۡمَ يُكۡشَفُ عَن سَاقٖ وَيُدۡعَوۡنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yawma yukshafu AAan saqin wayudAAawna ila alssujoodi fala yastateeAAoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The Day the shin will be uncovered and they are invited to prostration but the disbelievers will not be able,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Beware of˺ the Day the Shin ˹of Allah˺ will be bared, and the wicked will be asked to prostrate, but they will not be able to do so,

ayahs.textArabic: خَٰشِعَةً أَبۡصَٰرُهُمۡ تَرۡهَقُهُمۡ ذِلَّةٞۖ وَقَدۡ كَانُواْ يُدۡعَوۡنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ وَهُمۡ سَٰلِمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: KhashiAAatan absaruhum tarhaquhum thillatun waqad kanoo yudAAawna ila alssujoodi wahum salimoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. And they used to be invited to prostration while they were sound.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: with eyes downcast, totally covered with disgrace. For they were ˹always˺ called to prostrate ˹in the world˺ when they were fully capable ˹but they chose not to˺.

ayahs.textArabic: فَذَرۡنِي وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلۡحَدِيثِۖ سَنَسۡتَدۡرِجُهُم مِّنۡ حَيۡثُ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fatharnee waman yukaththibu bihatha alhadeethi sanastadrijuhum min haythu la yaAAlamoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So leave Me, [O Muhammad], with [the matter of] whoever denies the Qur'an. We will progressively lead them [to punishment] from where they do not know.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So leave to Me ˹O Prophet˺ those who reject this message. We will gradually draw them to destruction in ways they cannot comprehend.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأُمۡلِي لَهُمۡۚ إِنَّ كَيۡدِي مَتِينٌ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waomlee lahum inna kaydee mateenun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And I will give them time. Indeed, My plan is firm.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: I ˹only˺ delay their end for a while, but My planning is flawless.

ayahs.textArabic: أَمۡ تَسۡـَٔلُهُمۡ أَجۡرٗا فَهُم مِّن مَّغۡرَمٖ مُّثۡقَلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Am tasaluhum ajran fahum min maghramin muthqaloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Or do you ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Or are you asking them for a reward ˹for the message˺ so that they are overburdened by debt?

ayahs.textArabic: أَمۡ عِندَهُمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبُ فَهُمۡ يَكۡتُبُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Am AAindahumu alghaybu fahum yaktuboona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Or do they have access to ˹the Record in˺ the unseen, so they copy it ˹for all to see˺?

ayahs.textArabic: فَٱصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ ٱلۡحُوتِ إِذۡ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكۡظُومٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faisbir lihukmi rabbika wala takun kasahibi alhooti ith nada wahuwa makthoomun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then be patient for the decision of your Lord, [O Muhammad], and be not like the companion of the fish when he called out while he was distressed.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So be patient with your Lord’s decree, and do not be like ˹Jonah,˺ the Man of the Whale, who cried out ˹to Allah˺, in total distress.

ayahs.textArabic: لَّوۡلَآ أَن تَدَٰرَكَهُۥ نِعۡمَةٞ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ لَنُبِذَ بِٱلۡعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذۡمُومٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Lawla an tadarakahu niAAmatun min rabbihi lanubitha bialAAarai wahuwa mathmoomun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: If not that a favor from his Lord overtook him, he would have been thrown onto the naked shore while he was censured.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Had he not been shown grace by his Lord, he would have certainly been cast onto the open ˹shore˺, still blameworthy.

ayahs.textArabic: فَٱجۡتَبَٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَجَعَلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faijtabahu rabbuhu fajaAAalahu mina alssaliheena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And his Lord chose him and made him of the righteous.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then his Lord chose him, making him one of the righteous.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَيُزۡلِقُونَكَ بِأَبۡصَٰرِهِمۡ لَمَّا سَمِعُواْ ٱلذِّكۡرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجۡنُونٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wain yakadu allatheena kafaroo layuzliqoonaka biabsarihim lamma samiAAoo alththikra wayaqooloona innahu lamajnoonun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And indeed, those who disbelieve would almost make you slip with their eyes when they hear the message, and they say, "Indeed, he is mad."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The disbelievers would almost cut you down with their eyes when they hear ˹you recite˺ the Reminder, and say, “He is certainly a madman.”

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكۡرٞ لِّلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama huwa illa thikrun lilAAalameena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But it is not except a reminder to the worlds.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But it is simply a reminder to the whole world.

ayahs.textArabic: ٱلۡحَآقَّةُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Alhaqqatu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The Inevitable Reality -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The Inevitable Hour!

ayahs.textArabic: مَا ٱلۡحَآقَّةُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ma alhaqqatu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: What is the Inevitable Reality?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: What is the Inevitable Hour?

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلۡحَآقَّةُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama adraka ma alhaqqatu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And what can make you know what is the Inevitable Reality?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And what will make you realize what the Inevitable Hour is?

ayahs.textArabic: كَذَّبَتۡ ثَمُودُ وَعَادُۢ بِٱلۡقَارِعَةِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kaththabat thamoodu waAAadun bialqariAAati
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Thamud and 'Aad denied the Striking Calamity.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Both˺ Thamûd and ’Ȃd denied the Striking Disaster.

ayahs.textArabic: فَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَأُهۡلِكُواْ بِٱلطَّاغِيَةِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faamma thamoodu faohlikoo bialttaghiyati
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So as for Thamud, they were destroyed by the overpowering [blast].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: As for Thamûd, they were destroyed by an overwhelming blast.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَمَّا عَادٞ فَأُهۡلِكُواْ بِرِيحٖ صَرۡصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waamma AAadun faohlikoo bireehin sarsarin AAatiyatin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And as for 'Aad, they were destroyed by a screaming, violent wind
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And as for ’Ȃd, they were destroyed by a furious, bitter wind

ayahs.textArabic: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ سَبۡعَ لَيَالٖ وَثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومٗاۖ فَتَرَى ٱلۡقَوۡمَ فِيهَا صَرۡعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمۡ أَعۡجَازُ نَخۡلٍ خَاوِيَةٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Sakhkharaha AAalayhim sabAAa layalin wathamaniyata ayyamin husooman fatara alqawma feeha sarAAa kaannahum aAAjazu nakhlin khawiyatun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Which Allah imposed upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so you would see the people therein fallen as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: which Allah unleashed on them non-stop for seven nights and eight days, so that you would have seen its people lying dead like trunks of uprooted palm trees.

ayahs.textArabic: فَهَلۡ تَرَىٰ لَهُم مِّنۢ بَاقِيَةٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fahal tara lahum min baqiyatin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then do you see of them any remains?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Do you see any of them left alive?

ayahs.textArabic: وَجَآءَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ وَمَن قَبۡلَهُۥ وَٱلۡمُؤۡتَفِكَٰتُ بِٱلۡخَاطِئَةِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wajaa firAAawnu waman qablahu waalmutafikatu bialkhatiati
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And there came Pharaoh and those before him and the overturned cities with sin.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Also, Pharaoh and those before him, and ˹the people of˺ the overturned cities ˹of Lot˺ indulged in sin,

ayahs.textArabic: فَعَصَوۡاْ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمۡ فَأَخَذَهُمۡ أَخۡذَةٗ رَّابِيَةً
ayahs.textTransliteration: FaAAasaw rasoola rabbihim faakhathahum akhthatan rabiyatan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a seizure exceeding [in severity].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: each disobeying their Lord’s messenger, so He seized them with a crushing grip.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا ٱلۡمَآءُ حَمَلۡنَٰكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡجَارِيَةِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna lamma tagha almao hamalnakum fee aljariyati
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, when the water overflowed, We carried your ancestors in the sailing ship
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, when the floodwater had overflowed, We carried you in the floating Ark ˹with Noah˺,

ayahs.textArabic: لِنَجۡعَلَهَا لَكُمۡ تَذۡكِرَةٗ وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنٞ وَٰعِيَةٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: LinajAAalaha lakum tathkiratan wataAAiyaha othunun waAAiyatun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: That We might make it for you a reminder and [that] a conscious ear would be conscious of it.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: so that We may make this a reminder to you, and that attentive ears may grasp it.

ayahs.textArabic: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِي ٱلصُّورِ نَفۡخَةٞ وَٰحِدَةٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faitha nufikha fee alssoori nafkhatun wahidatun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then when the Horn is blown with one blast
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: At last, when the Trumpet will be blown with one blast,

ayahs.textArabic: وَحُمِلَتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَٱلۡجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wahumilati alardu waaljibalu fadukkata dakkatan wahidatan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the earth and the mountains are lifted and leveled with one blow -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and the earth and mountains will be lifted up and crushed with one blow,

ayahs.textArabic: فَيَوۡمَئِذٖ وَقَعَتِ ٱلۡوَاقِعَةُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fayawmaithin waqaAAati alwaqiAAatu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then on that Day, the Resurrection will occur,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: on that Day the Inevitable Event will have come to pass.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَهِيَ يَوۡمَئِذٖ وَاهِيَةٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wainshaqqati alssamao fahiya yawmaithin wahiyatun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the heaven will split [open], for that Day it is infirm.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The sky will then be so torn that it will be frail,

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلۡمَلَكُ عَلَىٰٓ أَرۡجَآئِهَاۚ وَيَحۡمِلُ عَرۡشَ رَبِّكَ فَوۡقَهُمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٖ ثَمَٰنِيَةٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalmalaku AAala arjaiha wayahmilu AAarsha rabbika fawqahum yawmaithin thamaniyatun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the angels are at its edges. And there will bear the Throne of your Lord above them, that Day, eight [of them].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: with the angels on its sides. On that Day eight ˹mighty angels˺ will bear the Throne of your Lord above them.

ayahs.textArabic: يَوۡمَئِذٖ تُعۡرَضُونَ لَا تَخۡفَىٰ مِنكُمۡ خَافِيَةٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yawmaithin tuAAradoona la takhfa minkum khafiyatun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: That Day, you will be exhibited [for judgement]; not hidden among you is anything concealed.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: You will then be presented ˹before Him for judgment˺, and none of your secrets will stay hidden.

ayahs.textArabic: فَأَمَّا مَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقۡرَءُواْ كِتَٰبِيَهۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faamma man ootiya kitabahu biyameenihi fayaqoolu haomu iqraoo kitabiyah
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So as for he who is given his record in his right hand, he will say, "Here, read my record!
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: As for those given their records in their right hand, they will cry ˹happily˺, “Here ˹everyone˺! Read my record!

ayahs.textArabic: إِنِّي ظَنَنتُ أَنِّي مُلَٰقٍ حِسَابِيَهۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innee thanantu annee mulaqin hisabiyah
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, I was certain that I would be meeting my account."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: I surely knew I would face my reckoning.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَهُوَ فِي عِيشَةٖ رَّاضِيَةٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fahuwa fee AAeeshatin radiyatin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So he will be in a pleasant life -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They will be in a life of bliss,

ayahs.textArabic: فِي جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fee jannatin AAaliyatin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: In an elevated garden,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: in an elevated Garden,

ayahs.textArabic: قُطُوفُهَا دَانِيَةٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qutoofuha daniyatun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Its [fruit] to be picked hanging near.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: whose fruit will hang within reach.

ayahs.textArabic: كُلُواْ وَٱشۡرَبُواْ هَنِيٓـَٔۢا بِمَآ أَسۡلَفۡتُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَيَّامِ ٱلۡخَالِيَةِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kuloo waishraboo haneean bima aslaftum fee alayyami alkhaliyati
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you put forth in the days past."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹They will be told,˺ “Eat and drink joyfully for what you did in the days gone by.”

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي لَمۡ أُوتَ كِتَٰبِيَهۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waamma man ootiya kitabahu bishimalihi fayaqoolu ya laytanee lam oota kitabiyah
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But as for he who is given his record in his left hand, he will say, "Oh, I wish I had not been given my record
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And as for those given their record in their left hand, they will cry ˹bitterly˺, “I wish I had not been given my record,

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَمۡ أَدۡرِ مَا حِسَابِيَهۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walam adri ma hisabiyah
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And had not known what is my account.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: nor known anything of my reckoning!

ayahs.textArabic: يَٰلَيۡتَهَا كَانَتِ ٱلۡقَاضِيَةَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ya laytaha kanati alqadiyatu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: I wish my death had been the decisive one.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: I wish death was the end!

ayahs.textArabic: مَآ أَغۡنَىٰ عَنِّي مَالِيَهۡۜ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ma aghna AAannee maliyah
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: My wealth has not availed me.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: My wealth has not benefited me!

ayahs.textArabic: هَلَكَ عَنِّي سُلۡطَٰنِيَهۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Halaka AAannee sultaniyah
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Gone from me is my authority."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: My authority has been stripped from me.”

ayahs.textArabic: خُذُوهُ فَغُلُّوهُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Khuthoohu faghulloohu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Allah will say], "Seize him and shackle him.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹It will be said,˺ “Seize and shackle them,

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ ٱلۡجَحِيمَ صَلُّوهُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thumma aljaheema salloohu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then into Hellfire drive him.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: then burn them in Hell,

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ فِي سِلۡسِلَةٖ ذَرۡعُهَا سَبۡعُونَ ذِرَاعٗا فَٱسۡلُكُوهُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thumma fee silsilatin tharAAuha sabAAoona thiraAAan faoslukoohu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then into a chain whose length is seventy cubits insert him."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: then tie them up with chains seventy arms long.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innahu kana la yuminu biAllahi alAAatheemi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, he did not used to believe in Allah, the Most Great,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: For they never had faith in Allah, the Greatest,

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلۡمِسۡكِينِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wala yahuddu AAala taAAami almiskeeni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Nor did he encourage the feeding of the poor.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: nor encouraged the feeding of the poor.

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَيۡسَ لَهُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ هَٰهُنَا حَمِيمٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Falaysa lahu alyawma hahuna hameemun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So there is not for him here this Day any devoted friend
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So this Day they will have no close friend here,

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَا طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِنۡ غِسۡلِينٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wala taAAamun illa min ghisleenin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Nor any food except from the discharge of wounds;
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: nor any food except ˹oozing˺ pus,

ayahs.textArabic: لَّا يَأۡكُلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلۡخَٰطِـُٔونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: La yakuluhu illa alkhatioona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: None will eat it except the sinners.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: which none will eat except the evildoers.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِمَا تُبۡصِرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fala oqsimu bima tubsiroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So I swear by what you see
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Now, I do swear by whatever you see,

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا لَا تُبۡصِرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama la tubsiroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And what you do not see
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and whatever you cannot see!

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوۡلُ رَسُولٖ كَرِيمٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innahu laqawlu rasoolin kareemin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [That] indeed, the Qur'an is the word of a noble Messenger.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, this ˹Quran˺ is the recitation of a noble Messenger.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوۡلِ شَاعِرٖۚ قَلِيلٗا مَّا تُؤۡمِنُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama huwa biqawli shaAAirin qaleelan ma tuminoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And it is not the word of a poet; little do you believe.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: It is not the prose of a poet ˹as you claim˺, ˹yet˺ you hardly have any faith.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَا بِقَوۡلِ كَاهِنٖۚ قَلِيلٗا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wala biqawli kahinin qaleelan ma tathakkaroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Nor the word of a soothsayer; little do you remember.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Nor is it the mumbling of a fortune-teller, ˹yet˺ you are hardly mindful.

ayahs.textArabic: تَنزِيلٞ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Tanzeelun min rabbi alAAalameena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹It is˺ a revelation from the Lord of all worlds.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَوۡ تَقَوَّلَ عَلَيۡنَا بَعۡضَ ٱلۡأَقَاوِيلِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walaw taqawwala AAalayna baAAda alaqaweeli
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And if Muhammad had made up about Us some [false] sayings,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Had the Messenger made up something in Our Name,

ayahs.textArabic: لَأَخَذۡنَا مِنۡهُ بِٱلۡيَمِينِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Laakhathna minhu bialyameeni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: We would have seized him by the right hand;
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We would have certainly seized him by his right hand,

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ لَقَطَعۡنَا مِنۡهُ ٱلۡوَتِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thumma laqataAAna minhu alwateena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then We would have cut from him the aorta.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: then severed his aorta,

ayahs.textArabic: فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنۡ أَحَدٍ عَنۡهُ حَٰجِزِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fama minkum min ahadin AAanhu hajizeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And there is no one of you who could prevent [Us] from him.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and none of you could have shielded him ˹from Us˺!

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَذۡكِرَةٞ لِّلۡمُتَّقِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wainnahu latathkiratun lilmuttaqeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And indeed, the Qur'an is a reminder for the righteous.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, this ˹Quran˺ is a reminder to those mindful ˹of Allah˺.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِنَّا لَنَعۡلَمُ أَنَّ مِنكُم مُّكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wainna lanaAAlamu anna minkum mukaththibeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And indeed, We know that among you are deniers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And We certainly know that some of you will persist in denial,

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَسۡرَةٌ عَلَى ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wainnahu lahasratun AAala alkafireena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And indeed, it will be [a cause of] regret upon the disbelievers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and it will surely be a source of regret for the disbelievers.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَقُّ ٱلۡيَقِينِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wainnahu lahaqqu alyaqeeni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And indeed, it is the truth of certainty.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And indeed, this ˹Quran˺ is the absolute truth.

ayahs.textArabic: فَسَبِّحۡ بِٱسۡمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fasabbih biismi rabbika alAAatheemi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So glorify the Name of your Lord, the Greatest.

ayahs.textArabic: سَأَلَ سَآئِلُۢ بِعَذَابٖ وَاقِعٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Saala sailun biAAathabin waqiAAin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: A supplicant asked for a punishment bound to happen
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: A challenger has demanded a punishment bound to come

ayahs.textArabic: لِّلۡكَٰفِرِينَ لَيۡسَ لَهُۥ دَافِعٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Lilkafireena laysa lahu dafiAAun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: To the disbelievers; of it there is no preventer.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: for the disbelievers—to be averted by none—

ayahs.textArabic: مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ ذِي ٱلۡمَعَارِجِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Mina Allahi thee almaAAariji
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [It is] from Allah, owner of the ways of ascent.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: from Allah, Lord of pathways of ˹heavenly˺ ascent,

ayahs.textArabic: تَعۡرُجُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ إِلَيۡهِ فِي يَوۡمٖ كَانَ مِقۡدَارُهُۥ خَمۡسِينَ أَلۡفَ سَنَةٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: TaAAruju almalaikatu waalrroohu ilayhi fee yawmin kana miqdaruhu khamseena alfa sanatin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The angels and the Spirit will ascend to Him during a Day the extent of which is fifty thousand years.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹through which˺ the angels and the ˹holy˺ spirit will ascend to Him on a Day fifty thousand years in length.

ayahs.textArabic: فَٱصۡبِرۡ صَبۡرٗا جَمِيلًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faisbir sabran jameelan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So be patient with gracious patience.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So endure ˹this denial, O Prophet,˺ with beautiful patience.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّهُمۡ يَرَوۡنَهُۥ بَعِيدٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innahum yarawnahu baAAeedan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, they see it [as] distant,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They truly see this ˹Day˺ as impossible,

ayahs.textArabic: وَنَرَىٰهُ قَرِيبٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wanarahu qareeban
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But We see it [as] near.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: but We see it as inevitable.

ayahs.textArabic: يَوۡمَ تَكُونُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ كَٱلۡمُهۡلِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yawma takoonu alssamao kaalmuhli
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: On the Day the sky will be like murky oil,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: On that Day the sky will be like molten brass

ayahs.textArabic: وَتَكُونُ ٱلۡجِبَالُ كَٱلۡعِهۡنِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Watakoonu aljibalu kaalAAihni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the mountains will be like wool,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and the mountains like ˹tufts of˺ wool.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَا يَسۡـَٔلُ حَمِيمٌ حَمِيمٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wala yasalu hameemun hameeman
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And no friend will ask [anything of] a friend,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And no close friend will ask ˹about˺ their friends,

ayahs.textArabic: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمۡۚ يَوَدُّ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُ لَوۡ يَفۡتَدِي مِنۡ عَذَابِ يَوۡمِئِذِۭ بِبَنِيهِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yubassaroonahum yawaddu almujrimu law yaftadee min AAathabi yawmiithin bibaneehi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They will be shown each other. The criminal will wish that he could be ransomed from the punishment of that Day by his children
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹although˺ they will be made to see each other. The wicked will wish to ransom themselves from the punishment of that Day by their children,

ayahs.textArabic: وَصَٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَأَخِيهِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wasahibatihi waakheehi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And his wife and his brother
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: their spouses, their siblings,

ayahs.textArabic: وَفَصِيلَتِهِ ٱلَّتِي تُـٔۡوِيهِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wafaseelatihi allatee tuweehi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And his nearest kindred who shelter him
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: their clan that sheltered them,

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَن فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ جَمِيعٗا ثُمَّ يُنجِيهِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waman fee alardi jameeAAan thumma yunjeehi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And whoever is on earth entirely [so] then it could save him.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and everyone on earth altogether, just to save themselves.

ayahs.textArabic: كـَلَّآۖ إِنَّهَا لَظَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kalla innaha latha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: No! Indeed, it is the Flame [of Hell],
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But no! There will certainly be a raging Flame

ayahs.textArabic: نَزَّاعَةٗ لِّلشَّوَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: NazzaAAatan lilshshawa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: A remover of exteriors.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ripping off scalps.

ayahs.textArabic: تَدۡعُواْ مَنۡ أَدۡبَرَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: TadAAoo man adbara watawalla
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: It invites he who turned his back [on truth] and went away [from obedience]
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: It will summon whoever turned their backs ˹on Allah˺ and turned away ˹from the truth˺,

ayahs.textArabic: وَجَمَعَ فَأَوۡعَىٰٓ
ayahs.textTransliteration: WajamaAAa faawAAa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And collected [wealth] and hoarded.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and gathered and hoarded ˹wealth˺.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ إِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ خُلِقَ هَلُوعًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna alinsana khuliqa halooAAan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, mankind was created anxious:
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, humankind was created impatient:

ayahs.textArabic: إِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ جَزُوعٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Itha massahu alshsharru jazooAAan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: When evil touches him, impatient,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: distressed when touched with evil,

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلۡخَيۡرُ مَنُوعًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waitha massahu alkhayru manooAAan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when good touches him, withholding [of it],
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and withholding when touched with good—

ayahs.textArabic: إِلَّا ٱلۡمُصَلِّينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Illa almusalleena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Except the observers of prayer -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: except those who pray,

ayahs.textArabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمۡ دَآئِمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Allatheena hum AAala salatihim daimoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Those who are constant in their prayer
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: consistently performing their prayers;

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ فِيٓ أَمۡوَٰلِهِمۡ حَقّٞ مَّعۡلُومٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waallatheena fee amwalihim haqqun maAAloomun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And those within whose wealth is a known right
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and who give the rightful share of their wealth

ayahs.textArabic: لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلۡمَحۡرُومِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Lilssaili waalmahroomi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: For the petitioner and the deprived -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: to the beggar and the poor;

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُصَدِّقُونَ بِيَوۡمِ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waallatheena yusaddiqoona biyawmi alddeeni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And those who believe in the Day of Recompense
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and who ˹firmly˺ believe in the Day of Judgment;

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنۡ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشۡفِقُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waallatheena hum min AAathabi rabbihim mushfiqoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And those who are fearful of the punishment of their Lord -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and those who fear the punishment of their Lord—

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّهِمۡ غَيۡرُ مَأۡمُونٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna AAathaba rabbihim ghayru mamoonin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, the punishment of their Lord is not that from which one is safe -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹knowing that˺ none should feel secure from their Lord’s punishment—

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ لِفُرُوجِهِمۡ حَٰفِظُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waallatheena hum lifuroojihim hafithoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And those who guard their private parts
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and those who guard their chastity

ayahs.textArabic: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزۡوَٰجِهِمۡ أَوۡ مَا مَلَكَتۡ أَيۡمَٰنُهُمۡ فَإِنَّهُمۡ غَيۡرُ مَلُومِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Illa AAala azwajihim aw ma malakat aymanuhum fainnahum ghayru maloomeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they are not to be blamed -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: except with their wives or those ˹bondwomen˺ in their possession, for then they are free from blame,

ayahs.textArabic: فَمَنِ ٱبۡتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡعَادُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Famani ibtagha waraa thalika faolaika humu alAAadoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But whoever seeks beyond that, then they are the transgressors -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: but whoever seeks beyond that are the transgressors.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ لِأَمَٰنَٰتِهِمۡ وَعَهۡدِهِمۡ رَٰعُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waallatheena hum liamanatihim waAAahdihim raAAoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And those who are to their trusts and promises attentive
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹The faithful are˺ also those who are true to their trusts and covenants;

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِشَهَٰدَٰتِهِمۡ قَآئِمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waallatheena hum bishahadatihim qaimoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And those who are in their testimonies upright
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and who are honest in their testimony;

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمۡ يُحَافِظُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waallatheena hum AAala salatihim yuhafithoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And those who [carefully] maintain their prayer:
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and who are ˹properly˺ observant of their prayers.

ayahs.textArabic: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ فِي جَنَّٰتٖ مُّكۡرَمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Olaika fee jannatin mukramoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They will be in gardens, honored.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: These will be in Gardens, held in honour.

ayahs.textArabic: فَمَالِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ قِبَلَكَ مُهۡطِعِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Famali allatheena kafaroo qibalaka muhtiAAeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So what is [the matter] with those who disbelieve, hastening [from] before you, [O Muhammad],
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So what is the matter with the disbelievers that they rush ˹head-long˺ towards you ˹O Prophet˺,

ayahs.textArabic: عَنِ ٱلۡيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ عِزِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: AAani alyameeni waAAani alshshimali AAizeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [To sit] on [your] right and [your] left in separate groups?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: from the right and the left, in groups ˹to mock you˺?

ayahs.textArabic: أَيَطۡمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمۡرِيٕٖ مِّنۡهُمۡ أَن يُدۡخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: AyatmaAAu kullu imriin minhum an yudkhala jannata naAAeemin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Does every person among them aspire to enter a garden of pleasure?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Does every one of them expect to be admitted into a Garden of Bliss?

ayahs.textArabic: كـَلَّآۖ إِنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰهُم مِّمَّا يَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kalla inna khalaqnahum mimma yaAAlamoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: No! Indeed, We have created them from that which they know.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But no! Indeed, they ˹already˺ know what We created them from.

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِرَبِّ ٱلۡمَشَٰرِقِ وَٱلۡمَغَٰرِبِ إِنَّا لَقَٰدِرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fala oqsimu birabbi almashariqi waalmagharibi inna laqadiroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So I swear by the Lord of [all] risings and settings that indeed We are able
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So, I do swear by the Lord of ˹all˺ the points of sunrise and sunset that We are truly capable

ayahs.textArabic: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيۡرٗا مِّنۡهُمۡ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمَسۡبُوقِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: AAala an nubaddila khayran minhum wama nahnu bimasbooqeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: To replace them with better than them; and We are not to be outdone.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: of replacing them with ˹others˺ better than them, and We cannot be prevented ˹from doing so˺.

ayahs.textArabic: فَذَرۡهُمۡ يَخُوضُواْ وَيَلۡعَبُواْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُواْ يَوۡمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fatharhum yakhoodoo wayalAAaboo hatta yulaqoo yawmahumu allathee yooAAadoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So let them indulge ˹in falsehood˺ and amuse ˹themselves˺ until they face their Day, which they have been threatened with—

ayahs.textArabic: يَوۡمَ يَخۡرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡأَجۡدَاثِ سِرَاعٗا كَأَنَّهُمۡ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٖ يُوفِضُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yawma yakhrujoona mina alajdathi siraAAan kaannahum ila nusubin yoofidoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The Day they will emerge from the graves rapidly as if they were, toward an erected idol, hastening.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: the Day they will come forth from the graves swiftly, as if racing to an idol ˹for a blessing˺,

ayahs.textArabic: خَٰشِعَةً أَبۡصَٰرُهُمۡ تَرۡهَقُهُمۡ ذِلَّةٞۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمُ ٱلَّذِي كَانُواْ يُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: KhashiAAatan absaruhum tarhaquhum thillatun thalika alyawmu allathee kanoo yooAAadoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. That is the Day which they had been promised.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: with eyes downcast, utterly covered with disgrace. That is the Day they have ˹always˺ been warned of.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِۦٓ أَنۡ أَنذِرۡ قَوۡمَكَ مِن قَبۡلِ أَن يَأۡتِيَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna arsalna noohan ila qawmihi an anthir qawmaka min qabli an yatiyahum AAathabun aleemun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people, [saying], "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful punishment."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people ˹saying to him˺, “Warn your people before a painful punishment comes to them.”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ إِنِّي لَكُمۡ نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٌ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala ya qawmi innee lakum natheerun mubeenun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He said, "O my people, indeed I am to you a clear warner,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Noah proclaimed, “O my people! I am truly sent to you with a clear warning:

ayahs.textArabic: أَنِ ٱعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ani oAAbudoo Allaha waittaqoohu waateeAAooni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Saying], 'Worship Allah, fear Him and obey me.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: worship Allah ˹alone˺, fear Him, and obey me.

ayahs.textArabic: يَغۡفِرۡ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمۡ وَيُؤَخِّرۡكُمۡ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٖ مُّسَمًّىۚ إِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُۚ لَوۡ كُنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yaghfir lakum min thunoobikum wayuakhkhirkum ila ajalin musamman inna ajala Allahi itha jaa la yuakhkharu law kuntum taAAlamoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Allah will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term. Indeed, the time [set by] Allah, when it comes, will not be delayed, if you only knew.' "
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He will forgive your sins, and delay your end until the appointed time. Indeed, when the time set by Allah comes, it cannot be delayed, if only you knew!”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي دَعَوۡتُ قَوۡمِي لَيۡلٗا وَنَهَارٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala rabbi innee daAAawtu qawmee laylan wanaharan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people [to truth] night and day.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He cried, “My Lord! I have surely called my people day and night,

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَمۡ يَزِدۡهُمۡ دُعَآءِيٓ إِلَّا فِرَارٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Falam yazidhum duAAaee illa firaran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But my invitation increased them not except in flight.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: but my calls only made them run farther away.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِنِّي كُلَّمَا دَعَوۡتُهُمۡ لِتَغۡفِرَ لَهُمۡ جَعَلُوٓاْ أَصَٰبِعَهُمۡ فِيٓ ءَاذَانِهِمۡ وَٱسۡتَغۡشَوۡاْ ثِيَابَهُمۡ وَأَصَرُّواْ وَٱسۡتَكۡبَرُواْ ٱسۡتِكۡبَارٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wainnee kullama daAAawtuhum litaghfira lahum jaAAaloo asabiAAahum fee athanihim waistaghshaw thiyabahum waasarroo waistakbaroo istikbaran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And indeed, every time I invited them that You may forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their garments, persisted, and were arrogant with [great] arrogance.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And whenever I invite them to be forgiven by You, they press their fingers into their ears, cover themselves with their clothes, persist ˹in denial˺, and act very arrogantly.

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ إِنِّي دَعَوۡتُهُمۡ جِهَارٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thumma innee daAAawtuhum jiharan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then I invited them publicly.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then I certainly called them openly,

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ إِنِّيٓ أَعۡلَنتُ لَهُمۡ وَأَسۡرَرۡتُ لَهُمۡ إِسۡرَارٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thumma innee aAAlantu lahum waasrartu lahum israran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then I announced to them and [also] confided to them secretly
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: then I surely preached to them publicly and privately,

ayahs.textArabic: فَقُلۡتُ ٱسۡتَغۡفِرُواْ رَبَّكُمۡ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faqultu istaghfiroo rabbakum innahu kana ghaffaran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: saying, ‘Seek your Lord’s forgiveness, ˹for˺ He is truly Most Forgiving.

ayahs.textArabic: يُرۡسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيۡكُم مِّدۡرَارٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yursili alssamaa AAalaykum midraran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He will shower you with abundant rain,

ayahs.textArabic: وَيُمۡدِدۡكُم بِأَمۡوَٰلٖ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجۡعَل لَّكُمۡ جَنَّٰتٖ وَيَجۡعَل لَّكُمۡ أَنۡهَٰرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wayumdidkum biamwalin wabaneena wayajAAal lakum jannatin wayajAAal lakum anharan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And give you increase in wealth and children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: supply you with wealth and children, and give you gardens as well as rivers.

ayahs.textArabic: مَّا لَكُمۡ لَا تَرۡجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ma lakum la tarjoona lillahi waqaran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: What is [the matter] with you that you do not attribute to Allah [due] grandeur
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: What is the matter with you that you are not in awe of the Majesty of Allah,

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَدۡ خَلَقَكُمۡ أَطۡوَارًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waqad khalaqakum atwaran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: While He has created you in stages?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: when He truly created you in stages ˹of development˺?

ayahs.textArabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَوۡاْ كَيۡفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبۡعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٖ طِبَاقٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Alam taraw kayfa khalaqa Allahu sabAAa samawatin tibaqan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Do you not consider how Allah has created seven heavens in layers
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Do you not see how Allah created seven heavens, one above the other,

ayahs.textArabic: وَجَعَلَ ٱلۡقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورٗا وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمۡسَ سِرَاجٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: WajaAAala alqamara feehinna nooran wajaAAala alshshamsa sirajan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And made the moon therein a [reflected] light and made the sun a burning lamp?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: placing the moon within them as a ˹reflected˺ light, and the sun as a ˹radiant˺ lamp?

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱللَّهُ أَنۢبَتَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ نَبَاتٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: WaAllahu anbatakum mina alardi nabatan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And Allah has caused you to grow from the earth a [progressive] growth.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Allah ˹alone˺ caused you to grow from the earth like a plant.

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمۡ فِيهَا وَيُخۡرِجُكُمۡ إِخۡرَاجٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thumma yuAAeedukum feeha wayukhrijukum ikhrajan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then He will return you into it and extract you [another] extraction.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then He will return you to it, and then simply bring you forth ˹again˺.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِسَاطٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: WaAllahu jaAAala lakumu alarda bisatan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And Allah has made for you the earth an expanse
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And Allah ˹alone˺ spread out the earth for you

ayahs.textArabic: لِّتَسۡلُكُواْ مِنۡهَا سُبُلٗا فِجَاجٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Litaslukoo minha subulan fijajan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: That you may follow therein roads of passage.' "
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: to walk along its spacious pathways.’”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ نُوحٞ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمۡ عَصَوۡنِي وَٱتَّبَعُواْ مَن لَّمۡ يَزِدۡهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qala noohun rabbi innahum AAasawnee waittabaAAoo man lam yazidhu maluhu wawaladuhu illa khasaran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Eventually,˺ Noah cried, “My Lord! They have certainly persisted in disobeying me, and followed ˹instead˺ those ˹elite˺ whose ˹abundant˺ wealth and children only increase them in loss,

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَكَرُواْ مَكۡرٗا كُبَّارٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wamakaroo makran kubbaran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And they conspired an immense conspiracy.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and who have devised a tremendous plot,

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالُواْ لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمۡ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدّٗا وَلَا سُوَاعٗا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسۡرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waqaloo la tatharunna alihatakum wala tatharunna waddan wala suwaAAan wala yaghootha wayaAAooqa wanasran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And said, 'Never leave your gods and never leave Wadd or Suwa' or Yaghuth and Ya'uq and Nasr.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: urging ˹their followers˺, ‘Do not abandon your idols—especially Wadd, Suwâ’, Yaghûth, Ya’ûq, and Nasr.’

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَدۡ أَضَلُّواْ كَثِيرٗاۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَٰلٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waqad adalloo katheeran wala tazidi alththalimeena illa dalalan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And already they have misled many. And, [my Lord], do not increase the wrongdoers except in error."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Those ˹elite˺ have already led many astray. So ˹O Lord˺, only allow the wrongdoers to stray farther away.”

ayahs.textArabic: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٰٔتِهِمۡ أُغۡرِقُواْ فَأُدۡخِلُواْ نَارٗا فَلَمۡ يَجِدُواْ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Mimma khateeatihim oghriqoo faodkhiloo naran falam yajidoo lahum min dooni Allahi ansaran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allah [any] helpers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So because of their sins, they were drowned, then admitted into the Fire. And they found none to help them against Allah.

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالَ نُوحٞ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرۡ عَلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ دَيَّارًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waqala noohun rabbi la tathar AAala alardi mina alkafireena dayyaran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And Noah said, "My Lord, do not leave upon the earth from among the disbelievers an inhabitant.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Noah had prayed, “My Lord! Do not leave a single disbeliever on earth.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرۡهُمۡ يُضِلُّواْ عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوٓاْ إِلَّا فَاجِرٗا كَفَّارٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innaka in tatharhum yudilloo AAibadaka wala yalidoo illa fajiran kaffaran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, if You leave them, they will mislead Your servants and not beget except [every] wicked one and [confirmed] disbeliever.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: For if You spare ˹any of˺ them, they will certainly mislead Your servants, and give birth only to ˹wicked˺ sinners, staunch disbelievers.

ayahs.textArabic: رَّبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ لِي وَلِوَٰلِدَيَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيۡتِيَ مُؤۡمِنٗا وَلِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارَۢا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Rabbi ighfir lee waliwalidayya waliman dakhala baytiya muminan walilmumineena waalmuminati wala tazidi alththalimeena illa tabaran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: My Lord! Forgive me, my parents, and whoever enters my house in faith, and ˹all˺ believing men and women. And increase the wrongdoers only in destruction.”

ayahs.textArabic: قُلۡ أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسۡتَمَعَ نَفَرٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا سَمِعۡنَا قُرۡءَانًا عَجَبٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qul oohiya ilayya annahu istamaAAa nafarun mina aljinni faqaloo inna samiAAna quranan AAajaban
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Say, [O Muhammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur'an.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “It has been revealed to me that a group of jinn listened ˹to the Quran,˺ and said ˹to their fellow jinn˺: ‘Indeed, we have heard a wondrous recitation.

ayahs.textArabic: يَهۡدِيٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشۡدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦۖ وَلَن نُّشۡرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yahdee ila alrrushdi faamanna bihi walan nushrika birabbina ahadan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: It leads to Right Guidance so we believed in it, and we will never associate anyone with our Lord ˹in worship˺.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ تَعَٰلَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا ٱتَّخَذَ صَٰحِبَةٗ وَلَا وَلَدٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waannahu taAAala jaddu rabbina ma ittakhatha sahibatan wala waladan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [it teaches] that exalted is the nobleness of our Lord; He has not taken a wife or a son
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Now, we believe that˺ our Lord—Exalted is His Majesty—has neither taken a mate nor offspring,

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ شَطَطٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waannahu kana yaqoolu safeehuna AAala Allahi shatatan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And that our foolish one has been saying about Allah an excessive transgression.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and that the foolish of us used to utter ˹outrageous˺ falsehoods about Allah.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن تَقُولَ ٱلۡإِنسُ وَٱلۡجِنُّ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waanna thananna an lan taqoola alinsu waaljinnu AAala Allahi kathiban
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And we had thought that mankind and the jinn would never speak about Allah a lie.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We certainly thought that humans and jinn would never speak lies about Allah.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ رِجَالٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمۡ رَهَقٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waannahu kana rijalun mina alinsi yaAAoothoona birijalin mina aljinni fazadoohum rahaqan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And there were men from mankind who sought refuge in men from the jinn, so they [only] increased them in burden.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And some men used to seek refuge with some jinn—so they increased each other in wickedness.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَنَّهُمۡ ظَنُّواْ كَمَا ظَنَنتُمۡ أَن لَّن يَبۡعَثَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waannahum thannoo kama thanantum an lan yabAAatha Allahu ahadan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And they had thought, as you thought, that Allah would never send anyone [as a messenger].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And those ˹humans˺ thought, just like you ˹jinn˺, that Allah would not resurrect anyone ˹for judgment˺.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَنَّا لَمَسۡنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدۡنَٰهَا مُلِئَتۡ حَرَسٗا شَدِيدٗا وَشُهُبٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waanna lamasna alssamaa fawajadnaha muliat harasan shadeedan washuhuban
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And we have sought [to reach] the heaven but found it filled with powerful guards and burning flames.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Earlier˺ we tried to reach heaven ˹for news˺, only to find it filled with stern guards and shooting stars.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقۡعُدُ مِنۡهَا مَقَٰعِدَ لِلسَّمۡعِۖ فَمَن يَسۡتَمِعِ ٱلۡأٓنَ يَجِدۡ لَهُۥ شِهَابٗا رَّصَدٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waanna kunna naqAAudu minha maqaAAida lilssamAAi faman yastamiAAi alana yajid lahu shihaban rasadan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And we used to sit therein in positions for hearing, but whoever listens now will find a burning flame lying in wait for him.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We used to take up positions there for eavesdropping, but whoever dares eavesdrop now will find a flare lying in wait for them.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَنَّا لَا نَدۡرِيٓ أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَمۡ أَرَادَ بِهِمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ رَشَدٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waanna la nadree asharrun oreeda biman fee alardi am arada bihim rabbuhum rashadan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And we do not know [therefore] whether evil is intended for those on earth or whether their Lord intends for them a right course.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Now, we do not really know whether evil is intended for those on earth, or their Lord intends for them what is right.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَۖ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waanna minna alssalihoona waminna doona thalika kunna taraiqa qidadan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Among us are those who are righteous and those who are less so. We have been of different factions.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعۡجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَن نُّعۡجِزَهُۥ هَرَبٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wanna thananna an lan nuAAjiza Allaha fee alardi walan nuAAjizahu haraban
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And we have become certain that we will never cause failure to Allah upon earth, nor can we escape Him by flight.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Now,˺ we truly know that we cannot frustrate Allah on earth, nor can we escape from Him ˹into heaven˺.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعۡنَا ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦۖ فَمَن يُؤۡمِنۢ بِرَبِّهِۦ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخۡسٗا وَلَا رَهَقٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waanna lamma samiAAna alhuda amanna bihi faman yumin birabbihi fala yakhafu bakhsan wala rahaqan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when we heard the guidance, we believed in it. And whoever believes in his Lord will not fear deprivation or burden.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: When we heard the guidance ˹of the Quran˺, we ˹readily˺ believed in it. For whoever believes in their Lord will have no fear of being denied ˹a reward˺ or wronged.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلۡمُسۡلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا ٱلۡقَٰسِطُونَۖ فَمَنۡ أَسۡلَمَ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ تَحَرَّوۡاْ رَشَدٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waanna minna almuslimoona waminna alqasitoona faman aslama faolaika taharraw rashadan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And among us are Muslims [in submission to Allah], and among us are the unjust. And whoever has become Muslim - those have sought out the right course.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And among us are those who have submitted ˹to Allah˺ and those who are deviant. So ˹as for˺ those who submitted, it is they who have attained Right Guidance.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلۡقَٰسِطُونَ فَكَانُواْ لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waama alqasitoona fakanoo lijahannama hataban
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But as for the unjust, they will be, for Hell, firewood.'
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And as for the deviant, they will be fuel for Hell.’”

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَلَّوِ ٱسۡتَقَٰمُواْ عَلَى ٱلطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسۡقَيۡنَٰهُم مَّآءً غَدَقٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waallawi istaqamoo AAala alttareeqati laasqaynahum maan ghadaqan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [Allah revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, We would have given them abundant provision
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Had the deniers followed the Right Way, We would have certainly granted them abundant rain to drink—

ayahs.textArabic: لِّنَفۡتِنَهُمۡ فِيهِۚ وَمَن يُعۡرِضۡ عَن ذِكۡرِ رَبِّهِۦ يَسۡلُكۡهُ عَذَابٗا صَعَدٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Linaftinahum feehi waman yuAArid AAan thikri rabbihi yaslukhu AAathaban saAAadan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So We might test them therein. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord He will put into arduous punishment.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: as a test for them. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of their Lord will be admitted by Him into an overwhelming punishment.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَنَّ ٱلۡمَسَٰجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدۡعُواْ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waanna almasajida lillahi fala tadAAoo maAAa Allahi ahadan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [He revealed] that the masjids are for Allah, so do not invoke with Allah anyone.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The places of worship are ˹only˺ for Allah, so do not invoke anyone besides Him.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبۡدُ ٱللَّهِ يَدۡعُوهُ كَادُواْ يَكُونُونَ عَلَيۡهِ لِبَدٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waannahu lamma qama AAabdu Allahi yadAAoohu kadoo yakoonoona AAalayhi libadan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And that when the Servant of Allah stood up supplicating Him, they almost became about him a compacted mass."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Yet when the servant of Allah stood up calling upon Him ˹alone˺, the pagans almost swarmed over him.

ayahs.textArabic: قُلۡ إِنَّمَآ أَدۡعُواْ رَبِّي وَلَآ أُشۡرِكُ بِهِۦٓ أَحَدٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qul innama adAAoo rabbee wala oshriku bihi ahadan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Say, [O Muhammad], "I only invoke my Lord and do not associate with Him anyone."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I call only upon my Lord, associating none with Him ˹in worship˺.”

ayahs.textArabic: قُلۡ إِنِّي لَآ أَمۡلِكُ لَكُمۡ ضَرّٗا وَلَا رَشَدٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qul innee la amliku lakum darran wala rashadan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Say, "Indeed, I do not possess for you [the power of] harm or right direction."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Say, “It is not in my power to harm or benefit you.”

ayahs.textArabic: قُلۡ إِنِّي لَن يُجِيرَنِي مِنَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٞ وَلَنۡ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلۡتَحَدًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qul innee lan yujeeranee mina Allahi ahadun walan ajida min doonihi multahadan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Say, "Indeed, there will never protect me from Allah anyone [if I should disobey], nor will I find in other than Him a refuge.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Say, “No one can protect me from Allah ˹if I were to disobey Him˺, nor can I find any refuge other than Him.

ayahs.textArabic: إِلَّا بَلَٰغٗا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِسَٰلَٰتِهِۦۚ وَمَن يَعۡصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Illa balaghan mina Allahi warisalatihi waman yaAAsi Allaha warasoolahu fainna lahu nara jahannama khalideena feeha abadan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But [I have for you] only notification from Allah, and His messages." And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger - then indeed, for him is the fire of Hell; they will abide therein forever.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹My duty is˺ only to convey ˹the truth˺ from Allah and ˹deliver˺ His messages.” And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger will certainly be in the Fire of Hell, to stay there for ever and ever.

ayahs.textArabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوۡاْ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعۡلَمُونَ مَنۡ أَضۡعَفُ نَاصِرٗا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Hatta itha raaw ma yooAAadoona fasayaAAlamoona man adAAafu nasiran waaqallu AAadadan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [The disbelievers continue] until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and less in number.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Only when they see what they have been threatened with will they know who is weaker in helpers and inferior in manpower.

ayahs.textArabic: قُلۡ إِنۡ أَدۡرِيٓ أَقَرِيبٞ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمۡ يَجۡعَلُ لَهُۥ رَبِّيٓ أَمَدًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qul in adree aqareebun ma tooAAadoona am yajAAalu lahu rabbee amadan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Say, "I do not know if what you are promised is near or if my Lord will grant for it a [long] period."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Say, “I do not know if what you are promised is near or my Lord has set a distant time for it.

ayahs.textArabic: عَٰلِمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ فَلَا يُظۡهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيۡبِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: AAalimu alghaybi fala yuthhiru AAala ghaybihi ahadan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [He is] Knower of the unseen, and He does not disclose His [knowledge of the] unseen to anyone
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹He is the˺ Knower of the unseen, disclosing none of it to anyone,

ayahs.textArabic: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱرۡتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولٖ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَسۡلُكُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِ يَدَيۡهِ وَمِنۡ خَلۡفِهِۦ رَصَدٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Illa mani irtada min rasoolin fainnahu yasluku min bayni yadayhi wamin khalfihi rasadan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Except whom He has approved of messengers, and indeed, He sends before each messenger and behind him observers
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: except messengers of His choice. Then He appoints angel-guards before and behind them

ayahs.textArabic: لِّيَعۡلَمَ أَن قَدۡ أَبۡلَغُواْ رِسَٰلَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيۡهِمۡ وَأَحۡصَىٰ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ عَدَدَۢا
ayahs.textTransliteration: LiyaAAlama an qad ablaghoo risalati rabbihim waahata bima ladayhim waahsa kulla shayin AAadadan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: That he may know that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord; and He has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: to ensure that the messengers fully deliver the messages of their Lord—though He ˹already˺ knows all about them, and keeps account of everything.”

ayahs.textArabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡمُزَّمِّلُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ya ayyuha almuzzammilu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: O you who wraps himself [in clothing],
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: O you wrapped ˹in your clothes˺!

ayahs.textArabic: قُمِ ٱلَّيۡلَ إِلَّا قَلِيلٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qumi allayla illa qaleelan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Arise [to pray] the night, except for a little -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Stand all night ˹in prayer˺ except a little—

ayahs.textArabic: نِّصۡفَهُۥٓ أَوِ ٱنقُصۡ مِنۡهُ قَلِيلًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Nisfahu awi onqus minhu qaleelan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Half of it - or subtract from it a little
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹pray˺ half the night, or a little less,

ayahs.textArabic: أَوۡ زِدۡ عَلَيۡهِ وَرَتِّلِ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ تَرۡتِيلًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Aw zid AAalayhi warattili alqurana tarteelan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Or add to it, and recite the Qur'an with measured recitation.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: or a little more—and recite the Quran ˹properly˺ in a measured way.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّا سَنُلۡقِي عَلَيۡكَ قَوۡلٗا ثَقِيلًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna sanulqee AAalayka qawlan thaqeelan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, We will cast upon you a heavy word.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹For˺ We will soon send upon you a weighty revelation.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ ٱلَّيۡلِ هِيَ أَشَدُّ وَطۡـٔٗا وَأَقۡوَمُ قِيلًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna nashiata allayli hiya ashaddu watan waaqwamu qeelan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, the hours of the night are more effective for concurrence [of heart and tongue] and more suitable for words.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, worship in the night is more impactful and suitable for recitation.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ لَكَ فِي ٱلنَّهَارِ سَبۡحٗا طَوِيلٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna laka fee alnnahari sabhan taweelan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, for you by day is prolonged occupation.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: For during the day you are over-occupied ˹with worldly duties˺.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱذۡكُرِ ٱسۡمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلۡ إِلَيۡهِ تَبۡتِيلٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waothkuri isma rabbika watabattal ilayhi tabteelan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with [complete] devotion.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Always˺ remember the Name of your Lord, and devote yourself to Him wholeheartedly.

ayahs.textArabic: رَّبُّ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقِ وَٱلۡمَغۡرِبِ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱتَّخِذۡهُ وَكِيلٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Rabbu almashriqi waalmaghribi la ilaha illa huwa faittakhithhu wakeelan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [He is] the Lord of the East and the West; there is no deity except Him, so take Him as Disposer of [your] affairs.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹He is the˺ Lord of the east and the west. There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him, so take Him ˹alone˺ as a Trustee of Affairs.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱصۡبِرۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱهۡجُرۡهُمۡ هَجۡرٗا جَمِيلٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waisbir AAala ma yaqooloona waohjurhum hajran jameelan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And be patient over what they say and avoid them with gracious avoidance.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Be patient ˹O Prophet˺ with what they say, and depart from them courteously.

ayahs.textArabic: وَذَرۡنِي وَٱلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ أُوْلِي ٱلنَّعۡمَةِ وَمَهِّلۡهُمۡ قَلِيلًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Watharnee waalmukaththibeena olee alnnaAAmati wamahhilhum qaleelan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And leave Me with [the matter of] the deniers, those of ease [in life], and allow them respite a little.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And leave to Me the deniers—the people of luxury—and bear with them for a little while.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ لَدَيۡنَآ أَنكَالٗا وَجَحِيمٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna ladayna ankalan wajaheeman
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, with Us [for them] are shackles and burning fire
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹For˺ We certainly have shackles, a ˹raging˺ Fire,

ayahs.textArabic: وَطَعَامٗا ذَا غُصَّةٖ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: WataAAaman tha ghussatin waAAathaban aleeman
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And food that chokes and a painful punishment -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: choking food, and a painful punishment ˹in store for them˺

ayahs.textArabic: يَوۡمَ تَرۡجُفُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَٱلۡجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلۡجِبَالُ كَثِيبٗا مَّهِيلًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yawma tarjufu alardu waaljibalu wakanati aljibalu katheeban maheelan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: On the Day the earth and the mountains will convulse and the mountains will become a heap of sand pouring down.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: on the Day the earth and mountains will shake ˹violently˺, and mountains will be ˹reduced to˺ dunes of shifting sand.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡكُمۡ رَسُولٗا شَٰهِدًا عَلَيۡكُمۡ كَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ رَسُولٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna arsalna ilaykum rasoolan shahidan AAalaykum kama arsalna ila firAAawna rasoolan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness upon you just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, We have sent to you a messenger as a witness over you, just as We sent a messenger to Pharaoh.

ayahs.textArabic: فَعَصَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذۡنَٰهُ أَخۡذٗا وَبِيلٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: FaAAasa firAAawnu alrrasoola faakhathnahu akhthan wabeelan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a ruinous seizure.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a stern grip.

ayahs.textArabic: فَكَيۡفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرۡتُمۡ يَوۡمٗا يَجۡعَلُ ٱلۡوِلۡدَٰنَ شِيبًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fakayfa tattaqoona in kafartum yawman yajAAalu alwildana sheeban
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then how can you fear, if you disbelieve, a Day that will make the children white- haired?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: If you ˹pagans˺ persist in disbelief, then how will you guard yourselves against ˹the horrors of˺ a Day which will turn children’s hair grey?

ayahs.textArabic: ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرُۢ بِهِۦۚ كَانَ وَعۡدُهُۥ مَفۡعُولًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Alssamao munfatirun bihi kana waAAduhu mafAAoolan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The heaven will break apart therefrom; ever is His promise fulfilled.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: It will ˹even˺ cause the sky to split apart. His promise ˹of judgment˺ must be fulfilled.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذۡكِرَةٞۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna hathihi tathkiratun faman shaa ittakhatha ila rabbihi sabeelan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, this is a reminder, so whoever wills may take to his Lord a way.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Surely this is a reminder. So let whoever wills take the ˹Right˺ Way to their Lord.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعۡلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدۡنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَيِ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَنِصۡفَهُۥ وَثُلُثَهُۥ وَطَآئِفَةٞ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعَكَۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ ٱلَّيۡلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَۚ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحۡصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيۡكُمۡۖ فَٱقۡرَءُواْ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِۚ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرۡضَىٰ وَءَاخَرُونَ يَضۡرِبُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ يَبۡتَغُونَ مِن فَضۡلِ ٱللَّهِ وَءَاخَرُونَ يُقَٰتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِۖ فَٱقۡرَءُواْ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنۡهُۚ وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُواْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَقۡرِضُواْ ٱللَّهَ قَرۡضًا حَسَنٗاۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُواْ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنۡ خَيۡرٖ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيۡرٗا وَأَعۡظَمَ أَجۡرٗاۚ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرُواْ ٱللَّهَۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمُۢ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna rabbaka yaAAlamu annaka taqoomu adna min thuluthayi allayli wanisfahu wathuluthahu wataifatun mina allatheena maAAaka waAllahu yuqaddiru allayla waalnnahara AAalima an lan tuhsoohu fataba AAalaykum faiqraoo ma tayassara mina alqurani AAalima an sayakoonu minkum marda waakharoona yadriboona fee alardi yabtaghoona min fadli Allahi waakharoona yuqatiloona fee sabeeli Allahi faiqraoo ma tayassara minhu waaqeemoo alssalata waatoo alzzakata waaqridoo Allaha qardan hasanan wama tuqaddimoo lianfusikum min khayrin tajidoohu AAinda Allahi huwa khayran waaAAthama ajran waistaghfiroo Allaha inna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, your Lord knows, [O Muhammad], that you stand [in prayer] almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and [so do] a group of those with you. And Allah determines [the extent of] the night and the day. He has known that you [Muslims] will not be able to do it and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy [for you] of the Qur'an. He has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking [something] of the bounty of Allah and others fighting for the cause of Allah. So recite what is easy from it and establish prayer and give zakah and loan Allah a goodly loan. And whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allah. It is better and greater in reward. And seek forgiveness of Allah. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Surely your Lord knows that you ˹O Prophet˺ stand ˹in prayer˺ for nearly two-thirds of the night, or ˹sometimes˺ half of it, or a third, as do some of those with you. Allah ˹alone˺ keeps a ˹precise˺ measure of the day and night. He knows that you ˹believers˺ are unable to endure this, and has turned to you in mercy. So recite ˹in prayer˺ whatever you can from the Quran. He knows that some of you will be sick, some will be travelling throughout the land seeking Allah’s bounty, and some fighting in the cause of Allah. So recite whatever you can from it. And ˹continue to˺ perform ˹regular˺ prayers, pay alms-tax, and lend to Allah a good loan. Whatever good you send forth for yourselves, you will find it with Allah far better and more rewarding. And seek Allah’s forgiveness. Surely Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

ayahs.textArabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡمُدَّثِّرُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ya ayyuha almuddaththiru
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: O you who covers himself [with a garment],
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: O you covered up ˹in your clothes˺!

ayahs.textArabic: قُمۡ فَأَنذِرۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qum faanthir
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Arise and warn
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Arise and warn ˹all˺.

ayahs.textArabic: وَرَبَّكَ فَكَبِّرۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Warabbaka fakabbir
