ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And your Lord glorify
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Revere your Lord ˹alone˺.

ayahs.textArabic: وَثِيَابَكَ فَطَهِّرۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wathiyabaka fatahhir
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And your clothing purify
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Purify your garments.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلرُّجۡزَ فَٱهۡجُرۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalrrujza faohjur
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And uncleanliness avoid
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Continue to˺ shun idols.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَا تَمۡنُن تَسۡتَكۡثِرُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wala tamnun tastakthiru
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And do not confer favor to acquire more
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Do not do a favour expecting more ˹in return˺.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلِرَبِّكَ فَٱصۡبِرۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walirabbika faisbir
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But for your Lord be patient.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And persevere for ˹the sake of˺ your Lord.

ayahs.textArabic: فَإِذَا نُقِرَ فِي ٱلنَّاقُورِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faitha nuqira fee alnnaqoori
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when the trumpet is blown,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹For˺ when the Trumpet will be sounded,

ayahs.textArabic: فَذَٰلِكَ يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَوۡمٌ عَسِيرٌ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fathalika yawmaithin yawmun AAaseerun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: That Day will be a difficult day
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: that will ˹truly˺ be a difficult Day—

ayahs.textArabic: عَلَى ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ غَيۡرُ يَسِيرٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: AAala alkafireena ghayru yaseerin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: For the disbelievers - not easy.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: far from easy for the disbelievers.

ayahs.textArabic: ذَرۡنِي وَمَنۡ خَلَقۡتُ وَحِيدٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Tharnee waman khalaqtu waheedan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Leave Me with the one I created alone
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And leave to me ˹O Prophet˺ the one I created all by Myself,

ayahs.textArabic: وَجَعَلۡتُ لَهُۥ مَالٗا مَّمۡدُودٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: WajaAAaltu lahu malan mamdoodan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And to whom I granted extensive wealth
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and granted him abundant wealth,

ayahs.textArabic: وَبَنِينَ شُهُودٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wabaneena shuhoodan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And children present [with him]
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and children always by his side,

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَهَّدتُّ لَهُۥ تَمۡهِيدٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wamahhadtu lahu tamheedan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And spread [everything] before him, easing [his life].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and made life very easy for him.

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ يَطۡمَعُ أَنۡ أَزِيدَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thumma yatmaAAu an azeeda
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then he desires that I should add more.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Yet he is hungry for more.

ayahs.textArabic: كـَلَّآۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لِأٓيَٰتِنَا عَنِيدٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kalla innahu kana liayatina AAaneedan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: No! Indeed, he has been toward Our verses obstinate.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But no! ˹For˺ he has been truly stubborn with Our revelations.

ayahs.textArabic: سَأُرۡهِقُهُۥ صَعُودًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Saorhiquhu saAAoodan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: I will cover him with arduous torment.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: I will make his fate unbearable,

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّهُۥ فَكَّرَ وَقَدَّرَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innahu fakkara waqaddara
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, he thought and deliberated.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: for he contemplated and determined ˹a degrading label for the Quran˺.

ayahs.textArabic: فَقُتِلَ كَيۡفَ قَدَّرَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faqutila kayfa qaddara
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: May he be condemned! How evil was what he determined!

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ قُتِلَ كَيۡفَ قَدَّرَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thumma qutila kayfa qaddara
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: May he be condemned even more! How evil was what he determined!

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ نَظَرَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thumma nathara
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then he considered [again];
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then he re-contemplated ˹in frustration˺,

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ عَبَسَ وَبَسَرَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thumma AAabasa wabasara
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then he frowned and scowled;
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: then frowned and scowled,

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ أَدۡبَرَ وَٱسۡتَكۡبَرَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thumma adbara waistakbara
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then he turned back and was arrogant
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: then turned his back ˹on the truth˺ and acted arrogantly,

ayahs.textArabic: فَقَالَ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحۡرٞ يُؤۡثَرُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faqala in hatha illa sihrun yutharu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And said, "This is not but magic imitated [from others].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: saying, “This ˹Quran˺ is nothing but magic from the ancients.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا قَوۡلُ ٱلۡبَشَرِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: In hatha illa qawlu albashari
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: This is not but the word of a human being."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: This is no more than the word of a man.”

ayahs.textArabic: سَأُصۡلِيهِ سَقَرَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Saosleehi saqara
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: I will drive him into Saqar.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Soon I will burn him in Hell!

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا سَقَرُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama adraka ma saqaru
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And what can make you know what is Saqar?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And what will make you realize what Hell is?

ayahs.textArabic: لَا تُبۡقِي وَلَا تَذَرُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: La tubqee wala tatharu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: It lets nothing remain and leaves nothing [unburned],
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: It does not let anyone live or die,

ayahs.textArabic: لَوَّاحَةٞ لِّلۡبَشَرِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Lawwahatun lilbashari
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Blackening the skins.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: scorching the skin.

ayahs.textArabic: عَلَيۡهَا تِسۡعَةَ عَشَرَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: AAalayha tisAAata AAashara
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Over it are nineteen [angels].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: It is overseen by nineteen ˹keepers˺.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا جَعَلۡنَآ أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَٰٓئِكَةٗۖ وَمَا جَعَلۡنَا عِدَّتَهُمۡ إِلَّا فِتۡنَةٗ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِيَسۡتَيۡقِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَيَزۡدَادَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِيمَٰنٗا وَلَا يَرۡتَابَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ وَلِيَقُولَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٞ وَٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَٰذَا مَثَلٗاۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهۡدِي مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَمَا يَعۡلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَۚ وَمَا هِيَ إِلَّا ذِكۡرَىٰ لِلۡبَشَرِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama jaAAalna ashaba alnnari illa malaikatan wama jaAAalna AAiddatahum illa fitnatan lillatheena kafaroo liyastayqina allatheena ootoo alkitaba wayazdada allatheena amanoo eemanan wala yartaba allatheena ootoo alkitaba waalmuminoona waliyaqoola allatheena fee quloobihim maradun waalkafiroona matha arada Allahu bihatha mathalan kathalika yudillu Allahu man yashao wayahdee man yashao wama yaAAlamu junooda rabbika illa huwa wama hiya illa thikra lilbashari
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We have not made the keepers of the Fire except angels. And We have not made their number except as a trial for those who disbelieve - that those who were given the Scripture will be convinced and those who have believed will increase in faith and those who were given the Scripture and the believers will not doubt and that those in whose hearts is hypocrisy and the disbelievers will say, "What does Allah intend by this as an example?" Thus does Allah leave astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. And none knows the soldiers of your Lord except Him. And mention of the Fire is not but a reminder to humanity.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We have appointed only ˹stern˺ angels as wardens of the Fire. And We have made their number only as a test for the disbelievers, so that the People of the Book will be certain, and the believers will increase in faith, and neither the People of the Book nor the believers will have any doubts, and so that those ˹hypocrites˺ with sickness in their hearts and the disbelievers will argue, “What does Allah mean by such a number?” In this way Allah leaves whoever He wills to stray and guides whoever He wills. And none knows the forces of your Lord except He. And this ˹description of Hell˺ is only a reminder to humanity.

ayahs.textArabic: كـَلَّا وَٱلۡقَمَرِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kalla waalqamari
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: No! By the moon
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But no! By the moon,

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلَّيۡلِ إِذۡ أَدۡبَرَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waallayli ith adbara
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [by] the night when it departs
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and the night as it retreats,

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلصُّبۡحِ إِذَآ أَسۡفَرَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalssubhi itha asfara
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [by] the morning when it brightens,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and the day as it breaks!

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّهَا لَإِحۡدَى ٱلۡكُبَرِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innaha laihda alkubari
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, the Fire is of the greatest [afflictions]
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Surely Hell is one of the mightiest catastrophes—

ayahs.textArabic: نَذِيرٗا لِّلۡبَشَرِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Natheeran lilbashari
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: As a warning to humanity -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: a warning to humankind,

ayahs.textArabic: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمۡ أَن يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوۡ يَتَأَخَّرَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Liman shaa minkum an yataqaddama aw yataakhkhara
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: To whoever wills among you to proceed or stay behind.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: to whichever of you chooses to take the lead or lag behind.

ayahs.textArabic: كُلُّ نَفۡسِۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتۡ رَهِينَةٌ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kullu nafsin bima kasabat raheenatun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Every soul, for what it has earned, will be retained
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Every soul will be detained for what it has done,

ayahs.textArabic: إِلَّآ أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلۡيَمِينِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Illa ashaba alyameeni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Except the companions of the right,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: except the people of the right,

ayahs.textArabic: فِي جَنَّٰتٖ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fee jannatin yatasaaloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Who will be] in gardens, questioning each other
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: who will be in Gardens, asking one another

ayahs.textArabic: عَنِ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: AAani almujrimeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: About the criminals,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: about the wicked ˹who will then be asked˺:

ayahs.textArabic: مَا سَلَكَكُمۡ فِي سَقَرَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ma salakakum fee saqara
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [And asking them], "What put you into Saqar?"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: “What has landed you in Hell?”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُواْ لَمۡ نَكُ مِنَ ٱلۡمُصَلِّينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qaloo lam naku mina almusalleena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They will say, "We were not of those who prayed,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They will reply, “We were not of those who prayed,

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَمۡ نَكُ نُطۡعِمُ ٱلۡمِسۡكِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walam naku nutAAimu almiskeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Nor did we used to feed the poor.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: nor did we feed the poor.

ayahs.textArabic: وَكُنَّا نَخُوضُ مَعَ ٱلۡخَآئِضِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wakunna nakhoodu maAAa alkhaideena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And we used to enter into vain discourse with those who engaged [in it],
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We used to indulge ˹in falsehood˺ along with others,

ayahs.textArabic: وَكُنَّا نُكَذِّبُ بِيَوۡمِ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wakunna nukaththibu biyawmi alddeeni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And we used to deny the Day of Recompense
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and deny the Day of Judgment,

ayahs.textArabic: حَتَّىٰٓ أَتَىٰنَا ٱلۡيَقِينُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Hatta atana alyaqeenu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Until there came to us the certainty."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: until the inevitable came to us.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَمَا تَنفَعُهُمۡ شَفَٰعَةُ ٱلشَّٰفِعِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fama tanfaAAuhum shafaAAatu alshshafiAAeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So there will not benefit them the intercession of [any] intercessors.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So the pleas of intercessors will be of no benefit to them.

ayahs.textArabic: فَمَا لَهُمۡ عَنِ ٱلتَّذۡكِرَةِ مُعۡرِضِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fama lahum AAani alttathkirati muAArideena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then what is [the matter] with them that they are, from the reminder, turning away
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Now, what is the matter with them that they are turning away from the reminder,

ayahs.textArabic: كَأَنَّهُمۡ حُمُرٞ مُّسۡتَنفِرَةٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kaannahum humurun mustanfiratun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: As if they were alarmed donkeys
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: as if they were spooked zebras

ayahs.textArabic: فَرَّتۡ مِن قَسۡوَرَةِۭ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Farrat min qaswaratin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Fleeing from a lion?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: fleeing from a lion?

ayahs.textArabic: بَلۡ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ ٱمۡرِيٕٖ مِّنۡهُمۡ أَن يُؤۡتَىٰ صُحُفٗا مُّنَشَّرَةٗ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Bal yureedu kullu imriin minhum an yuta suhufan munashsharatan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Rather, every person among them desires that he would be given scriptures spread about.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: In fact, each one of them wishes to be given a ˹personal˺ letter ˹from Allah˺ for all ˹to read˺.

ayahs.textArabic: كـَلَّاۖ بَل لَّا يَخَافُونَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kalla bal la yakhafoona alakhirata
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: No! But they do not fear the Hereafter.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But no! In fact, they do not fear the Hereafter.

ayahs.textArabic: كـَلَّآ إِنَّهُۥ تَذۡكِرَةٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kalla innahu tathkiratun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: No! Indeed, the Qur'an is a reminder
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Enough! Surely this ˹Quran˺ is a reminder.

ayahs.textArabic: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faman shaa thakarahu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then whoever wills will remember it.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So let whoever wills be mindful of it.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا يَذۡكُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُۚ هُوَ أَهۡلُ ٱلتَّقۡوَىٰ وَأَهۡلُ ٱلۡمَغۡفِرَةِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama yathkuroona illa an yashaa Allahu huwa ahlu alttaqwa waahlu almaghfirati
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And they will not remember except that Allah wills. He is worthy of fear and adequate for [granting] forgiveness.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But they cannot do so unless Allah wills. He ˹alone˺ is worthy to be feared and entitled to forgive.

ayahs.textArabic: لَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِيَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: La oqsimu biyawmi alqiyamati
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: I swear by the Day of Resurrection
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: I do swear by the Day of Judgment!

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِٱلنَّفۡسِ ٱللَّوَّامَةِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wala oqsimu bialnnafsi allawwamati
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And I swear by the reproaching soul [to the certainty of resurrection].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And I do swear by the self-reproaching soul!

ayahs.textArabic: أَيَحۡسَبُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ أَلَّن نَّجۡمَعَ عِظَامَهُۥ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ayahsabu alinsanu allan najmaAAa AAithamahu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Does man think that We will not assemble his bones?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Do people think We cannot reassemble their bones?

ayahs.textArabic: بَلَىٰ قَٰدِرِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّسَوِّيَ بَنَانَهُۥ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Bala qadireena AAala an nusawwiya bananahu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Yes. [We are] Able [even] to proportion his fingertips.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Yes ˹indeed˺! We are ˹most˺ capable of restoring ˹even˺ their very fingertips.

ayahs.textArabic: بَلۡ يُرِيدُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ لِيَفۡجُرَ أَمَامَهُۥ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Bal yureedu alinsanu liyafjura amamahu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But man desires to continue in sin.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Still people want to deny what is yet to come,

ayahs.textArabic: يَسۡـَٔلُ أَيَّانَ يَوۡمُ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yasalu ayyana yawmu alqiyamati
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He asks, "When is the Day of Resurrection?"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: asking ˹mockingly˺, “When is this Day of Judgment?”

ayahs.textArabic: فَإِذَا بَرِقَ ٱلۡبَصَرُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faitha bariqa albasaru
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So when vision is dazzled
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But when the sight is stunned,

ayahs.textArabic: وَخَسَفَ ٱلۡقَمَرُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wakhasafa alqamaru
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the moon darkens
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and the moon is dimmed,

ayahs.textArabic: وَجُمِعَ ٱلشَّمۡسُ وَٱلۡقَمَرُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: WajumiAAa alshshamsu waalqamaru
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the sun and the moon are joined,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and the sun and the moon are brought together,

ayahs.textArabic: يَقُولُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ يَوۡمَئِذٍ أَيۡنَ ٱلۡمَفَرُّ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yaqoolu alinsanu yawmaithin ayna almafarru
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Man will say on that Day, "Where is the [place of] escape?"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: on that Day one will cry, “Where is the escape?”

ayahs.textArabic: كـَلَّا لَا وَزَرَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kalla la wazara
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: No! There is no refuge.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But no! There will be no refuge.

ayahs.textArabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوۡمَئِذٍ ٱلۡمُسۡتَقَرُّ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ila rabbika yawmaithin almustaqarru
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: To your Lord, that Day, is the [place of] permanence.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: On that Day all will end up before your Lord.

ayahs.textArabic: يُنَبَّؤُاْ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ يَوۡمَئِذِۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yunabbao alinsanu yawmaithin bima qaddama waakhkhara
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Man will be informed that Day of what he sent ahead and kept back.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: All will then be informed of what they have sent forth and left behind.

ayahs.textArabic: بَلِ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ عَلَىٰ نَفۡسِهِۦ بَصِيرَةٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Bali alinsanu AAala nafsihi baseeratun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Rather, man, against himself, will be a witness,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: In fact, people will testify against their own souls,

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَوۡ أَلۡقَىٰ مَعَاذِيرَهُۥ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walaw alqa maAAatheerahu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Even if he presents his excuses.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: despite the excuses they come up with.

ayahs.textArabic: لَا تُحَرِّكۡ بِهِۦ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعۡجَلَ بِهِۦٓ
ayahs.textTransliteration: La tuharrik bihi lisanaka litaAAjala bihi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Move not your tongue with it, [O Muhammad], to hasten with recitation of the Qur'an.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Do not rush your tongue trying to memorize ˹a revelation of˺ the Quran.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ عَلَيۡنَا جَمۡعَهُۥ وَقُرۡءَانَهُۥ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna AAalayna jamAAahu waquranahu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, upon Us is its collection [in your heart] and [to make possible] its recitation.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: It is certainly upon Us to ˹make you˺ memorize and recite it.

ayahs.textArabic: فَإِذَا قَرَأۡنَٰهُ فَٱتَّبِعۡ قُرۡءَانَهُۥ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faitha qaranahu faittabiAA quranahu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So when We have recited it [through Gabriel], then follow its recitation.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So once We have recited a revelation ˹through Gabriel˺, follow its recitation ˹closely˺.

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيۡنَا بَيَانَهُۥ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thumma inna AAalayna bayanahu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then upon Us is its clarification [to you].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then it is surely upon Us to make it clear ˹to you˺.

ayahs.textArabic: كـَلَّا بَلۡ تُحِبُّونَ ٱلۡعَاجِلَةَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kalla bal tuhibboona alAAajilata
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: No! But you love the immediate
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But no! In fact, you love this fleeting world,

ayahs.textArabic: وَتَذَرُونَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Watatharoona alakhirata
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And leave the Hereafter.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and neglect the Hereafter.

ayahs.textArabic: وُجُوهٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ نَّاضِرَةٌ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wujoohun yawmaithin nadiratun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Some] faces, that Day, will be radiant,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: On that Day ˹some˺ faces will be bright,

ayahs.textArabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ila rabbiha nathiratun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Looking at their Lord.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: looking at their Lord.

ayahs.textArabic: وَوُجُوهٞ يَوۡمَئِذِۭ بَاسِرَةٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wawujoohun yawmaithin basiratun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [some] faces, that Day, will be contorted,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And ˹other˺ faces will be gloomy,

ayahs.textArabic: تَظُنُّ أَن يُفۡعَلَ بِهَا فَاقِرَةٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Tathunnu an yufAAala biha faqiratun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Expecting that there will be done to them [something] backbreaking.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: anticipating something devastating to befall them.

ayahs.textArabic: كـَلَّآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلتَّرَاقِيَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kalla itha balaghati alttaraqiya
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: No! When the soul has reached the collar bones
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But no! ˹Beware of the day˺ when the soul reaches the collar bone ˹as it leaves˺,

ayahs.textArabic: وَقِيلَ مَنۡۜ رَاقٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waqeela man raqin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And it is said, "Who will cure [him]?"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and it will be said, “Is there any healer ˹who can save this life˺?”

ayahs.textArabic: وَظَنَّ أَنَّهُ ٱلۡفِرَاقُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wathanna annahu alfiraqu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the dying one is certain that it is the [time of] separation
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And the dying person realizes it is ˹their˺ time to depart,

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلۡتَفَّتِ ٱلسَّاقُ بِٱلسَّاقِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wailtaffati alssaqu bialssaqi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the leg is wound about the leg,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and ˹then˺ their feet are tied together ˹in a shroud˺.

ayahs.textArabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوۡمَئِذٍ ٱلۡمَسَاقُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ila rabbika yawmaithin almasaqu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: To your Lord, that Day, will be the procession.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: On that day they will be driven to your Lord ˹alone˺.

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fala saddaqa wala salla
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the disbeliever had not believed, nor had he prayed.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: This denier neither believed nor prayed,

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَٰكِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walakin kaththaba watawalla
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But [instead], he denied and turned away.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: but persisted in denial and turned away,

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِۦ يَتَمَطَّىٰٓ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thumma thahaba ila ahlihi yatamatta
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And then he went to his people, swaggering [in pride].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: then went to their own people, walking boastfully.

ayahs.textArabic: أَوۡلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوۡلَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Awla laka faawla
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Woe to you, and woe!
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Woe to you, and more woe!

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ أَوۡلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوۡلَىٰٓ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thumma awla laka faawla
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then woe to you, and woe!
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Again, woe to you, and even more woe!

ayahs.textArabic: أَيَحۡسَبُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ أَن يُتۡرَكَ سُدًى
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ayahsabu alinsanu an yutraka sudan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Does man think that he will be left neglected?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Do people think they will be left without purpose?

ayahs.textArabic: أَلَمۡ يَكُ نُطۡفَةٗ مِّن مَّنِيّٖ يُمۡنَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Alam yaku nutfatan min manayyin yumna
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Had he not been a sperm from semen emitted?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Were they not ˹once˺ a sperm-drop emitted?

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةٗ فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thumma kana AAalaqatan fakhalaqa fasawwa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then he was a clinging clot, and [Allah] created [his form] and proportioned [him]
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then they became a clinging clot ˹of blood˺, then He developed and perfected their form,

ayahs.textArabic: فَجَعَلَ مِنۡهُ ٱلزَّوۡجَيۡنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلۡأُنثَىٰٓ
ayahs.textTransliteration: FajaAAala minhu alzzawjayni alththakara waalontha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And made of him two mates, the male and the female.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: producing from it both sexes, male and female.

ayahs.textArabic: أَلَيۡسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحۡـِۧيَ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Alaysa thalika biqadirin AAala an yuhyiya almawta
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Is not that [Creator] Able to give life to the dead?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Is such ˹a Creator˺ unable to bring the dead back to life?

ayahs.textArabic: هَلۡ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلۡإِنسَٰنِ حِينٞ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهۡرِ لَمۡ يَكُن شَيۡـٔٗا مَّذۡكُورًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Hal ata AAala alinsani heenun mina alddahri lam yakun shayan mathkooran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Has there [not] come upon man a period of time when he was not a thing [even] mentioned?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Is there not a period of time when each human is nothing yet worth mentioning?

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطۡفَةٍ أَمۡشَاجٖ نَّبۡتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُ سَمِيعَۢا بَصِيرًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna khalaqna alinsana min nutfatin amshajin nabtaleehi fajaAAalnahu sameeAAan baseeran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, We created man from a sperm-drop mixture that We may try him; and We made him hearing and seeing.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹For˺ indeed, We ˹alone˺ created humans from a drop of mixed fluids, ˹in order˺ to test them, so We made them hear and see.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّا هَدَيۡنَٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرٗا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna hadaynahu alssabeela imma shakiran waimma kafooran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, We guided him to the way, be he grateful or be he ungrateful.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We already showed them the Way, whether they ˹choose to˺ be grateful or ungrateful.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّآ أَعۡتَدۡنَا لِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ سَلَٰسِلَاْ وَأَغۡلَٰلٗا وَسَعِيرًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna aAAtadna lilkafireena salasila waaghlalan wasaAAeeran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains and shackles and a blaze.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains, shackles, and a blazing Fire.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارَ يَشۡرَبُونَ مِن كَأۡسٖ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna alabrara yashraboona min kasin kana mizajuha kafooran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, the righteous will drink from a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of Kafur,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, the virtuous will have a drink ˹of pure wine˺—flavoured with camphor—

ayahs.textArabic: عَيۡنٗا يَشۡرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفۡجِيرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: AAaynan yashrabu biha AAibadu Allahi yufajjiroonaha tafjeeran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: A spring of which the [righteous] servants of Allah will drink; they will make it gush forth in force [and abundance].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹from˺ a spring where Allah’s servants will drink, flowing at their will.

ayahs.textArabic: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذۡرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوۡمٗا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسۡتَطِيرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yoofoona bialnnathri wayakhafoona yawman kana sharruhu mustateeran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They [are those who] fulfill [their] vows and fear a Day whose evil will be widespread.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They ˹are those who˺ fulfil ˹their˺ vows and fear a Day of sweeping horror,

ayahs.textArabic: وَيُطۡعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسۡكِينٗا وَيَتِيمٗا وَأَسِيرًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: WayutAAimona alttaAAama AAala hubbihi miskeenan wayateeman waaseeran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And they give food in spite of love for it to the needy, the orphan, and the captive,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and give food—despite their desire for it—to the poor, the orphan, and the captive,

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّمَا نُطۡعِمُكُمۡ لِوَجۡهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمۡ جَزَآءٗ وَلَا شُكُورًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innama nutAAimukum liwajhi Allahi la nureedu minkum jazaan wala shukooran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Saying], "We feed you only for the countenance of Allah. We wish not from you reward or gratitude.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹saying to themselves,˺ “We feed you only for the sake of Allah, seeking neither reward nor thanks from you.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوۡمًا عَبُوسٗا قَمۡطَرِيرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna nakhafu min rabbina yawman AAaboosan qamtareeran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, We fear from our Lord a Day austere and distressful."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We fear from our Lord a horribly distressful Day.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمۡ نَضۡرَةٗ وَسُرُورٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fawaqahumu Allahu sharra thalika alyawmi walaqqahum nadratan wasurooran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So Allah will protect them from the evil of that Day and give them radiance and happiness
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So Allah will deliver them from the horror of that Day, and grant them radiance and joy,

ayahs.textArabic: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُواْ جَنَّةٗ وَحَرِيرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wajazahum bima sabaroo jannatan wahareeran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And will reward them for what they patiently endured [with] a garden [in Paradise] and silk [garments].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and reward them for their perseverance with a Garden ˹in Paradise˺ and ˹garments of˺ silk.

ayahs.textArabic: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلۡأَرَآئِكِۖ لَا يَرَوۡنَ فِيهَا شَمۡسٗا وَلَا زَمۡهَرِيرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Muttakieena feeha AAala alaraiki la yarawna feeha shamsan wala zamhareeran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [They will be] reclining therein on adorned couches. They will not see therein any [burning] sun or [freezing] cold.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: There they will be reclining on ˹canopied˺ couches, never seeing scorching heat or bitter cold.

ayahs.textArabic: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيۡهِمۡ ظِلَٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتۡ قُطُوفُهَا تَذۡلِيلٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wadaniyatan AAalayhim thilaluha wathullilat qutoofuha tathleelan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And near above them are its shades, and its [fruit] to be picked will be lowered in compliance.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The Garden’s shade will be right above them, and its fruit will be made very easy to reach.

ayahs.textArabic: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيۡهِم بِـَٔانِيَةٖ مِّن فِضَّةٖ وَأَكۡوَابٖ كَانَتۡ قَوَارِيرَا۠
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wayutafu AAalayhim bianiyatin min fiddatin waakwabin kanat qawareera
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And there will be circulated among them vessels of silver and cups having been [created] clear [as glass],
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They will be waited on with silver vessels and cups of crystal—

ayahs.textArabic: قَوَارِيرَاْ مِن فِضَّةٖ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقۡدِيرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qawareera min fiddatin qaddarooha taqdeeran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Clear glasses [made] from silver of which they have determined the measure.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: crystalline silver, filled precisely as desired.

ayahs.textArabic: وَيُسۡقَوۡنَ فِيهَا كَأۡسٗا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wayusqawna feeha kasan kana mizajuha zanjabeelan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And they will be given to drink a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of ginger
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And they will be given a drink ˹of pure wine˺ flavoured with ginger

ayahs.textArabic: عَيۡنٗا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلۡسَبِيلٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: AAaynan feeha tusamma salsabeelan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [From] a fountain within Paradise named Salsabeel.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: from a spring there, called Salsabîl.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وِلۡدَٰنٞ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيۡتَهُمۡ حَسِبۡتَهُمۡ لُؤۡلُؤٗا مَّنثُورٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wayatoofu AAalayhim wildanun mukhalladoona itha raaytahum hasibtahum luluan manthooran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal. When you see them, you would think them [as beautiful as] scattered pearls.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They will be waited on by eternal youths. If you saw them, you would think they were scattered pearls.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِذَا رَأَيۡتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيۡتَ نَعِيمٗا وَمُلۡكٗا كَبِيرًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waitha raayta thamma raayta naAAeeman wamulkan kabeeran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when you look there [in Paradise], you will see pleasure and great dominion.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And if you looked around, you would see ˹indescribable˺ bliss and a vast kingdom.

ayahs.textArabic: عَٰلِيَهُمۡ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضۡرٞ وَإِسۡتَبۡرَقٞۖ وَحُلُّوٓاْ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٖ وَسَقَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ شَرَابٗا طَهُورًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: AAaliyahum thiyabu sundusin khudrun waistabraqun wahulloo asawira min fiddatin wasaqahum rabbuhum sharaban tahooran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Upon the inhabitants will be green garments of fine silk and brocade. And they will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The virtuous will be ˹dressed˺ in garments of fine green silk and rich brocade, and adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمۡ جَزَآءٗ وَكَانَ سَعۡيُكُم مَّشۡكُورًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna hatha kana lakum jazaan wakana saAAyukum mashkooran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [And it will be said], "Indeed, this is for you a reward, and your effort has been appreciated."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹And they will be told,˺ “All this is surely a reward for you. Your striving has been appreciated.”

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نَزَّلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ تَنزِيلٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna nahnu nazzalna AAalayka alqurana tanzeelan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, it is We who have sent down to you, [O Muhammad], the Qur'an progressively.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, it is We Who have revealed the Quran to you ˹O Prophet˺ in stages.

ayahs.textArabic: فَٱصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعۡ مِنۡهُمۡ ءَاثِمًا أَوۡ كَفُورٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faisbir lihukmi rabbika wala tutiAA minhum athiman aw kafooran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So be patient for the decision of your Lord and do not obey from among them a sinner or ungrateful [disbeliever].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So be patient with your Lord’s decree, and do not yield to any evildoer or ˹staunch˺ disbeliever from among them.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱذۡكُرِ ٱسۡمَ رَبِّكَ بُكۡرَةٗ وَأَصِيلٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waothkuri isma rabbika bukratan waaseelan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And mention the name of your Lord [in prayer] morning and evening
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Always˺ remember the Name of your Lord morning and evening,

ayahs.textArabic: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ فَٱسۡجُدۡ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحۡهُ لَيۡلٗا طَوِيلًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wamina allayli faosjud lahu wasabbihhu laylan taweelan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And during the night prostrate to Him and exalt Him a long [part of the] night.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and prostrate before Him during part of the night, and glorify Him long at night.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلۡعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمۡ يَوۡمٗا ثَقِيلٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna haolai yuhibboona alAAajilata wayatharoona waraahum yawman thaqeelan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, these [disbelievers] love the immediate and leave behind them a grave Day.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Surely those ˹pagans˺ love this fleeting world, ˹totally˺ neglecting a weighty Day ahead of them.

ayahs.textArabic: نَّحۡنُ خَلَقۡنَٰهُمۡ وَشَدَدۡنَآ أَسۡرَهُمۡۖ وَإِذَا شِئۡنَا بَدَّلۡنَآ أَمۡثَٰلَهُمۡ تَبۡدِيلًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Nahnu khalaqnahum washadadna asrahum waitha shina baddalna amthalahum tabdeelan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: We have created them and strengthened their forms, and when We will, We can change their likenesses with [complete] alteration.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: It is We Who created them and perfected their ˹physical˺ form. But if We will, We can easily replace them with others.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذۡكِرَةٞۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna hathihi tathkiratun faman shaa ittakhatha ila rabbihi sabeelan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, this is a reminder, so he who wills may take to his Lord a way.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Surely this is a reminder. So let whoever wills take the ˹Right˺ Way to their Lord.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama tashaoona illa an yashaa Allahu inna Allaha kana AAaleeman hakeeman
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And you do not will except that Allah wills. Indeed, Allah is ever Knowing and Wise.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But you cannot will ˹to do so˺ unless Allah wills. Indeed, Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.

ayahs.textArabic: يُدۡخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِي رَحۡمَتِهِۦۚ وَٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمۡ عَذَابًا أَلِيمَۢا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yudkhilu man yashao fee rahmatihi waalththalimeena aAAadda lahum AAathaban aleeman
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He admits whom He wills into His mercy; but the wrongdoers - He has prepared for them a painful punishment.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He admits whoever He wills into His mercy. As for the wrongdoers, He has prepared for them a painful punishment

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلۡمُرۡسَلَٰتِ عُرۡفٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalmursalati AAurfan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: By those [winds] sent forth in gusts
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: By those ˹winds˺ sent forth successively,

ayahs.textArabic: فَٱلۡعَٰصِفَٰتِ عَصۡفٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: FaalAAasifati AAasfan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the winds that blow violently
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and those blowing violently,

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلنَّٰشِرَٰتِ نَشۡرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalnnashirati nashran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [by] the winds that spread [clouds]
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and those scattering ˹rainclouds˺ widely!

ayahs.textArabic: فَٱلۡفَٰرِقَٰتِ فَرۡقٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faalfariqati farqan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And those [angels] who bring criterion
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And ˹by˺ those ˹angels˺ fully distinguishing ˹truth from falsehood˺,

ayahs.textArabic: فَٱلۡمُلۡقِيَٰتِ ذِكۡرًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faalmulqiyati thikran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And those [angels] who deliver a message
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and those delivering revelation,

ayahs.textArabic: عُذۡرًا أَوۡ نُذۡرًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: AAuthran aw nuthran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: As justification or warning,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ending excuses and giving warnings.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَوَٰقِعٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innama tooAAadoona lawaqiAAun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, what you are promised is to occur.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Surely, what you are promised will come to pass.

ayahs.textArabic: فَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ طُمِسَتۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faitha alnnujoomu tumisat
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So when the stars are obliterated
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So when the stars are put out,

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ فُرِجَتۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waitha alssamao furijat
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when the heaven is opened
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and the sky is torn apart,

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِذَا ٱلۡجِبَالُ نُسِفَتۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waitha aljibalu nusifat
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when the mountains are blown away
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and the mountains are blown away,

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِذَا ٱلرُّسُلُ أُقِّتَتۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waitha alrrusulu oqqitat
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when the messengers' time has come...
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and the messengers’ time ˹to testify˺ comes up—

ayahs.textArabic: لِأَيِّ يَوۡمٍ أُجِّلَتۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Liayyi yawmin ojjilat
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: For what Day was it postponed?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: for which Day has all this been set?

ayahs.textArabic: لِيَوۡمِ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Liyawmi alfasli
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: For the Day of Judgement.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: For the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision!

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا يَوۡمُ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama adraka ma yawmu alfasli
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And what can make you know what is the Day of Judgement?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And what will make you realize what the Day of Decision is?

ayahs.textArabic: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Woe on that Day to the deniers!

ayahs.textArabic: أَلَمۡ نُهۡلِكِ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Alam nuhliki alawwaleena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Did We not destroy the former peoples?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Did We not destroy earlier disbelievers?

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ نُتۡبِعُهُمُ ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thumma nutbiAAuhumu alakhireena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then We will follow them with the later ones.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And We will make the later disbelievers follow them.

ayahs.textArabic: كَذَٰلِكَ نَفۡعَلُ بِٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kathalika nafAAalu bialmujrimeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Thus do We deal with the criminals.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: This is how We deal with the wicked.

ayahs.textArabic: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Woe on that Day to the deniers!

ayahs.textArabic: أَلَمۡ نَخۡلُقكُّم مِّن مَّآءٖ مَّهِينٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Alam nakhluqkum min main maheenin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Did We not create you from a liquid disdained?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Did We not create you from a humble fluid,

ayahs.textArabic: فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُ فِي قَرَارٖ مَّكِينٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: FajaAAalnahu fee qararin makeenin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We placed it in a firm lodging
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: placing it in a secure place

ayahs.textArabic: إِلَىٰ قَدَرٖ مَّعۡلُومٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ila qadarin maAAloomin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: For a known extent.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: until an appointed time?

ayahs.textArabic: فَقَدَرۡنَا فَنِعۡمَ ٱلۡقَٰدِرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faqadarna faniAAma alqadiroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We determined [it], and excellent [are We] to determine.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We ˹perfectly˺ ordained ˹its development˺. How excellent are We in doing so!

ayahs.textArabic: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Woe on that Day to the deniers!

ayahs.textArabic: أَلَمۡ نَجۡعَلِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ كِفَاتًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Alam najAAali alarda kifatan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Have We not made the earth a container
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Have We not made the earth a lodging

ayahs.textArabic: أَحۡيَآءٗ وَأَمۡوَٰتٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ahyaan waamwatan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Of the living and the dead?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: for the living and the dead,

ayahs.textArabic: وَجَعَلۡنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِيَ شَٰمِخَٰتٖ وَأَسۡقَيۡنَٰكُم مَّآءٗ فُرَاتٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: WajaAAalna feeha rawasiya shamikhatin waasqaynakum maan furatan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We placed therein lofty, firmly set mountains and have given you to drink sweet water.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and placed upon it towering, firm mountains, and given you fresh water to drink?

ayahs.textArabic: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Woe on that Day to the deniers!

ayahs.textArabic: ٱنطَلِقُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Intaliqoo ila ma kuntum bihi tukaththiboona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [They will be told], "Proceed to that which you used to deny.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹The disbelievers will be told,˺ “Proceed into that ˹Fire˺ which you used to deny!

ayahs.textArabic: ٱنطَلِقُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ ظِلّٖ ذِي ثَلَٰثِ شُعَبٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Intaliqoo ila thillin thee thalathi shuAAabin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Proceed to a shadow [of smoke] having three columns
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Proceed into the shade ˹of smoke˺ which rises in three columns,

ayahs.textArabic: لَّا ظَلِيلٖ وَلَا يُغۡنِي مِنَ ٱللَّهَبِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: La thaleelin wala yughnee mina allahabi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [But having] no cool shade and availing not against the flame."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: providing neither coolness nor shelter from the flames.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّهَا تَرۡمِي بِشَرَرٖ كَٱلۡقَصۡرِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innaha tarmee bishararin kaalqasri
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, it throws sparks [as huge] as a fortress,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, it hurls sparks ˹as big˺ as huge castles,

ayahs.textArabic: كَأَنَّهُۥ جِمَٰلَتٞ صُفۡرٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kaannahu jimalatun sufrun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: As if they were yellowish [black] camels.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and ˹as dark˺ as black camels.”

ayahs.textArabic: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Woe on that Day to the deniers!

ayahs.textArabic: هَٰذَا يَوۡمُ لَا يَنطِقُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Hatha yawmu la yantiqoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: This is a Day they will not speak,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: On that Day they will not ˹be in a position to˺ speak,

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَا يُؤۡذَنُ لَهُمۡ فَيَعۡتَذِرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wala yuthanu lahum fayaAAtathiroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Nor will it be permitted for them to make an excuse.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: nor will they be permitted to offer excuses.

ayahs.textArabic: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Woe on that Day to the deniers!

ayahs.textArabic: هَٰذَا يَوۡمُ ٱلۡفَصۡلِۖ جَمَعۡنَٰكُمۡ وَٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Hatha yawmu alfasli jamaAAnakum waalawwaleena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: This is the Day of Judgement; We will have assembled you and the former peoples.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹They will be told by Allah,˺ “This is the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision: We have gathered you along with earlier disbelievers ˹for punishment˺.

ayahs.textArabic: فَإِن كَانَ لَكُمۡ كَيۡدٞ فَكِيدُونِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fain kana lakum kaydun fakeedooni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So if you have a plan, then plan against Me.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So if you have a scheme ˹to save yourselves˺, then use it against Me.”

ayahs.textArabic: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Woe on that Day to the deniers!

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي ظِلَٰلٖ وَعُيُونٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna almuttaqeena fee thilalin waAAuyoonin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, the righteous will be among shades and springs
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, the righteous will be amid ˹cool˺ shade and springs

ayahs.textArabic: وَفَوَٰكِهَ مِمَّا يَشۡتَهُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wafawakiha mimma yashtahoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And fruits from whatever they desire,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and any fruit they desire.

ayahs.textArabic: كُلُواْ وَٱشۡرَبُواْ هَنِيٓـَٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kuloo waishraboo haneean bima kuntum taAAmaloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Being told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹They will be told,˺ “Eat and drink happily for what you used to do.”

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna kathalika najzee almuhsineena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Surely this is how We reward the good-doers.

ayahs.textArabic: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹But˺ woe on that Day to the deniers!

ayahs.textArabic: كُلُواْ وَتَمَتَّعُواْ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكُم مُّجۡرِمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kuloo watamattaAAoo qaleelan innakum mujrimoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [O disbelievers], eat and enjoy yourselves a little; indeed, you are criminals.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: “Eat and enjoy yourselves for a little while, ˹for˺ you are truly wicked.”

ayahs.textArabic: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Woe on that Day to the deniers!

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱرۡكَعُواْ لَا يَرۡكَعُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waitha qeela lahumu irkaAAoo la yarkaAAoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when it is said to them, "Bow [in prayer]," they do not bow.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: When it is said to them, “Bow down ˹before Allah,” they do not bow.

ayahs.textArabic: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Woe on that Day to the deniers!

ayahs.textArabic: فَبِأَيِّ حَدِيثِۭ بَعۡدَهُۥ يُؤۡمِنُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fabiayyi hadeethin baAAdahu yuminoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then in what statement after the Qur'an will they believe?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So what message after this ˹Quran˺ would they believe in?

ayahs.textArabic: عَمَّ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: AAamma yatasaaloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: About what are they asking one another?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: What are they asking one another about?

ayahs.textArabic: عَنِ ٱلنَّبَإِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: AAani alnnabai alAAatheemi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: About the great news -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: About the momentous news,

ayahs.textArabic: ٱلَّذِي هُمۡ فِيهِ مُخۡتَلِفُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Allathee hum feehi mukhtalifoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: That over which they are in disagreement.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: over which they disagree.

ayahs.textArabic: كـَلَّا سَيَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kalla sayaAAlamoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: No! They are going to know.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But no! They will come to know.

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ كـَلَّا سَيَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thumma kalla sayaAAlamoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then, no! They are going to know.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Again, no! They will come to know.

ayahs.textArabic: أَلَمۡ نَجۡعَلِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ مِهَٰدٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Alam najAAali alarda mihadan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Have We not made the earth a resting place?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Have We not smoothed out the earth ˹like a bed˺,

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلۡجِبَالَ أَوۡتَادٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waaljibala awtadan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the mountains as stakes?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and ˹made˺ the mountains as ˹its˺ pegs,

ayahs.textArabic: وَخَلَقۡنَٰكُمۡ أَزۡوَٰجٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wakhalaqnakum azwajan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We created you in pairs
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and created you in pairs,

ayahs.textArabic: وَجَعَلۡنَا نَوۡمَكُمۡ سُبَاتٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: WajaAAalna nawmakum subatan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And made your sleep [a means for] rest
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and made your sleep for rest,

ayahs.textArabic: وَجَعَلۡنَا ٱلَّيۡلَ لِبَاسٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: WajaAAalna allayla libasan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And made the night as clothing
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and made the night as a cover,

ayahs.textArabic: وَجَعَلۡنَا ٱلنَّهَارَ مَعَاشٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: WajaAAalna alnnahara maAAashan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And made the day for livelihood
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and made the day for livelihood,

ayahs.textArabic: وَبَنَيۡنَا فَوۡقَكُمۡ سَبۡعٗا شِدَادٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wabanayna fawqakum sabAAan shidadan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And constructed above you seven strong [heavens]
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and built above you seven mighty ˹heavens˺,

ayahs.textArabic: وَجَعَلۡنَا سِرَاجٗا وَهَّاجٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: WajaAAalna sirajan wahhajan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And made [therein] a burning lamp
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and placed ˹in them˺ a shining lamp,

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَنزَلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلۡمُعۡصِرَٰتِ مَآءٗ ثَجَّاجٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waanzalna mina almuAAsirati maan thajjajan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And sent down, from the rain clouds, pouring water
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and sent down from rainclouds pouring water,

ayahs.textArabic: لِّنُخۡرِجَ بِهِۦ حَبّٗا وَنَبَاتٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Linukhrija bihi habban wanabatan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: That We may bring forth thereby grain and vegetation
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: producing by it grain and ˹various˺ plants,

ayahs.textArabic: وَجَنَّٰتٍ أَلۡفَافًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wajannatin alfafan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And gardens of entwined growth.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and dense orchards?

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ كَانَ مِيقَٰتٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna yawma alfasli kana meeqatan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is an appointed time -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision is an appointed time—

ayahs.textArabic: يَوۡمَ يُنفَخُ فِي ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأۡتُونَ أَفۡوَاجٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yawma yunfakhu fee alssoori fatatoona afwajan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The Day the Horn is blown and you will come forth in multitudes
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹it is˺ the Day the Trumpet will be blown, and you will ˹all˺ come forth in crowds.

ayahs.textArabic: وَفُتِحَتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتۡ أَبۡوَٰبٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wafutihati alssamao fakanat abwaban
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the heaven is opened and will become gateways
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The sky will be ˹split˺ open, becoming ˹many˺ gates,

ayahs.textArabic: وَسُيِّرَتِ ٱلۡجِبَالُ فَكَانَتۡ سَرَابًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wasuyyirati aljibalu fakanat saraban
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the mountains are removed and will be [but] a mirage.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and the mountains will be blown away, becoming ˹like˺ a mirage.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ كَانَتۡ مِرۡصَادٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna jahannama kanat mirsadan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, Hell is lying in ambush

ayahs.textArabic: لِّلطَّٰغِينَ مَـَٔابٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Lilttagheena maaban
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: For the transgressors, a place of return,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: as a home for the transgressors,

ayahs.textArabic: لَّٰبِثِينَ فِيهَآ أَحۡقَابٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Labitheena feeha ahqaban
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: In which they will remain for ages [unending].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: where they will remain for ˹endless˺ ages.

ayahs.textArabic: لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرۡدٗا وَلَا شَرَابًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: La yathooqoona feeha bardan wala sharaban
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They will not taste therein [any] coolness or drink
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: There they will not taste any coolness or drink,

ayahs.textArabic: إِلَّا حَمِيمٗا وَغَسَّاقٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Illa hameeman waghassaqan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Except scalding water and [foul] purulence -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: except boiling water and ˹oozing˺ pus—

ayahs.textArabic: جَزَآءٗ وِفَاقًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Jazaan wifaqan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: An appropriate recompense.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: a fitting reward.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ لَا يَرۡجُونَ حِسَابٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innahum kanoo la yarjoona hisaban
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, they were not expecting an account
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: For they never expected any reckoning,

ayahs.textArabic: وَكَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كِذَّابٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wakaththaboo biayatina kiththaban
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And denied Our verses with [emphatic] denial.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and totally rejected Our signs.

ayahs.textArabic: وَكُلَّ شَيۡءٍ أَحۡصَيۡنَٰهُ كِتَٰبٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wakulla shayin ahsaynahu kitaban
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But all things We have enumerated in writing.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And We have everything recorded precisely.

ayahs.textArabic: فَذُوقُواْ فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمۡ إِلَّا عَذَابًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fathooqoo falan nazeedakum illa AAathaban
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: "So taste [the penalty], and never will We increase you except in torment."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹So the deniers will be told,˺ “Taste ˹the punishment˺, for all you will get from Us is more torment.”

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna lilmuttaqeena mafazan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, for the righteous is attainment -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, the righteous will have salvation—

ayahs.textArabic: حَدَآئِقَ وَأَعۡنَٰبٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Hadaiqa waaAAnaban
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Gardens and grapevines
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Gardens, vineyards,

ayahs.textArabic: وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتۡرَابٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: WakawaAAiba atraban
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And full-breasted [companions] of equal age
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and full-bosomed maidens of equal age,

ayahs.textArabic: وَكَأۡسٗا دِهَاقٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wakasan dihaqan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And a full cup.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and full cups ˹of pure wine˺,

ayahs.textArabic: لَّا يَسۡمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغۡوٗا وَلَا كِذَّٰبٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: La yasmaAAoona feeha laghwan wala kiththaban
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: No ill speech will they hear therein or any falsehood -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: never to hear any idle talk or lying therein—

ayahs.textArabic: جَزَآءٗ مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَآءً حِسَابٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Jazaan min rabbika AAataan hisaban
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [As] reward from your Lord, [a generous] gift [made due by] account,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: a ˹fitting˺ reward as a generous gift from your Lord,

ayahs.textArabic: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِۖ لَا يَمۡلِكُونَ مِنۡهُ خِطَابٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Rabbi alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma alrrahmani la yamlikoona minhu khitaban
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [From] the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Most Merciful. They possess not from Him [authority for] speech.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything in between, the Most Compassionate. No one will dare speak to Him

ayahs.textArabic: يَوۡمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ صَفّٗاۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنۡ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yawma yaqoomu alrroohu waalmalaikatu saffan la yatakallamoona illa man athina lahu alrrahmanu waqala sawaban
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The Day that the Spirit and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will say what is correct.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: on the Day the ˹holy˺ spirit and the angels will stand in ranks. None will talk, except those granted permission by the Most Compassionate and whose words are true.

ayahs.textArabic: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمُ ٱلۡحَقُّۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thalika alyawmu alhaqqu faman shaa ittakhatha ila rabbihi maaban
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: That is the True Day; so he who wills may take to his Lord a [way of] return.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: That Day is the ˹ultimate˺ truth. So let whoever wills take the path leading back to their Lord.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّآ أَنذَرۡنَٰكُمۡ عَذَابٗا قَرِيبٗا يَوۡمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلۡمَرۡءُ مَا قَدَّمَتۡ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلۡكَافِرُ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي كُنتُ تُرَٰبَۢا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna antharnakum AAathaban qareeban yawma yanthuru almaro ma qaddamat yadahu wayaqoolu alkafiru ya laytanee kuntu turaban
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, We have warned you of a near punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust!"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, We have warned you of an imminent punishment—the Day every person will see ˹the consequences of˺ what their hands have done, and the disbelievers will cry, “I wish I were dust.”

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلنَّٰزِعَٰتِ غَرۡقٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: WaalnnaziAAati gharqan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: By those [angels] who extract with violence
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: By those ˹angels˺ stripping out ˹evil souls˺ harshly,

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلنَّٰشِطَٰتِ نَشۡطٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalnnashitati nashtan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [by] those who remove with ease
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and those pulling out ˹good souls˺ gently,

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلسَّٰبِحَٰتِ سَبۡحٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalssabihati sabhan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [by] those who glide [as if] swimming
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and those gliding ˹through heavens˺ swiftly,

ayahs.textArabic: فَٱلسَّٰبِقَٰتِ سَبۡقٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faalssabiqati sabqan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And those who race each other in a race
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and those taking the lead vigorously,

ayahs.textArabic: فَٱلۡمُدَبِّرَٰتِ أَمۡرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faalmudabbirati amran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And those who arrange [each] matter,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and those conducting affairs ˹obediently˺!

ayahs.textArabic: يَوۡمَ تَرۡجُفُ ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yawma tarjufu alrrajifatu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: On the Day the blast [of the Horn] will convulse [creation],
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Consider˺ the Day ˹when˺ the quaking Blast will come to pass,

ayahs.textArabic: تَتۡبَعُهَا ٱلرَّادِفَةُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: TatbaAAuha alrradifatu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: There will follow it the subsequent [one].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: followed by a second Blast.

ayahs.textArabic: قُلُوبٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ وَاجِفَةٌ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Quloobun yawmaithin wajifatun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Hearts, that Day, will tremble,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹The deniers’˺ hearts on that Day will be trembling ˹in horror˺,

ayahs.textArabic: أَبۡصَٰرُهَا خَٰشِعَةٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Absaruha khashiAAatun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Their eyes humbled.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: with their eyes downcast.

ayahs.textArabic: يَقُولُونَ أَءِنَّا لَمَرۡدُودُونَ فِي ٱلۡحَافِرَةِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yaqooloona ainna lamardoodoona fee alhafirati
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They are [presently] saying, "Will we indeed be returned to [our] former state [of life]?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹But now˺ they ask ˹mockingly˺, “Will we really be restored to our former state,

ayahs.textArabic: أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَٰمٗا نَّخِرَةٗ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Aitha kunna AAithaman nakhiratan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Even if we should be decayed bones?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: even after we have been reduced to decayed bones?”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُواْ تِلۡكَ إِذٗا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qaloo tilka ithan karratun khasiratun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They say, "That, then, would be a losing return."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Adding, “Then such a return would be a ˹total˺ loss ˹for us˺!”

ayahs.textArabic: فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ زَجۡرَةٞ وَٰحِدَةٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fainnama hiya zajratun wahidatun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, it will be but one shout,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But indeed, it will take only one ˹mighty˺ Blast,

ayahs.textArabic: فَإِذَا هُم بِٱلسَّاهِرَةِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faitha hum bialssahirati
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And suddenly they will be [alert] upon the earth's surface.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and at once they will be above ground.

ayahs.textArabic: هَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Hal ataka hadeethu moosa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Has there reached you the story of Moses? -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Has the story of Moses reached you ˹O Prophet˺?

ayahs.textArabic: إِذۡ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلۡوَادِ ٱلۡمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ith nadahu rabbuhu bialwadi almuqaddasi tuwan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: When his Lord called to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: His Lord called him in the sacred valley of Ṭuwa,

ayahs.textArabic: ٱذۡهَبۡ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ithhab ila firAAawna innahu tagha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: "Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹commanding,˺ “Go to Pharaoh, for he has truly transgressed ˹all bounds˺.

ayahs.textArabic: فَقُلۡ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faqul hal laka ila an tazakka
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And say to him, 'Would you [be willing to] purify yourself
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And say, ‘Would you ˹be willing to˺ purify yourself,

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَهۡدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخۡشَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waahdiyaka ila rabbika fatakhsha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And let me guide you to your Lord so you would fear [Him]?'"
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and let me guide you to your Lord so that you will be in awe ˹of Him˺?’”

ayahs.textArabic: فَأَرَىٰهُ ٱلۡأٓيَةَ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faarahu alayata alkubra
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And he showed him the greatest sign,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then Moses showed him the great sign,

ayahs.textArabic: فَكَذَّبَ وَعَصَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fakaththaba waAAasa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But Pharaoh denied and disobeyed.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: but he denied and disobeyed ˹Allah˺,

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ أَدۡبَرَ يَسۡعَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thumma adbara yasAAa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then he turned his back, striving.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: then turned his back, striving ˹against the truth˺.

ayahs.textArabic: فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fahashara fanada
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And he gathered [his people] and called out
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then he summoned ˹his people˺ and called out,

ayahs.textArabic: فَقَالَ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faqala ana rabbukumu alaAAla
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And said, "I am your most exalted lord."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: saying, “I am your lord, the most high!”

ayahs.textArabic: فَأَخَذَهُ ٱللَّهُ نَكَالَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ وَٱلۡأُولَىٰٓ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faakhathahu Allahu nakala alakhirati waaloola
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So Allah seized him in exemplary punishment for the last and the first [transgression].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So Allah overtook him, making him an example in this life and the next.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبۡرَةٗ لِّمَن يَخۡشَىٰٓ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna fee thalika laAAibratan liman yakhsha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed in that is a warning for whoever would fear [Allah].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Surely in this is a lesson for whoever stands in awe of ˹Allah˺.

ayahs.textArabic: ءَأَنتُمۡ أَشَدُّ خَلۡقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُۚ بَنَىٰهَا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Aantum ashaddu khalqan ami alssamao banaha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Are you a more difficult creation or is the heaven? Allah constructed it.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Which is harder to create: you or the sky? He built it,

ayahs.textArabic: رَفَعَ سَمۡكَهَا فَسَوَّىٰهَا
ayahs.textTransliteration: RafaAAa samkaha fasawwaha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He raised its ceiling and proportioned it.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: raising it high and forming it flawlessly.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَغۡطَشَ لَيۡلَهَا وَأَخۡرَجَ ضُحَىٰهَا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waaghtasha laylaha waakhraja duhaha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And He darkened its night and extracted its brightness.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He dimmed its night, and brought forth its daylight.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ ذَٰلِكَ دَحَىٰهَآ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalarda baAAda thalika dahaha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And after that He spread the earth.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: As for the earth, He spread it out as well,

ayahs.textArabic: أَخۡرَجَ مِنۡهَا مَآءَهَا وَمَرۡعَىٰهَا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Akhraja minha maaha wamarAAaha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He extracted from it its water and its pasture,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: bringing forth its water and pastures

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلۡجِبَالَ أَرۡسَىٰهَا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waaljibala arsaha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the mountains He set firmly
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and setting the mountains firmly ˹upon it˺—

ayahs.textArabic: مَتَٰعٗا لَّكُمۡ وَلِأَنۡعَٰمِكُمۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: MataAAan lakum walianAAamikum
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: As provision for you and your grazing livestock.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: all as ˹a means of˺ sustenance for you and your animals.

ayahs.textArabic: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلطَّآمَّةُ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faitha jaati alttammatu alkubra
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But when there comes the greatest Overwhelming Calamity -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But, when the Supreme Disaster comes to pass—

ayahs.textArabic: يَوۡمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مَا سَعَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yawma yatathakkaru alinsanu ma saAAa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The Day when man will remember that for which he strove,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: the Day every person will remember all ˹their˺ striving,

ayahs.textArabic: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلۡجَحِيمُ لِمَن يَرَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waburrizati aljaheemu liman yara
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And Hellfire will be exposed for [all] those who see -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and the Hellfire will be displayed for all to see—

ayahs.textArabic: فَأَمَّا مَن طَغَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faamma man tagha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So as for he who transgressed
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: then as for those who transgressed

ayahs.textArabic: وَءَاثَرَ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waathara alhayata alddunya
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And preferred the life of the world,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and preferred the ˹fleeting˺ life of this world,

ayahs.textArabic: فَإِنَّ ٱلۡجَحِيمَ هِيَ ٱلۡمَأۡوَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fainna aljaheema hiya almawa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then indeed, Hellfire will be [his] refuge.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: the Hellfire will certainly be ˹their˺ home.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفۡسَ عَنِ ٱلۡهَوَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waama man khafa maqama rabbihi wanaha alnnafsa AAani alhawa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But as for he who feared the position of his Lord and prevented the soul from [unlawful] inclination,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And as for those who were in awe of standing before their Lord and restrained themselves from ˹evil˺ desires,

ayahs.textArabic: فَإِنَّ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ هِيَ ٱلۡمَأۡوَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fainna aljannata hiya almawa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then indeed, Paradise will be [his] refuge.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Paradise will certainly be ˹their˺ home.

ayahs.textArabic: يَسۡـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرۡسَىٰهَا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yasaloonaka AAani alssaAAati ayyana mursaha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They ask you, [O Muhammad], about the Hour: when is its arrival?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They ask you ˹O Prophet˺ regarding the Hour, “When will it be?”

ayahs.textArabic: فِيمَ أَنتَ مِن ذِكۡرَىٰهَآ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Feema anta min thikraha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: In what [position] are you that you should mention it?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But it is not for you to tell its time.

ayahs.textArabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ مُنتَهَىٰهَآ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ila rabbika muntahaha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: To your Lord is its finality.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: That knowledge rests with your Lord ˹alone˺.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُنذِرُ مَن يَخۡشَىٰهَا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innama anta munthiru man yakhshaha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: You are only a warner for those who fear it.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Your duty is only to warn whoever is in awe of it.

ayahs.textArabic: كَأَنَّهُمۡ يَوۡمَ يَرَوۡنَهَا لَمۡ يَلۡبَثُوٓاْ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوۡ ضُحَىٰهَا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kaannahum yawma yarawnaha lam yalbathoo illa AAashiyyatan aw duhaha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: It will be, on the Day they see it, as though they had not remained [in the world] except for an afternoon or a morning thereof.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: On the Day they see it, it will be as if they had stayed ˹in the world˺ no more than one evening or its morning.

ayahs.textArabic: عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ
ayahs.textTransliteration: AAabasa watawalla
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The Prophet frowned and turned away
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He frowned and turned ˹his attention˺ away,

ayahs.textArabic: أَن جَآءَهُ ٱلۡأَعۡمَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: An jaahu alaAAma
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Because there came to him the blind man, [interrupting].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹simply˺ because the blind man came to him ˹interrupting˺.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا يُدۡرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُۥ يَزَّكَّىٰٓ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama yudreeka laAAallahu yazzakka
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But what would make you perceive, [O Muhammad], that perhaps he might be purified
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: You never know ˹O Prophet˺, perhaps he may be purified,

ayahs.textArabic: أَوۡ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰٓ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Aw yaththakkaru fatanfaAAahu alththikra
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Or be reminded and the remembrance would benefit him?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: or he may be mindful, benefitting from the reminder.

ayahs.textArabic: أَمَّا مَنِ ٱسۡتَغۡنَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Amma mani istaghna
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: As for he who thinks himself without need,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: As for the one who was indifferent,

ayahs.textArabic: فَأَنتَ لَهُۥ تَصَدَّىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faanta lahu tasadda
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: To him you give attention.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: you gave him your ˹undivided˺ attention,

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا عَلَيۡكَ أَلَّا يَزَّكَّىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama AAalayka alla yazzakka
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And not upon you [is any blame] if he will not be purified.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: even though you are not to blame if he would not be purified.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَمَّا مَن جَآءَكَ يَسۡعَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waamma man jaaka yasAAa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But as for he who came to you striving [for knowledge]
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But as for the one who came to you, eager ˹to learn˺,

ayahs.textArabic: وَهُوَ يَخۡشَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wahuwa yakhsha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: While he fears [Allah],
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: being in awe ˹of Allah˺,

ayahs.textArabic: فَأَنتَ عَنۡهُ تَلَهَّىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faanta AAanhu talahha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: From him you are distracted.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: you were inattentive to him.

ayahs.textArabic: كـَلَّآ إِنَّهَا تَذۡكِرَةٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kalla innaha tathkiratun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: No! Indeed, these verses are a reminder;
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But no! This ˹revelation˺ is truly a reminder.

ayahs.textArabic: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faman shaa thakarahu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So whoever wills may remember it.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So let whoever wills be mindful of it.

ayahs.textArabic: فِي صُحُفٖ مُّكَرَّمَةٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fee suhufin mukarramatin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [It is recorded] in honored sheets,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: It is ˹written˺ on pages held in honour—

ayahs.textArabic: مَّرۡفُوعَةٖ مُّطَهَّرَةِۭ
ayahs.textTransliteration: MarfooAAatin mutahharatin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Exalted and purified,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: highly esteemed, purified—

ayahs.textArabic: بِأَيۡدِي سَفَرَةٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Biaydee safaratin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Carried] by the hands of messenger-angels,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: by the hands of angel-scribes,

ayahs.textArabic: كِرَامِۭ بَرَرَةٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kiramin bararatin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Noble and dutiful.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: honourable and virtuous.

ayahs.textArabic: قُتِلَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مَآ أَكۡفَرَهُۥ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qutila alinsanu ma akfarahu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Cursed is man; how disbelieving is he.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Condemned are ˹disbelieving˺ humans! How ungrateful they are ˹to Allah˺!

ayahs.textArabic: مِنۡ أَيِّ شَيۡءٍ خَلَقَهُۥ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Min ayyi shayin khalaqahu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: From what substance did He create him?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: From what substance did He create them?

ayahs.textArabic: مِن نُّطۡفَةٍ خَلَقَهُۥ فَقَدَّرَهُۥ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Min nutfatin khalaqahu faqaddarahu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: From a sperm-drop He created him and destined for him;
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He created them from a sperm-drop, and ordained their development.

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ ٱلسَّبِيلَ يَسَّرَهُۥ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thumma alssabeela yassarahu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then He eased the way for him;
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then He makes the way easy for them,

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ أَمَاتَهُۥ فَأَقۡبَرَهُۥ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thumma amatahu faaqbarahu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then He causes his death and provides a grave for him.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: then causes them to die and be buried.

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ إِذَا شَآءَ أَنشَرَهُۥ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thumma itha shaa ansharahu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then when He wills, He will resurrect him.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then when He wills, He will resurrect them.

ayahs.textArabic: كـَلَّا لَمَّا يَقۡضِ مَآ أَمَرَهُۥ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kalla lamma yaqdi ma amarahu
