ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: No! Man has not yet accomplished what He commanded him.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But no! They have failed to comply with what He ordered.

ayahs.textArabic: فَلۡيَنظُرِ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ إِلَىٰ طَعَامِهِۦٓ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Falyanthuri alinsanu ila taAAamihi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then let mankind look at his food -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Let people then consider their food:

ayahs.textArabic: أَنَّا صَبَبۡنَا ٱلۡمَآءَ صَبّٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Anna sababna almaa sabban
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: How We poured down water in torrents,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: how We pour down rain in abundance

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ شَقَقۡنَا ٱلۡأَرۡضَ شَقّٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thumma shaqaqna alarda shaqqan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then We broke open the earth, splitting [it with sprouts],
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and meticulously split the earth open ˹for sprouts˺,

ayahs.textArabic: فَأَنۢبَتۡنَا فِيهَا حَبّٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faanbatna feeha habban
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And caused to grow within it grain
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: causing grain to grow in it,

ayahs.textArabic: وَعِنَبٗا وَقَضۡبٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: WaAAinaban waqadban
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And grapes and herbage
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: as well as grapes and greens,

ayahs.textArabic: وَزَيۡتُونٗا وَنَخۡلٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wazaytoonan wanakhlan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And olive and palm trees
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and olives and palm trees,

ayahs.textArabic: وَحَدَآئِقَ غُلۡبٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wahadaiqa ghulban
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And gardens of dense shrubbery
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and dense orchards,

ayahs.textArabic: وَفَٰكِهَةٗ وَأَبّٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wafakihatan waabban
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And fruit and grass -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and fruit and fodder—

ayahs.textArabic: مَّتَٰعٗا لَّكُمۡ وَلِأَنۡعَٰمِكُمۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: MataAAan lakum walianAAamikum
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [As] enjoyment for you and your grazing livestock.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: all as ˹a means of˺ sustenance for you and your animals.

ayahs.textArabic: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلصَّآخَّةُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faitha jaati alssakhkhatu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But when there comes the Deafening Blast
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then, when the Deafening Blast comes to pass—

ayahs.textArabic: يَوۡمَ يَفِرُّ ٱلۡمَرۡءُ مِنۡ أَخِيهِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yawma yafirru almaro min akheehi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: On the Day a man will flee from his brother
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: on that Day every person will flee from their own siblings,

ayahs.textArabic: وَأُمِّهِۦ وَأَبِيهِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waommihi waabeehi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And his mother and his father
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and ˹even˺ their mother and father,

ayahs.textArabic: وَصَٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَبَنِيهِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wasahibatihi wabaneehi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And his wife and his children,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and ˹even˺ their spouse and children.

ayahs.textArabic: لِكُلِّ ٱمۡرِيٕٖ مِّنۡهُمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٖ شَأۡنٞ يُغۡنِيهِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Likulli imriin minhum yawmaithin shanun yughneehi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: For every man, that Day, will be a matter adequate for him.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: For then everyone will have enough concern of their own.

ayahs.textArabic: وُجُوهٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ مُّسۡفِرَةٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wujoohun yawmaithin musfiratun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Some] faces, that Day, will be bright -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: On that Day ˹some˺ faces will be bright,

ayahs.textArabic: ضَاحِكَةٞ مُّسۡتَبۡشِرَةٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Dahikatun mustabshiratun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Laughing, rejoicing at good news.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: laughing and rejoicing,

ayahs.textArabic: وَوُجُوهٞ يَوۡمَئِذٍ عَلَيۡهَا غَبَرَةٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wawujoohun yawmaithin AAalayha ghabaratun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [other] faces, that Day, will have upon them dust.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: while ˹other˺ faces will be dusty,

ayahs.textArabic: تَرۡهَقُهَا قَتَرَةٌ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Tarhaquha qataratun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Blackness will cover them.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: cast in gloom—

ayahs.textArabic: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡكَفَرَةُ ٱلۡفَجَرَةُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Olaika humu alkafaratu alfajaratu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked ones.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: those are the disbelievers, the ˹wicked˺ sinners.

similarNames: wound round and lost its light

ayahs.textArabic: إِذَا ٱلشَّمۡسُ كُوِّرَتۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Itha alshshamsu kuwwirat
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: When the sun is wrapped up [in darkness]
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: When the sun is put out,

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ ٱنكَدَرَتۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waitha alnnujoomu inkadarat
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when the stars fall, dispersing,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and when the stars fall down,

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِذَا ٱلۡجِبَالُ سُيِّرَتۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waitha aljibalu suyyirat
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when the mountains are removed
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and when the mountains are blown away,

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِذَا ٱلۡعِشَارُ عُطِّلَتۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waitha alAAisharu AAuttilat
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when full-term she-camels are neglected
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and when pregnant camels are left untended,

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِذَا ٱلۡوُحُوشُ حُشِرَتۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waitha alwuhooshu hushirat
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when the wild beasts are gathered
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and when wild beasts are gathered together,

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِذَا ٱلۡبِحَارُ سُجِّرَتۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waitha albiharu sujjirat
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when the seas are filled with flame
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and when the seas are set on fire,

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّفُوسُ زُوِّجَتۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waitha alnnufoosu zuwwijat
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when the souls are paired
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and when the souls ˹and their bodies˺ are paired ˹once more˺,

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِذَا ٱلۡمَوۡءُۥدَةُ سُئِلَتۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waitha almawoodatu suilat
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when the girl [who was] buried alive is asked
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and when baby girls, buried alive, are asked

ayahs.textArabic: بِأَيِّ ذَنۢبٖ قُتِلَتۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Biayyi thanbin qutilat
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: For what sin she was killed
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: for what crime they were put to death,

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِذَا ٱلصُّحُفُ نُشِرَتۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waitha alssuhufu nushirat
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when the pages are made public
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and when the records ˹of deeds˺ are laid open,

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ كُشِطَتۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waitha alssamao kushitat
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when the sky is stripped away
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and when the sky is stripped away,

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِذَا ٱلۡجَحِيمُ سُعِّرَتۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waitha aljaheemu suAAAAirat
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when Hellfire is set ablaze
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and when the Hellfire is fiercely flared up,

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِذَا ٱلۡجَنَّةُ أُزۡلِفَتۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waitha aljannatu ozlifat
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when Paradise is brought near,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and when Paradise is brought near—

ayahs.textArabic: عَلِمَتۡ نَفۡسٞ مَّآ أَحۡضَرَتۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: AAalimat nafsun ma ahdarat
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: A soul will [then] know what it has brought [with it].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹on that Day˺ each soul will know what ˹deeds˺ it has brought along.

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِٱلۡخُنَّسِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fala oqsimu bialkhunnasi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So I swear by the retreating stars -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: I do swear by the receding stars

ayahs.textArabic: ٱلۡجَوَارِ ٱلۡكُنَّسِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Aljawari alkunnasi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Those that run [their courses] and disappear -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: which travel and hide,

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلَّيۡلِ إِذَا عَسۡعَسَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waallayli itha AAasAAasa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And by the night as it closes in
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and the night as it falls

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلصُّبۡحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalssubhi itha tanaffasa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And by the dawn when it breathes
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and the day as it breaks!

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوۡلُ رَسُولٖ كَرِيمٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innahu laqawlu rasoolin kareemin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [That] indeed, the Qur'an is a word [conveyed by] a noble messenger
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, this ˹Quran˺ is the Word of ˹Allah delivered by Gabriel,˺ a noble messenger-angel,

ayahs.textArabic: ذِي قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِي ٱلۡعَرۡشِ مَكِينٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thee quwwatin AAinda thee alAAarshi makeenin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Who is] possessed of power and with the Owner of the Throne, secure [in position],
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: full of power, held in honour by the Lord of the Throne,

ayahs.textArabic: مُّطَاعٖ ثَمَّ أَمِينٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: MutaAAin thamma ameenin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Obeyed there [in the heavens] and trustworthy.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: obeyed there ˹in heaven˺, and trustworthy.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا صَاحِبُكُم بِمَجۡنُونٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama sahibukum bimajnoonin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And your companion is not [at all] mad.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And your fellow man is not insane.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدۡ رَءَاهُ بِٱلۡأُفُقِ ٱلۡمُبِينِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walaqad raahu bialofuqi almubeeni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And he has already seen Gabriel in the clear horizon.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And he did see that ˹angel˺ on the clear horizon,

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى ٱلۡغَيۡبِ بِضَنِينٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama huwa AAala alghaybi bidaneenin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And Muhammad is not a withholder of [knowledge of] the unseen.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and he does not withhold ˹what is revealed to him of˺ the unseen.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوۡلِ شَيۡطَٰنٖ رَّجِيمٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama huwa biqawli shaytanin rajeemin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the Qur'an is not the word of a devil, expelled [from the heavens].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And this ˹Quran˺ is not the word of an outcast devil.

ayahs.textArabic: فَأَيۡنَ تَذۡهَبُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faayna tathhaboona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So where are you going?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So what ˹other˺ path would you take?

ayahs.textArabic: إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكۡرٞ لِّلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: In huwa illa thikrun lilAAalameena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: It is not except a reminder to the worlds
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Surely this ˹Quran˺ is only a reminder to the whole world—

ayahs.textArabic: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمۡ أَن يَسۡتَقِيمَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Liman shaa minkum an yastaqeema
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: For whoever wills among you to take a right course.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: to whoever of you wills to take the Straight Way.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama tashaoona illa an yashaa Allahu rabbu alAAalameena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And you do not will except that Allah wills - Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But you cannot will ˹to do so˺, except by the Will of Allah, the Lord of all worlds.

ayahs.textArabic: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنفَطَرَتۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Itha alssamao infatarat
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: When the sky breaks apart
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: When the sky splits open,

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِذَا ٱلۡكَوَاكِبُ ٱنتَثَرَتۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waitha alkawakibu intatharat
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when the stars fall, scattering,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and when the stars fall away,

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِذَا ٱلۡبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waitha albiharu fujjirat
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when the seas are erupted
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and when the seas burst forth,

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِذَا ٱلۡقُبُورُ بُعۡثِرَتۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waitha alqubooru buAAthirat
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when the [contents of] graves are scattered,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and when the graves spill out,

ayahs.textArabic: عَلِمَتۡ نَفۡسٞ مَّا قَدَّمَتۡ وَأَخَّرَتۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: AAalimat nafsun ma qaddamat waakhkharat
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: A soul will [then] know what it has put forth and kept back.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹then˺ each soul will know what it has sent forth or left behind.

ayahs.textArabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلۡكَرِيمِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ya ayyuha alinsanu ma gharraka birabbika alkareemi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: O humanity! What has emboldened you against your Lord, the Most Generous,

ayahs.textArabic: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّىٰكَ فَعَدَلَكَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Allathee khalaqaka fasawwaka faAAadalaka
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Who created you, proportioned you, and balanced you?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Who created you, fashioned you, and perfected your design,

ayahs.textArabic: فِيٓ أَيِّ صُورَةٖ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fee ayyi sooratin ma shaa rakkabaka
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: In whatever form He willed has He assembled you.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: moulding you in whatever form He willed?

ayahs.textArabic: كـَلَّا بَلۡ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kalla bal tukaththiboona bialddeeni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: No! But you deny the Recompense.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But no! In fact, you deny the ˹final˺ Judgment,

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِنَّ عَلَيۡكُمۡ لَحَٰفِظِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wainna AAalaykum lahafitheena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And indeed, [appointed] over you are keepers,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: while you are certainly observed by vigilant,

ayahs.textArabic: كِرَامٗا كَٰتِبِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kiraman katibeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Noble and recording;
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: honourable angels, recording ˹everything˺.

ayahs.textArabic: يَعۡلَمُونَ مَا تَفۡعَلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: YaAAlamoona ma tafAAaloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They know whatever you do.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They know whatever you do.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارَ لَفِي نَعِيمٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna alabrara lafee naAAeemin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, the virtuous will be in bliss,

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِنَّ ٱلۡفُجَّارَ لَفِي جَحِيمٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wainna alfujjara lafee jaheemin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And indeed, the wicked will be in Hellfire.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and the wicked will be in Hell,

ayahs.textArabic: يَصۡلَوۡنَهَا يَوۡمَ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yaslawnaha yawma alddeeni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They will [enter to] burn therein on the Day of Recompense,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: burning in it on Judgment Day,

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا هُمۡ عَنۡهَا بِغَآئِبِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama hum AAanha bighaibeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And never therefrom will they be absent.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and they will have no escape from it.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا يَوۡمُ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama adraka ma yawmu alddeeni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: What will make you realize what Judgment Day is?

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا يَوۡمُ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thumma ma adraka ma yawmu alddeeni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then, what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Again, what will make you realize what Judgment Day is?

ayahs.textArabic: يَوۡمَ لَا تَمۡلِكُ نَفۡسٞ لِّنَفۡسٖ شَيۡـٔٗاۖ وَٱلۡأَمۡرُ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلَّهِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yawma la tamliku nafsun linafsin shayan waalamru yawmaithin lillahi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: It is the Day when a soul will not possess for another soul [power to do] a thing; and the command, that Day, is [entirely] with Allah.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹It is˺ the Day no soul will be of ˹any˺ benefit to another whatsoever, for all authority on that Day belongs to Allah ˹entirely˺.

ayahs.textArabic: وَيۡلٞ لِّلۡمُطَفِّفِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waylun lilmutaffifeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Woe to those who give less [than due],
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Woe to the defrauders!

ayahs.textArabic: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكۡتَالُواْ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسۡتَوۡفُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Allatheena itha iktaloo AAala alnnasi yastawfoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Who, when they take a measure from people, take in full.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Those who take full measure ˹when they buy˺ from people,

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِذَا كَالُوهُمۡ أَو وَّزَنُوهُمۡ يُخۡسِرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waitha kaloohum aw wazanoohum yukhsiroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But if they give by measure or by weight to them, they cause loss.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: but give less when they measure or weigh for buyers.

ayahs.textArabic: أَلَا يَظُنُّ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ أَنَّهُم مَّبۡعُوثُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ala yathunnu olaika annahum mabAAoothoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Do they not think that they will be resurrected
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Do such people not think that they will be resurrected

ayahs.textArabic: لِيَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Liyawmin AAatheemin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: For a tremendous Day -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: for a tremendous Day—

ayahs.textArabic: يَوۡمَ يَقُومُ ٱلنَّاسُ لِرَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yawma yaqoomu alnnasu lirabbi alAAalameena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: the Day ˹all˺ people will stand before the Lord of all worlds?

ayahs.textArabic: كـَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلۡفُجَّارِ لَفِي سِجِّينٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kalla inna kitaba alfujjari lafee sijjeenin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: No! Indeed, the record of the wicked is in sijjeen.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But no! The wicked are certainly bound for Sijjîn ˹in the depths of Hell˺—

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا سِجِّينٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama adraka ma sijjeenun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And what can make you know what is sijjeen?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and what will make you realize what Sijjîn is?—

ayahs.textArabic: كِتَٰبٞ مَّرۡقُومٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kitabun marqoomun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: a fate ˹already˺ sealed.

ayahs.textArabic: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Woe, that Day, to the deniers,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Woe on that Day to the deniers—

ayahs.textArabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوۡمِ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Allatheena yukaththiboona biyawmi alddeeni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Who deny the Day of Recompense.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: those who deny Judgment Day!

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعۡتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama yukaththibu bihi illa kullu muAAtadin atheemin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And none deny it except every sinful transgressor.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: None would deny it except every evildoing transgressor.

ayahs.textArabic: إِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Itha tutla AAalayhi ayatuna qala asateeru alawwaleena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Whenever Our revelations are recited to them, they say, “Ancient fables!”

ayahs.textArabic: كـَلَّاۖ بَلۡۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kalla bal rana AAala quloobihim ma kanoo yaksiboona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But no! In fact, their hearts have been stained by all ˹the evil˺ they used to commit!

ayahs.textArabic: كـَلَّآ إِنَّهُمۡ عَن رَّبِّهِمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لَّمَحۡجُوبُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kalla innahum AAan rabbihim yawmaithin lamahjooboona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: No! Indeed, from their Lord, that Day, they will be partitioned.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Undoubtedly, they will be sealed off from their Lord on that Day.

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمۡ لَصَالُواْ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thumma innahum lasaloo aljaheemi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Moreover, they will surely burn in Hell,

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thumma yuqalu hatha allathee kuntum bihi tukaththiboona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then it will be said [to them], "This is what you used to deny."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and then be told, “This is what you used to deny.”

ayahs.textArabic: كـَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارِ لَفِي عِلِّيِّينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kalla inna kitaba alabrari lafee AAilliyyeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: No! Indeed, the record of the righteous is in 'illiyyun.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But no! The virtuous are certainly bound for ’Illiyûn ˹in elevated Gardens˺—

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama adraka ma AAilliyyoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And what can make you know what is 'illiyyun?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and what will make you realize what ’Illiyûn is?—

ayahs.textArabic: كِتَٰبٞ مَّرۡقُومٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kitabun marqoomun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: a fate ˹already˺ sealed,

ayahs.textArabic: يَشۡهَدُهُ ٱلۡمُقَرَّبُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yashhaduhu almuqarraboona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Which is witnessed by those brought near [to Allah].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: witnessed by those nearest ˹to Allah˺.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارَ لَفِي نَعِيمٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna alabrara lafee naAAeemin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Surely the virtuous will be in bliss,

ayahs.textArabic: عَلَى ٱلۡأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: AAala alaraiki yanthuroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: On adorned couches, observing.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹seated˺ on ˹canopied˺ couches, gazing around.

ayahs.textArabic: تَعۡرِفُ فِي وُجُوهِهِمۡ نَضۡرَةَ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: TaAArifu fee wujoohihim nadrata alnnaAAeemi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: You will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: You will recognize on their faces the glow of delight.

ayahs.textArabic: يُسۡقَوۡنَ مِن رَّحِيقٖ مَّخۡتُومٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yusqawna min raheeqin makhtoomin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They will be given to drink [pure] wine [which was] sealed.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They will be given a drink of sealed, pure wine,

ayahs.textArabic: خِتَٰمُهُۥ مِسۡكٞۚ وَفِي ذَٰلِكَ فَلۡيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلۡمُتَنَٰفِسُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Khitamuhu miskun wafee thalika falyatanafasi almutanafisoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The last of it is musk. So for this let the competitors compete.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: whose last sip will smell like musk. So let whoever aspires to this strive ˹diligently˺.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمِزَاجُهُۥ مِن تَسۡنِيمٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wamizajuhu min tasneemin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And its mixture is of Tasneem,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And this drink’s flavour will come from Tasnîm—

ayahs.textArabic: عَيۡنٗا يَشۡرَبُ بِهَا ٱلۡمُقَرَّبُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: AAaynan yashrabu biha almuqarraboona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: A spring from which those near [to Allah] drink.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: a spring from which those nearest ˹to Allah˺ will drink.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجۡرَمُواْ كَانُواْ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ يَضۡحَكُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna allatheena ajramoo kanoo mina allatheena amanoo yadhakoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, the wicked used to laugh at the believers,

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِذَا مَرُّواْ بِهِمۡ يَتَغَامَزُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waitha marroo bihim yataghamazoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when they passed by them, they would exchange derisive glances.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: wink to one another whenever they passed by,

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓاْ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُواْ فَكِهِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waitha inqalaboo ila ahlihimu inqalaboo fakiheena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when they returned to their people, they would return jesting.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and muse ˹over these exploits˺ upon returning to their own people.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِذَا رَأَوۡهُمۡ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waitha raawhum qaloo inna haolai ladalloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when they saw them, they would say, "Indeed, those are truly lost."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And when they saw the faithful, they would say, “These ˹people˺ are truly astray,”

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَآ أُرۡسِلُواْ عَلَيۡهِمۡ حَٰفِظِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama orsiloo AAalayhim hafitheena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But they had not been sent as guardians over them.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: even though they were not sent as keepers over the believers.

ayahs.textArabic: فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مِنَ ٱلۡكُفَّارِ يَضۡحَكُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faalyawma allatheena amanoo mina alkuffari yadhakoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So Today those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But on that Day the believers will be laughing at the disbelievers,

ayahs.textArabic: عَلَى ٱلۡأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: AAala alaraiki yanthuroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: On adorned couches, observing.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: as they sit on ˹canopied˺ couches, looking on.

ayahs.textArabic: هَلۡ ثُوِّبَ ٱلۡكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُواْ يَفۡعَلُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Hal thuwwiba alkuffaru ma kanoo yafAAaloona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Have the disbelievers [not] been rewarded [this Day] for what they used to do?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹The believers will be asked,˺ “Have the disbelievers ˹not˺ been paid back for what they used to do?”

ayahs.textArabic: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنشَقَّتۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Itha alssamao inshaqqat
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: When the sky has split [open]
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: When the sky bursts open,

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَذِنَتۡ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waathinat lirabbiha wahuqqat
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: obeying its Lord as it must,

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِذَا ٱلۡأَرۡضُ مُدَّتۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waitha alardu muddat
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when the earth has been extended
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and when the earth is flattened out,

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَلۡقَتۡ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalqat ma feeha watakhallat
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And has cast out that within it and relinquished [it]
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and ejects ˹all˺ its contents and becomes empty,

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَذِنَتۡ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waathinat lirabbiha wahuqqat
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so] -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: obeying its Lord as it must, ˹surely you will all be judged˺.

ayahs.textArabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدۡحٗا فَمُلَٰقِيهِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ya ayyuha alinsanu innaka kadihun ila rabbika kadhan famulaqeehi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with [great] exertion and will meet it.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: O humanity! Indeed, you are labouring restlessly towards your Lord, and will ˹eventually˺ meet the consequences.

ayahs.textArabic: فَأَمَّا مَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faama man ootiya kitabahu biyameenihi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then as for he who is given his record in his right hand,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: As for those who are given their record in their right hand,

ayahs.textArabic: فَسَوۡفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابٗا يَسِيرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fasawfa yuhasabu hisaban yaseeran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He will be judged with an easy account
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: they will have an easy reckoning,

ayahs.textArabic: وَيَنقَلِبُ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِۦ مَسۡرُورٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wayanqalibu ila ahlihi masrooran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And return to his people in happiness.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and will return to their people joyfully.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهۡرِهِۦ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waamma man ootiya kitabahu waraa thahrihi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But as for he who is given his record behind his back,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And as for those who are given their record ˹in their left hand˺ from behind their backs,

ayahs.textArabic: فَسَوۡفَ يَدۡعُواْ ثُبُورٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fasawfa yadAAoo thubooran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He will cry out for destruction
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: they will cry for ˹instant˺ destruction,

ayahs.textArabic: وَيَصۡلَىٰ سَعِيرًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wayasla saAAeeran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [enter to] burn in a Blaze.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and will burn in the blazing Fire.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فِيٓ أَهۡلِهِۦ مَسۡرُورًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innahu kana fee ahlihi masrooran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, he had [once] been among his people in happiness;
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: For they used to be prideful among their people,

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّهُۥ ظَنَّ أَن لَّن يَحُورَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innahu thanna an lan yahoora
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, he had thought he would never return [to Allah].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: thinking they would never return ˹to Allah˺.

ayahs.textArabic: بَلَىٰٓۚ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Bala inna rabbahu kana bihi baseeran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But yes! Indeed, his Lord was ever of him, Seeing.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Yes ˹they would˺! Surely their Lord has always been All-Seeing of them.

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِٱلشَّفَقِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fala oqsimu bialshshafaqi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So I swear by the twilight glow
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So, I do swear by the twilight!

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلَّيۡلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waallayli wama wasaqa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [by] the night and what it envelops
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And by the night and whatever it envelops!

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلۡقَمَرِ إِذَا ٱتَّسَقَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalqamari itha ittasaqa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [by] the moon when it becomes full
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And by the moon when it waxes full!

ayahs.textArabic: لَتَرۡكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَن طَبَقٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Latarkabunna tabaqan AAan tabaqin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [That] you will surely experience state after state.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: You will certainly pass from one state to another.

ayahs.textArabic: فَمَا لَهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fama lahum la yuminoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So what is [the matter] with them [that] they do not believe,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So what is the matter with them that they do not believe,

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانُ لَا يَسۡجُدُونَۤ۩
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waitha quria AAalayhimu alquranu la yasjudoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And when the Qur'an is recited to them, they do not prostrate [to Allah]?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and when the Quran is recited to them, they do not bow down ˹in submission˺?

ayahs.textArabic: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ يُكَذِّبُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Bali allatheena kafaroo yukaththiboona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But those who have disbelieved deny,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: In fact, the disbelievers persist in denial.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱللَّهُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: WaAllahu aAAlamu bima yooAAoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And Allah is most knowing of what they keep within themselves.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But Allah knows best whatever they hide.

ayahs.textArabic: فَبَشِّرۡهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fabashshirhum biAAathabin aleemin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So give them tidings of a painful punishment,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So give them good news of a painful punishment.

ayahs.textArabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمۡ أَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُونِۭ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Illa allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati lahum ajrun ghayru mamnoonin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds. For them is a reward uninterrupted.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But those who believe and do good will have a never-ending reward.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلۡبُرُوجِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalssamai thati alburooji
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: By the sky containing great stars
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: By the sky full of constellations,

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلۡيَوۡمِ ٱلۡمَوۡعُودِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalyawmi almawAAoodi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [by] the promised Day
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and the promised Day ˹of Judgment˺,

ayahs.textArabic: وَشَاهِدٖ وَمَشۡهُودٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Washahidin wamashhoodin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [by] the witness and what is witnessed,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and the witness and what is witnessed!

ayahs.textArabic: قُتِلَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡأُخۡدُودِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qutila ashabu alukhdoodi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Cursed were the companions of the trench
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Condemned are the makers of the ditch—

ayahs.textArabic: ٱلنَّارِ ذَاتِ ٱلۡوَقُودِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Alnnari thati alwaqoodi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Containing] the fire full of fuel,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: the fire ˹pit˺, filled with fuel—

ayahs.textArabic: إِذۡ هُمۡ عَلَيۡهَا قُعُودٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ith hum AAalayha quAAoodun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: When they were sitting near it
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: when they sat around it,

ayahs.textArabic: وَهُمۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفۡعَلُونَ بِٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ شُهُودٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wahum AAala ma yafAAaloona bialmumineena shuhoodun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And they, to what they were doing against the believers, were witnesses.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: watching what they had ˹ordered to be˺ done to the believers,

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا نَقَمُواْ مِنۡهُمۡ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤۡمِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡحَمِيدِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama naqamoo minhum illa an yuminoo biAllahi alAAazeezi alhameedi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: who they resented for no reason other than belief in Allah—the Almighty, the Praiseworthy—

ayahs.textArabic: ٱلَّذِي لَهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ شَهِيدٌ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Allathee lahu mulku alssamawati waalardi waAllahu AAala kulli shayin shaheedun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: To whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And Allah, over all things, is Witness.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹the One˺ to Whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and earth. And Allah is a Witness over all things.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُواْ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمۡ يَتُوبُواْ فَلَهُمۡ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابُ ٱلۡحَرِيقِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna allatheena fatanoo almumineena waalmuminati thumma lam yatooboo falahum AAathabu jahannama walahum AAathabu alhareeqi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, those who have tortured the believing men and believing women and then have not repented will have the punishment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the Burning Fire.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Those who persecute the believing men and women and then do not repent will certainly suffer the punishment of Hell and the torment of burning.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمۡ جَنَّٰتٞ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡكَبِيرُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati lahum jannatun tajree min tahtiha alanharu thalika alfawzu alkabeeru
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great attainment.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Surely those who believe and do good will have Gardens under which rivers flow. That is the greatest triumph.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ بَطۡشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna batsha rabbika lashadeedun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, the vengeance of your Lord is severe.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, the ˹crushing˺ grip of your Lord is severe.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ يُبۡدِئُ وَيُعِيدُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innahu huwa yubdio wayuAAeedu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, it is He who originates [creation] and repeats.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹For˺ He is certainly the One Who originates and resurrects ˹all˺.

ayahs.textArabic: وَهُوَ ٱلۡغَفُورُ ٱلۡوَدُودُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wahuwa alghafooru alwadoodu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And He is the Forgiving, the Affectionate,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And He is the All-Forgiving, All-Loving—

ayahs.textArabic: ذُو ٱلۡعَرۡشِ ٱلۡمَجِيدُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thoo alAAarshi almajeedi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Honorable Owner of the Throne,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Lord of the Throne, the All-Glorious,

ayahs.textArabic: فَعَّالٞ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: FaAAAAalun lima yureedu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Effecter of what He intends.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Doer of whatever He wills.

ayahs.textArabic: هَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلۡجُنُودِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Hal ataka hadeethu aljunoodi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Has there reached you the story of the soldiers -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Has the story of the ˹destroyed˺ forces reached you ˹O Prophet˺—

ayahs.textArabic: فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَثَمُودَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: FirAAawna wathamooda
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Those of] Pharaoh and Thamud?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹the forces of˺ Pharaoh and Thamûd?

ayahs.textArabic: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِي تَكۡذِيبٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Bali allatheena kafaroo fee taktheebin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But they who disbelieve are in [persistent] denial,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Yet the disbelievers ˹still˺ persist in denial.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱللَّهُ مِن وَرَآئِهِم مُّحِيطُۢ
ayahs.textTransliteration: WaAllahu min waraihim muheetun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: While Allah encompasses them from behind.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But Allah encompasses them from all sides.

ayahs.textArabic: بَلۡ هُوَ قُرۡءَانٞ مَّجِيدٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Bal huwa quranun majeedun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But this is an honored Qur'an
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: In fact, this is a glorious Quran,

ayahs.textArabic: فِي لَوۡحٖ مَّحۡفُوظِۭ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fee lawhin mahfoothin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Inscribed] in a Preserved Slate.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹recorded˺ in a Preserved Tablet.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلطَّارِقِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalssamai waalttariqi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: By the sky and the night comer -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: By the heaven and the nightly star!

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلطَّارِقُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama adraka ma alttariqu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And what can make you know what is the night comer?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And what will make you realize what the nightly star is?

ayahs.textArabic: ٱلنَّجۡمُ ٱلثَّاقِبُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Alnnajmu alththaqibu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: It is the piercing star -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹It is˺ the star of piercing brightness.

ayahs.textArabic: إِن كُلُّ نَفۡسٖ لَّمَّا عَلَيۡهَا حَافِظٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: In kullu nafsin lamma AAalayha hafithun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: There is no soul but that it has over it a protector.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: There is no soul without a vigilant angel ˹recording everything˺.

ayahs.textArabic: فَلۡيَنظُرِ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Falyanthuri alinsanu mimma khuliqa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So let man observe from what he was created.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Let people then consider what they were created from!

ayahs.textArabic: خُلِقَ مِن مَّآءٖ دَافِقٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Khuliqa min main dafiqin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He was created from a fluid, ejected,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹They were˺ created from a spurting fluid,

ayahs.textArabic: يَخۡرُجُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِ ٱلصُّلۡبِ وَٱلتَّرَآئِبِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yakhruju min bayni alssulbi waalttaraibi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: stemming from between the backbone and the ribcage.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَجۡعِهِۦ لَقَادِرٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innahu AAala rajAAihi laqadirun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, Allah, to return him [to life], is Able.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Surely He is fully capable of bringing them back ˹to life˺

ayahs.textArabic: يَوۡمَ تُبۡلَى ٱلسَّرَآئِرُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yawma tubla alssarairu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The Day when secrets will be put on trial,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: on the Day all secrets will be disclosed.

ayahs.textArabic: فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٖ وَلَا نَاصِرٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fama lahu min quwwatin wala nasirin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then man will have no power or any helper.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then one will have neither power nor ˹any˺ helper.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلرَّجۡعِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalssamai thati alrrajAAi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: By the sky which returns [rain]
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: By the sky with its recurring cycles,

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ ذَاتِ ٱلصَّدۡعِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalardi thati alssadAAi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [by] the earth which cracks open,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and the earth with its sprouting plants!

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوۡلٞ فَصۡلٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innahu laqawlun faslun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, the Qur'an is a decisive statement,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Surely this ˹Quran˺ is a decisive word,

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا هُوَ بِٱلۡهَزۡلِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama huwa bialhazli
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And it is not amusement.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and is not to be taken lightly.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّهُمۡ يَكِيدُونَ كَيۡدٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Innahum yakeedoona kaydan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, they are planning a plan,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They are certainly devising ˹evil˺ plans,

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَكِيدُ كَيۡدٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waakeedu kaydan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But I am planning a plan.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: but I too am planning.

ayahs.textArabic: فَمَهِّلِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ أَمۡهِلۡهُمۡ رُوَيۡدَۢا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Famahhili alkafireena amhilhum ruwaydan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So bear with the disbelievers ˹O Prophet˺. Let them be for ˹just˺ a little while.

ayahs.textArabic: سَبِّحِ ٱسۡمَ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡأَعۡلَى
ayahs.textTransliteration: Sabbihi isma rabbika alaAAla
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Glorify the Name of your Lord, the Most High,

ayahs.textArabic: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Allathee khalaqa fasawwa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Who created and proportioned
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Who created and ˹perfectly˺ fashioned ˹all˺,

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلَّذِي قَدَّرَ فَهَدَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waallathee qaddara fahada
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And who destined and [then] guided
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and Who ordained precisely and inspired accordingly,

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلَّذِيٓ أَخۡرَجَ ٱلۡمَرۡعَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waallathee akhraja almarAAa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And who brings out the pasture
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and Who brings forth ˹green˺ pasture,

ayahs.textArabic: فَجَعَلَهُۥ غُثَآءً أَحۡوَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: FajaAAalahu ghuthaan ahwa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [then] makes it black stubble.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: then reduces it to withered chaff.

ayahs.textArabic: سَنُقۡرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنسَىٰٓ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Sanuqrioka fala tansa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: We will make you recite, [O Muhammad], and you will not forget,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We will have you recite ˹the Quran, O Prophet,˺ so you will not forget ˹any of it˺,

ayahs.textArabic: إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَعۡلَمُ ٱلۡجَهۡرَ وَمَا يَخۡفَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Illa ma shaa Allahu innahu yaAAlamu aljahra wama yakhfa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Except what Allah should will. Indeed, He knows what is declared and what is hidden.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: unless Allah wills otherwise. He surely knows what is open and what is hidden.

ayahs.textArabic: وَنُيَسِّرُكَ لِلۡيُسۡرَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wanuyassiruka lilyusra
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We will ease you toward ease.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We will facilitate for you the Way of Ease.

ayahs.textArabic: فَذَكِّرۡ إِن نَّفَعَتِ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fathakkir in nafaAAati alththikra
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So remind, if the reminder should benefit;
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So ˹always˺ remind ˹with the Quran˺—˹even˺ if the reminder is beneficial ˹only to some˺.

ayahs.textArabic: سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَن يَخۡشَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Sayaththakkaru man yakhsha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He who fears [Allah] will be reminded.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Those in awe ˹of Allah˺ will be mindful ˹of it˺.

ayahs.textArabic: وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا ٱلۡأَشۡقَى
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wayatajannabuha alashqa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But the wretched one will avoid it -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But it will be shunned by the most wretched,

ayahs.textArabic: ٱلَّذِي يَصۡلَى ٱلنَّارَ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Allathee yasla alnnara alkubra
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [He] who will [enter and] burn in the greatest Fire,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: who will burn in the greatest Fire,

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحۡيَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thumma la yamootu feeha wala yahya
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Neither dying therein nor living.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: where they will not ˹be able to˺ live or die.

ayahs.textArabic: قَدۡ أَفۡلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qad aflaha man tazakka
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Successful indeed are those who purify themselves,

ayahs.textArabic: وَذَكَرَ ٱسۡمَ رَبِّهِۦ فَصَلَّىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wathakara isma rabbihi fasalla
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And mentions the name of his Lord and prays.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: remember the Name of their Lord, and pray.

ayahs.textArabic: بَلۡ تُؤۡثِرُونَ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Bal tuthiroona alhayata alddunya
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But you prefer the worldly life,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But you ˹deniers only˺ prefer the life of this world,

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةُ خَيۡرٞ وَأَبۡقَىٰٓ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalakhiratu khayrun waabqa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: While the Hereafter is better and more enduring.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: even though the Hereafter is far better and more lasting.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَفِي ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلۡأُولَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna hatha lafee alssuhufi aloola
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, this is in the former scriptures,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: This is certainly ˹mentioned˺ in the earlier Scriptures—

ayahs.textArabic: صُحُفِ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Suhufi ibraheema wamoosa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The scriptures of Abraham and Moses.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: the Scriptures of Abraham and Moses.

ayahs.textArabic: هَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلۡغَٰشِيَةِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Hal ataka hadeethu alghashiyati
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Has there reached you the report of the Overwhelming [event]?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Has the news of the Overwhelming Event reached you ˹O Prophet˺?

ayahs.textArabic: وُجُوهٞ يَوۡمَئِذٍ خَٰشِعَةٌ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wujoohun yawmaithin khashiAAatun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Some] faces, that Day, will be humbled,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: On that Day ˹some˺ faces will be downcast,

ayahs.textArabic: عَامِلَةٞ نَّاصِبَةٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: AAamilatun nasibatun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Working [hard] and exhausted.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹totally˺ overburdened, exhausted,

ayahs.textArabic: تَصۡلَىٰ نَارًا حَامِيَةٗ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Tasla naran hamiyatan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They will [enter to] burn in an intensely hot Fire.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: burning in a scorching Fire,

ayahs.textArabic: تُسۡقَىٰ مِنۡ عَيۡنٍ ءَانِيَةٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Tusqa min AAaynin aniyatin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: They will be given drink from a boiling spring.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: left to drink from a scalding spring.

ayahs.textArabic: لَّيۡسَ لَهُمۡ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Laysa lahum taAAamun illa min dareeAAin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: For them there will be no food except from a poisonous, thorny plant
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They will have no food except a foul, thorny shrub,

ayahs.textArabic: لَّا يُسۡمِنُ وَلَا يُغۡنِي مِن جُوعٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: La yusminu wala yughnee min jooAAin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Which neither nourishes nor avails against hunger.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: neither nourishing nor satisfying hunger.

ayahs.textArabic: وُجُوهٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ نَّاعِمَةٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wujoohun yawmaithin naAAimatun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [Other] faces, that Day, will show pleasure.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: On that Day ˹other˺ faces will be glowing with bliss,

ayahs.textArabic: لِّسَعۡيِهَا رَاضِيَةٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: LisaAAyiha radiyatun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: With their effort [they are] satisfied
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹fully˺ pleased with their striving,

ayahs.textArabic: فِي جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fee jannatin AAaliyatin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: In an elevated garden,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: in an elevated Garden,

ayahs.textArabic: لَّا تَسۡمَعُ فِيهَا لَٰغِيَةٗ
ayahs.textTransliteration: La tasmaAAu feeha laghiyatan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Wherein they will hear no unsuitable speech.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: where no idle talk will be heard.

ayahs.textArabic: فِيهَا عَيۡنٞ جَارِيَةٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Feeha AAaynun jariyatun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Within it is a flowing spring.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: In it will be a running spring,

ayahs.textArabic: فِيهَا سُرُرٞ مَّرۡفُوعَةٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Feeha sururun marfooAAatun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Within it are couches raised high
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: along with thrones raised high,

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَكۡوَابٞ مَّوۡضُوعَةٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waakwabun mawdooAAatun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And cups put in place
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and cups set at hand,

ayahs.textArabic: وَنَمَارِقُ مَصۡفُوفَةٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wanamariqu masfoofatun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And cushions lined up
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and ˹fine˺ cushions lined up,

ayahs.textArabic: وَزَرَابِيُّ مَبۡثُوثَةٌ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wazarabiyyu mabthoothatun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And carpets spread around.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and ˹splendid˺ carpets spread out.

ayahs.textArabic: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلۡإِبِلِ كَيۡفَ خُلِقَتۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Afala yanthuroona ila alibili kayfa khuliqat
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then do they not look at the camels - how they are created?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Do they not ever reflect on camels—how they were ˹masterfully˺ created;

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيۡفَ رُفِعَتۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waila alssamai kayfa rufiAAat
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And at the sky - how it is raised?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and the sky—how it was raised ˹high˺;

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِلَى ٱلۡجِبَالِ كَيۡفَ نُصِبَتۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waila aljibali kayfa nusibat
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And at the mountains - how they are erected?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and the mountains—how they were firmly set up;

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ كَيۡفَ سُطِحَتۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waila alardi kayfa sutihat
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And at the earth - how it is spread out?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and the earth—how it was levelled out?

ayahs.textArabic: فَذَكِّرۡ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُذَكِّرٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fathakkir innama anta muthakkirun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So remind, [O Muhammad]; you are only a reminder.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So, ˹continue to˺ remind ˹all, O Prophet˺, for your duty is only to remind.

ayahs.textArabic: لَّسۡتَ عَلَيۡهِم بِمُصَيۡطِرٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Lasta AAalayhim bimusaytirin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: You are not over them a controller.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: You are not ˹there˺ to compel them ˹to believe˺.

ayahs.textArabic: إِلَّا مَن تَوَلَّىٰ وَكَفَرَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Illa man tawalla wakafara
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: However, he who turns away and disbelieves -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But whoever turns away, persisting in disbelief,

ayahs.textArabic: فَيُعَذِّبُهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡعَذَابَ ٱلۡأَكۡبَرَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: FayuAAaththibuhu Allahu alAAathaba alakbara
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then Allah will punish him with the greatest punishment.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: then Allah will inflict upon them the major punishment.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ إِلَيۡنَآ إِيَابَهُمۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna ilayna iyabahum
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, to Us is their return.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Surely to Us is their return,

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيۡنَا حِسَابَهُم
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thumma inna AAalayna hisabahum
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then indeed, upon Us is their account.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: then surely with Us is their reckoning.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلۡفَجۡرِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalfajri
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: By the dawn
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: By the dawn,

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَيَالٍ عَشۡرٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walayalin AAashrin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [by] ten nights
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and the ten nights,

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلشَّفۡعِ وَٱلۡوَتۡرِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: WaalshshafAAi waalwatri
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [by] the even [number] and the odd
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and the even and the odd,

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلَّيۡلِ إِذَا يَسۡرِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waallayli itha yasri
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [by] the night when it passes,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and the night when it passes!

ayahs.textArabic: هَلۡ فِي ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٞ لِّذِي حِجۡرٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Hal fee thalika qasamun lithee hijrin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Is there [not] in [all] that an oath [sufficient] for one of perception?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Is all this ˹not˺ a sufficient oath for those who have sense?

ayahs.textArabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ كَيۡفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Alam tara kayfa faAAala rabbuka biAAadin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Have you not considered how your Lord dealt with 'Aad -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Did you not see how your Lord dealt with ’Ȃd—

ayahs.textArabic: إِرَمَ ذَاتِ ٱلۡعِمَادِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Irama thati alAAimadi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [With] Iram - who had lofty pillars,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹the people˺ of Iram—with ˹their˺ great stature,

ayahs.textArabic: ٱلَّتِي لَمۡ يُخۡلَقۡ مِثۡلُهَا فِي ٱلۡبِلَٰدِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Allatee lam yukhlaq mithluha fee albiladi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The likes of whom had never been created in the land?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: unmatched in any other land;

ayahs.textArabic: وَثَمُودَ ٱلَّذِينَ جَابُواْ ٱلصَّخۡرَ بِٱلۡوَادِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wathamooda allatheena jaboo alssakhra bialwadi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [with] Thamud, who carved out the rocks in the valley?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and Thamûd who carved ˹their homes into˺ the rocks in the ˹Stone˺ Valley;

ayahs.textArabic: وَفِرۡعَوۡنَ ذِي ٱلۡأَوۡتَادِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: WafirAAawna thee alawtadi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [with] Pharaoh, owner of the stakes? -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and the Pharaoh of mighty structures?

ayahs.textArabic: ٱلَّذِينَ طَغَوۡاْ فِي ٱلۡبِلَٰدِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Allatheena taghaw fee albiladi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [All of] whom oppressed within the lands
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They all transgressed throughout the land,

ayahs.textArabic: فَأَكۡثَرُواْ فِيهَا ٱلۡفَسَادَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faaktharoo feeha alfasada
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And increased therein the corruption.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: spreading much corruption there.

ayahs.textArabic: فَصَبَّ عَلَيۡهِمۡ رَبُّكَ سَوۡطَ عَذَابٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fasabba AAalayhim rabbuka sawta AAathabin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So your Lord poured upon them a scourge of punishment.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So your Lord unleashed on them a scourge of punishment.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِٱلۡمِرۡصَادِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna rabbaka labialmirsadi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, your Lord is in observation.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹For˺ your Lord is truly vigilant.

ayahs.textArabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبۡتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكۡرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّيٓ أَكۡرَمَنِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faamma alinsanu itha ma ibtalahu rabbuhu faakramahu wanaAAAAamahu fayaqoolu rabbee akramani
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And as for man, when his Lord tries him and [thus] is generous to him and favors him, he says, "My Lord has honored me."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Now, whenever a human being is tested by their Lord through ˹His˺ generosity and blessings, they boast, “My Lord has ˹deservedly˺ honoured me!”

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبۡتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيۡهِ رِزۡقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّيٓ أَهَٰنَنِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waamma itha ma ibtalahu faqadara AAalayhi rizqahu fayaqoolu rabbee ahanani
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But when He tries him and restricts his provision, he says, "My Lord has humiliated me."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But when He tests them by limiting their provision, they protest, “My Lord has ˹undeservedly˺ humiliated me!”

ayahs.textArabic: كـَلَّاۖ بَل لَّا تُكۡرِمُونَ ٱلۡيَتِيمَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kalla bal la tukrimoona alyateema
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: No! But you do not honor the orphan
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Absolutely not! In fact, you are not ˹even˺ gracious to the orphan,

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَا تَحَٰٓضُّونَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلۡمِسۡكِينِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wala tahaddoona AAala taAAami almiskeeni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And you do not encourage one another to feed the poor.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: nor do you urge one another to feed the poor.

ayahs.textArabic: وَتَأۡكُلُونَ ٱلتُّرَاثَ أَكۡلٗا لَّمّٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Watakuloona altturatha aklan lamman
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And you consume inheritance, devouring [it] altogether,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And you devour ˹others’˺ inheritance greedily,

ayahs.textArabic: وَتُحِبُّونَ ٱلۡمَالَ حُبّٗا جَمّٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Watuhibboona almala hubban jamman
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And you love wealth with immense love.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and love wealth fervently.

ayahs.textArabic: كـَلَّآۖ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ دَكّٗا دَكّٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kalla itha dukkati alardu dakkan dakkan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: No! When the earth has been leveled - pounded and crushed -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Enough! When the earth is entirely crushed over and over,

ayahs.textArabic: وَجَآءَ رَبُّكَ وَٱلۡمَلَكُ صَفّٗا صَفّٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wajaa rabbuka waalmalaku saffan saffan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And your Lord has come and the angels, rank upon rank,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and your Lord comes ˹to judge˺ with angels, rank upon rank,

ayahs.textArabic: وَجِاْيٓءَ يَوۡمَئِذِۭ بِجَهَنَّمَۚ يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wajeea yawmaithin bijahannama yawmaithin yatathakkaru alinsanu waanna lahu alththikra
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And brought [within view], that Day, is Hell - that Day, man will remember, but what good to him will be the remembrance?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and Hell is brought forth on that Day—this is when every ˹disbelieving˺ person will remember ˹their own sins˺. But what is the use of remembering then?

ayahs.textArabic: يَقُولُ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي قَدَّمۡتُ لِحَيَاتِي
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yaqoolu ya laytanee qaddamtu lihayatee
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He will say, "Oh, I wish I had sent ahead [some good] for my life."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They will cry, “I wish I had sent forth ˹something good˺ for my ˹true˺ life.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَيَوۡمَئِذٖ لَّا يُعَذِّبُ عَذَابَهُۥٓ أَحَدٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fayawmaithin la yuAAaththibu AAathabahu ahadun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So on that Day, none will punish [as severely] as His punishment,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: On that Day He will punish ˹them˺ severely, like no other,

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَا يُوثِقُ وَثَاقَهُۥٓ أَحَدٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wala yoothiqu wathaqahu ahadun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And none will bind [as severely] as His binding [of the evildoers].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and bind ˹them˺ tightly, like no other.

ayahs.textArabic: يَٰٓأَيَّتُهَا ٱلنَّفۡسُ ٱلۡمُطۡمَئِنَّةُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ya ayyatuha alnnafsu almutmainnatu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [To the righteous it will be said], "O reassured soul,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹Allah will say to the righteous,˺ “O tranquil soul!

ayahs.textArabic: ٱرۡجِعِيٓ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةٗ مَّرۡضِيَّةٗ
ayahs.textTransliteration: IrjiAAee ila rabbiki radiyatan mardiyyatan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Return to your Lord, well-pleased and pleasing [to Him],
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Return to your Lord, well pleased ˹with Him˺ and well pleasing ˹to Him˺.

ayahs.textArabic: فَٱدۡخُلِي فِي عِبَٰدِي
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faodkhulee fee AAibadee
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And enter among My [righteous] servants
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So join My servants,

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱدۡخُلِي جَنَّتِي
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waodkhulee jannatee
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And enter My Paradise."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and enter My Paradise.”

ayahs.textArabic: لَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلۡبَلَدِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: La oqsimu bihatha albaladi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: I swear by this city, Mecca -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: I do swear by this city ˹of Mecca˺—

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَنتَ حِلُّۢ بِهَٰذَا ٱلۡبَلَدِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waanta hillun bihatha albaladi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And you, [O Muhammad], are free of restriction in this city -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: even though you ˹O Prophet˺ are subject to abuse in this city—

ayahs.textArabic: وَوَالِدٖ وَمَا وَلَدَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wawalidin wama walada
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [by] the father and that which was born [of him],
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and by every parent and ˹their˺ child!

ayahs.textArabic: لَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ فِي كَبَدٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Laqad khalaqna alinsana fee kabadin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: We have certainly created man into hardship.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, We have created humankind in ˹constant˺ struggle.

ayahs.textArabic: أَيَحۡسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقۡدِرَ عَلَيۡهِ أَحَدٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ayahsabu an lan yaqdira AAalayhi ahadun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Does he think that never will anyone overcome him?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Do they think that no one has power over them,

ayahs.textArabic: يَقُولُ أَهۡلَكۡتُ مَالٗا لُّبَدًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yaqoolu ahlaktu malan lubadan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He says, "I have spent wealth in abundance."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: boasting, “I have wasted enormous wealth!”?

ayahs.textArabic: أَيَحۡسَبُ أَن لَّمۡ يَرَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ayahsabu an lam yarahu ahadun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Does he think that no one has seen him?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Do they think that no one sees them?

ayahs.textArabic: أَلَمۡ نَجۡعَل لَّهُۥ عَيۡنَيۡنِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Alam najAAal lahu AAaynayni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Have We not made for him two eyes?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Have We not given them two eyes,

ayahs.textArabic: وَلِسَانٗا وَشَفَتَيۡنِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walisanan washafatayni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And a tongue and two lips?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: a tongue, and two lips;

ayahs.textArabic: وَهَدَيۡنَٰهُ ٱلنَّجۡدَيۡنِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wahadaynahu alnnajdayni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And have shown him the two ways?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and shown them the two ways ˹of right and wrong˺?

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَا ٱقۡتَحَمَ ٱلۡعَقَبَةَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fala iqtahama alAAaqabata
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But he has not broken through the difficult pass.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: If only they had attempted the challenging path ˹of goodness instead˺!

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلۡعَقَبَةُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama adraka ma alAAaqabatu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And what can make you know what is [breaking through] the difficult pass?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And what will make you realize what ˹attempting˺ the challenging path is?

ayahs.textArabic: فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fakku raqabatin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: It is the freeing of a slave
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: It is to free a slave;

ayahs.textArabic: أَوۡ إِطۡعَٰمٞ فِي يَوۡمٖ ذِي مَسۡغَبَةٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Aw itAAamun fee yawmin thee masghabatin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Or feeding on a day of severe hunger
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: or to give food in times of famine

ayahs.textArabic: يَتِيمٗا ذَا مَقۡرَبَةٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yateeman tha maqrabatin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: An orphan of near relationship
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: to an orphaned relative

ayahs.textArabic: أَوۡ مِسۡكِينٗا ذَا مَتۡرَبَةٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Aw miskeenan tha matrabatin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Or a needy person in misery
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: or to a poor person in distress;

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلصَّبۡرِ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلۡمَرۡحَمَةِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thumma kana mina allatheena amanoo watawasaw bialssabri watawasaw bialmarhamati
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And then being among those who believed and advised one another to patience and advised one another to compassion.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and—above all—to be one of those who have faith and urge each other to perseverance and urge each other to compassion.

ayahs.textArabic: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَيۡمَنَةِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Olaika ashabu almaymanati
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Those are the companions of the right.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: These are the people of the right.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا هُمۡ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَشۡـَٔمَةِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waallatheena kafaroo biayatina hum ashabu almashamati
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But they who disbelieved in Our signs - those are the companions of the left.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: As for those who deny Our signs, they are the people of the left.

ayahs.textArabic: عَلَيۡهِمۡ نَارٞ مُّؤۡصَدَةُۢ
ayahs.textTransliteration: AAalayhim narun musadatun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Over them will be fire closed in.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The Fire will be sealed over them.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلشَّمۡسِ وَضُحَىٰهَا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalshshamsi waduhaha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: By the sun and its brightness
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: By the sun and its brightness,

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلۡقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَىٰهَا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalqamari itha talaha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [by] the moon when it follows it
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and the moon as it follows it,

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّىٰهَا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalnnahari itha jallaha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [by] the day when it displays it
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and the day as it unveils it,

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلَّيۡلِ إِذَا يَغۡشَىٰهَا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waallayli itha yaghshaha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [by] the night when it covers it
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and the night as it conceals it!

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا بَنَىٰهَا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalssamai wama banaha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [by] the sky and He who constructed it
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And by heaven and ˹the One˺ Who built it,

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا طَحَىٰهَا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalardi wama tahaha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [by] the earth and He who spread it
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and the earth and ˹the One˺ Who spread it!

ayahs.textArabic: وَنَفۡسٖ وَمَا سَوَّىٰهَا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wanafsin wama sawwaha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [by] the soul and He who proportioned it
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And by the soul and ˹the One˺ Who fashioned it,

ayahs.textArabic: فَأَلۡهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقۡوَىٰهَا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faalhamaha fujooraha wataqwaha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: then with ˹the knowledge of˺ right and wrong inspired it!

ayahs.textArabic: قَدۡ أَفۡلَحَ مَن زَكَّىٰهَا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qad aflaha man zakkaha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He has succeeded who purifies it,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Successful indeed is the one who purifies their soul,

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَدۡ خَابَ مَن دَسَّىٰهَا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waqad khaba man dassaha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And he has failed who instills it [with corruption].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and doomed is the one who corrupts it!

ayahs.textArabic: كَذَّبَتۡ ثَمُودُ بِطَغۡوَىٰهَآ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kaththabat thamoodu bitaghwaha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Thamud denied [their prophet] by reason of their transgression,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Thamûd rejected ˹the truth˺ out of arrogance,

ayahs.textArabic: إِذِ ٱنۢبَعَثَ أَشۡقَىٰهَا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ithi inbaAAatha ashqaha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: When the most wretched of them was sent forth.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: when the most wicked of them was roused ˹to kill the she-camel˺.

ayahs.textArabic: فَقَالَ لَهُمۡ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقۡيَٰهَا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faqala lahum rasoolu Allahi naqata Allahi wasuqyaha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the messenger of Allah [Salih] said to them, "[Do not harm] the she-camel of Allah or [prevent her from] her drink."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But the messenger of Allah warned them, “˹Do not disturb˺ Allah’s camel and her ˹turn to˺ drink!”

ayahs.textArabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمۡدَمَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمۡ فَسَوَّىٰهَا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fakaththaboohu faAAaqarooha fadamdama AAalayhim rabbuhum bithanbihim fasawwaha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But they denied him and hamstrung her. So their Lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal [upon all of them].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Still they defied him and slaughtered her. So their Lord crushed them for their crime, levelling all to the ground.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقۡبَٰهَا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wala yakhafu AAuqbaha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And He does not fear the consequence thereof.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He has no fear of consequences.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلَّيۡلِ إِذَا يَغۡشَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waallayli itha yaghsha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: By the night when it covers
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: By the night when it covers,

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waalnnahari itha tajalla
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [by] the day when it appears
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and the day when it shines!

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا خَلَقَ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلۡأُنثَىٰٓ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama khalaqa alththakara waalontha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [by] He who created the male and female,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And by ˹the One˺ Who created male and female!

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ سَعۡيَكُمۡ لَشَتَّىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna saAAyakum lashatta
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, your efforts are diverse.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Surely the ends you strive for are diverse.

ayahs.textArabic: فَأَمَّا مَنۡ أَعۡطَىٰ وَٱتَّقَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faamma man aAAta waittaqa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: As for he who gives and fears Allah
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: As for the one who is charitable, mindful ˹of Allah˺,

ayahs.textArabic: وَصَدَّقَ بِٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wasaddaqa bialhusna
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And believes in the best [reward],
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and ˹firmly˺ believes in the finest reward,

ayahs.textArabic: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلۡيُسۡرَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fasanuyassiruhu lilyusra
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: We will ease him toward ease.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We will facilitate for them the Way of Ease.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَمَّا مَنۢ بَخِلَ وَٱسۡتَغۡنَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waamma man bakhila waistaghna
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But as for he who withholds and considers himself free of need
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And as for the one who is stingy, indifferent ˹to Allah˺,

ayahs.textArabic: وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wakaththaba bialhusna
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And denies the best [reward],
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and ˹staunchly˺ denies the finest reward,

ayahs.textArabic: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلۡعُسۡرَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fasanuyassiruhu lilAAusra
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: We will ease him toward difficulty.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We will facilitate for them the path of hardship.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا يُغۡنِي عَنۡهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama yughnee AAanhu maluhu itha taradda
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And what will his wealth avail him when he falls?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And their wealth will be of no benefit to them when they tumble ˹into Hell˺.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ عَلَيۡنَا لَلۡهُدَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna AAalayna lalhuda
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, [incumbent] upon Us is guidance.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: It is certainly upon Us ˹alone˺ to show ˹the way to˺ guidance.

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلۡأٓخِرَةَ وَٱلۡأُولَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wainna lana lalakhirata waaloola
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And indeed, to Us belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And surely to Us ˹alone˺ belong this life and the next.

ayahs.textArabic: فَأَنذَرۡتُكُمۡ نَارٗا تَلَظَّىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faanthartukum naran talaththa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So I have warned you of a Fire which is blazing.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And so I have warned you of a raging Fire,

ayahs.textArabic: لَا يَصۡلَىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلۡأَشۡقَى
ayahs.textTransliteration: La yaslaha illa alashqa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: None will [enter to] burn therein except the most wretched one.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: in which none will burn except the most wretched—

ayahs.textArabic: ٱلَّذِي كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Allathee kaththaba watawalla
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Who had denied and turned away.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: who deny and turn away.

ayahs.textArabic: وَسَيُجَنَّبُهَا ٱلۡأَتۡقَى
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wasayujannabuha alatqa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But the righteous one will avoid it -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But the righteous will be spared from it—

ayahs.textArabic: ٱلَّذِي يُؤۡتِي مَالَهُۥ يَتَزَكَّىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Allathee yutee malahu yatazakka
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [He] who gives [from] his wealth to purify himself
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: who donate ˹some of˺ their wealth only to purify themselves,

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعۡمَةٖ تُجۡزَىٰٓ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama liahadin AAindahu min niAAmatin tujza
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And not [giving] for anyone who has [done him] a favor to be rewarded
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: not in return for someone’s favours,

ayahs.textArabic: إِلَّا ٱبۡتِغَآءَ وَجۡهِ رَبِّهِ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Illa ibtighaa wajhi rabbihi alaAAla
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But only seeking the countenance of his Lord, Most High.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: but seeking the pleasure of their Lord, the Most High.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَسَوۡفَ يَرۡضَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walasawfa yarda
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And he is going to be satisfied.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: They will certainly be pleased.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلضُّحَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waaldduha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: By the morning brightness
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: By the morning sunlight,

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلَّيۡلِ إِذَا سَجَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waallayli itha saja
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [by] the night when it covers with darkness,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and the night when it falls still!

ayahs.textArabic: مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ma waddaAAaka rabbuka wama qala
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muhammad], nor has He detested [you].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Your Lord ˹O Prophet˺ has not abandoned you, nor has He become hateful ˹of you˺.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَلۡأٓخِرَةُ خَيۡرٞ لَّكَ مِنَ ٱلۡأُولَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walalakhiratu khayrun laka mina aloola
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And the next life is certainly far better for you than this one.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَسَوۡفَ يُعۡطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرۡضَىٰٓ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walasawfa yuAAteeka rabbuka fatarda
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.
