ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And ˹surely˺ your Lord will give so much to you that you will be pleased.

ayahs.textArabic: أَلَمۡ يَجِدۡكَ يَتِيمٗا فَـَٔاوَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Alam yajidka yateeman faawa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Did He not find you as an orphan then shelter you?

ayahs.textArabic: وَوَجَدَكَ ضَآلّٗا فَهَدَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wawajadaka dallan fahada
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And He found you lost and guided [you],
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Did He not find you unguided then guide you?

ayahs.textArabic: وَوَجَدَكَ عَآئِلٗا فَأَغۡنَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wawajadaka AAailan faaghna
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And He found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And did He not find you needy then satisfy your needs?

ayahs.textArabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلۡيَتِيمَ فَلَا تَقۡهَرۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faamma alyateema fala taqhar
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So as for the orphan, do not oppress [him].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So do not oppress the orphan,

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلسَّآئِلَ فَلَا تَنۡهَرۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waamma alssaila fala tanhar
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And as for the petitioner, do not repel [him].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: nor repulse the beggar.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَمَّا بِنِعۡمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waamma biniAAmati rabbika fahaddith
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And proclaim the blessings of your Lord.

ayahs.textArabic: أَلَمۡ نَشۡرَحۡ لَكَ صَدۡرَكَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Alam nashrah laka sadraka
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Did We not expand for you, [O Muhammad], your breast?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Have We not uplifted your heart for you ˹O Prophet˺,

ayahs.textArabic: وَوَضَعۡنَا عَنكَ وِزۡرَكَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: WawadaAAna AAanka wizraka
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And We removed from you your burden
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: relieved you of the burden

ayahs.textArabic: ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنقَضَ ظَهۡرَكَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Allathee anqada thahraka
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Which had weighed upon your back
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: which weighed so heavily on your back,

ayahs.textArabic: وَرَفَعۡنَا لَكَ ذِكۡرَكَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: WarafaAAna laka thikraka
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And raised high for you your repute.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and elevated your renown for you?

ayahs.textArabic: فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلۡعُسۡرِ يُسۡرًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fainna maAAa alAAusri yusran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So, surely with hardship comes ease.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ مَعَ ٱلۡعُسۡرِ يُسۡرٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna maAAa alAAusri yusran
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Surely with ˹that˺ hardship comes ˹more˺ ease.

ayahs.textArabic: فَإِذَا فَرَغۡتَ فَٱنصَبۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faitha faraghta fainsab
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So when you have finished [your duties], then stand up [for worship].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So once you have fulfilled ˹your duty˺, strive ˹in devotion˺,

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَٱرۡغَب
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waila rabbika fairghab
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And to your Lord direct [your] longing.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: turning to your Lord ˹alone˺ with hope.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلتِّينِ وَٱلزَّيۡتُونِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waaltteeni waalzzaytooni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: By the fig and the olive
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: By the fig and the olive ˹of Jerusalem˺,

ayahs.textArabic: وَطُورِ سِينِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Watoori seeneena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [by] Mount Sinai
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and Mount Sinai,

ayahs.textArabic: وَهَٰذَا ٱلۡبَلَدِ ٱلۡأَمِينِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wahatha albaladi alameeni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And [by] this secure city [Mecca],
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and this secure city ˹of Mecca˺!

ayahs.textArabic: لَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ فِيٓ أَحۡسَنِ تَقۡوِيمٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Laqad khalaqna alinsana fee ahsani taqweemin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: We have certainly created man in the best of stature;
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, We created humans in the best form.

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ رَدَدۡنَٰهُ أَسۡفَلَ سَٰفِلِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thumma radadnahu asfala safileena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then We return him to the lowest of the low,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But We will reduce them to the lowest of the low ˹in Hell˺,

ayahs.textArabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمۡ أَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُونٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Illa allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati falahum ajrun ghayru mamnoonin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for they will have a reward uninterrupted.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: except those who believe and do good—they will have a never-ending reward.

ayahs.textArabic: فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ بَعۡدُ بِٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fama yukaththibuka baAAdu bialddeeni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So what yet causes you to deny the Recompense?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Now, what makes you deny the ˹final˺ Judgment?

ayahs.textArabic: أَلَيۡسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَحۡكَمِ ٱلۡحَٰكِمِينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Alaysa Allahu biahkami alhakimeena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Is not Allah the most just of judges?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Is Allah not the most just of all judges?

ayahs.textArabic: ٱقۡرَأۡ بِٱسۡمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Iqra biismi rabbika allathee khalaqa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Recite in the name of your Lord who created -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Read, ˹O Prophet,˺ in the Name of your Lord Who created—

ayahs.textArabic: خَلَقَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِنۡ عَلَقٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Khalaqa alinsana min AAalaqin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Created man from a clinging substance.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: created humans from a clinging clot.

ayahs.textArabic: ٱقۡرَأۡ وَرَبُّكَ ٱلۡأَكۡرَمُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Iqra warabbuka alakramu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Recite, and your Lord is the most Generous -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Read! And your Lord is the Most Generous,

ayahs.textArabic: ٱلَّذِي عَلَّمَ بِٱلۡقَلَمِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Allathee AAallama bialqalami
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Who taught by the pen -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Who taught by the pen—

ayahs.textArabic: عَلَّمَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مَا لَمۡ يَعۡلَمۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: AAallama alinsana ma lam yaAAlam
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Taught man that which he knew not.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: taught humanity what they knew not.

ayahs.textArabic: كـَلَّآ إِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ لَيَطۡغَىٰٓ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kalla inna alinsana layatgha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: No! [But] indeed, man transgresses
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Most certainly, one exceeds all bounds

ayahs.textArabic: أَن رَّءَاهُ ٱسۡتَغۡنَىٰٓ
ayahs.textTransliteration: An raahu istaghna
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Because he sees himself self-sufficient.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: once they think they are self-sufficient.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلرُّجۡعَىٰٓ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna ila rabbika alrrujAAa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, to your Lord is the return.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹But˺ surely to your Lord is the return ˹of all˺.

ayahs.textArabic: أَرَءَيۡتَ ٱلَّذِي يَنۡهَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Araayta allathee yanha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Have you seen the one who forbids
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Have you seen the man who prevents

ayahs.textArabic: عَبۡدًا إِذَا صَلَّىٰٓ
ayahs.textTransliteration: AAabdan itha salla
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: A servant when he prays?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: a servant ˹of Ours˺ from praying?

ayahs.textArabic: أَرَءَيۡتَ إِن كَانَ عَلَى ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Araayta in kana AAala alhuda
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Have you seen if he is upon guidance
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: What if this ˹servant˺ is ˹rightly˺ guided,

ayahs.textArabic: أَوۡ أَمَرَ بِٱلتَّقۡوَىٰٓ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Aw amara bialttaqwa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Or enjoins righteousness?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: or encourages righteousness?

ayahs.textArabic: أَرَءَيۡتَ إِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Araayta in kaththaba watawalla
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Have you seen if he denies and turns away -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: What if that ˹man˺ persists in denial and turns away?

ayahs.textArabic: أَلَمۡ يَعۡلَم بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرَىٰ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Alam yaAAlam bianna Allaha yara
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Does he not know that Allah sees?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Does he not know that Allah sees ˹all˺?

ayahs.textArabic: كـَلَّا لَئِن لَّمۡ يَنتَهِ لَنَسۡفَعَۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kalla lain lam yantahi lanasfaAAan bialnnasiyati
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: No! If he does not desist, We will surely drag him by the forelock -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But no! If he does not desist, We will certainly drag him by the forelock—

ayahs.textArabic: نَاصِيَةٖ كَٰذِبَةٍ خَاطِئَةٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Nasiyatin kathibatin khatiatin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: A lying, sinning forelock.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: a lying, sinful forelock.

ayahs.textArabic: فَلۡيَدۡعُ نَادِيَهُۥ
ayahs.textTransliteration: FalyadAAu nadiyahu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then let him call his associates;
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So let him call his associates.

ayahs.textArabic: سَنَدۡعُ ٱلزَّبَانِيَةَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: SanadAAu alzzabaniyata
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: We will call the angels of Hell.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: We will call the wardens of Hell.

ayahs.textArabic: كـَلَّا لَا تُطِعۡهُ وَٱسۡجُدۡۤ وَٱقۡتَرِب۩
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kalla la tutiAAhu waosjud waiqtarib
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: No! Do not obey him. But prostrate and draw near [to Allah].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Again, no! Never obey him ˹O Prophet˺! Rather, ˹continue to˺ prostrate and draw near ˹to Allah˺.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّآ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ فِي لَيۡلَةِ ٱلۡقَدۡرِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna anzalnahu fee laylati alqadri
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, We sent the Qur'an down during the Night of Decree.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, ˹It is˺ We ˹Who˺ sent this ˹Quran˺ down on the Night of Glory.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا لَيۡلَةُ ٱلۡقَدۡرِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama adraka ma laylatu alqadri
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And what will make you realize what the Night of Glory is?

ayahs.textArabic: لَيۡلَةُ ٱلۡقَدۡرِ خَيۡرٞ مِّنۡ أَلۡفِ شَهۡرٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Laylatu alqadri khayrun min alfi shahrin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The Night of Glory is better than a thousand months.

ayahs.textArabic: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذۡنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمۡرٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Tanazzalu almalaikatu waalrroohu feeha biithni rabbihim min kulli amrin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The angels and the Spirit descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: That night the angels and the ˹holy˺ spirit descend, by the permission of their Lord, for every ˹decreed˺ matter.

ayahs.textArabic: سَلَٰمٌ هِيَ حَتَّىٰ مَطۡلَعِ ٱلۡفَجۡرِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Salamun hiya hatta matlaAAi alfajri
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Peace it is until the emergence of dawn.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: It is all peace until the break of dawn.

ayahs.textArabic: لَمۡ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنۡ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأۡتِيَهُمُ ٱلۡبَيِّنَةُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Lam yakuni allatheena kafaroo min ahli alkitabi waalmushrikeena munfakkeena hatta tatiyahumu albayyinatu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Those who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists were not to be parted [from misbelief] until there came to them clear evidence -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The disbelievers from the People of the Book and the polytheists were not going to desist ˹from disbelief˺ until the clear proof came to them:

ayahs.textArabic: رَسُولٞ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ يَتۡلُواْ صُحُفٗا مُّطَهَّرَةٗ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Rasoolun mina Allahi yatloo suhufan mutahharatan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: A Messenger from Allah, reciting purified scriptures
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: a messenger from Allah, reciting scrolls of ˹utmost˺ purity,

ayahs.textArabic: فِيهَا كُتُبٞ قَيِّمَةٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Feeha kutubun qayyimatun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Within which are correct writings.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: containing upright commandments.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا جَآءَتۡهُمُ ٱلۡبَيِّنَةُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama tafarraqa allatheena ootoo alkitaba illa min baAAdi ma jaathumu albayyinatu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Nor did those who were given the Scripture become divided until after there had come to them clear evidence.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: It was not until this clear proof came to the People of the Book that they became divided ˹about his prophethood˺—

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓاْ إِلَّا لِيَعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤۡتُواْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَۚ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ ٱلۡقَيِّمَةِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama omiroo illa liyaAAbudoo Allaha mukhliseena lahu alddeena hunafaa wayuqeemoo alssalata wayutoo alzzakata wathalika deenu alqayyimati
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And they were not commanded except to worship Allah, [being] sincere to Him in religion, inclining to truth, and to establish prayer and to give zakah. And that is the correct religion.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: even though they were only commanded to worship Allah ˹alone˺ with sincere devotion to Him in all uprightness, establish prayer, and pay alms-tax. That is the upright Way.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنۡ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ فِي نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمۡ شَرُّ ٱلۡبَرِيَّةِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna allatheena kafaroo min ahli alkitabi waalmushrikeena fee nari jahannama khalideena feeha olaika hum sharru albariyyati
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, they who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists will be in the fire of Hell, abiding eternally therein. Those are the worst of creatures.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, those who disbelieve from the People of the Book and the polytheists will be in the Fire of Hell, to stay there forever. They are the worst of ˹all˺ beings.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمۡ خَيۡرُ ٱلۡبَرِيَّةِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati olaika hum khayru albariyyati
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, they who have believed and done righteous deeds - those are the best of creatures.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, those who believe and do good—they are the best of ˹all˺ beings.

ayahs.textArabic: جَزَآؤُهُمۡ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ جَنَّٰتُ عَدۡنٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدٗاۖ رَّضِيَ ٱللَّهُ عَنۡهُمۡ وَرَضُواْ عَنۡهُۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنۡ خَشِيَ رَبَّهُۥ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Jazaohum AAinda rabbihim jannatu AAadnin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha abadan radiya Allahu AAanhum waradoo AAanhu thalika liman khashiya rabbahu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Their reward with Allah will be gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever, Allah being pleased with them and they with Him. That is for whoever has feared his Lord.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Their reward with their Lord will be Gardens of Eternity, under which rivers flow, to stay there for ever and ever. Allah is pleased with them and they are pleased with Him. This is ˹only˺ for those in awe of their Lord.

ayahs.textArabic: إِذَا زُلۡزِلَتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ زِلۡزَالَهَا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Itha zulzilati alardu zilzalaha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: When the earth is shaken with its [final] earthquake
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: When the earth is shaken ˹in˺ its ultimate quaking,

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَخۡرَجَتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ أَثۡقَالَهَا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waakhrajati alardu athqalaha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the earth discharges its burdens
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and when the earth throws out ˹all˺ its contents,

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مَا لَهَا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waqala alinsanu ma laha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And man says, "What is [wrong] with it?" -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and humanity cries, “What is wrong with it?”—

ayahs.textArabic: يَوۡمَئِذٖ تُحَدِّثُ أَخۡبَارَهَا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yawmaithin tuhaddithu akhbaraha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: That Day, it will report its news
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: on that Day the earth will recount everything,

ayahs.textArabic: بِأَنَّ رَبَّكَ أَوۡحَىٰ لَهَا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Bianna rabbaka awha laha
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Because your Lord has commanded it.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: having been inspired by your Lord ˹to do so˺.

ayahs.textArabic: يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَصۡدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشۡتَاتٗا لِّيُرَوۡاْ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yawmaithin yasduru alnnasu ashtatan liyuraw aAAmalahum
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: That Day, the people will depart separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: On that Day people will proceed in separate groups to be shown ˹the consequences of˺ their deeds.

ayahs.textArabic: فَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيۡرٗا يَرَهُۥ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faman yaAAmal mithqala tharratin khayran yarahu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So whoever does an atom’s weight of good will see it.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٖ شَرّٗا يَرَهُۥ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waman yaAAmal mithqala tharratin sharran yarahu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And whoever does an atom’s weight of evil will see it.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلۡعَٰدِيَٰتِ ضَبۡحٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: WaalAAadiyati dabhan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: By the racers, panting,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ’ By the galloping, panting horses,

ayahs.textArabic: فَٱلۡمُورِيَٰتِ قَدۡحٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faalmooriyati qadhan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the producers of sparks [when] striking
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: striking sparks of fire ˹with their hoofs˺,

ayahs.textArabic: فَٱلۡمُغِيرَٰتِ صُبۡحٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faalmugheerati subhan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the chargers at dawn,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: launching raids at dawn,

ayahs.textArabic: فَأَثَرۡنَ بِهِۦ نَقۡعٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faatharna bihi naqAAan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Stirring up thereby [clouds of] dust,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: stirring up ˹clouds of˺ dust,

ayahs.textArabic: فَوَسَطۡنَ بِهِۦ جَمۡعًا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fawasatna bihi jamAAan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Arriving thereby in the center collectively,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and penetrating into the heart of enemy lines!

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ لِرَبِّهِۦ لَكَنُودٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna alinsana lirabbihi lakanoodun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed mankind, to his Lord, is ungrateful.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Surely humankind is ungrateful to their Lord—

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ لَشَهِيدٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wainnahu AAala thalika lashaheedun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And indeed, he is to that a witness.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and they certainly attest to this—

ayahs.textArabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لِحُبِّ ٱلۡخَيۡرِ لَشَدِيدٌ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wainnahu lihubbi alkhayri lashadeedun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And indeed he is, in love of wealth, intense.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and they are truly extreme in their love of ˹worldly˺ gains.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ أَفَلَا يَعۡلَمُ إِذَا بُعۡثِرَ مَا فِي ٱلۡقُبُورِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Afala yaAAlamu itha buAAthira ma fee alquboori
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But does he not know that when the contents of the graves are scattered
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Do they not know that when the contents of the graves will be spilled out,

ayahs.textArabic: وَحُصِّلَ مَا فِي ٱلصُّدُورِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wahussila ma fee alssudoori
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And that within the breasts is obtained,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and the secrets of the hearts will be laid bare—

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ رَبَّهُم بِهِمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لَّخَبِيرُۢ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna rabbahum bihim yawmaithin lakhabeerun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, their Lord with them, that Day, is [fully] Acquainted.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: surely their Lord is All-Aware of them on that Day.

ayahs.textArabic: ٱلۡقَارِعَةُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: AlqariAAatu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The Striking Calamity -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: The Striking Disaster!

ayahs.textArabic: مَا ٱلۡقَارِعَةُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ma alqariAAatu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: What is the Striking Calamity?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: What is the Striking Disaster?

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلۡقَارِعَةُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama adraka ma alqariAAatu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And what can make you know what is the Striking Calamity?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And what will make you realize what the Striking Disaster is?

ayahs.textArabic: يَوۡمَ يَكُونُ ٱلنَّاسُ كَٱلۡفَرَاشِ ٱلۡمَبۡثُوثِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yawma yakoonu alnnasu kaalfarashi almabthoothi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: It is the Day when people will be like moths, dispersed,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹It is˺ the Day people will be like scattered moths,

ayahs.textArabic: وَتَكُونُ ٱلۡجِبَالُ كَٱلۡعِهۡنِ ٱلۡمَنفُوشِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Watakoonu aljibalu kaalAAihni almanfooshi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And the mountains will be like wool, fluffed up.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and the mountains will be like carded wool.

ayahs.textArabic: فَأَمَّا مَن ثَقُلَتۡ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faamma man thaqulat mawazeenuhu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then as for one whose scales are heavy [with good deeds],
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So as for those whose scale is heavy ˹with good deeds˺,

ayahs.textArabic: فَهُوَ فِي عِيشَةٖ رَّاضِيَةٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fahuwa fee AAeeshatin radiyatin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He will be in a pleasant life.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: they will be in a life of bliss.

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ خَفَّتۡ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waamma man khaffat mawazeenuhu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: But as for one whose scales are light,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And as for those whose scale is light,

ayahs.textArabic: فَأُمُّهُۥ هَاوِيَةٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Faommuhu hawiyatun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: His refuge will be an abyss.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: their home will be the abyss.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا هِيَهۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama adraka ma hiyah
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And what can make you know what that is?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And what will make you realize what that is?

ayahs.textArabic: نَارٌ حَامِيَةُۢ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Narun hamiyatun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: It is a Fire, intensely hot.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹It is˺ a scorching Fire.

ayahs.textArabic: أَلۡهَىٰكُمُ ٱلتَّكَاثُرُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Alhakumu alttakathuru
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Competition in [worldly] increase diverts you
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Competition for more ˹gains˺ diverts you ˹from Allah˺,

ayahs.textArabic: حَتَّىٰ زُرۡتُمُ ٱلۡمَقَابِرَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Hatta zurtumu almaqabira
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Until you visit the graveyards.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: until you end up in ˹your˺ graves.

ayahs.textArabic: كـَلَّا سَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kalla sawfa taAAlamoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: No! You are going to know.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: But no! You will soon come to know.

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ كـَلَّا سَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thumma kalla sawfa taAAlamoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then no! You are going to know.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Again, no! You will soon come to know.

ayahs.textArabic: كـَلَّا لَوۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ عِلۡمَ ٱلۡيَقِينِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kalla law taAAlamoona AAilma alyaqeeni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: No! If you only knew with knowledge of certainty...
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, if you were to know ˹your fate˺ with certainty, ˹you would have acted differently˺.

ayahs.textArabic: لَتَرَوُنَّ ٱلۡجَحِيمَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Latarawunna aljaheema
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: You will surely see the Hellfire.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹But˺ you will surely see the Hellfire.

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ لَتَرَوُنَّهَا عَيۡنَ ٱلۡيَقِينِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thumma latarawunnaha AAayna alyaqeeni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then you will surely see it with the eye of certainty.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Again, you will surely see it with the eye of certainty.

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ لَتُسۡـَٔلُنَّ يَوۡمَئِذٍ عَنِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Thumma latusalunna yawmaithin AAani alnnaAAeemi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then you will surely be asked that Day about pleasure.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Then, on that Day, you will definitely be questioned about ˹your worldly˺ pleasures.

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱلۡعَصۡرِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: WaalAAasri
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: By time,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: By the ˹passage of˺ time!

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ لَفِي خُسۡرٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna alinsana lafee khusrin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, mankind is in loss,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Surely humanity is in ˹grave˺ loss,

ayahs.textArabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلصَّبۡرِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Illa allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati watawasaw bialhaqqi watawasaw bialssabri
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: except those who have faith, do good, and urge each other to the truth, and urge each other to perseverance.

ayahs.textArabic: وَيۡلٞ لِّكُلِّ هُمَزَةٖ لُّمَزَةٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waylun likulli humazatin lumazatin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Woe to every scorner and mocker
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Woe to every backbiter, slanderer,

ayahs.textArabic: ٱلَّذِي جَمَعَ مَالٗا وَعَدَّدَهُۥ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Allathee jamaAAa malan waAAaddadahu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Who collects wealth and [continuously] counts it.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: who amasses wealth ˹greedily˺ and counts it ˹repeatedly˺,

ayahs.textArabic: يَحۡسَبُ أَنَّ مَالَهُۥٓ أَخۡلَدَهُۥ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Yahsabu anna malahu akhladahu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He thinks that his wealth will make him immortal.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: thinking that their wealth will make them immortal!

ayahs.textArabic: كـَلَّاۖ لَيُنۢبَذَنَّ فِي ٱلۡحُطَمَةِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Kalla layunbathanna fee alhutamati
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: No! He will surely be thrown into the Crusher.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Not at all! Such a person will certainly be tossed into the Crusher.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلۡحُطَمَةُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wama adraka ma alhutamatu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And what can make you know what is the Crusher?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And what will make you realize what the Crusher is?

ayahs.textArabic: نَارُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمُوقَدَةُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Naru Allahi almooqadatu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: It is the fire of Allah, [eternally] fueled,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹It is˺ Allah’s kindled Fire,

ayahs.textArabic: ٱلَّتِي تَطَّلِعُ عَلَى ٱلۡأَفۡـِٔدَةِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Allatee tattaliAAu AAala alafidati
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Which mounts directed at the hearts.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: which rages over the hearts.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّهَا عَلَيۡهِم مُّؤۡصَدَةٞ
ayahs.textTransliteration: lnnaha AAalayhim musadatun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, Hellfire will be closed down upon them
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: It will be sealed over them,

ayahs.textArabic: فِي عَمَدٖ مُّمَدَّدَةِۭ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fee AAamadin mumaddadatin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: In extended columns.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹tightly secured˺ with long braces.

ayahs.textArabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ كَيۡفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلۡفِيلِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Alam tara kayfa faAAala rabbuka biashabi alfeeli
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Have you not considered, [O Muhammad], how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Have you not seen ˹O Prophet˺ how your Lord dealt with the Army of the Elephant?

ayahs.textArabic: أَلَمۡ يَجۡعَلۡ كَيۡدَهُمۡ فِي تَضۡلِيلٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Alam yajAAal kaydahum fee tadleelin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Did He not make their plan into misguidance?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Did He not frustrate their scheme?

ayahs.textArabic: وَأَرۡسَلَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ طَيۡرًا أَبَابِيلَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waarsala AAalayhim tayran ababeela
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And He sent against them birds in flocks,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: For He sent against them flocks of birds,

ayahs.textArabic: تَرۡمِيهِم بِحِجَارَةٖ مِّن سِجِّيلٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Tarmeehim bihijaratin min sijjeelin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Striking them with stones of hard clay,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: that pelted them with stones of baked clay,

ayahs.textArabic: فَجَعَلَهُمۡ كَعَصۡفٖ مَّأۡكُولِۭ
ayahs.textTransliteration: FajaAAalahum kaAAasfin makoolin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And He made them like eaten straw.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: leaving them like chewed up straw.

ayahs.textArabic: لِإِيلَٰفِ قُرَيۡشٍ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Lieelafi qurayshin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: For the accustomed security of the Quraysh -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: ˹At least˺ for ˹the favour of˺ making Quraysh habitually secure—

ayahs.textArabic: إِۦلَٰفِهِمۡ رِحۡلَةَ ٱلشِّتَآءِ وَٱلصَّيۡفِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Eelafihim rihlata alshshitai waalssayfi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Their accustomed security [in] the caravan of winter and summer -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: secure in their trading caravan ˹to Yemen˺ in the winter and ˹Syria˺ in the summer—

ayahs.textArabic: فَلۡيَعۡبُدُواْ رَبَّ هَٰذَا ٱلۡبَيۡتِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: FalyaAAbudoo rabba hatha albayti
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Let them worship the Lord of this House,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: let them worship the Lord of this ˹Sacred˺ House,

ayahs.textArabic: ٱلَّذِيٓ أَطۡعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٖ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنۡ خَوۡفِۭ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Allathee atAAamahum min jooAAin waamanahum min khawfin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Who has fed them, [saving them] from hunger and made them safe, [saving them] from fear.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Who has fed them against hunger and made them secure against fear.

revelationExceptions: Only 1-3 from Makkah; the rest from Madinah

ayahs.textArabic: أَرَءَيۡتَ ٱلَّذِي يُكَذِّبُ بِٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Araayta allathee yukaththibu bialddeeni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense?
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Have you seen the one who denies the ˹final˺ Judgment?

ayahs.textArabic: فَذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِي يَدُعُّ ٱلۡيَتِيمَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fathalika allathee yaduAAAAu alyateema
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: For that is the one who drives away the orphan
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: That is the one who repulses the orphan,

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلۡمِسۡكِينِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wala yahuddu AAala taAAami almiskeeni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And does not encourage the feeding of the poor.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and does not encourage the feeding of the poor.

ayahs.textArabic: فَوَيۡلٞ لِّلۡمُصَلِّينَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fawaylun lilmusalleena
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So woe to those who pray
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So woe to those ˹hypocrites˺ who pray

ayahs.textArabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ عَن صَلَاتِهِمۡ سَاهُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Allatheena hum AAan salatihim sahoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: [But] who are heedless of their prayer -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: yet are unmindful of their prayers;

ayahs.textArabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ يُرَآءُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Allatheena hum yuraoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Those who make show [of their deeds]
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: those who ˹only˺ show off,

ayahs.textArabic: وَيَمۡنَعُونَ ٱلۡمَاعُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: WayamnaAAoona almaAAoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And withhold [simple] assistance.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and refuse to give ˹even the simplest˺ aid.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّآ أَعۡطَيۡنَٰكَ ٱلۡكَوۡثَرَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna aAAtaynaka alkawthara
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muhammad], al-Kawthar.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Indeed, We have granted you ˹O Prophet˺ abundant goodness.

ayahs.textArabic: فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَٱنۡحَرۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fasalli lirabbika wainhar
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: So pray to your Lord and sacrifice [to Him alone].
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: So pray and sacrifice to your Lord ˹alone˺.

ayahs.textArabic: إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ ٱلۡأَبۡتَرُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Inna shaniaka huwa alabtaru
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Only the one who hates you is truly cut off ˹from any goodness˺.

ayahs.textArabic: قُلۡ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qul ya ayyuha alkafiroona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Say, "O disbelievers,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “O you disbelievers!

ayahs.textArabic: لَآ أَعۡبُدُ مَا تَعۡبُدُونَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: La aAAbudu ma taAAbudoona
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: I do not worship what you worship.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: I do not worship what you worship,

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَآ أَنتُمۡ عَٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعۡبُدُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wala antum AAabidoona ma aAAbudu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Nor are you worshippers of what I worship.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: nor do you worship what I worship.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَآ أَنَا۠ عَابِدٞ مَّا عَبَدتُّمۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wala ana AAabidun ma AAabadtum
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Nor will I be a worshipper of what you worship.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: I will never worship what you worship,

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَآ أَنتُمۡ عَٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعۡبُدُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wala antum AAabidoona ma aAAbudu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Nor will you be worshippers of what I worship.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: nor will you ever worship what I worship.

ayahs.textArabic: لَكُمۡ دِينُكُمۡ وَلِيَ دِينِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Lakum deenukum waliya deeni
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: For you is your religion, and for me is my religion."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: You have your way, and I have my Way.”

revelationExceptions: Revealed at Mina on Last Hajj, but regarded as Madinan sura

ayahs.textArabic: إِذَا جَآءَ نَصۡرُ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلۡفَتۡحُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Itha jaa nasru Allahi waalfathu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: When the victory of Allah has come and the conquest,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: When Allah’s ˹ultimate˺ help comes and the victory ˹over Mecca is achieved˺,

ayahs.textArabic: وَرَأَيۡتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدۡخُلُونَ فِي دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفۡوَاجٗا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waraayta alnnasa yadkhuloona fee deeni Allahi afwajan
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And you see the people entering into the religion of Allah in multitudes,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and you ˹O Prophet˺ see the people embracing Allah’s Way in crowds,

ayahs.textArabic: فَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرۡهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابَۢا
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fasabbih bihamdi rabbika waistaghfirhu innahu kana tawwaban
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Then exalt [Him] with praise of your Lord and ask forgiveness of Him. Indeed, He is ever Accepting of repentance.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: then glorify the praises of your Lord and seek His forgiveness, for certainly He is ever Accepting of Repentance.

ayahs.textArabic: تَبَّتۡ يَدَآ أَبِي لَهَبٖ وَتَبَّ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Tabbat yada abee lahabin watabba
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: May the hands of Abu Lahab be ruined, and ruined is he.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: May the hands of Abu Lahab perish, and he ˹himself˺ perish!

ayahs.textArabic: مَآ أَغۡنَىٰ عَنۡهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ma aghna AAanhu maluhu wama kasaba
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Neither his wealth nor ˹worldly˺ gains will benefit him.

ayahs.textArabic: سَيَصۡلَىٰ نَارٗا ذَاتَ لَهَبٖ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Sayasla naran thata lahabin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He will [enter to] burn in a Fire of [blazing] flame
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He will burn in a flaming Fire,

ayahs.textArabic: وَٱمۡرَأَتُهُۥ حَمَّالَةَ ٱلۡحَطَبِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Waimraatuhu hammalata alhatabi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And his wife [as well] - the carrier of firewood.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and ˹so will˺ his wife, the carrier of ˹thorny˺ kindling,

ayahs.textArabic: فِي جِيدِهَا حَبۡلٞ مِّن مَّسَدِۭ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Fee jeediha hablun min masadin
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Around her neck is a rope of [twisted] fiber.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: around her neck will be a rope of palm-fibre.

ayahs.textArabic: قُلۡ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qul huwa Allahu ahadun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Say, "He is Allah, [who is] One,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “He is Allah—One ˹and Indivisible˺;

ayahs.textArabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Allahu alssamadu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Allah, the Eternal Refuge.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Allah—the Sustainer ˹needed by all˺.

ayahs.textArabic: لَمۡ يَلِدۡ وَلَمۡ يُولَدۡ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Lam yalid walam yooladu
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: He neither begets nor is born,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: He has never had offspring, nor was He born.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَمۡ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدُۢ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Walam yakun lahu kufuwan ahadun
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Nor is there to Him any equivalent."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: And there is none comparable to Him.”

ayahs.textArabic: قُلۡ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلۡفَلَقِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qul aAAoothu birabbi alfalaqi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak

ayahs.textArabic: مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Min sharri ma khalaqa
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: From the evil of that which He created
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: from the evil of whatever He has created,

ayahs.textArabic: وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wamin sharri ghasiqin itha waqaba
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And from the evil of darkness when it settles
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and from the evil of the night when it grows dark,

ayahs.textArabic: وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّٰثَٰتِ فِي ٱلۡعُقَدِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wamin sharri alnnaffathati fee alAAuqadi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And from the evil of the blowers in knots
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and from the evil of those ˹witches casting spells by˺ blowing onto knots,

ayahs.textArabic: وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Wamin sharri hasidin itha hasada
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: And from the evil of an envier when he envies."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: and from the evil of an envier when they envy.”

ayahs.textArabic: قُلۡ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Qul aAAoothu birabbi alnnasi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I seek refuge in the Lord of humankind,

ayahs.textArabic: مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Maliki alnnasi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The Sovereign of mankind.
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: the Master of humankind,

ayahs.textArabic: إِلَٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Ilahi alnnasi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: The God of mankind,
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: the God of humankind,

ayahs.textArabic: مِن شَرِّ ٱلۡوَسۡوَاسِ ٱلۡخَنَّاسِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Min sharri alwaswasi alkhannasi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: From the evil of the retreating whisperer -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: from the evil of the lurking whisperer—

ayahs.textArabic: ٱلَّذِي يُوَسۡوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Allathee yuwaswisu fee sudoori alnnasi
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind -
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: who whispers into the hearts of humankind—

ayahs.textArabic: مِنَ ٱلۡجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ
ayahs.textTransliteration: Mina aljinnati wa alnnas
ayahs.textEnglishSaheeh: From among the jinn and mankind."
ayahs.textEnglishMustafa: from among jinn and humankind.”
